At the same time, regression to the mean and self-report bias may lead pre-post comparisons to overstate crime reductions associated with SAT. Using 1992-1997 data from the National Treatment Improvement Evaluation Study (NTIES), we examined pre-post differences in self-reported robbery among clients in five residential and outpatient SAT modalities. Fixed-effect negative binomial regression was used to examine incidence rate reductions (IRR) in armed robbery. Published data on willingness to pay to avoid robbery were used to determine the social valuation of these effects. Differences in IRR across SAT modalities were explored to bound potential biases.All SAT modalities were associated with large and statistically significant reductions in robbery. The average number of self-reported robberies declined from 0.83/client/year pre-entry to 0.12/client/year following SAT (p<0.001). Under worst-case assumptions, monetized valuations of reductions in armed robbery associated with outpatient methadone and residential SAT exceeded economic costs of these interventions. Conventional wisdom posits the economic benefits of SAT. We find that SAT is even more beneficial than is commonly assumed.

10.1002/hec.1305.abstractZh: 减少犯罪是物质滥用治疗（SAT）的一个关键益处。武装抢劫是一种尤其昂贵且频繁发生的犯罪，一些涉及毒品的罪犯会实施这种行为。许多研究采用的价值评估方法低估了抢劫行为的实际成本，因此也低估了与SAT相关的抢劫行为减少所带来的社会效益。同时，回归均值效应和自我报告偏差可能导致前后对比结果夸大与SAT相关的犯罪减少情况。我们利用1992-1997年《国家治疗改进评估研究》的数据，研究了五种住院和门诊SAT模式下患者自我报告的抢劫行为的前后差异。采用固定效应负二项回归模型来研究武装抢劫的发生率减少情况。通过已发表的数据来评估人们为避免抢劫而愿意支付的费用，以此确定这些效应的社会价值。我们还探讨了不同SAT模式下的IRR差异，以排除潜在的偏差。所有SAT模式都带来了显著且统计学上显著的抢劫行为减少。自我报告的抢劫次数从入院前的0.83次/患者/年减少到SAT实施后的0.12次/患者/年（p<0.001）。在最坏的情况下，门诊美沙酮治疗和住院SAT所减少的武装抢劫行为的货币价值超过了这些干预措施的经济成本。传统观点认为SAT具有经济效益，但我们发现SAT的效益甚至超过了人们的普遍预期。

abstract.text: We report the results of a review of the Chinese- and English-language literatures on service delivery in China, asking how well China's health-care providers perform and what determines their performance. Although data and methodological limitations suggest caution in drawing conclusions, a critical reading of the available evidence suggests that current health service delivery in China leaves room for improvement, in terms of quality, responsiveness to patients, efficiency, cost escalation, and equity. The literature suggests that these problems will not be solved by simply shifting ownership to the private sector or by simply encouraging providers -- public and private -- to compete with one another for individual patients. By contrast, substantial improvements could be (and in some places have already been) made by changing the way providers are paid -- shifting away from fee-for-service and the distorted price schedule. Other elements of 'active purchasing' by insurers could further improve outcomes. Rigorous evaluations, based on richer micro-level data, could considerably strengthen the evidence base for service delivery policy in China.

10.1002/hec.1306.abstractZh: 我们对中国和英文文献中关于医疗服务提供情况的综述结果进行了分析，探讨了中国的医疗服务提供者表现如何，以及影响其表现的因素。尽管数据和方法上的局限性要求我们在得出结论时保持谨慎，但现有证据表明，中国的当前医疗服务提供在质量、对患者响应的程度、效率、成本上升和公平性方面仍有改进空间。文献指出，这些问题不能仅仅通过将所有权转移给私营部门或鼓励公共和私营医疗服务提供者相互竞争来解决。相反，通过改变支付方式——摆脱按服务收费制度以及扭曲的价格体系——可以取得显著改善。保险公司进行的“主动采购”等其他措施也可能进一步改善服务效果。基于更丰富的微观数据进行的严格评估，可以大大增强中国医疗服务政策制定的证据基础。

abstract.text: Because of aging trends in the US, the number of prevalent colorectal cancer patients is expected to increase. We projected economic burden to the Medicare program and its beneficiaries through the year 2020. Burden was estimated for the initial phase of care, the period following diagnosis, the last year of life, and the continuing phase. Projected burden was evaluated with varying assumptions about incidence, survival, and costs of care. Estimated costs of care in 2000 in the initial, continuing, and last year of life phases of care were approximately $3.18 billion, $1.68 billion, and $2.63 billion, respectively. By the year 2020 under the 'fixed' current incidence, survival, and cost scenario, projected costs for the initial, continuing, and last year of life phases were $4.75 billion, $2.63 billion, and $4.05 billion. Under the current trends scenario (decreasing incidence, improving survival, and increasing costs), costs were $5.19 billion, $3.57 billion, and $5.27 billion. By the year 2020, estimated costs of colorectal cancer care among individuals aged 65 and older increased by 53% in the fixed scenario and by 89% in the current trends scenario. The future economic burden of colorectal cancer to the Medicare program and its beneficiaries in the US will be substantial.

10.1002/hec.1307.abstractZh: 由于美国的老龄化趋势，预计结直肠癌患者的数量将增加。我们对医疗保险计划及其受益人的经济负担进行了预测，时间跨度至2020年。经济负担的估算涵盖了治疗的初始阶段、诊断后的时期、生命的最后一年以及持续治疗阶段。通过不同的发病率、生存率和护理成本假设，对预测的经济负担进行了评估。2000年，治疗的初始阶段、持续阶段和生命最后一年阶段的护理成本分别约为31.8亿美元、16.8亿美元和26.3亿美元。在2020年，按照“固定”的发病率、生存率和成本情景，初始阶段、持续阶段和生命最后一年阶段的护理成本分别预计为47.5亿美元、26.3亿美元和40.5亿美元。而在当前趋势情景下（发病率下降、生存率提高、成本增加），这些成本分别预计为51.9亿美元、35.7亿美元和52.7亿美元。到2020年，65岁及以上人群结直肠癌护理的预计成本在固定情景下将增加53%，在当前趋势情景下将增加89%。未来，结直肠癌对美国医疗保险计划及其受益人的经济负担将相当巨大。

abstract.text: This paper adapts a multinomial logit model to obtain the parameter estimates of demand with multiple choices for medical care services in the urban areas of Iran. The objective is to verify the effectiveness of the cost recovery policy by the Medical Services Insurance Organization of Iran. The results suggest that an out-of-pocket fee increase will not be conducive to the cost recovery and any increase in price would have a serious negative impact on the likelihood of healthcare utilization. Income appears to have a significant positive effect on the decision to seek medical care and the choice of facilities. Patients from wealthy families seem to seek more health care and prefer private facilities.

10.1002/hec.1308.abstractZh: 本文采用多项逻辑模型来估算伊朗城市地区医疗服务的多重选择需求参数。研究旨在验证伊朗医疗服务保险组织所实施的成本回收政策的有效性。研究结果表明，增加自付费用并不会有助于成本回收，而价格的任何上涨都会对医疗利用的可能性产生严重的负面影响。收入对寻求医疗服务的决策以及选择医疗机构的方式具有显著的积极影响。来自富裕家庭的患者似乎更倾向于寻求更多的医疗服务，并偏好私立医疗机构。

abstract.text: We use a simple lifetime utility maximization model to study the problem of medical resource allocation. This model leads to a welfare specification with a QALY (quality-adjusted life-year) component that captures an individual's preferences over both life expectancy and health status. The goal of medical cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) is characterized as maximizing the QALY measure for a given total medical expenditure. We show that the CEA with such a goal has a longevity bias: the CEA-based division of a given total medical expenditure between extending life and improving health gives the former a larger share than is called for by welfare maximization.

10.1002/hec.1309.abstractZh: 我们采用一个简单的终身效用最大化模型来研究医疗资源分配问题。该模型得出的福利规范包含QALY（质量调整生命年）成分，能够反映个体对预期寿命和健康状况的偏好。医疗成本效益分析的目标在于在给定总医疗支出的情况下最大化QALY值。研究表明，具有此类目标的CEA存在长寿偏见：基于CEA的给定总医疗支出分配，将更多资金用于延长寿命而非改善健康，这意味着寿命延长部分获得的资金份额超过了福利最大化所要求的份额。

abstract.text: This paper presents the findings from simulations of the introduction of publicly funded medical savings accounts (MSAs) in the province of Ontario, Canada. The analysis exploits a unique data set linking population-based health survey information with individual-level information on all physician services and hospital services utilization over a four-year period. The analysis provides greater detail along three dimensions than have previous analyses: (1) the distributional impacts of publicly funded MSAs across individuals of differing health statuses, incomes, ages, and current expenditures; (2) the impact of differing degrees of risk adjustment for MSA contributions; and (3) the impact of MSA funding over multiple years, incorporating year-to-year variation in spending at the individual level. In addition, it analyses more plausible designs for publicly funded MSAs than the existing studies. Government uses information available from year t - 1 to allocate its budget for year t in a manner that is ex ante fiscally neutral for the public sector: the government first withholds funds equal to expected catastrophic insurance payments under the MSA plan, and then allocates only the balance to individual MSA accounts. The government captures the savings associated with reduced health-care utilization under MSAs and we examine deductibles that vary by income rather than by current health-care expenditures. The impacts on public expenditures under these designs are more modest than in the previous studies and under plausible assumptions MSAs are predicted to decrease public expenditures. MSAs, however, are also predicted to have unavoidable negative distributional consequences with respect to both public expenditures and out-of-pocket spending.

10.1002/hec.1310.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在加拿大安大略省引入公共资助的医疗储蓄账户（MSAs）的模拟研究结果。该分析利用了一个独特的数据集，将基于人口的健康调查信息与四年期间个体层面的所有医疗服务和医院服务使用情况相结合。该分析在三个维度上提供了比以往研究更详细的资料：（1）公共资助的MSAs对不同健康状况、收入、年龄和当前支出的人群产生的分配影响；（2）不同风险调整程度的MSA贡献的影响；（3）多年间MSA资金的影响，包括个体层面每年的支出变化。此外，本文还分析了比现有研究更合理的公共资助MSA设计方案。政府利用前一年的信息来为当年分配预算，这种方式对公共部门来说在财政上是中性的：政府首先预留相当于MSA计划下预期灾难性保险赔付的资金，然后仅将剩余资金分配给各个MSA账户。政府通过MSA减少了医疗服务的需求，我们研究了按收入而非当前医疗支出来设定免赔额的方法。在这些设计方案下，公共支出的影响比以往研究更为温和，在合理的假设下，MSA预计会减少公共支出。然而，MSA也预计会在公共支出和自付支出方面产生不可避免的负面分配后果。

abstract.text: Concerns about deficiencies in the quality of care delivered in US hospitals grew during a time period when an increasing number of hospitals were experiencing financial problems. Our study examines a six-year longitudinal database of general acute care hospitals in 11 states to assess the relationship between hospital financial condition and quality of care. We evaluate two measures of financial performance: operating margin and a broader profitability measure that encompasses both operating and non-operating sources of income. Our model specification allows for gradual adjustments in quality-enhancing activities and recognizes that current realizations of patient quality may affect future financial performance. Empirical results suggest that there is a relationship between financial performance and quality of care, but not as strong as suggested in earlier research. Overall, our results suggest that deep financial problems that go beyond the patient care side of business may be important to prompting quality problems.

10.1002/hec.1311.abstractZh: 在越来越多的医院面临财务问题的时期，人们对美国医院所提供的护理质量存在担忧。本研究基于11个州的一般急性护理医院建立的为期六年的纵向数据库，旨在评估医院财务状况与护理质量之间的关系。我们评估了两种财务表现指标：营业利润率和涵盖运营与非运营收入在内的综合盈利能力。我们的模型允许逐步调整提升质量的措施，并认识到当前的患者护理质量状况可能会影响未来的财务表现。实证结果表明，财务表现与护理质量之间存在关联，但这种关联并不如早期研究所提出的那么强烈。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，超出患者护理领域的严重财务问题可能是导致护理质量问题的关键因素。

abstract.text: The objective of this study is to estimate the amount of and factors associated with out-of-pocket (OOP) payment for medical care under Taiwan's National Health Insurance (NHI) program. This research used two methods to collect original data. The first method consisted of using a sample household survey and household diary records to collect data on OOP payment prospectively over a two-month period from a random sample of 600 households in central Taiwan. Using the individual as the unit of analysis, we obtained a total of 1062 sample subjects. To ascertain the quality and accuracy of survey data, the claim records of the bureau of NHI were merged with the survey data. These data were analyzed by a two-part model, with a probit model for use of health care and an ordinary least-squares model for OOP payments. Results of this research indicate that on average an individual's annual OOP payment for medical care was euro 247, which is substantial, compared with the average euro 144 for per capita NHI earmarked tax. Finally, results of model estimation indicate that supplemental health insurance and household income were positively associated with any use of health care, while household income was also positively associated with OOP payment for health care.

10.1002/hec.1312.abstractZh: 本研究旨在估算台湾国民健康保险计划下个人自付医疗费用的数额及相关因素。研究采用两种方法收集原始数据。第一种方法是通过样本家庭调查和家庭日记记录，从台湾中部随机选取的600户家庭中，前瞻性收集两个月内的自付医疗费用数据。以个人为分析单位，共获得了1062名样本对象。为确保调查数据的质量和准确性，将国民健康保险局的索赔记录与调查数据进行了合并。这些数据通过两部分模型进行分析：一部分用于评估对医疗服务的使用情况，另一部分用于计算自付医疗费用。研究结果显示，个人每年用于医疗的自付医疗费用平均为247欧元，这一数值相当可观，相比之下，人均国民健康保险专项税的平均金额为144欧元。此外，模型估计结果显示，补充性健康保险和家庭收入与医疗服务的使用呈正相关关系，而家庭收入也与自付医疗费用呈正相关关系。

abstract.text: Many low- and middle-income countries are currently undergoing a dramatic epidemiological transition, with an increasing disease burden due to degenerative noncommunicable diseases. Inexpensive medication treatment often represents a cost-effective means to prevent, control or cure many of these health conditions. Using micro-data from the 2001 Mexican Health and Aging Study, we assess horizontal inequity in medication treatment among older Mexicans before the introduction of Popular Health Insurance in Mexico. In doing so, we investigate the role of various dimensions of socioeconomic status for obtaining indicated medication treatment within a comparatively fragmented health-care system that features relatively high out-of-pocket expenditures. Our empirical analysis suggests health insurance coverage as a key socioeconomic determinant of indicated medication use with large and statistically significant positive effects on take-up. The effects of insurance status thereby clearly dominate any other possible effects of socioeconomic status on medication treatment. Our results thus highlight the importance of access to reliable health care and comprehensive coverage for rational medication use in the management of degenerative diseases. In light of this evidence, we expect that recent Mexican health-care reforms, which expand health insurance coverage to the previously uninsured population, will alleviate socioeconomic gradients in medication treatment among older people in need.

10.1002/hec.1313.abstractZh: 许多低收入和中等收入国家正在经历显著的流行病学转变，由于退行性非传染性疾病的影响，疾病负担日益加重。价格低廉的药物治疗通常是一种具有成本效益的方法，可以预防、控制或治愈许多这些健康状况。利用2001年墨西哥健康与老龄化研究中的微观数据，我们评估了在墨西哥普及医疗保险之前，老年墨西哥人在药物治疗方面的不平等情况。通过这项研究，我们探讨了在相对分散的医疗保健体系中，各种社会经济地位因素对获得必要药物治疗的影响，而该体系的特点是较高的自付费用。我们的实证分析表明，医疗保险覆盖是必要药物治疗使用的重要社会经济决定因素，对药物使用的增加具有显著且统计上显著的积极影响。因此，保险状态的影响明显超过了社会经济地位对药物治疗的其他可能影响。我们的研究结果强调了获得可靠医疗保健和全面覆盖对于合理使用药物治疗以管理退行性疾病的重要性。鉴于这些证据，我们预计，最近墨西哥的医疗保健改革将扩大医疗保险覆盖范围，使以前没有保险的人群也能获得必要的医疗服务，从而缓解老年人群在药物治疗方面的社会经济差异。

abstract.text: This paper reports the results of a Fall 2005 survey of US health economists, the first in over 18 years. Where appropriate, the results are compared with the earlier findings of Feldman and Morrisey (J. Health Politics Policy Law 1990; 15(3):627-646). The paper describes the demographics and training of health economists. It also describes how employers view the substitutability between a Ph.D. in economics and a Ph.D. in health services research, which is a key question because self-identified health economists increasingly include health services researchers trained in schools of public health or medicine. This study also reports the expectations of various, employers of health economists regarding external grant and contract support. It also reports health economists' perceptions of the processes that allocate resources and recognition: promotion review, journal refereeing, and grant review.

10.1002/hec.1314.abstractZh: 本文报告了2005年秋季对美国健康经济学家的调查结果，这是18多年来首次进行的此类调查。在适当的情况下，这些结果与Feldman和Morrisey的早期研究进行了比较（《健康政治政策法律杂志》，1990年；15卷第3期，第627-646页）。文章描述了健康经济学家的群体特征与培训情况。同时，文章还探讨了雇主对于经济学博士学位与卫生服务研究博士学位之间可替代性的看法。这一问题是关键所在，因为自认为从事健康经济学研究的学者中，越来越多的是来自公共卫生或医学领域的卫生服务研究领域的学者。本研究还报告了不同雇主对于外部资助和合同支持的期望。此外，文章还探讨了健康经济学家对于资源分配过程的看法，以及他们在晋升评审、期刊审稿和资助评审方面的认可情况。

abstract.text: The TTO-method is often used to value health states, but it is susceptible to several biases and methodological difficulties. One of these is a violation of procedural invariance, which means that the way a TTO-question is framed, i.e. either by fixing the period in imperfect health or that in perfect health, can have a substantial effect on the elicited value of a health state. There are four important sources of discrepancy of the two procedures: loss aversion, maximum endurable time, scale compatibility and discounting. In this article, we present the results of a new test of procedural invariance in which we avoided or corrected for two of these sources (discounting and maximum endurable time). Our results indicate that while correcting for discounting does diminish the difference between the two TTO-procedures, a large and significant violation of procedural invariance remains. Loss aversion is probably the main determinant of the remainder of this difference.

10.1002/hec.1315.abstractZh: TTO方法常被用于评估健康状态，但它容易受到多种偏差和方法论难题的影响。其中之一就是程序不变性的违反，这意味着TTO问题的表述方式——例如设定在不完美健康状态下的期限或完美健康状态下的期限——会对健康状态的评估价值产生显著影响。这两种方法存在四个主要的差异来源：损失厌恶、最大可忍受时间、尺度兼容性以及折现效应。在本文中，我们展示了一种新的程序不变性测试结果，该测试避免了或纠正了其中两个来源的影响（折现效应和最大可忍受时间）。我们的结果表明，虽然纠正折现效应确实减少了两种TTO方法之间的差异，但程序不变性的严重违反仍然存在。损失厌恶可能是造成这种差异的主要原因。

abstract.text: While there is a growing literature that examines the issue of cointegration (co-movement over the long run) among health expenditures, there are no studies that examine the issue of common cycles (co-movement over the short run) among health expenditures. We undertake a multivariate variance decomposition analysis of per capita health expenditures of the USA, the UK, Japan, Canada, and Switzerland based on a common-trend-common-cycle restriction framework, to examine the relative importance of permanent and transitory innovations in explaining variations in per capita health expenditures in each of the five countries. Our main finding is that transitory shocks are more important in explaining per capita health expenditures in the UK, Japan, and Switzerland, while permanent shocks dominate variations in per capita health expenditures in the USA and Canada over short horizons.

10.1002/hec.1316.abstractZh: 虽然已有越来越多的文献研究健康支出之间的长期共整合现象，但尚无研究探讨健康支出之间的短期共循环现象。我们基于共同趋势-共同循环框架，对美国、英国、日本、加拿大和瑞士的人均健康支出进行了多变量方差分解分析，以考察在解释这五个国家人均健康支出变化中，永久性创新与暂时性创新各自的相对重要性。我们的主要发现是，暂时性冲击在解释英国、日本和瑞士的人均健康支出方面更为重要，而在美国和加拿大的短期范围内，永久性冲击则主导了人均健康支出的变化。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the evolution of pharmaceutical expenditure with respect to GDP for a group of the most important OECD economies. We find that this relationship is not stable across the sample considered (1960-2003), and heterogeneity is found in the temporal evolution of the variables and across countries. Furthermore, we can see differences in the income elasticity estimation when we disaggregate pharmaceutical expenditure into its private and government components or when the total health-care expenditure (Total HCE) is disaggregated into its pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical components. We conclude that the changes in the elasticity of pharmaceutical expenditure and in the Total HCE elasticity are due to the private component and the pharmaceutical expenditure behaviour, respectively.

10.1002/hec.1317.abstractZh: 本文分析了OECD部分重要经济体中药品支出与GDP之间的关系演变情况。研究发现，在1960至2003年的样本期间，这种关系并不稳定，且各变量在时间上的演变以及不同国家之间存在差异。此外，当我们将药品支出分解为私人支出和政府支出部分，或者将总医疗保健支出分解为药品支出和非药品支出部分时，收入弹性估计结果也会有所不同。我们得出结论，药品支出弹性以及总医疗保健支出弹性的变化分别是由私人支出部分以及药品支出行为所导致的。

abstract.text: Can self-assessments of health reveal the true health differentials between 'rich' and 'poor'? The potential sources of bias include psychological adaptation to ill-health, socioeconomic covariates of health reporting errors and income measurement errors. We propose an estimation method to reduce the bias by isolating the component of self-assessed health that is explicable in terms of objective health indicators and allowing for broader dimensions of economic welfare than captured by current incomes. On applying our method to survey data for Russia we find a pronounced (nonlinear) economic gradient in health status that is not evident in the raw data. This is largely attributable to the health effects of age, education and location.

10.1002/hec.1318.abstractZh: 自我评估的健康状况能否揭示“富人”与“穷人”之间的真实健康差异？潜在的偏见来源包括心理对健康状况的适应、健康报告错误的社会经济因素以及收入测量错误。我们提出了一种估算方法，通过分离出可以用客观健康指标解释的自我评估健康部分，并考虑比当前收入更能反映经济福利的更广泛维度，从而减少偏见。将我们的方法应用于俄罗斯的调查数据后，我们发现健康状况存在明显的（非线性）经济梯度，这在原始数据中并不明显。这主要归因于年龄、教育和地理位置对健康的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, I use nationally representative longitudinal data to examine adolescent depression and educational attainment. First, I examine the individual, family, and community-level determinants of adolescent depression, diagnosis, and treatment. I find that male and minority adolescents who score high on depression scales are less likely to be diagnosed as depressed or receive treatment than female and non-Hispanic white adolescents. Additionally, I find several community-level variables to be important determinants of depression, diagnosis, and treatment. Second, I examine the importance of adolescent depression for educational attainment. Although it is uncontroversial to expect a negative relationship, most previous research uses cross-sectional data, making it difficult to adequately determine the magnitude of the effect. I find that depressive symptoms are related to educational attainment along multiple margins: dropping out of high school, college enrollment, and college type. These relationships are only found for adolescent females, and there are several interesting results across income groups. Overall, these findings suggest that further attempts to diagnose and treat adolescents with depressive symptoms are needed and that additional treatment options may be required to combat the important relationship between adolescent depression and human capital accumulation for females.

10.1002/hec.1319.abstractZh: 在本文中，我使用具有全国代表性的纵向数据来研究青少年抑郁与教育成就之间的关系。首先，我探讨了青少年抑郁、诊断及治疗在个体、家庭和社区层面的决定因素。研究发现，在抑郁量表得分较高的男性及少数族裔青少年，被诊断出抑郁或接受治疗的几率低于女性及非西班牙裔白人青少年。此外，我还发现一些社区层面的变量对抑郁、诊断及治疗具有重要影响。其次，我研究了青少年抑郁对教育成就的重要性。虽然预期存在负相关关系是毋庸置疑的，但大多数先前的研究使用的是横断面数据，难以充分确定影响的程度。研究发现，抑郁症状与多个教育成就指标相关，包括高中辍学、大学入学率以及大学类型。这些关系仅存在于青少年女性中，并且不同收入群体之间也存在一些有趣的结果。总体而言，这些发现表明，需要进一步努力诊断和治疗有抑郁症状的青少年，并且可能需要更多的治疗方法来应对青少年抑郁与女性人力资本积累之间的重要关系。

abstract.text: The cost-effectiveness of health-care interventions is often evaluated using quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) as a measure of outcome. QALYs are valid representations of welfare only under the questionable assumption of additive independence of utility of health states across time periods. Therefore, some alternatives to QALYs have been proposed, among them healthy-year equivalents (HYEs) (Med. Decis. Making 1989; 9(2):142-149) and a semi-separable utility function (SSUF) (J. Health Econ. 2005; 24(1):33-54). This paper shows that HYEs using a single probability-equivalent standard gamble (SG) question measure the same health construct as the SSUF, which uses a series of probability-equivalent SG questions. The underlying assumption is that final health states are independent of initial health states. In contrast to the SSUF, however, HYEs are not bound by this assumption and also avoid propagating bias in the measurement of SG utilities from one question to the next. This paper also shows that both approaches can incorporate feelings related to the uncertainty about future health and capture them by using certainty equivalent questions.

10.1002/hec.1320.abstractZh: 医疗干预的成本效益评估通常采用质量调整生命年（QALYs）作为衡量结果的指标。然而，QALYs只有在健康状态效用在时间段内具有加性独立性的假设下才能有效反映福利状况。因此，人们提出了一些替代QALYs的方法，例如健康年当量（HYEs）和半可分离效用函数（SSUF）。本文表明，使用单一概率等效标准赌博问题的HYEs能够衡量与SSUF相同的健康状况，而SSUF则通过一系列概率等效的SG问题来测量。其基本假设是最终的健康状态与初始的健康状态无关。然而，与SSUF不同的是，HYEs不受此假设的限制，并且可以避免在测量SG效用时将偏差从一个问题传递到另一个问题。本文还表明，这两种方法都可以纳入与未来健康不确定性相关的感受，并通过使用确定性等效问题来捕捉这些感受。

abstract.text: Zero tolerance laws make it illegal per se for anyone under age 21 to drive with any measurable amount of blood alcohol. Although a link has been established between zero tolerance laws and lower motor vehicle fatalities, research has not produced strong evidence on how zero tolerance laws influence individual alcohol use and drinking and driving behaviors. Using a unique data set and a difference-in-difference-in-difference-type research design, we are able to analyze a number of pathways through which zero tolerance laws can work among an important underage population, college students. We find that zero tolerance laws reduce drinking and driving among college students. Further analysis of our detailed alcohol use measures suggests that zero tolerance laws are particularly effective at reducing the probability of driving after drinking for those who reported drinking away from home.

10.1002/hec.1321.abstractZh: 零容忍法律本身就禁止21岁以下的人驾驶时血液酒精含量超过一定标准。虽然零容忍法律与较低的机动车死亡事故之间存在关联，但研究尚未提供强有力的证据来证明零容忍法律如何影响个人的酒精使用以及驾驶行为。通过独特的数据集和差异-差异-差异型研究设计，我们能够分析零容忍法律在重要未成年群体——大学生中发挥作用的各种途径。我们发现，零容忍法律确实减少了大学生的酒驾行为。对我们详细的酒精使用数据的进一步分析表明，对于那些报告在户外饮酒的人来说，零容忍法律在降低酒后驾车的可能性方面特别有效。

abstract.text: The aim of this study was to determine whether between-country variations in hospital costs are larger than within-country variations and, furthermore, to explore reasons for this variability. For this purpose, we chose the primary treatment of patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) as an episode of care. We obtained hospitalisation costs and reimbursement rates from 45 hospitals in nine different EU member states (i.e. Denmark, England, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, and Spain) for the year 2005. To further analyse the variations in hospital costs, we employed a hierarchical random effects model based on treatment and hospital characteristics and using purchasing power parities (PPPs) as a proxy for country-specific price levels. The between-country standard error was estimated at 2473 euros, whereas the within-country standard error was estimated at 1242 euros. Our regression analysis showed that percutaneous coronary intervention was associated with significantly increased hospitals costs compared to other treatment strategies. We were able to distinguish between three groups of countries with different cost levels based on the number of hospitals that were able to provide these services (i.e. percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) with intracoronary stenting). Excluding Hungary, Poland, and Spain, where none of the participating hospitals were able to provide these procedures, the between-country standard error decreased to 1632 euros, whereas the within-country standard error increased to 1416 euros. Finally, we observed exogenous price-level effects between countries and within countries for hospitals located in urban areas.

10.1002/hec.1322.abstractZh: 本研究旨在确定国家间医院费用的差异是否大于国内差异，并进一步探讨这种差异性的原因。为此，我们选择了急性心肌梗死患者的主要治疗作为研究案例。我们获取了2005年来自9个欧盟成员国（即丹麦、英格兰、法国、德国、匈牙利、意大利、荷兰、波兰和西班牙）的45家医院的住院费用及报销率数据。为了进一步分析医院费用的差异，我们采用了基于治疗和医院特征的层次随机效应模型，并使用购买力平价作为国家特定价格水平的代理变量。国家间标准误差估计为2473欧元，而国内标准误差估计为1242欧元。我们的回归分析显示，与其它治疗策略相比，经皮冠状动脉介入治疗显著增加了医院费用。根据能够提供这些服务的医院数量，我们将国家分为三组，这些国家的费用水平有所不同。排除匈牙利、波兰和西班牙，这些国家没有医院能够提供这些手术，国家间标准误差降至1632欧元，而国内标准误差则上升至1416欧元。最后，我们观察到城市地区医院在国家和国内范围内的价格水平差异。

abstract.text: This paper aims (a) to determine whether variations in the hospital costs of appendectomy in EU member states are larger within individual countries or between different countries and (b) to explore causes for variations in costs between hospitals and countries. To do so, hospitalisation costs and reimbursement rates for appendectomy were obtained from 54 hospitals in nine European member states based on 1786 cases using a standardised methodology. Regression analysis was performed using hospital characteristics, treatment characteristics, and purchasing power parities (PPP) as explanatory variables in a multilevel framework. The within-country standard error was estimated to 294 euros (27%), whereas the between-country standard error was 796 euros (73%). Excluding hospitals in Spain, Hungary, and Poland, which had significantly lower costs than hospitals in the other countries in our analysis, the within-country standard error was 331 euros (57%) and the between-country standard error dropped to 248 euros (43%). Regression results show that the treatment decision for open surgery was associated with significantly lower costs, whereas a greater number of beds and a higher staff per bed ratio were associated with significantly higher costs. PPP explained a major part of the between-country variance.

10.1002/hec.1323.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨：(a) 欧盟成员国内各医院阑尾切除术费用的差异是更大，还是不同国家之间存在差异；(b) 导致医院与国家之间费用差异的原因。为此，基于1786例病例，从9个欧洲成员国的54家医院获取了阑尾切除术的住院费用及报销率数据，并采用标准化方法进行了分析。采用多层次框架，将医院特征、治疗特征以及购买力平价作为解释变量进行回归分析。结果显示，国家内部的误差标准差为294欧元（27%），而国家之间的误差标准差为796欧元（73%）。排除西班牙、匈牙利和波兰的医院后，这些国家的费用明显低于其他国家的费用，此时国家内部的误差标准差为331欧元（57%），而国家之间的误差标准差降至248欧元（43%）。回归分析表明，选择开放手术作为治疗方式与显著较低的费用相关，而床位数量较多以及每床配备更多医护人员则与显著较高的费用相关。购买力平价解释了国家间费用差异的很大一部分。

abstract.text: The number of cataract extractions has increased substantially over time. At present, cataract surgery is estimated to be the most common single procedure performed in the developed world. The present study compares the costs of a cataract intervention across nine European countries. To enhance comparability, data were collected using a common template based on a case vignette. Adequate data for analysis were collected from 41 providers and were used to evaluate variation across countries and providers. Ordinary least squares and a multilevel model were used to investigate cost variation. Mean total costs per cataract intervention varied considerably from country to country, ranging from 318 euros in Hungary to 1087 euros in Italy. Variations of a similar magnitude were detected for personnel costs and overheads. However, variations in the cost of the lens were more modest. Overall, our results confirm expectations about the causes of cost variations across EU member states, indicating that these variations may be attributable to the quantity of resources used in performing the operation, the price of resources, and the type of setting in which the operation is performed. The study highlights how accounting practices and available cost data differ across Europe. It also shows the feasibility of collecting data on the basis of vignettes using common cost templates. Studies following this approach will gain importance if cross-country comparisons are to be used to promote European benchmarking exercises.

10.1002/hec.1324.abstractZh: 白内障手术的手术数量随着时间的推移而大幅增加。目前，白内障手术被认为是发达国家中最常见的单一手术项目。本研究比较了九个欧洲国家中白内障手术的成本。为了增强可比性，数据采用基于案例模板的通用模板进行收集。从41家医疗机构收集了足够的数据，用于评估各国和医疗机构之间的差异。采用普通最小二乘法和多层次模型来研究成本差异。每次白内障手术的平均总成本在不同国家之间存在显著差异，从匈牙利的318欧元到意大利的1087欧元不等。人员成本和管理费用的变化幅度也相当大。然而，人工晶状体的成本变化则较为温和。总体而言，我们的研究结果证实了关于欧盟成员国成本差异原因的预期，表明这些差异可能归因于手术中使用的资源数量、资源价格以及手术进行的环境类型。该研究还揭示了欧洲各地会计实践和可用成本数据的差异。同时，它也证明了基于案例模板使用通用成本模板收集数据的可行性。如果后续研究能够利用跨国比较来促进欧洲范围内的基准测试，那么这种研究方法将变得尤为重要。

abstract.text: This study provides a comparative analysis of the costs of normal delivery in hospital in nine European countries using the data collected as part of the HealthBASKET project. The results show that both the level of input (medical labour) prices and the skill mix used for delivery are major determinants of total delivery costs. At the hospital level, there seems to be room for greater efficiency through specialisation and task shifting from doctors to midwives and nurses. More generally, the results of our study suggest that the costs of delivery in hospital are not independent of supplementary home care provided outside of hospitals. The cost information and analysis in this study may also be useful for developing healthcare-specific purchasing power parities (PPPs) that allow for healthcare expenditures to be compared across countries.

10.1002/hec.1325.abstractZh: 本研究利用HealthBASKET项目收集的数据，对九个欧洲国家医院常规分娩的成本进行了比较分析。研究结果表明，分娩过程中所需的医疗劳动力成本以及使用的技能组合是总分娩成本的主要决定因素。在医院层面，通过专业化和任务转移，将医生的工作交由助产士和护士承担，可以提高效率。总体而言，研究结果表明，医院分娩的成本并非独立于医院外提供的辅助家庭护理。本研究中的成本信息和分析也有助于制定特定于医疗保健的购买力平价，从而便于跨国比较医疗支出。

abstract.text: Dental fillings represent an established procedure to treat tooth decay. The present paper provides a cost comparison of dental filling procedures across nine European countries. More specifically, the paper aims to estimate the costs and prices (i.e. reimbursement fees) of a single dental filling procedure in an approximately 12-year-old child with a toothache in a lower molar who presents at a dental practice, as described in a case vignette. Both amalgam and composite fillings were examined. Total costs were determined by identifying resource use and unit costs for the following cost components: diagnostic procedures, labour, materials, drugs, and overheads. Altogether, 49 practices provided data for the cost calculations. Mean total costs per country varied considerably, ranging from 8 euros to 156 euros. Labour costs were the most important cost driver in all practices, comprising 58% of total costs. Overhead costs were the second-most important cost component in the majority of countries. Actual cost differences across practices within countries were relatively small. Cost variations between countries were primarily due to differences in unit costs, especially for labour and overheads, and only to a lesser extent to differences in resource use. Finally, cost estimates for a single dental filling procedure based on reimbursement fees led to an underestimation of the total costs by approximately 50%.

10.1002/hec.1326.abstractZh: 牙齿填充是一种常用的治疗蛀牙的方法。本文对九个欧洲国家的牙齿填充费用进行了比较。具体而言，本文旨在估算一个大约12岁、患有下磨牙牙痛的儿童在牙科诊所接受一次牙齿填充手术的费用和价格（即报销费用）。文中考察了银汞合金和复合材料的填充方式。通过确定以下成本组成部分的资源使用量和单位成本，从而计算出总成本：诊断程序、劳动力、材料、药品以及管理费用。共有49家诊所提供了数据用于成本计算。每个国家的总成本差异较大，从8欧元到156欧元不等。在所有诊所中，劳动力成本是最重要的成本因素，占总成本的58%。在大多数国家，管理费用是第二重要的成本因素。同一国家内不同诊所之间的实际成本差异相对较小。国家之间的成本差异主要源于单位成本的差异，尤其是劳动力和管理费用的成本差异，其次才是资源使用的差异。最后，基于报销费用对一次牙齿填充手术的成本估算，导致总成本被低估了大约50%。

abstract.text: International comparisons of healthcare costs are growing in importance for a number of different applications. The use of common approaches to converting costs such as GDP purchasing power parities (PPPs) often does not reflect price differences in healthcare in an appropriate manner. This means that new approaches need to be explored. The objective of this paper is to demonstrate the feasibility of using episode-specific PPPs (ESPPPs) to facilitate cross-country comparisons of healthcare costs and to compare this approach with other common approaches to conversion. Costs for five care episodes from hospitals in eight European countries were obtained from the EU HealthBASKET project. ESPPPs were created by using Fisher-type PPPs in combination with the Eltetö-Köves-Szulc method at the episode level. Differences in ESPPPs among the five care episodes were discussed and compared with other common conversion approaches. We found that ESPPPs-reflected prices and resource use more accurately than conventional conversion approaches such as GDP PPPs and medical care PPPs. This was particularly evident for labour-intensive care episodes in which other conversion approaches revealed problems in the way that labour input had not been considered appropriately. The results demonstrate that ESPPPs are preferable to other common conversion approaches when international healthcare cost comparisons are performed.

10.1002/hec.1327.abstractZh: 国际间的医疗费用比较在多种应用中变得越来越重要。使用常见的转换方法，如GDP购买力平价（PPP），往往无法准确反映医疗保健领域的价格差异。这意味着需要探索新的方法。本文旨在证明使用特定病例的PPP（ESPPP）来比较不同国家的医疗费用的可行性，并将其与其他常见的转换方法进行比较。来自八个欧洲国家医院的五个护理病例的医疗费用数据来源于EU HealthBASKET项目。ESPPP是通过结合Fisher型PPP和Eltetö-Köves-Szulc方法在病例层面创建的。我们对这五个护理病例的ESPPP之间的差异进行了讨论，并与其他常见的转换方法进行了比较。我们发现，ESPPP比传统的转换方法，如GDP PPP和医疗护理PPP，更能准确反映价格和资源使用情况。这一点在劳动密集型护理病例中尤为明显，因为其他转换方法在考虑劳动投入方面存在不足。结果表明，在进行国际医疗费用比较时，ESPPP优于其他常见的转换方法。

abstract.text: This paper assesses variations in the cost of primary hip replacement between and within nine member states of the European Union (EU). It also compares the cost of service with public-payer reimbursements. To do so, data on cost and reimbursement were surveyed at the micro-level in 42 hospitals in Denmark, England, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, The Netherlands, Poland, and Spain. The total cost of treatment ranged from 1290 euros (Hungary) to 8739 euros (The Netherlands), with a mean cost of 5043 euros (STD +/- 2071 euros). The main cost drivers were found to be implants (34% of total cost on average) and ward costs (20.9% of total cost on average). A one-way random effects analysis of variance model indicated that 74.0% of variation was between and only 26% of variation was within countries. In a two-level random-intercept regression model, purchasing-power parities explained 79.4% of the explainable between-country variation, while the percentage of uncemented implants used and the number of beds explained 12.1 and 1.6% of explainable within-country variation, respectively. The large differences in cost and reimbursement between Poland, Hungary, and the other EU member states shows that primary total hip replacement is a highly relevant case for cross-border care.

10.1002/hec.1328.abstractZh: 本文评估了欧洲联盟九个成员国之间及内部初次髋关节置换手术成本的差异。同时，还比较了手术费用与公共支付者报销情况。为此，研究人员在丹麦、英格兰、法国、德国、匈牙利、意大利、荷兰、波兰和西班牙的42家医院进行了微观层面的成本和报销数据调查。治疗的总费用从1290欧元（匈牙利）到8739欧元（荷兰）不等，平均费用为5043欧元（标准差±2071欧元）。主要成本因素包括植入物（平均占总成本的34%）和病房费用（平均占总成本的20.9%）。单向随机效应方差分析模型显示，74.0%的变异发生在不同国家之间，而仅26%的变异发生在同一国家内部。在双层随机截距回归模型中，购买力平价解释了79.4%的国家间变异，而未使用未固定植入物的比例和床位数量分别解释了12.1%和1.6%的国内变异。波兰、匈牙利与其他欧盟成员国在成本和报销方面的巨大差异表明，初次全髋关节置换手术是一个具有高度跨境治疗相关性的案例。

abstract.text: Stroke is a major cause of mortality and morbidity, but the reasons for differences in costs of care within and between countries are not well understood. The HealthBASKET project used a vignette methodology to compare the mean costs and prices of hospital care across providers in nine European Union countries. Data on resource use, unit costs and prices of care for female stroke patients without co-morbidity were collected from a sample of 50 hospitals. Mean costs for each provider were analysed using multiple regression. Sensitivity analysis explored the effects on cost of using official exchange rates, purchasing power parity (PPP) and proportion of national income per capita. The mean cost of a hospital episode per patient for stroke at PPP was 3813 euros (standard error 227) with an additional day in hospital typically associated with 6.9% (95% CI: 4-9%) higher costs and thrombolysis associated with 41% higher costs (10-73%). After adjusting for explanatory factors, about 76% of the variation in cost could be attributed to between-country differences, and the extent of this variation was sensitive to the method of currency conversion. There was considerable variation in the care pathways within and between countries, including differences in the availability of stroke units and access to rehabilitative services, but only the length of stay and use of thrombolytic therapy were significantly associated with higher cost. The vignette methodology appears feasible, but further research needs to consider access to healthcare over a longer follow up and to include both costs and outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1329.abstractZh: 中风是死亡和疾病的主要原因之一，但不同国家之间在护理成本上的差异原因尚不清楚。HealthBASKET项目采用案例研究方法，比较了欧盟九个国家不同医疗机构的住院护理平均成本和价格。从50家医院收集了无合并症的女性中风患者的资源使用、单位成本及护理价格数据。通过多元回归分析各医疗机构的平均成本。敏感性分析探讨了使用官方汇率、购买力平价以及人均国民收入比例对成本的影响。按购买力平价计算，每位中风患者住院一次的平均成本为3813欧元（标准误差227），额外住院一天通常会导致成本增加6.9%（95%置信区间：4-9%），而溶栓治疗则会使成本增加41%（10-73%）。在调整了各种解释因素后，约76%的成本差异可归因于国家间的差异，且这种差异程度受货币转换方法的影响。各国之间在护理路径上存在显著差异，包括中风病房的可及性和康复服务的获取情况，但住院时间和溶栓治疗的使用才是与成本显著相关的因素。案例研究方法似乎是可行的，但后续研究需要更长时间地关注医疗保健的获取情况，并同时考虑成本和结果。

abstract.text: The power family, also known as the family of constant relative risk aversion (CRRA), is the most widely used parametric family for fitting utility functions to data. Its characteristics have, however, been little understood, and have led to numerous misunderstandings. This paper explains these characteristics in a manner accessible to a wide audience.

10.1002/hec.1331.abstractZh: 幂函数族，也被称为恒定相对风险厌恶函数族（CRRA），是最常用的参数化函数族，用于拟合数据中的效用函数。然而，其特性一直鲜为人知，并导致了许多误解。本文以通俗易懂的方式解释了这些特性。

abstract.text: Limited use conditions (LUCs) are a method of directing treatment with new drugs to those populations where they will be most cost effective. In this paper we investigate how a drug manufacturer could determine pricing and LUCs to maximize profits. We assume that the payer makes formulary decisions on the basis of net monetary benefits, that the disease can be modeled using a Markov model of disease progression, and that the drug reduces the probability of progression between states of the Markov model. LUCs are expressed as a range of probabilities of disease progression over which patients would have access to the new drug. We assume that the manufacturer determines the price and LUCs in order to maximize profits. We show that an explicit trade-off exists between the drug's price and the use conditions, that there is an upper bound on the drug price, that the proportion of the population targeted by the LUC does not depend on quality of life or costs in each health state or the payer's willingness to pay, and that high drug prices do not always correspond with high profits.

10.1002/hec.1332.abstractZh: 有限使用条件是一种将新药治疗指导到最具成本效益的人群中的方法。在本文中，我们探讨了制药公司如何确定定价和有限使用条件以最大化利润。我们假设支付方基于净货币收益做出处方决策，疾病可以使用马尔可夫模型进行建模，且该药物能够降低疾病进展到不同状态的概率。有限使用条件表示为疾病进展的概率范围，患者可以在这一范围内使用新药。我们假设制药公司确定价格和有限使用条件是为了最大化利润。我们表明，药物价格与使用条件之间存在明确的权衡关系，药物价格存在上限，有限使用条件所针对的人群比例并不取决于每个健康状态的生活质量或成本，以及支付方的支付意愿，而且高药物价格并不总是伴随着高利润。

abstract.text: This systematic review examines what factors explain the diversity of findings regarding hospital ownership and quality. We identified 31 observational studies written in English since 1990 that used multivariate analysis to examine quality of care at nonfederal general acute, short-stay US hospitals. We find that pooled estimates of ownership effects are sensitive to the subset of studies included and the extent of overlap among hospitals analyzed in the underlying studies. Ownership does appear to be systematically related to differences in quality among hospitals in several contexts. Whether studies find for-profit and government-controlled hospitals to have higher mortality rates or rates of adverse events than their nonprofit counterparts depends on data sources, time period, and region covered. Policymakers should be aware of the underlying reasons for conflicting evidence in this literature, and the strengths and weaknesses of meta-analytic synthesis. The 'true' effect of ownership appears to depend on institutional context, including differences across regions, markets, and over time.

10.1002/hec.1333.abstractZh: 本系统综述旨在探讨哪些因素解释了关于医院所有权与服务质量差异的研究结果多样性。我们识别了1990年以来以英语撰写的31项观察性研究，这些研究采用多变量分析方法来评估非联邦通用急性病院及短期住院医院的服务质量。研究发现，所有权效应的汇总估计值受到所纳入研究子集以及基础研究中分析的医院重叠程度的影响。在多个情境下，所有权似乎与医院之间的服务质量差异存在系统性关联。研究是否发现营利性和政府控制的医院比非营利性医院具有更高的死亡率或不良事件发生率，这取决于数据来源、时间范围以及所覆盖的区域。政策制定者应当了解这些文献中证据相互矛盾的根本原因，以及元分析综合方法的优缺点。所有权的“真实”影响似乎取决于制度环境，包括不同地区、市场以及时间上的差异。

abstract.text: Promoting cessation is a cornerstone of tobacco control efforts by public-health agencies. Economic information to support cessation programs has generally emphasized cost-effectiveness or the impact of cigarette pricing and smoking restrictions on quit rates. In contrast, this study provides empirical estimates of smoker preferences for increased efficacy and other attributes of smoking cessation therapies (SCTs). Choice data were collected through a national survey of Canadian smokers. We find systematic preference heterogeneity for therapy types and SCT attributes between light and heavy smokers, as well as random heterogeneity using random parameters logit models. Preference heterogeneity is greatest between length of use and types of SCTs. We estimate that light smokers would be willing to pay nearly $500 ($CAN) to increase success rates to 40% with the comparable figure for heavy smokers being near $300 ($CAN). Results from this study can be used to inform research and development for smoking cessation products and programs and suggest important areas of future inquiry regarding heterogeneity of smoker preferences and preferences for other health programs.

10.1002/hec.1336.abstractZh: 促进戒烟是公共卫生机构烟草控制工作的核心。支持戒烟计划的经济信息通常强调成本效益或香烟定价和吸烟限制对戒烟率的影响。相比之下，本研究提供了关于吸烟者对戒烟疗法（SCTs）的疗效提升及其他属性的偏好的实证估计。通过一项针对加拿大吸烟者的全国调查收集了选择数据。我们发现，轻烟者与重烟者在治疗类型和SCT属性偏好上存在系统性差异，同时使用随机参数Logit模型也发现了随机性偏好差异。在使用时间和SCT类型之间，偏好差异最为明显。我们估计，轻烟者愿意支付近500加元来将成功率提高到40%，而重烟者则愿意支付约300加元。本研究的结果可用于指导戒烟产品和项目的研发，并为未来关于吸烟者偏好差异及其他健康项目的偏好研究提供重要线索。

abstract.text: In May, 2003, British Columbia transitioned from an age-based public drug program, with public subsidy primarily based on age, to an age-irrelevant income-based drug program, in which public subsidy is based primarily on household income. As one of the specific aims of the policy change was to improve fairness by increasing the extent to which payment for drugs is based on ability to pay, we measure the progressivity of pharmaceutical financing before and after the policy change in BC using Kakwani indices. Our results suggest that pharmaceutical financing became less regressive after the policy change. However, this decrease in regressivity arose primarily because high-income seniors were making greater direct contributions to pharmaceutical financing and not because low-income households were making smaller direct contributions. Our results also suggest that if the public financing of pharmaceuticals were maintained or increased, a change from age-based to income-based eligibility can unambiguously improve equity in finance. As populations in developed countries age, governments will increasingly consider reforms to publicly financed health-care programs with age-based eligibility. In assessing policy options, financial equity is likely to be a key consideration. These results suggest that income-based pharmacare can improve financial equity especially when implemented with a commitment to maintain or increase public funding for prescription drugs.

10.1002/hec.1337.abstractZh: 2003年5月，不列颠哥伦比亚省从基于年龄的公共药物计划转变为基于收入的药物计划，其中公共补贴主要依据家庭收入。政策变更的一个具体目标是通过提高药物支付与支付能力之间的关联度来提升公平性。我们使用Kakwani指数来衡量不列颠哥伦比亚省在政策变更前后药物融资的公平性变化。研究结果表明，政策变更后药物融资的递减趋势有所减轻。然而，这种递减趋势的减少主要源于高收入老年人对药物融资的直接贡献增加，而非低收入家庭对药物融资的直接贡献减少。研究还表明，如果继续维持或增加公共药物融资，从基于年龄的资格标准转变为基于收入的资格标准，可以明确提升财务公平性。随着发达国家人口的老龄化，政府将越来越多地考虑对基于年龄的公共医疗计划进行改革。在评估政策选项时，财务公平性很可能是重要的考虑因素。这些结果表明，基于收入的药物计划可以提升财务公平性，尤其是在承诺维持或增加公共药物资金的情况下。

abstract.text: In the absence of formal health insurance, we argue that the strategies households adopt to finance health care have important implications for the measurement and interpretation of how health payments impact on consumption and poverty. Given data on source of finance, we propose to (a) approximate the relative impact of health payments on current consumption with a 'coping'-adjusted health expenditure ratio, (b) uncover poverty that is 'hidden' because total household expenditure is inflated by financial coping strategies and (c) identify poverty that is 'transient' because necessary consumption is temporarily sacrificed to pay for health care. Measures that ignore coping strategies not only overstate the risk to current consumption and exaggerate the scale of catastrophic payments but also overlook the long-run burden of health payments. Nationally representative data from India reveal that coping strategies finance as much as three-quarters of the cost of inpatient care. Payments for inpatient care exceed 10% of total household expenditure for around 30% of hospitalized households but less than 4% sacrifice more than 10% of current consumption to accommodate this spending.Ignoring health payments leads to underestimate poverty by 7-8% points among hospitalized households; 80% of this adjustment is hidden poverty due to coping.

10.1002/hec.1338.abstractZh: 在缺乏正式健康保险的情况下，我们认为家庭采用的融资策略对衡量和解释健康支出对消费和贫困的影响具有重要意义。根据融资来源的数据，我们提出：(a) 用“应对”调整后的健康支出比率来近似健康支出对当前消费的相对影响；(b) 揭示因家庭总支出被融资策略所夸大而“隐藏”的贫困现象；(c) 识别因为支付医疗费用而暂时牺牲必要消费而产生的“暂时性”贫困。忽略融资策略的衡量方法不仅会高估当前消费的风险并夸大灾难性支出的规模，还会忽视健康支出的长期负担。来自印度的全国代表性数据显示，融资策略为住院治疗的成本提供了高达四分之三的资金。大约30%的住院家庭在总家庭支出中用于支付住院治疗的费用超过10%，但不到4%的家庭为了支付这些费用而牺牲超过10%的当前消费。忽略健康支出会导致对住院家庭贫困程度的低估，这一低估幅度为7-8个百分点；其中80%的偏差是由于融资策略导致的“隐藏贫困”。

abstract.text: We argue that traditional health economic analysis is ill-equipped to estimate the cost effectiveness and cost benefit of interventions that aim at controlling and/or preventing public health emergencies of international concern (such as pandemic influenza or severe acute respiratory syndrome). The implicit assumption of partial equilibrium within both the health sector itself and--if a wider perspective is adopted--the economy as a whole would be violated by such emergencies. We propose an alternative, with the specific aim of accounting for the behavioural changes and capacity problems that are expected to occur when such an outbreak strikes.

10.1002/hec.1339.abstractZh: 我们认为，传统的健康经济分析在评估旨在控制和/或预防国际关注的公共卫生突发事件（如流感大流行或严重急性呼吸综合征）的干预措施的成本效益方面存在不足。这些突发事件会打破健康部门内部以及更广泛的经济体系中的部分均衡假设。我们提出了一种替代方法，旨在考虑到此类疫情爆发时预期会出现的行为变化和能力问题。

abstract.text: Using panel data, we estimate the impact of an increasing share of female physicians on the total output of Canadian physicians. A micro-econometric model is developed specifically for the Canadian context and estimated using administrative data on all Canadian physicians paid on a fee-for-service basis from 1989 to 1998. Our results suggest that female physicians systematically provide fewer services than their male counterparts for almost all specialties and provinces studied. Given that females account for an increasing share of the physician population and that female physicians provide, on average, fewer services, potentially important future reductions in total health-care service provision are likely.

10.1002/hec.1344.abstractZh: 通过面板数据，我们估计了女性医生比例增加对加拿大医生总体产出的影响。我们专门为加拿大情境开发了一个微观计量经济模型，并使用1989至1998年间所有按服务收费方式雇用的加拿大医生的行政数据进行了估计。我们的研究结果表明，对于几乎所有专业和省份而言，女性医生提供的服务数量普遍低于男性医生。鉴于女性医生在医生群体中的比例不断增加，且女性医生平均提供的服务数量较少，未来医疗服务总量的减少可能是不可避免的。

abstract.text: The impact of healthcare interventions on health utility values is most frequently measured using a preference-based instrument. Each of the available instruments instructs the respondent to report their health status over different recall periods ranging from the current day to the past month. In an ongoing randomised controlled trial in patients with advanced HIV disease, the impact of using a preference-based instrument with a 1-week recall period vs a 1-day recall period (e.g. today) for capturing recently resolved serious adverse events was measured. The results suggest that the instrument with a 1-week recall period gave lower utility values for recently resolved events in comparison with the instrument with a 1-day recall period. A plausible interpretation of these results is that the recall period was adhered to; for example, patients ignored the impact of recently resolved events in their response if the questionnaire asked them only about their health today. While there are limitations to our study, we believe further consideration should be given to the recall period used for preference-based instruments, and future research should examine other patient groups using a single instrument with multiple recall periods.

10.1002/hec.1351.abstractZh: 医疗干预对健康效用值的影响通常通过基于偏好的工具进行测量。这些工具要求受访者报告他们在不同回忆期内的健康状况，这些回忆期从当前日延伸到过去一个月。在一项针对晚期HIV患者的随机对照试验中，研究了使用基于偏好的工具与使用1天回忆期（例如今天）来捕捉最近发生的严重不良事件的影响。结果表明，使用1周回忆期的工具对最近发生的事件的效用值较低，而使用1天回忆期的工具则没有这种差异。对这些结果的一个合理解释是，受访者遵循了所设定的回忆期；例如，如果问卷仅询问他们今天的健康状况，那么他们可能会忽略最近发生的事件的影响。尽管我们的研究存在局限性，但我们认为应进一步考虑用于基于偏好工具的重忆期，并且未来的研究应使用单一工具来考察其他患者群体，并采用多个回忆期。

abstract.text: Recent literature has shown consistent evidence of a positive relationship between maternal employment and children's overweight status. These studies largely use average weekly work hours over the child's life to measure employment. This paper specifically aims at exploring the importance of the timing of employment. Using various econometric techniques to control for observable and unobservable child and family characteristics, the results show that full-time maternal employment during mid-childhood positively affects the probability of being overweight at age 16. There is no evidence that part-time or full-time employment at earlier/later ages affects this probability.

10.1002/hec.1357.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，母亲就业与儿童超重状况之间存在正相关关系。这些研究通常采用儿童成长过程中的平均每周工作小时数来衡量母亲的就业情况。本文特别关注就业时间的重要性。通过运用多种计量经济技术来控制可观测和不可观测的儿童及家庭特征，研究结果表明，在儿童中期阶段从事全职工作的母亲，会积极影响儿童在16岁时超重的概率。研究未发现早期或晚期从事兼职或全职工作会对这一概率产生影响。

abstract.text: The excess female infant mortality observed in South Asia has typically been attributed to gender discrimination in the intra-household allocation of food and medical care. However, studies on child nutrition find no evidence of gender differences. A natural explanation could be that in environments of high infant mortality of females, the surviving children are healthier, so that child nutrition cannot be studied independently of mortality. In this paper, we use data from the 2004 Bangladesh Demographic Health Survey to investigate if there are any gender differences in survival probabilities and whether this leads to differences in child nutrition. We argue the importance of establishing whether or not there exists a dependence relationship between the two random variables--infant mortality and child nutrition--and in order to detect this we employ a copula approach to model specification. The results suggest, for example, that while male children have a significantly lower likelihood of surviving their first year relative to female children, should they survive they have significantly better height-for-age Z-scores. From a policy perspective, household wealth and public health interventions such as vaccinations are found to be important predictors of better nutritional outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1379.abstractZh: 在南亚地区观察到的女性婴儿死亡率偏高现象，通常被认为是由于家庭内部在食物和医疗照顾方面的性别歧视所致。然而，关于儿童营养的研究并未发现性别差异的证据。一个自然的解释是，在女性婴儿死亡率较高的环境中，存活下来的儿童往往更健康，因此儿童营养状况无法独立于死亡率来研究。在本文中，我们利用了2004年孟加拉国人口健康调查的数据，来探讨是否存在生存概率上的性别差异，以及这种差异是否会导致儿童营养状况的不同。我们认为，确定婴儿死亡率和儿童营养状况这两个随机变量之间是否存在依赖关系非常重要，为了检测这一点，我们采用了copula方法来构建模型。研究结果表明，例如，与女性儿童相比，男性儿童在第一年存活的可能性显著降低，但如果能够存活下来，他们的身高年龄Z分数则明显更好。从政策角度来看，家庭财富和公共卫生干预措施，如疫苗接种，被认为是改善儿童营养状况的重要预测因素。

abstract.text: Economists have argued that obesity may lead to worse labor market outcomes, especially for women. Empirical methods to test this hypothesis have not thus far adequately controlled for the endogeneity of obesity. We use variation in genotype to predict variation in phenotype (obesity). Genetic information from specific genes linked to obesity in the biomedical literature provides strong exogenous variation in the body mass index and thus can be used as instrumental variables. These genes predict swings in weight of between 5 and 20 pounds for persons between five and six feet tall. We use additional genetic information to control for omitted variables correlated with both obesity and labor market outcomes. We analyzed data from the third wave of the Add Health data set, when respondents are in their mid-twenties. Results from our preferred models show no effect of lagged obesity on the probability of employment or on wages, for either men or women. This paper shows the potential of using genetic information in social sciences.

10.1002/hec.1383.abstractZh: 经济学家认为，肥胖可能导致更差的劳动力市场结果，尤其是对女性而言。迄今为止，用于验证这一假设的实证方法未能充分控制肥胖的内生性。我们利用基因变异来预测表型变异（肥胖）。生物医学文献中有关与肥胖相关的特定基因的遗传信息提供了体重指数的强外部变异，因此可以作为工具变量。这些基因能够预测身高在五到六英尺之间的人体重变化在5到20磅之间。我们还利用额外的遗传信息来控制与肥胖和劳动力市场结果相关的遗漏变量。我们分析了Add Health数据集的第三波数据，此时受访者年龄大约在二十五岁左右。我们优选模型的结果表明，肥胖的滞后效应对男性或女性的就业概率和工资水平都没有影响。本文展示了在社会科学中利用遗传信息的潜力。

abstract.text: This article examines the link between restrictions on the number of physicians and general practitioners' (GPs) earnings. Using a representative panel of 6016 French self-employed GPs over the years 1983-2004, we estimate an earnings function to identify experience, time and cohort effects. The estimated gap in earnings between 'good' and 'bad' cohorts can be as large as 25%. GPs who began their practices during the eighties have the lowest permanent earnings: they belong to the large cohorts of the baby-boom and face the consequences of an unlimited number of places in medical schools. Conversely, the decrease in the number of places in medical schools led to an increase in permanent earnings of GPs who began their practices in the mid-nineties. A stochastic dominance analysis shows that unobserved heterogeneity does not compensate for average differences in earnings between cohorts. These findings suggest that the first years of practice are decisive for a GP. If competition between physicians is too intense at the beginning of their careers, they will suffer from permanently lower earnings. To conclude, our results show that the policies aimed at reducing the number of medical students succeeded in buoying up physicians' permanent earnings.

10.1002/hec.1387.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医生数量限制与全科医生收入之间的关系。通过1983年至2004年间6016名法国自由职业全科医生的代表性样本数据，我们建立了收入函数模型，以识别经验、时间和群体效应。研究发现，“优秀”与“较差”群体之间的收入差距可达25%。在八十年代开始执业的全科医生，其长期收入最低；他们属于婴儿潮一代，而医学院的招生名额有限，这成为他们的困境。相反，九十年代中期开始执业的全科医生，由于医学院招生名额的增加，其长期收入有所提升。随机优势分析表明，未观察到的异质性无法弥补不同群体之间的平均收入差异。这些发现表明，执业初期对全科医生的收入至关重要。如果医生在职业生涯初期面临过于激烈的竞争，他们将面临长期较低的收入。总之，我们的研究结果表明，旨在减少医学院招生人数的政策确实有助于提升医生的长期收入。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to investigate both the technical and cost efficiency of more than 1500 German general hospitals. More specifically, it deals with the question how hospital efficiency varies with ownership, patient structure, and other exogenous factors, which are neither inputs to nor outputs of the production process. The empirical results for the years from 2001 to 2003 indicate that private and non-profit hospitals are on average less cost efficient and less technically efficient than publicly owned hospitals. The hospital rankings based on estimated efficiency scores turn out to be negatively correlated with average length of stay, which is highest in private hospitals. The results are derived by conducting a Stochastic Frontier Analysis assuming both Cobb-Douglas and translog production technologies and using a newly available and multifaceted administrative German data set.

10.1002/hec.1388.abstractZh: 本文首次对1500多家德国综合医院的技术效率与成本效率进行了研究。具体而言，本文探讨了医院效率如何随所有权、患者结构以及其他外部因素而变化，这些因素既不属于生产过程的输入，也不属于输出。2001至2003年的实证结果表明，私立医院与非营利性医院的平均成本效率和技术效率均低于公立医院。基于估算的效率得分所确定的医院排名与平均住院时间呈负相关，而私立医院的住院时间最长。这些结果是通过进行随机边界分析得出的，该分析采用了Cobb-Douglas和translog生产技术模型，并使用了最新获得的、包含多方面信息的德国行政数据。

abstract.text: The measurement of efficiency and productivity of health service delivery has become a small industry. This is a review of 317 published papers on frontier efficiency measurement. The techniques used are mainly based on non-parametric data envelopment analysis, but there is increasing use of parametric techniques, such as stochastic frontier analysis. Applications to hospitals and other health care organizations and areas are reviewed and summarised, and some meta-type analysis undertaken. Cautious conclusions are that public provision may be potentially more efficient than private, in certain settings. The paper also considers conceptualizations of efficiency, and points to dangers and opportunities in generating such information. Finally, some criteria for assessing the use and usefulness of efficiency studies are established, with a view to helping both researchers and those assessing whether or not to act upon published results.

10.1002/hec.1391.abstractZh: 对医疗服务提供效率和生产力的评估已成为一个小型研究领域。本文回顾了317篇关于前沿效率评估的论文。所使用的技术主要基于非参数数据包络分析，但参数技术如随机前沿分析的应用也越来越广泛。文章还回顾并总结了这些技术在医院和其他医疗保健组织中的应用情况，并进行了一些元分析。谨慎的结论是，在某些情况下，公共提供可能比私人提供更高效。文章还探讨了效率的概念化问题，并指出了在生成此类信息过程中存在的风险和机遇。最后，文章提出了一些评估效率研究使用性和实用性的标准，旨在帮助研究人员以及那些需要依据已发表结果来决定是否采取行动的人。

abstract.text: This paper examines links between the way in which a household spreads their food expenditure over time and the dietary quality of the food they purchase. I find that households who make more frequent, smaller food purchases buy healthier foods than households who make fewer, larger purchases. These households are more likely to purchase foods with a lower share of total calories from fats, saturated fats and a larger share of calories from fruits and vegetables. The analysis is extended using quantile regression. The effect of expenditure dispersion is found to be largest among households with poor diets i.e. those households with diets high in saturated fats and low in fruits and vegetables.

10.1002/hec.1393.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭在一段时间内分配食物支出的方式与其所购买食物的膳食质量之间的关系。研究发现，那些更频繁、更少量购买食物的家庭，所购买的食物通常更健康。这些家庭更有可能购买那些总热量中来自脂肪和饱和脂肪的比例较低，而来自水果和蔬菜的比例较高的食物。分析还采用了分位数回归方法进行了扩展。结果表明，在饮食状况较差的家庭中，即那些饱和脂肪含量较高、水果和蔬菜摄入量较低的家庭中，食物支出的分散性对膳食质量的影响最为显著。

abstract.text: In the health economics literature there is an ongoing debate over approaches used to estimate the efficiency of health systems at various levels, from the level of the individual hospital - or nursing home - up to that of the health system as a whole. The two most widely used approaches to evaluating the efficiency with which various units deliver care are non-parametric data envelopment analysis (DEA) and parametric stochastic frontier analysis (SFA). Productivity researchers tend to have very strong preferences over which methodology to use for efficiency estimation. In this paper, we use Monte Carlo simulation to compare the performance of DEA and SFA in terms of their ability to accurately estimate efficiency. We also evaluate quantile regression as a potential alternative approach. A Cobb-Douglas production function, random error terms and a technical inefficiency term with different distributions are used to calculate the observed output. The results, based on these experiments, suggest that neither DEA nor SFA can be regarded as clearly dominant, and that, depending on the quantile estimated, the quantile regression approach may be a useful addition to the armamentarium of methods for estimating technical efficiency.

10.1002/hec.1398.abstractZh: 在健康经济学文献中，关于如何估算不同层级健康系统的效率一直存在争议，从单个医院或护理院层面，到整个健康系统层面。用于评估各单位提供护理效率的两种最常用方法是非参数数据包络分析（DEA）和参数随机前沿分析（SFA）。生产力研究者往往对使用哪种方法来估算效率有非常强烈的偏好。在本文中，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟来比较DEA和SFA在准确估算效率方面的表现。我们还评估了分位数回归作为一种潜在替代方法。我们使用Cobb-Douglas生产函数、随机误差项以及具有不同分布的技术无效项来计算观测到的产出。基于这些实验的结果表明，DEA和SFA都不能被视为明显占优的方法，而且根据所估计的分位数，分位数回归方法可能是估算技术效率方法体系中的一个有用补充。

abstract.text: In recent years the cost of health insurance has been increasing much faster than wages. In the face of these rising costs, many employers will have to make difficult decisions about whether to cut back health benefits or to compensate workers with lower wages or lower wage growth. In this paper, we ask the question, "Which do workers value more -- one additional dollar's worth of health benefits or one more dollar in their pockets?" Using a new approach to obtaining estimates of insured workers' marginal valuation of health benefits this paper estimates how much, on average, employees value the marginal dollar paid by employers for their workers' health insurance. We find that insured workers value the marginal health premium dollar at significantly less than the marginal wage dollar. However, workers value insurance generosity very highly. The marginal dollar spent on health insurance that adds an additional dollar's worth of observable dimensions of plan generosity, such as lower deductibles or coverage of additional services, is valued at significantly more than one dollar.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.10.013.abstractZh: 近年来，健康保险的成本增长速度远远超过了工资的增长速度。面对如此上升的成本，许多雇主将不得不做出艰难的决定：是削减健康福利，还是以较低的工资或较慢的工资增长来补偿员工。在本文中，我们提出了一个问题：“员工更看重什么——是额外的健康福利价值一美元，还是口袋里多出一美元？”通过采用一种新的方法来估算受保员工对健康福利的边际价值，本文估计了员工平均愿意为雇主支付的健康保险边际费用。我们发现，受保员工对健康保险边际费用的重视程度明显低于对工资的重视程度。然而，员工非常看重保险提供的福利程度。为增加健康保险福利而额外花费的每一美元，比如降低免赔额或提供额外的服务，其价值远高于一美元。

abstract.text: This paper uses the British Health and Lifestyle Survey (1984-1985) data and the longitudinal follow-up of May 2003 to investigate the determinants of premature mortality in Great Britain and the contribution of lifestyle choices to socio-economic inequality in mortality. A behavioural model, which relates premature mortality to a set of observable and unobservable factors, is considered. A maximum simulated likelihood (MSL) approach for a multivariate probit (MVP) is used to estimate a recursive system of equations for mortality, morbidity and lifestyles. Health inequality is explored using the Gini coefficient and a decomposition technique. The decomposition analysis for predicted mortality shows that, after allowing for endogeneity, lifestyles contribute strongly to inequality in mortality, reducing the direct role of socio-economic status. This contradicts the view, which is widely held in epidemiology, that lifestyles make a relatively minor contribution to observed socio-economic gradients in health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.001.abstractZh: 本文利用英国健康与生活方式调查（1984-1985年）的数据以及2003年5月的纵向随访数据，研究英国早死的决定因素以及生活方式选择对社会经济不平等中死亡率的影响。文中采用了一个行为模型，将早死与一系列可观测和不可观测因素联系起来。采用最大模拟似然法对多变量Probit模型进行估计，以构建死亡率、发病率和生活方式的递归方程组。通过基尼系数和分解技术探讨了健康不平等问题。分解分析显示，在考虑内生性因素后，生活方式对死亡率不平等的贡献显著，从而削弱了社会经济地位的直接作用。这与流行病学中普遍持有的观点相矛盾，即生活方式对观察到的社会经济健康梯度贡献相对较小。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of informal care on Medicare expenditures not only for care provided by children but also by the source of informal care (sons versus daughters, children versus others) and recipient characteristics (marital status). Our conceptual framework predicts heterogeneous effectiveness by source and recipient of informal care. We estimate two-part expenditure models as a function of informal care, controlling for endogeneity. We find that informal care by children reduces Medicare long-term care and inpatient expenditures of single elderly. We find that children are less effective caregivers among recipients who are married. For single elderly, child caregivers are more effective than other types. Gender of a child caregiver does not matter.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.002.abstractZh: 我们估计了非正式照顾对医疗保险支出的影响，不仅涉及由儿童提供的照顾，还涉及非正式照顾的提供方（儿子与女儿、儿童与其他人）以及接受者的特征（婚姻状况）。我们的概念框架预测，非正式照顾的提供方和接受者之间存在不同的效果差异。我们建立了两部分支出模型，以非正式照顾为变量，并控制了内生性问题。研究发现，儿童提供的非正式照顾减少了单身老年人的长期护理和住院支出。我们还发现，在已婚接受者中，儿童作为照顾者时效果较差。对于单身老年人而言，儿童作为照顾者比其他类型的照顾者更有效。儿童照顾者的性别并不重要。

abstract.text: We present a dynamic general equilibrium model of the U.S. economy and the medical sector in which the adoption of new medical treatments is endogenous and the demand for medical services is conditional on the state of technology. We use this model to prepare 75-year medical spending forecasts and a projection of the Medicare actuarial balance, and we compare our results to those obtained from a method that has been used by government actuaries. Our baseline forecast predicts slower health spending growth in the long run and a lower Medicare actuarial deficit relative to the previous projection methodology.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.003.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态的一般均衡模型，用于分析美国经济和医疗行业。在该模型中，新医疗技术的采用是内生的，而医疗服务的需求则取决于技术状况。我们利用该模型进行了75年的医疗支出预测，并预测了医疗保险的精算平衡情况。我们将我们的结果与政府精算师使用的方法得出的结果进行了比较。我们的基线预测表明，从长期来看，医疗支出的增长将会放缓，而医疗保险的精算赤字也将低于之前的预测方法。

abstract.text: Past studies have demonstrated an association between maternal depression and poor management of pediatric asthma. Using an instrumental variables strategy to address the endogeneity of depression treatment, I build on this literature to answer the question of whether treating maternal depression leads to an improvement in pediatric asthma management. I show that treatment of mother's depression improves management of child's asthma, resulting in a reduction in asthma costs in the 6-month period following diagnosis of $798 per asthmatic child whose mother is treated for depression.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.005.abstractZh: 过去的研究表明，母亲抑郁与儿童哮喘管理不善之间存在关联。采用工具变量策略来解决抑郁治疗的内生性问题，我基于这些研究来探讨治疗母亲抑郁是否有助于改善儿童哮喘管理。我的研究表明，治疗母亲的抑郁可以改善儿童哮喘的管理，从而在诊断后6个月内，每名接受抑郁治疗的母亲所抚养的哮喘儿童，其哮喘相关费用减少了798美元。

abstract.text: Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) is a leading cause of mortality among infants and is responsible for thousands of infant deaths every year. Prenatal smoking and postnatal environmental smoke have been identified as strong risk factors for SIDS. Given the link between smoking and SIDS, this paper examines the direct effects of cigarette prices, taxes and clean indoor air laws in explaining changes in the incidence of SIDS over time in the United States. State-level counts of SIDS cases are generated from death certificates for 1973-2003. After controlling for some observed and unobserved confounding factors, the results show that higher cigarette prices and taxes are associated with reductions in SIDS cases. Stronger restrictions on smoking in workplaces, restaurants and child care centers are also effective in reducing SIDS deaths.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.03.006.abstractZh: 婴儿猝死综合症（SIDS）是婴儿死亡的主要原因之一，每年导致数千名婴儿死亡。孕期吸烟和产后环境中的烟雾已被确定为SIDS的重要风险因素。鉴于吸烟与SIDS之间的关联，本文探讨了香烟价格、税收以及清洁室内空气质量法规对美国SIDS发病率随时间变化的影响。数据来源于1973年至2003年的死亡证明记录。在控制了一些可观测和不可观测的混杂因素后，研究结果表明，较高的香烟价格和税收与SIDS病例的减少有关。对工作场所、餐馆和托儿中心吸烟行为的严格限制也有助于减少SIDS死亡案例。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical model to identify conditions under which price and income changes are most likely to change weight. Although it is intuitive that raising the price of high-calorie food will decrease consumption of such goods; it is not clear that such an outcome will actually reduce weight. Our empirical analysis demonstrates a case where a tax on food away from home, a food intake category blamed for much of the rise in obesity, could lead to an increase in body weight; a finding which emphasizes the need to employ economic modeling when developing public policy to reduce obesity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.04.001.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个理论模型，以识别价格和收入变化最有可能改变体重的条件。虽然提高高热量食品的价格会降低这类商品的消费，但尚不清楚这种结果是否真的能减少体重。我们的实证分析表明，对外出就餐的食品征税——这种食品摄入类别被认为是肥胖率上升的主要原因之一——可能会导致体重增加；这一发现强调了在制定减少肥胖的公共政策时，需要运用经济模型进行分析。

abstract.text: There is widespread concern about the quality of health care in the US, and the effect of provider payments on the quality of care is an important and unsettled issue in this debate. The critical question is whether changes in provider payments affect health. To date there is relatively little research on this question. Here, we present evidence of the effect of plausibly exogenous changes in Medicare reimbursement--caused by geographical reclassification--on hospital staffing (nurses) and patient outcomes. We find that changes in Medicare reimbursement levels of approximately 10% have no meaningful effect on hospital use of resources or patient outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.04.003.abstractZh: 目前，人们对美国医疗保健的质量存在广泛的担忧，而医疗服务提供者支付方式对护理质量的影响则是这一讨论中一个重要且尚未解决的问题。关键问题在于，医疗服务提供者支付方式的改变是否会影响健康。迄今为止，关于这一问题的研究相对较少。本文提供了关于Medicare报销金额因地理重新分类而发生的合理外生变化对医院人员配置（如护士）以及患者结果的影响的实证数据。我们发现，Medicare报销金额增加约10%并不会对医院资源使用或患者结果产生显著影响。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence suggests that people's risk-perceptions are often systematically biased. This paper develops a simple framework to analyse public policy when this is the case. Expected utility (well-being) is shown to depend on both objective and perceived risks (beliefs). The latter are important because of the fear associated with the risk and as a basis for corrective taxation and second-best adjustments. Optimality rules for public provision of risk-reducing investments, "internality-correcting" taxation (e.g. fat taxes) and provision of costly information to reduce people's risk-perception bias are presented.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.04.004.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，人们的风险认知往往存在系统性偏差。本文提出了一个简单的框架来分析这种情况下的公共政策。预期效用（即幸福感）取决于客观风险和感知风险（信念）。后者之所以重要，是因为风险会引发恐惧，同时也是进行矫正性税收和二次最优调整的基础。文中还提出了关于公共提供降低风险的投资、实施“内部矫正”性税收（例如肥胖税）以及提供昂贵信息以减少人们风险认知偏差的最优规则。

abstract.text: Few cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) models have accounted for geographic variation in input parameters. This paper describes a deterministic discrete-time multi-state model to estimate the cost-effectiveness of vector control policies for Chagas disease, where implementation varies according to village characteristics. The model outputs include the total number of new infections, disability adjusted life years (DALYs) incurred, costs of associated healthcare, and total costs of the Ministry of Health's control policy for house surveillance and spraying. Incremental net benefits were estimated to determine Colombian villages in which it is cost-effective to implement the control policy. The robustness of these conclusions was evaluated by deterministic sensitivity analyses. The model should help provide a decision-support system to compare control policies and to allocate resources geographically.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.04.005.abstractZh: 目前，很少有成本效益分析模型考虑输入参数的地理差异。本文描述了一个确定性离散时间多状态模型，用于估算针对查加斯病的向量控制政策的成本效益，其中实施策略会根据村庄特征而有所不同。模型输出结果包括新感染病例总数、因疾病造成的伤残调整生命年数、相关医疗成本，以及卫生部实施房屋监测和喷洒控制政策的总成本。通过增量净效益分析，确定了在哥伦比亚哪些村庄实施控制政策具有成本效益。通过确定性敏感性分析，对这些结论的稳健性进行了评估。该模型有助于提供一个决策支持系统，以比较不同的控制政策，并实现资源的地理分配。

abstract.text: This study provides empirical evidence regarding the income productivity of health human capital in China. We appeal to concepts from human capital theory to support a basic model that treats health as a form of human capital in the income production process. Our model examines the economic return at the household level from the health of its individual members. We estimate this with a longitudinal sample drawn from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS), allowing us to exploit "within" variation in health and income to address possible unobservables biasing estimates of the impact of health on income in the simple cross-sectional setting. Household income is strongly influenced by the health of its members, particularly in rural areas. These findings could have important implications for health and economic policy-making aimed at reducing the long-standing urban-rural economic gap and more comprehensively insuring the rural population against health and economic risk.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.001.abstractZh: 本研究提供了关于中国健康人力资本收入生产率的实证证据。我们借鉴人力资本理论的概念，构建了一个基本模型，将健康视为收入生产过程中的一种人力资本形式。我们的模型考察了家庭层面个体成员健康状况所带来的经济回报。我们采用来自中国健康与营养调查（CHNS）的纵向样本数据来进行估计，从而能够利用健康与收入之间的“内部”差异，来弥补简单横截面分析中可能存在的不可观测因素对健康对收入影响估计的偏差。家庭收入受到其成员健康状况的强烈影响，尤其是在农村地区。这些发现对于旨在缩小长期存在的城乡经济差距以及为农村人口提供更全面的健康和经济风险保障的健康与经济政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of pain dynamics in subsequently affecting dynamics in self-reported work disability and the dynamics of employment patterns of older workers in the US. Not only is pain prevalence quite high, there also are many transitions in and out of pain at these ages. We investigate pain and its relationship to health (work disability) and work in a dynamic panel data model, using six biennial waves from the Health and Retirement Study. We find that the dynamics of the presence of pain are central to understanding the dynamics of self-reported work disability and through this pathway, pain dynamics are also a significant factor in the dynamic patterns of employment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了疼痛动态在随后影响自我报告的工作残疾状况以及美国老年工人就业模式动态中的作用。不仅疼痛的患病率相当高，而且在这些年龄段，疼痛的发作和缓解也频繁发生。我们采用动态面板数据模型，利用《健康与退休研究》的六次双年度数据，探讨了疼痛与其与健康（工作残疾）以及工作之间的关系。研究发现，疼痛存在的动态变化对于理解自我报告的工作残疾状况至关重要，而疼痛动态也是就业模式动态变化的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: Numerous researchers have explored whether general practitioners compensate for a shortage of patients by providing more items of treatment. Empirical testing of this hypothesis often lacks a valid measure of the relevant patient population. In the Norwegian case, researchers have exploited the fact that most patients are registered on a patient list of one general practitioner. However, a significant number of patients move between physicians. We show that physicians with a deficit of patients on the list attract more external patients than those with a surplus of patients on the list. In contrast with previous research, we find no evidence of revenue compensation when consultations with external patients are taken into account.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.003.abstractZh: 许多研究人员探讨了全科医生是否通过提供更多的治疗项目来弥补患者数量的不足。对这一假设的实证测试往往缺乏有效的相关患者群体衡量方法。在挪威的案例中，研究人员利用了大多数患者都登记在一位全科医生的患者名单上的事实。然而，相当数量的患者会在不同医生之间转移。我们发现，那些在患者名单上患者数量不足的医疗人员，比那些患者数量过剩的医疗人员更能吸引外部患者。与以往的研究不同，我们发现，在考虑与外部患者的咨询时，并没有证据表明存在收入补偿的情况。

abstract.text: Prior studies find that the growth of managed care through the early 1990s introduced a strong positive relationship between price and concentration in hospital markets. We hypothesize that the relaxation of constraints on consumer choice in response to a "managed care backlash" has diminished the price sensitivity of demand facing hospitals, reducing or possibly reversing the price-concentration relationship. We test this hypothesis by studying the price/concentration relationship for hospitals in California and Florida for selected years between 1990 and 2003, while addressing the potential endogeneity of concentration. We find an increasingly positive price/concentration in the 1990s with a peak occurring by 2001. Between 2001 and 2003, the growth in this relationship halts and possibly reverses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.004.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，从20世纪90年代初开始，管理式医疗的发展使得医院市场中的价格与集中度之间存在强烈的正相关关系。我们假设，由于“管理式医疗的反动”导致消费者选择的限制被放宽，医院面对的需求对价格的敏感性降低，从而可能减弱或逆转了价格与集中度之间的关系。我们通过研究1990年至2003年间加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州医院的价格与集中度关系来验证这一假设，同时考虑集中度的潜在内生性。研究发现，在20世纪90年代，价格与集中度之间的关系逐渐增强，并在2001年达到顶峰。在2001年至2003年期间，这种关系的发展趋于停滞，甚至可能逆转。

abstract.text: Virtually all social science research related to obesity studies a person's body mass index (BMI). Yet there is wide agreement in the medical literature that BMI is seriously flawed because it does not distinguish fat from fat-free mass such as muscle and bone. This paper studies data that include multiple measures of fatness and finds that many important patterns, such as who is classified as obese, group rates of obesity, and correlations of obesity with social science outcomes, are all sensitive to the measure of fatness and obesity used. We show that, relative to percent body fat, BMI misclassifies substantial fractions of individuals as obese or non-obese; in general, BMI is less accurate classifying men than women. Furthermore, when percent body fat instead of BMI is used to define obesity, the gap in obesity between white and African American men increases substantially but the gap in obesity between African American and white women is cut in half. Finally, total body fat is negatively correlated with employment for some groups and fat-free mass is not significantly correlated with employment for any group, a difference that was obscured in previous research that studied BMI. In the long run, social science datasets should include more accurate measures of fatness. In the short run, estimating more accurate measures of fatness using height and weight is not possible except by making unattractive assumptions, but there is also no reason to adhere uncritically to BMI as a measure of fatness. Social science research on obesity would be enriched by greater consideration of alternate specifications of weight and height and more accurate measures of fatness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.005.abstractZh: 几乎所有与肥胖相关的社会科学研究都关注一个人的体质指数（BMI）。然而，医学文献中普遍认为BMI存在严重缺陷，因为它无法区分脂肪与非脂肪组织，如肌肉和骨骼。本文研究了包含多种脂肪测量指标的数据，发现许多重要模式，例如哪些人被归类为肥胖、不同群体的肥胖率以及肥胖与社会科学结果之间的相关性，都受到所使用的脂肪测量指标的影响。研究表明，相对于体脂百分比而言，BMI会将相当一部分个体误分类为肥胖或非肥胖；总体而言，BMI在分类男性时不如在分类女性时准确。此外，当使用体脂百分比而非BMI来定义肥胖时，白人男性与非洲裔美国男性之间的肥胖差距会显著增大，而非洲裔美国女性与白人女性之间的肥胖差距则减半。最后，总体脂对某些群体而言与就业状况呈负相关，而非脂肪组织与任何群体的就业状况均无显著相关性，这一差异在之前使用BMI的研究中并未被充分考虑。从长远来看，社会科学数据集应包含更精确的脂肪测量指标。短期内，除非做出不切实际的假设，否则无法使用身高和体重来估算更精确的脂肪测量值。但也没有理由不加批判地接受BMI作为脂肪的测量指标。通过对体重和身高的其他规格以及更精确的脂肪测量方法进行更深入的研究，肥胖的社会科学研究将会得到丰富。

abstract.text: The share of health care expenditure in GDP rises rapidly in virtually all OECD countries, causing increasing concern among politicians and the general public. Yet, economists have to date failed to reach an agreement on what the main determinants of this development are. This paper revisits Baumol's [Baumol, W.J., 1967. Macroeconomics of unbalanced growth: the anatomy of urban crisis. American Economic Review 57 (3), 415-426] model of 'unbalanced growth', showing that the latter offers a ready explanation for the observed inexorable rise in health care expenditure. The main implication of Baumol's model in this context is that health care expenditure is driven by wage increases in excess of productivity growth.
