This hypothesis is tested empirically using data from a panel of 19 OECD countries. Our tests yield robust evidence in favor of Baumol's theory.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.006.abstractZh: 几乎所有经合组织国家的医疗保健支出占GDP的比例迅速上升，这引起了政界人士和公众越来越多的担忧。然而，经济学家至今尚未就这一趋势的主要决定因素达成一致。本文重新审视了Baumol的“不平衡增长”模型，指出该模型能够很好地解释医疗保健支出不断上升的现象。Baumol模型的主要结论是，医疗保健支出的增加是由工资增长超过生产率增长所驱动的。本文利用19个经合组织国家的面板数据对这一假设进行了实证检验，结果支持Baumol的理论。

abstract.text: It is believed that income affects health directly but it is argued that indirect income effects due to relative deprivation may be equally important. This paper investigates these relationships using parametric and semiparametric panel data models which ameliorate problems of mis-specification and unobservable heterogeneity. By allowing for a flexible functional form of income we ensure that coefficients on relative deprivation variables are not an artefact of a highly non-linear relationship between health and income. The results provide strong evidence for the impact of income on self-reported measures of health for men and women. These results are robust across a range of techniques and are resilient to the inclusion of measures of relative deprivation. The parametric results for relative deprivation largely reject its influence on health, although there is some evidence of an effect in the semiparametric models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.007.abstractZh: 人们认为收入直接影响健康，但有人认为由于相对剥夺导致的间接收入效应同样重要。本文使用参数和半参数面板数据模型来研究这些关系，这些模型能够解决模型设定不准确和不可观测的异质性问题。通过允许收入具有灵活的函数形式，我们可以确保相对剥夺变量上的系数不是健康和收入之间高度非线性关系的产物。研究结果有力证明了收入对男女自我报告的健康状况的影响。这些结果在不同技术下都具有稳健性，并且即使纳入相对剥夺的衡量指标，结果仍然保持稳定。参数模型的结果基本否定了相对剥夺对健康的影响，尽管在半参数模型中存在一些证据支持其影响。

abstract.text: Several studies have examined the effects of state cigarette tax increases on youth substance use over the 1990s, with most--but not all--finding that higher taxes reduce youth consumption of tobacco. We advance the literature by using data from the 1991 to 2005 waves of the national Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS), providing information on over 100,000 high school age youths. We also are the first to make use of hundreds of independently fielded state and local versions of the YRBS, reflecting data from over 750,000 youths. Importantly, these data are to our knowledge the only sources of relevant information on youth smoking that were explicitly designed to be representative of the sampled state or locality. We estimate two-way fixed effects models of the effect of state cigarette taxes on youth smoking, controlling for survey demographics and area and year fixed effects. Our most consistent finding is that--contrary to some recent research--the large state tobacco tax increases of the past 15 years were associated with significant reductions in smoking participation and frequent smoking by youths. Our price elasticity estimates for smoking participation by high school youths are generally smaller than previous cross-sectional approaches but are similar to recent quasi-experimental estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.05.008.abstractZh: 多项研究探讨了20世纪90年代州级香烟税增加对青少年物质使用的影响，其中大多数研究（但并非全部）都发现更高的税收会减少青少年的烟草消费。我们通过使用1991年至2005年间的全国青少年风险行为调查数据，对现有研究进行了补充。这些数据涵盖了超过10万名高中年龄段的青少年。我们也是首次利用数百个独立进行的州级和地区级青少年风险行为调查数据，这些数据涵盖了超过75万名青少年。重要的是，据我们所知，这些数据是唯一专门设计用于反映所抽样州或地区情况的青少年吸烟相关信息的来源。我们建立了双向固定效应模型，以控制调查人口统计信息以及地区和年份的固定效应，来研究州级香烟税对青少年吸烟的影响。我们最一致的发现是——与一些近期研究相反——过去15年中州级烟草税的大幅增加与青少年吸烟参与率和频繁吸烟行为的显著减少有关。我们对高中青少年吸烟参与率的价格弹性估计值通常比之前的横断面研究方法要小，但与最近的准实验研究估计值相似。

abstract.text: The presence of voluntary deductibles in the Swiss and Dutch mandatory health insurance has important implications for the respective risk equalization systems. In a theoretical analysis, we discuss the consequences of equalizing three types of expenditures: the net claims that are reimbursed by the insurer, the out-of-pocket expenditures and the expenditure savings due to moral hazard reduction. Equalizing only the net claims, as done in Switzerland, creates incentives for cream skimming and prevents insurers from incorporating out-of-pocket expenditures and moral hazard reductions into their premium structure. In an empirical analysis, we examine the effect of self-selection and conclude that the Swiss and Dutch risk equalization systems do not fully adjust for differences in health status between those who choose a deductible and those who do not. We discuss how this may lead to incentives for cream skimming and to a reduction of cross-subsidies from healthy to unhealthy individuals compared to a situation without voluntary deductibles.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.06.001.abstractZh: 瑞士和荷兰的强制性健康保险中存在的自愿免赔额对各自的风险均衡体系具有重要意义。在理论分析中，我们探讨了均衡三种类型的支出所带来的后果：由保险公司报销的净索赔金额、自付费用以及因减少道德风险而导致的费用节省。仅均衡净索赔金额的做法，如瑞士所采用的，会促使保险行业进行利益输送，并阻碍保险公司将自付费用和减少道德风险的因素纳入其保费结构中。在实证分析中，我们考察了自我选择的影响，并得出结论：瑞士和荷兰的风险均衡体系未能充分考虑到选择免赔额与未选择免赔额的人群在健康状况上的差异。我们讨论了这种情况如何可能导致利益输送，以及与没有自愿免赔额的情况相比，健康个体向不健康个体进行交叉补贴的情况会有所减少。

abstract.text: In surveys of well-being, countries such as Denmark and the Netherlands emerge as particularly happy while nations like Germany and Italy report lower levels of happiness. But are these kinds of findings credible? This paper provides some evidence that the answer is yes. Using data on 16 countries, it shows that happier nations report systematically lower levels of hypertension. As well as potentially validating the differences in measured happiness across nations, this suggests that blood-pressure readings might be valuable as part of a national well-being index. A new ranking of European nations' GHQ-N6 mental health scores is also given.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.06.002.abstractZh: 在幸福感调查中，像丹麦和荷兰这样的国家被认定为特别幸福，而像德国和意大利这样的国家则报告的幸福感水平较低。但这些发现可信吗？本文提供了一些证据，表明答案是肯定的。通过对16个国家的数据分析，发现幸福感较高的国家高血压的发病率系统性地较低。这不仅有助于验证不同国家之间幸福感差异的存在，还表明血压指标可能作为国家幸福感指数的一部分具有价值。文章还给出了欧洲各国GHQ-N6心理健康评分的最新排名。

abstract.text: We study the strategic interaction between the pricing decisions of a pharmaceutical firm and the reimbursement decisions of a government agency which grants reimbursement rights to patients for whom new drugs are most cost-effective. If the reimbursement decision precedes pricing, the agency only reimburses some patients if the drug's private and public health benefits diverge. This is, there are consumption externalities and the variable cost of the drug exceeds the alternative's. Contrarily, if the firm can commit to a price before reimbursement, a strategic effect implies that by setting a sufficiently high price, the firm can make the agency more willing to reimburse than without commitment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.06.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了制药公司的定价决策与政府机构的报销决策之间的战略互动关系。政府机构负责为那些新药物成本效益最高的患者提供报销权利。如果报销决策先于定价决策，那么只有当药物的私人健康效益与公共健康效益存在差异时，该机构才会对部分患者进行报销。也就是说，存在消费外部性，且该药物的变动成本高于其他替代方案。相反，如果制药公司能够在报销决策之前确定价格，那么通过设定足够高的价格，公司可以促使机构更愿意进行报销，而无需这种承诺。

abstract.text: There is a well-established debate between Heckman sample selection and two-part models in health econometrics, particularly when no obvious exclusion restrictions are available. Most of this debate has focussed on the application of these models to health care expenditure. This paper revisits the debate in the context of female smoking and drinking, and evaluates the two approaches on three grounds: theoretical, practical and statistical. The two-part model is generally favoured but it is stressed that this comparison should be carried out on a case-by-case basis.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.07.001.abstractZh: 在健康经济计量学中，关于Heckman样本选择与两部分模型之间的争论由来已久，尤其是在没有明显的排除限制条件的情况下。这一争论大多集中在将这些模型应用于医疗保健支出上。本文重新审视了这一争论，将其置于女性吸烟和饮酒的背景下，并从理论、实践和统计三个角度对这两种方法进行了评估。总体而言，两部分模型更受青睐，但强调这种比较应该逐案进行。

abstract.text: Recently, there has been much interest in using the cost-effectiveness acceptability curve (CEAC) to measure the statistical evidence of cost-effectiveness. The CEAC has two well established but fundamentally different interpretations: one frequentist and one Bayesian. As an alternative, we suggest characterizing the statistical evidence about cost-effectiveness using the likelihood function (the key element of both approaches). Its interpretation is neither dependent on the sample space nor on the prior distribution. Moreover, the probability of observing misleading evidence is low and controllable, so this approach is justifiable in the traditional sense of frequentist long-run behaviour. We propose a new graphic for displaying the evidence about cost-effectiveness and explore the strengths of likelihood methods using data from an economic evaluation of a Program in Assertive Community Treatment (PACT).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.07.002.abstractZh: 最近，人们非常关注使用成本效益可接受性曲线来衡量成本效益的统计证据。成本效益可接受性曲线有两种被广泛认可但本质上不同的解释：一种属于频率主义观点，另一种属于贝叶斯观点。作为替代方案，我们建议利用似然函数来描述成本效益的统计证据（这是两种方法的共同要素）。似然函数的解释既不依赖于样本空间，也不依赖于先验分布。此外，观察到误导性证据的概率较低且可控，因此这种方法在频率主义长期行为传统意义上是合理的。我们提出了一种新的图形方式来表示成本效益的证据，并通过一项关于积极社区治疗计划的经济评估数据来探讨似然方法的优势。

abstract.text: 'Extra-welfarism' has received some attention in health economics, yet there is little consensus on what distinguishes it from more conventional 'welfarist economics'. In this paper, we seek to identify the characteristics of each in order to make a systematic comparison of the ways in which they evaluate alternative social states. The focus, though this is not intended to be exclusive, is on health. Specifically, we highlight four areas in which the two schools differ: (i) the outcomes considered relevant in an evaluation; (ii) the sources of valuation of the relevant outcomes; (iii) the basis of weighting of relevant outcomes and (iv) interpersonal comparisons. We conclude that these differences are substantive.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.07.003.abstractZh: “额外福利主义”在健康经济学领域受到了一些关注，但关于它与更传统的“福利主义经济学”之间的区别，目前还没有达成共识。在本文中，我们试图确定这两种经济学流派各自的特点，以便系统地比较它们对不同社会状态的评估方式。虽然本文并不打算排除其他领域，但重点在于健康领域。具体来说，我们指出了这两种经济学流派在以下四个方面的差异：(i) 评估中考虑的结果；(ii) 对相关结果的评估依据；(iii) 相关结果的权重分配依据；(iv) 人际比较的方式。我们得出结论，这些差异是实质性的。

abstract.text: We introduce a new instrument to evaluate the impact of behavior on outcomes when the behavior may be a function of unobserved variables that also affect outcomes. The instrument is introduced through a test of patient sensitivity to increases in the quality of care provided by doctors. We utilize the Hawthorne effect, in which the very presence of a research team causes doctors to provide measurably superior quality care for any type of patient to show that patients respond to this increased quality and are more likely to be very satisfied. Using the Hawthorne effect as an instrument allows us to examine the responsiveness of satisfaction to improvements in quality despite the fact that patient satisfaction is subjective and jointly produced with quality during the course of a consultation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.07.004.abstractZh: 我们引入了一种新的工具来评估行为对结果的影响，这种行为可能是受未观测变量影响的函数，而这些未观测变量同样会影响结果。该工具是通过测试患者对医生提供的护理质量提升的敏感度来引入的。我们利用了霍桑效应，即研究团队的存在使得医生能够为任何类型的患者提供质量更高的护理，从而表明患者会对这种质量的提升作出反应，并且更有可能感到非常满意。利用霍桑效应作为工具，我们可以考察满意度对质量提升的响应，尽管患者的满意度是主观的，并且会在咨询过程中与服务质量共同产生。

abstract.text: We extend the recent literature on peer effects to test the possible role of asymmetric social influences in the determination of youth smoking. We analyzed cigarette smoking among people aged 15-24 in approximately 90,000 households in the 1992-1999 U.S. Current Population Surveys. The presence of additional smoking sibling in a household, we estimated, raised a young person's probability of smoking by 7.6%, while each non-smoking sibling lowered the probability by an estimated 3.5%. Moreover, the overall deterrent effect of an increase in cigarette price on the probability of smoking was approximately 60% greater than the estimated effect when peer influences were held constant. The concept of asymmetric social influence may have applications in other fields, including labor economics, education, crime prevention, and group dynamics.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.07.005.abstractZh: 我们扩展了关于同伴效应的现有研究，以探讨不对称社会影响在青少年吸烟行为决定中的可能作用。我们分析了1992-1999年美国当前人口调查中约9万个家庭中15-24岁人群的吸烟情况。研究发现，家庭中有一个吸烟的兄弟姐妹时，年轻人吸烟的概率会上升7.6%；而每个不吸烟的兄弟姐妹则会使吸烟概率下降约3.5%。此外，香烟价格上升对吸烟概率的整体抑制作用，比在保持同伴影响不变的情况下估计的效应高出约60%。不对称社会影响的概念可能适用于其他领域，包括劳动经济学、教育、犯罪预防以及群体动力学等。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a data envelopment method to separate avoidable and unavoidable mortality risks. As unavoidable mortality is either beyond the control of humanity or likely to be very cost-ineffective to reduce in the short to medium term, avoidable mortality is of much greater practical relevance in measuring wellbeing and inequality. The new method is applied to a dataset consisting of life tables for 191 countries in the year 2000 to obtain a reference distribution of unavoidable mortality risks. The reference distribution is used to improve on the standard age-at-death measure to obtain an age-at-avoidable-death measure. Compared with the standard measure, age-at-avoidable-death provides a very different picture of wellbeing, and more so when it comes to inequality measures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.003.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种数据包络分析法，用于区分可避免与不可避免的死亡风险。由于不可避免的死亡风险要么超出人类的控制范围，要么在短期内难以有效降低，因此可避免死亡风险在衡量福祉和不平等方面具有更大的实际意义。该方法应用于包含191个国家在2000年的生命表数据集，以得出不可避免的死亡风险参考分布。利用该参考分布，可以改进传统的死亡年龄指标，得到可避免死亡年龄指标。与传统的死亡年龄指标相比，可避免死亡年龄指标能够提供更全面的福祉状况描述，尤其是在衡量不平等方面。

abstract.text: We examine the role of quality and waiting time in health insurance when there is ex post moral hazard. Quality and waiting time provide additional instruments to control demand and potentially can improve the trade-off between optimal risk bearing and optimal consumption of health care. We show that optimal quality is lower than it would be in the absence of ex post moral hazard. But it is never optimal to have a positive waiting time if the marginal cost of waiting is higher for patients with greater benefits from health care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了在存在事后道德风险的情况下，质量与等待时间对医疗保险的影响。质量和等待时间提供了额外的工具来控制需求，并可能改善最优风险承担与最优医疗消费之间的权衡。我们发现，最优质量水平低于没有事后道德风险的情况下的水平。但是，如果等待的边际成本对于从医疗服务中获益更多的人来说更高，那么拥有正的等待时间从来都不是最优的。

abstract.text: We estimate the distributional incidence of health care financing in 13 Asian territories that account for 55% of the Asian population. In all territories, higher-income households contribute more to the financing of health care. The better-off contribute more as a proportion of ability to pay in most low- and lower-middle-income territories. Health care financing is slightly regressive in three high-income economies with universal social insurance. Direct taxation is the most progressive source of finance and is most so in poorer economies. In universal systems, social insurance is proportional to regressive. In high-income economies, the out-of-pocket (OOP) payments are proportional or regressive while in low-income economies the better-off spend relatively more OOP. But in most low-/middle-income countries, the better-off not only pay more, they also get more health care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.005.abstractZh: 我们估算了13个亚洲地区的医疗保健融资分配情况，这些地区占亚洲人口的55%。在所有地区中，高收入家庭对医疗保健融资的贡献更大。在大多数低收入和较低中等收入地区，富裕群体在支付能力中所占的比例更高。在三个拥有全民社会保险的高收入经济体中，医疗保健融资略呈递减趋势。直接税收是最具有进步性的融资来源，在较贫困的经济体中尤为如此。在全民保险体系中，社会保险与递减趋势呈正比。在高收入经济体中，自付费用呈正比或递减趋势，而在低收入经济体中，富裕群体相对花费更多的自付费用。但在大多数低收入/中等收入国家，富裕群体不仅支付更多，还能获得更多的医疗保健服务。

abstract.text: This paper uses a novel dataset and research design to examine the effects of information networks on immigrants' access to health care. The dataset consists of an unusually large sample of undocumented immigrants and contains a direct indicator of information networks-whether an immigrant was referred to health care opportunities by a strong social tie (relative or friend). This measure allows to overcome some of the major identification issues that afflict most of the existing literature on network effects and to concentrate on one of the channels through which social contacts might operate. The analysis focuses on the time spent in Italy before an immigrant first receives medical assistance. Estimates indicate that networks significantly foster health care utilization: after controlling for all available individual characteristics and for ethnic heterogeneity, I find that relying on a strong social tie reduces the time to visit by 30%. The effect of information networks is stable across specifications and it is relatively large. Further investigation seems to confirm the quantitative importance of networks as an information device.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.08.006.abstractZh: 本文采用新颖的数据集和研究设计，探讨信息网络对移民获取医疗服务的影响。该数据集包含了大量无证移民的样本，并包含了一个直接反映信息网络存在的指标——即移民是否通过强大的社会联系（如亲属或朋友）获得医疗服务的机会。这一指标有助于克服现有文献中大多数关于网络效应研究所面临的主要识别问题，并专注于社会联系可能发挥作用的渠道之一。分析重点在于移民首次获得医疗帮助之前在意大利的时间长度。估计结果显示，信息网络显著促进了医疗服务的利用：在控制了所有可用的个人特征和种族差异后，我发现依靠强大的社会联系可以将就诊时间缩短30%。信息网络的效果在不同情况下都是稳定的，且影响较为显著。进一步的调查似乎也证实了信息网络作为信息工具的重要性。

abstract.text: If fertility reflects the choice of households, results of their choice (duration between successive births and health of the children) cannot be considered to be determined randomly. Most existing studies of child health, however, tend to overlook the effects of fertility selection on child health. This paper argues that not accounting for this selection issue yields biased estimates and it is difficult a priori to predict the direction of this bias. We find that the estimates of birth spacing on child mortality are different when we do not account for fertility selection. Additionally, the correlated hazard estimates that we present here better fit our samples than the corresponding bivariate probit estimates used in the literature. A comparison of the fertility behaviour of households in the Indian and the Pakistani Punjab highlights the differential nature of institutions on demographic transition in these neighbouring regions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.005.abstractZh: 如果生育能力反映了家庭的选择，那么家庭选择的结果（如连续生育之间的间隔以及子女的健康状况）就不能被视为随机决定的。然而，大多数关于儿童健康的研究往往忽略了生育选择对儿童健康的影响。本文认为，如果不考虑这种选择因素，得到的估计结果会存在偏差，而且很难事先预测这种偏差的方向。我们发现，如果不考虑生育选择，对出生间隔与儿童死亡率关系的估计结果会有所不同。此外，我们在这里提出的相关风险估计，比文献中使用的双变量Probit估计更能符合我们的样本数据。对印度和巴基斯坦旁遮普地区家庭生育行为的比较，揭示了这两个邻近地区在人口转型方面的制度差异。

abstract.text: Health progress, as measured by the decline in mortality rates and the increase in life expectancy, is usually conceived as related to economic growth, especially in the long run. In this investigation it is shown that economic growth is positively associated with health progress in Sweden throughout the 19th century. However, the relation becomes weaker as time passes and is completely reversed in the second half of the 20th century, when economic growth negatively affects health progress. The effect of the economy on health occurs mostly at lag 0 in the 19th century and is lagged up to 2 years in the 20th century. No evidence is found for economic effects on mortality at greater lags. These findings are shown to be robustly consistent across a variety of statistical procedures, including linear regression, spectral analysis, cross-correlation, and lag regression models. Models using inflation and unemployment as economic indicators reveal similar results. Evidence for reverse effects of health progress on economic growth is weak, and unobservable in the second half of the 20th century.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.006.abstractZh: 健康进步，通过死亡率的下降和预期寿命的延长来衡量，通常被认为与经济增长相关，尤其是在长期内。本研究表明，在19世纪期间，瑞典的经济增长与健康进步呈正相关。然而，随着时间的推移，这种关系逐渐减弱，在20世纪下半叶则完全逆转，此时经济增长对健康进步产生了负面影响。在19世纪，经济对健康的影响主要滞后0年，而在20世纪则滞后至2年。没有证据表明经济因素在更长的滞后期内对死亡率产生影响。这些发现通过多种统计方法得到了验证，包括线性回归、频谱分析、交叉相关和滞后回归模型。使用通货膨胀和失业作为经济指标的模型也显示了类似的结果。关于健康进步对经济增长产生反向影响的证据较弱，在20世纪下半叶甚至无法观察到这种效应。

abstract.text: In this paper, I test a simple microeconomic theory of sexuality. I apply the theory to make predictions about the effect of AIDS on sexuality, since AIDS dramatically altered the cost of sexual activities. Using a nationally representative dataset on sexuality in the United States, I estimate the effect of AIDS on male and female homosexual behavior. To do so, I postulate that people who have a relative with AIDS, on average, have more knowledge, awareness, and fear of AIDS. Empirically, this variable is uncorrelated with a number of individual background characteristics. I present evidence that AIDS causes some men to shift from homosexual to heterosexual behavior, whereas AIDS causes some women to shift from heterosexual to homosexual behavior. Thus, sexual behavior may respond to incentives. I consider alternative hypotheses, including biological theories of sexual orientation and stigma-related survey bias, and argue that they are unlikely to explain the results.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.007.abstractZh: 在本文中，我测试了一个关于性行为的简单微观经济理论。我运用这一理论来预测艾滋病对性行为的影响，因为艾滋病显著改变了性行为的成本。通过使用美国具有全国代表性的性行为数据集，我估计了艾滋病对男性和女性同性恋行为的影响。为此，我假设有艾滋病亲属的人，平均而言，对艾滋病的了解、意识以及恐惧程度更高。从经验来看，这一变量与许多个人背景特征无关。我有证据表明，艾滋病促使一些男性从同性恋行为转变为异性恋行为，而艾滋病则促使一些女性从异性恋行为转变为同性恋行为。因此，性行为可能会受到激励的影响。我考虑了其他假设，包括关于性取向的生物学理论以及与污名相关的调查偏差，并认为这些假设不太可能解释这些结果。

abstract.text: Expected longevity is an important factor influencing older individuals' decisions such as consumption, savings, purchase of life insurance and annuities, claiming of Social Security benefits, and labor supply. It has also been shown to be a good predictor of actual longevity, which in turn is highly correlated with health status. A relatively new literature on health investments under uncertainty, which builds upon the seminal work by Grossman [Grossman, M., 1972. On the concept of health capital and demand for health. Journal of Political Economy 80, 223-255] has directly linked longevity with characteristics, behaviors, and decisions by utility maximizing agents. Our empirical model can be understood within that theoretical framework as estimating a production function of longevity. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, we directly incorporate health dynamics in explaining the variation in expected longevities, and compare two alternative measures of health dynamics: the self-reported health change, and the computed health change based on self-reports of health status. In 38% of the reports in our sample, computed health changes are inconsistent with the direct report on health changes over time. And another 15% of the sample can suffer from information losses if computed changes are used to assess changes in actual health. These potentially serious problems raise doubts regarding the use and interpretation of the computed health changes and even the lagged measures of self-reported health as controls for health dynamics in a variety of empirical settings. Our empirical results, controlling for both subjective and objective measures of health status and unobserved heterogeneity in reporting, suggest that self-reported health changes are a preferred measure of health dynamics.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.008.abstractZh: 预期寿命是影响老年人决策的重要因素，这些决策包括消费、储蓄、购买人寿保险和年金、领取社会保障福利以及劳动力供应等。研究还表明，预期寿命是实际寿命的良好预测指标，而实际寿命又与健康状况高度相关。关于在不确定性下的健康投资的相关文献相对较新，这些文献基于Grossman在1972年发表的开创性研究，将预期寿命与效用最大化代理人的特征、行为和决策直接联系起来。我们的实证模型可以在这一理论框架内理解，即估计出预期寿命的生产函数。利用《健康与退休研究》的纵向数据，我们直接将健康动态纳入解释预期寿命变化的分析中，并比较了两种衡量健康动态的方法：自我报告的健康变化，以及基于自我报告的健康状况计算得出的健康变化。在我们的样本中，有38%的报告显示，计算得出的健康变化与直接报告的健康变化不一致；另外15%的样本如果使用计算出的变化来评估实际健康的变化，可能会遇到信息丢失的问题。这些潜在的问题使得人们对计算得出的健康变化的使用和解释产生怀疑，甚至对作为健康动态控制变量的自我报告健康指标也产生了质疑。我们的实证结果表明，在控制主观和客观的健康状况指标以及未观察到的报告异质性之后，自我报告的健康变化是衡量健康动态的首选指标。

abstract.text: The paper focuses on two estimation methods that have been widely used to address endogeneity in empirical research in health economics and health services research-two-stage predictor substitution (2SPS) and two-stage residual inclusion (2SRI). 2SPS is the rote extension (to nonlinear models) of the popular linear two-stage least squares estimator. The 2SRI estimator is similar except that in the second-stage regression, the endogenous variables are not replaced by first-stage predictors. Instead, first-stage residuals are included as additional regressors. In a generic parametric framework, we show that 2SRI is consistent and 2SPS is not. Results from a simulation study and an illustrative example also recommend against 2SPS and favor 2SRI. Our findings are important given that there are many prominent examples of the application of inconsistent 2SPS in the recent literature. This study can be used as a guide by future researchers in health economics who are confronted with endogeneity in their empirical work.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.009.abstractZh: 本文重点介绍了两种在健康经济学和卫生服务研究中广泛使用的内生性估计方法——两阶段预测变量替代法（2SPS）和两阶段残差包含法（2SRI）。2SPS是对流行的线性两阶段最小二乘估计方法的自然扩展（适用于非线性模型）。2SRI估计方法与之类似，只是在第二阶段回归中，内生变量不会被第一阶段预测变量所替代，而是将第一阶段残差作为额外的回归变量纳入模型。在通用的参数框架中，我们证明了2SRI是一致的，而2SPS则不一致。模拟研究和一个示例案例的结果也表明，2SPS并不推荐，而2SRI则更优。鉴于近期文献中出现了许多使用不一致的2SPS的例子，我们的发现具有重要意义。这项研究可以作为未来从事健康经济学研究的学者在处理内生性问题时的参考指南。

abstract.text: We provide the first comprehensive assessment of the effects of mandatory seatbelt laws on self-reported seatbelt use, highway fatalities, and crash-related injuries among high school age youths using data from the Centers for Disease Control's (CDC) national, state, and local Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS) and the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) from 1991 to 2005, a period spanning over 20 changes in state seatbelt laws. Our quasi-experimental approaches isolate the independent effects of seatbelt laws net of demographic characteristics, area and year fixed effects, and smooth area-specific trends. Across all data sources, we find consistent evidence that state mandatory seatbelt laws - particularly those permitting primary enforcement - significantly increased seatbelt use among high school age youths by 45-80%, primarily at the extensive margin. Unlike previous research for adults, however, we find evidence against the selective recruitment hypothesis: seatbelt laws had consistently larger effects on those most likely to be involved in traffic accidents (drinkers, alcohol-involved drivers). We also find that mandatory seatbelt laws significantly reduced traffic fatalities and serious injuries resulting from fatal crashes by 8 and 9%, respectively. Our results suggest that if all states had primary enforcement seatbelt laws then regular youth seatbelt use would be nearly universal and youth fatalities would fall by about 120 per year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.010.abstractZh: 我们首次全面评估了强制安全带法律对高中生自我报告的安全带使用情况、公路死亡事故以及与交通事故相关的伤害的影响。研究数据来源于疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）在1991至2005年间进行的全国、州和当地青少年风险行为调查（YRBS）以及致命事故分析报告系统（FARS）。这一时间段内，各州的安全带法律发生了20多次变化。我们的准实验方法在排除人口统计特征、地区及年份固定效应后，单独分析了安全带法律的影响。从所有数据来源来看，我们发现各州强制安全带法律——尤其是那些允许主要强制执行的法规——显著提高了高中生的安全带使用率，增幅在45%到80%之间，且这种提升主要体现在高比例人群中。然而，与以往针对成年人的研究不同，我们发现安全带法律对最有可能参与交通事故的人群（如饮酒者、涉酒驾驶者）的影响更大，这与选择性招募假设相悖。此外，我们还发现，强制安全带法律使致命事故的死亡人数和严重伤害人数分别减少了8%和9%。我们的研究结果表明，如果所有州都实行主要强制执行的安全带法律，那么青少年的安全带使用率将几乎达到普遍水平，每年因交通事故导致的青少年死亡人数将减少约120人。

abstract.text: This paper resolves several controversies in CEA. Generalizing [Garber, A.M., Phelps, C.E., 1997. Economic foundations of cost-effectiveness analysis. Journal of Health Economics 16 (1), 1-31], the paper shows accounting for unrelated future costs distorts decision making. After replicating [Meltzer, D., 1997. Accounting for future costs in medical cost-effectiveness analysis. Journal of Health Economics 16 (1), 33-64] quite different conclusion that unrelated future costs should be included in CEA, the paper shows that Meltzer's findings result from modeling the budget constraint as an annuity, which is problematic. The paper also shows that related costs should be included in CEA. This holds for a variety of models, including a health maximization model. CEA should treat costs in the manner recommended by Garber and Phelps.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.09.011.abstractZh: 本文解决了CEA中的若干争议问题。通过推广[Garber, A.M., Phelps, C.E., 1997. 成本效益分析的经济基础. 健康经济学杂志 16 (1), 1-31]的研究，本文指出忽略相关未来成本会扭曲决策过程。在重复[Meltzer, D., 1997. 在医疗成本效益分析中考虑未来成本. 健康经济学杂志 16 (1), 33-64]得出的结论——即应在CEA中纳入相关未来成本之后，本文指出Meltzer的研究结果是由于将预算约束模型化为年金形式所导致的，这一模型化方式存在缺陷。本文还表明，在CEA中应包括相关成本。这一结论适用于多种模型，包括健康最大化模型。CEA应按照Garber和Phelps的建议来处理成本问题。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical model of the ethical preferences of individuals, combining individual social welfare functions and random utility theory. The model is applied by conducting a choice experiment regarding safety-enhancing road investments that target different age groups and road user types. The relative value of a saved life is found to decrease with age, such that the present value of a saved life-year is almost independent of age at a pure rate of time preference of a few percent. Moreover, a saved pedestrian is consistently valued higher than a saved car driver of the same age.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.001.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于个体伦理偏好的理论模型，该模型结合了个体社会福利函数和随机效用理论。通过进行一项关于安全提升道路投资的选择实验来应用该模型，实验针对的是不同年龄组和道路使用者类型。研究发现，被挽救的生命的相对价值随年龄增长而降低，即被挽救的生命年数的现值几乎不受年龄的影响，其时间偏好率仅为几个百分点。此外，同年龄的被挽救行人所创造的价值始终高于被挽救的驾车者。

abstract.text: The aim of this study is to examine whether individuals' risk attitude for life years differ from their risk attitude for quality of life. The study also investigates two different framing effects, an order and sequence effect, and the interaction between risk attitude and time preferences. The results showed that individuals tended to be risk averse with respect to the gamble involving risk of immediate death and risk seeking with respect to the other health gambles. Varying the order of the questions or the sequence of full health and ill-health did not seem to systematically bias the estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.002.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨个体对生命年数的风险态度与对生活质量的风险态度是否存在差异。研究还考察了两种不同的框架效应，即顺序效应，以及风险态度与时间偏好之间的相互作用。研究结果表明，个体在涉及即时死亡风险的风险行为中倾向于规避风险，而在其他健康相关风险行为中则倾向于寻求风险。改变问题的顺序或健康状态变化的顺序并未对估计结果产生系统性影响。

abstract.text: The evaluation of health care programmes is commonly approached with stated preference methods such as contingent valuation or discrete choice experiments. These methods provide useful information for policy decisions involving health regulations and infrastructures for health care. However, econometric modelling of these data usually relies on a number of maintained assumptions, such as the use of the compensatory or random utility maximization rule. On the other hand, health policy issues can raise emotional concerns among individuals, which might induce other types of choice behaviour. In this paper we consider potential deviations from the general compensatory rule, and how these deviations might be explained by the emotional state of the subject. We utilized a mixture econometric model which allows for various potential decisions rules within the sample, such as the complete ignorance, conjunctive rule and satisfactory rules. The results show that deviations from the full linear compensatory decision rule are predominant, but they are significantly less observed for those subjects with a medium emotional state about the issue of caring for the health state of the elderly. The implication is that the emotional impact of health policy issues should be taken into account when making assumptions of individual choice behaviour in health valuation methods.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.003.abstractZh: 对医疗保健项目的评估通常采用陈述偏好方法，如条件价值评估或离散选择实验。这些方法为涉及健康法规和健康基础设施的政策决策提供了有用的信息。然而，这些数据的计量经济建模通常依赖于一些假设，例如使用补偿效用最大化规则或随机效用最大化规则。另一方面，健康政策问题可能会引发个人的情感担忧，这可能会导致其他类型的选择行为。在本文中，我们考虑了与一般补偿规则可能偏离的情况，以及这些偏离如何可以通过受试者的情感状态来解释。我们采用了一种混合计量经济模型，该模型允许样本中存在多种可能的决策规则，例如完全无知、联合规则和满意规则。结果表明，偏离完全线性补偿决策规则的情况较为常见，但对于那些对老年人健康护理问题情感状态较为中立的受试者来说，这种偏离现象明显较少。这意味着，在采用个体选择行为假设的健康评估方法中，应考虑到健康政策问题的情感影响。

abstract.text: An increasing demand for both formal and informal care is likely to result from the ongoing demographic transition at the same time as there is a further move away from the traditional domestic division of labour. Public policy-making that aims at increasing the supply of informal care necessitates knowledge about the relative importance of various incentives for individual care providers. This paper takes as a point of departure that the willingness to supply informal care is partly explained by the extent to which it adversely affects labour-market outcomes and analyses the effect on labour-market outcomes of providing informal care to one's elderly parent(s) among the 50+ of Europe. Data from SHARE (Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe) was used to examine the association between, on the one hand, hours of informal care provided and, on the other, (1) the probability of employment, (2) hours worked, and (3) wages, respectively. The results suggest that giving informal care to one's elderly parents is associated with significant costs in terms of foregone labour-market opportunities and that these adverse effects vary between countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.004.abstractZh: 对正式和非正式护理的需求不断增加，这可能是由于人口结构的持续变化所导致的，同时传统家庭劳动分工的模式也在逐渐消失。旨在增加非正式护理供给的公共政策制定需要了解各种激励因素对个体护理提供者的影响程度。本文以非正式护理的意愿部分由其对劳动力市场结果的不利影响所解释为出发点，分析了在欧洲50岁以上人群中，为年长父母提供非正式护理对劳动力市场结果的影响。研究使用了SHARE（欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查）的数据，来考察提供非正式护理的时间与以下因素之间的关联：1）就业的可能性；2）工作时长；3）工资水平。研究结果表明，为年长父母提供非正式护理会导致劳动力市场的机会损失，而且这些不利影响在不同国家之间存在差异。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the relationships between health care visits to general practitioners, public and private sector specialists using data from Italy, which has a mixed public-private health care system. We develop a simultaneous equations model that allows for the discreteness of measures of utilization and estimate this model using maximum simulated likelihood. Once common unobserved heterogeneity is properly accounted for, general practitioners, public and private specialists are found to be substitute sources of medical care. In contrast, a naive model finds they are complements.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.006.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了意大利公共与私营部门专科医生与全科医生之间的就诊关系，研究数据来自一个具有混合公共-私人医疗系统的国家。我们建立了一个同时方程模型，该模型能够考虑利用度指标的离散性，并通过最大模拟似然法对模型进行估计。在正确考虑了常见的未观测异质性后，我们发现全科医生、公共部门专科医生和私营部门专科医生都是医疗服务的替代来源。相比之下，一个简单的模型则认为它们是互补关系。

abstract.text: Drug review speed has increased substantially in the 1990s, largely due to industry-funded user fees. Following several drug withdrawals, however, new questions have emerged about the effects of this change on drug safety. This article examines the impact of review speed and user fees on counts of serious adverse reactions among drugs approved in 1990-2001. The analysis controls for the influence of drug utilization, patient conditions, drug novelty, black box warnings, foreign drug launch, US launch lags, patient age, and gender on drug reactions. Results show that drugs receiving faster reviews are associated with increased counts of serious adverse drug reactions. Other results show that novel drugs, drugs with black box warnings, drugs first launched abroad, and drugs with shorter US launch lags also have increased adverse drug reactions. Although any increase in risks must be weighed against benefits, the results show a trade-off between review speed and drug safety.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.007.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代，药品审查的速度显著加快，这主要得益于行业资助的用户费用。然而，在多次药品被撤出市场之后，关于这一变化对药品安全的影响出现了新的疑问。本文研究了审查速度和用户费用对1990至2001年间获批药品中严重不良反应发生情况的影响。分析过程中考虑了药品使用情况、患者状况、药品新颖性、黑框警告、国外药品上市、美国上市延迟、患者年龄和性别等因素对药品不良反应的影响。结果显示，接受更快审查的药品与更严重的不良反应相关。其他研究结果表明，新颖药品、带有黑框警告的药品、首次在国外上市的药品以及美国上市延迟较短的药品也出现了更多的不良反应。尽管任何风险的增加都必须与收益进行权衡，但研究结果显示，审查速度与药品安全之间存在一种权衡关系。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of a decision support tool designed to help physicians detect and correct medical "missteps". The data comes from a randomized trial of the technology on a population of commercial HMO patients. The key findings are that the new information technology lowers average charges by 6% relative to the control group. This reduction in resource utilization was the result of reduced in-patient charges (and associated professional charges) for the most costly patients. The rate at which identified issues were resolved was generally higher in the study group than in the control group, suggesting the possibility of improvements in care quality along measured dimensions and enhanced diffusion of new protocols based on new clinical evidence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.008.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种旨在帮助医生发现和纠正医疗“错误”的决策支持工具的效果。数据来自一项针对商业健康保险计划患者群体的随机试验。主要发现是，新的信息技术使平均费用比对照组降低了6%。这种资源利用的减少是由于对最昂贵患者的住院费用及相关专业费用进行了降低。在研究组中，已识别问题的解决速度通常比对照组更快，这表明有可能在护理质量方面取得改进，并基于新的临床证据推广新的治疗方案。

abstract.text: The 1996 Welfare Reform Act tightened public health-insurance coverage restrictions for non-permanent residents (NPRs) and altered the eligibility of newly permanent residents (PRs). By drawing on data from the SIPP, this paper explores to what extent welfare reform led to a decline in health-insurance coverage for children of NPRs. This paper proposes that the proportion of uninsured children of NPRs with low social economic status (SES) increased by approximately 10 percentage points relative to their PR counterparts. Furthermore, although eligible for Medicaid, citizen children of NPRs of low SES lost approximately 17 percentage points in coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.10.009.abstractZh: 1996年的福利改革法案收紧了非永久居民在公共健康保险方面的覆盖范围限制，并改变了新永久居民的资格要求。本文基于SIPP的数据，探讨了福利改革在多大程度上导致非永久居民子女的健康保险覆盖率下降。研究结果表明，社会经济地位较低的非永久居民子女，在健康保险覆盖方面相比永久居民子女减少了约10个百分点的覆盖率。此外，尽管有资格享受医疗补助，但社会经济地位较低的非永久居民子女在医疗补助覆盖方面的覆盖率减少了约17个百分点。

abstract.text: Ten years ago, Cutler and Gruber [Cutler, D., Gruber, J., 1996. Does public health insurance crowdout private insurance? Quarterly Journal of Economics 111, 391-430] suggested that crowd-out might be quite large, but much subsequent research has questioned this conclusion. Our results using improved data and methods clearly show that crowd-out is still significant in the 1996-2002 period. This finding emerges most strongly when we consider family level measures of public insurance eligibility. We also find that recent anti-crowd-out provisions in public expansions may have had the opposite effect, lowering take-up by the uninsured faster than they lower crowd-out of private insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.11.004.abstractZh: 十年前，Cutler和Gruber在《经济学季刊》第111卷第391-430页的论文中提出，公共健康保险可能会大幅挤占私人保险市场。然而，后续的研究对这一结论提出了质疑。我们使用改进的数据和方法得出的结果显示，在1996至2002年期间，公共保险对私人保险的挤占效应仍然显著。这一发现在我们考虑家庭层面的公共保险资格指标时尤为明显。此外，我们发现，最近在公共保险扩展中采取的防止挤占措施可能产生了相反的效果，即无保险人群的使用率下降速度比公共保险对私人保险的挤占效应下降速度更快。

abstract.text: While recent evidence casts some doubt, it is generally accepted that the price sensitivity of smoking varies inversely with age. We investigate the responsiveness of older adult smoking using variation from recent historically large cigarette tax increases in the United States. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System from 2000 to 2005, we find consistent evidence that higher taxes reduced smoking participation by older adults, especially those who are less educated and live in low-income households. Our findings run contrary to existing evidence which suggests that cessation behavior by older adults is not sensitive to price. Since a large literature suggests smoking cessation even later in life reduces morbidity and increases longevity, our findings may represent substantial gains in health among tax-induced quitters.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.11.005.abstractZh: 尽管最近的一些证据对此提出了质疑，但普遍认为，吸烟的价格敏感度与年龄成反比。我们通过美国近期大幅提高香烟税的情况，来研究老年人群吸烟行为的反应。根据2000至2005年行为风险因素监测系统的数据，我们发现较高的税收确实减少了老年人群的吸烟行为，尤其是那些受教育程度较低且生活在低收入家庭的人群。我们的研究结果与现有证据相矛盾，现有证据表明老年人群的戒烟行为并不受价格的影响。由于大量研究表明，即使是在晚年戒烟也能降低发病率并延长寿命，因此我们的研究结果可能代表了因税收而戒烟的人在健康方面的显著收益。

abstract.text: This paper examines the distribution of preferences among respondents to a discrete choice experiment on the choice of general practitioner appointments. In addition to standard logit, mixed and latent class logit models are used to analyse the data from the choice experiment. It is found that there is significant preference heterogeneity for all the attributes in the experiment and that both the mixed and latent class models lead to significant improvements in fit compared to the standard logit model. Moreover, the distribution of preferences implied by the preferred mixed and latent class models is similar for many attributes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.11.006.abstractZh: 本文研究了在全科医生选择实验中，受访者偏好分布的差异。除了标准的逻辑模型外，还使用了混合逻辑模型和潜在类逻辑模型来分析实验数据。研究发现，实验中的所有属性都存在显著的偏好异质性，且混合逻辑模型和潜在类逻辑模型在模型拟合度方面均优于标准逻辑模型。此外，由这些模型所揭示的偏好分布在许多属性上都是相似的。

abstract.text: Objectives This study estimates the value that clients place on methadone maintenance and how this value varies with the effectiveness of treatment and availability of case management. We provide the first estimate of the price elasticity of the demand for drug treatment. Methods We interviewed 241 heroin users who had been referred to, but had not yet entered, methadone maintenance treatment in Baltimore, Maryland. We asked each subject to state a preference among three hypothetical treatment programs that varied across three domains: weekly fee paid by the client out-of-pocket ($5-$100), presence/absence of case management, and time spent heroin-free (3-24 months). Each subject was asked to complete 18 orthogonal comparisons. Subsequently each subject was asked if they likely would enroll in their preferred choice among the set of three. We computed the expected willingness to pay (WTP) as the probability of enrollment times the fee considered in each choice considered from a multivariate logistic model that controlled for product attributes. We also estimated the price elasticity of demand. Results The median expected fee subjects were willing to pay for a program that offered 3 months of heroin-free time was $7.30 per week, rising to $17.11 per week for programs that offered 24 months of heroin-free time. The availability of case management increased median WTP by $5.64 per week. The price elasticity was -0.39 (S.E. 0.042). Conclusions Clients will pay more for higher rates of treatment success and for the presence of case management. Clients are willing to pay for drug treatment but the median willingness to pay falls short of the estimated program costs of $82 per week. Thus a combined approach of user fees and subsidization may be the optimal financing strategy for the drug treatment system.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.11.007.abstractZh:
研究目的  本研究旨在估算客户对美沙酮维持治疗的重视程度，以及这种重视程度如何随着治疗效果和个案管理的可用性而变化。我们首次估算了药物治疗需求的价格弹性。  

研究方法  我们对马里兰州巴尔的摩市被推荐但尚未开始美沙酮维持治疗的241名海洛因使用者进行了访谈。每位受访者被要求从三个不同的治疗方案中选择一个，这三个方案在三个领域有所不同：客户自付的每周费用（5至100美元）、是否有个案管理，以及无海洛因的时间长度（3至24个月）。每位受访者还需完成18项正交比较。随后，我们询问受访者是否愿意选择他们最满意的那一个方案。我们通过多元逻辑模型计算预期支付意愿，即注册概率乘以每个方案中的费用。我们还估算了需求的价格弹性。  

研究结果  受访者愿意为提供3个月无海洛因时间的方案支付的中位费用为每周7.30美元，而对于提供24个月无海洛因时间的方案，这一费用上升至每周17.11美元。个案管理的可用性使预期支付意愿增加了每周5.64美元。价格弹性为-0.39（标准误差0.042）。  

结论  客户愿意为更高的治疗成功率和个案管理的存在支付更多费用。客户确实愿意为药物治疗付费，但中位支付意愿仍低于每周82美元的估计费用。因此，结合用户付费和补贴可能是药物治疗系统的最佳融资策略。

abstract.text: This paper presents a multivariate decomposition analysis of racial and ethnic differences in children's health insurance using the 2004-2005 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. We present two methodological contributions. First, we adapt a recently-developed matching decomposition method for use with sample-weighted data. Second, we develop a fully nonparametric approach that implements decomposition through weight adjustments. Accounting for the black-white wealth gap: a nonparametric approach. Journal of the American Statistical Association 97, 663-673]. Differences in observed characteristics explain large percentages of racial and ethnic coverage differences. Important contributors include poverty levels, parent education, family structure (for black children), and immigration-related factors (for Hispanic children). We also examine racial and ethnic differences in parent offers of employer-sponsored insurance and in children's coverage conditional on having a parent offer. Comparison of our linear, nonlinear, and nonparametric results suggests researchers may face a trade-off between robustness and precision when selecting among decomposition methodologies for discrete outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.12.001.abstractZh: 本文利用2004-2005年的医疗支出调查数据，对儿童健康保险中的种族和族裔差异进行了多变量分解分析。我们提出了两项方法论上的创新：首先，我们采用了一种新开发的匹配分解方法，以适用于样本加权数据；其次，我们开发了一种完全非参数的方法，通过权重调整来实现分解。考虑到黑人与白人之间的财富差距，我们采用了一种非参数方法。《美国统计协会杂志》97卷，663-673页。观察到的特征差异解释了种族和族裔在健康保险覆盖方面的较大差异。重要的影响因素包括贫困水平、父母教育水平、家庭结构（针对黑人儿童）以及与移民相关的因素（针对西班牙裔儿童）。我们还研究了父母提供的雇主赞助保险情况，以及儿童在父母提供保险条件下的保险覆盖情况。我们的线性、非线性和非参数分析结果表明，研究人员在选择用于离散结果的分解方法时，可能会面临稳健性和精确度之间的权衡。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence has hitherto been inconclusive about the strength of the link between health care spending and health outcomes. This paper uses programme budgeting data prepared by 295 English Primary Care Trusts to model the link for two specific programmes of care: cancer and circulatory diseases. A theoretical model is developed in which decision-makers must allocate a fixed budget across programmes of care so as to maximize social welfare, in the light of a health production function for each programme. This yields an expenditure equation and a health outcomes equation for each programme. These are estimated for the two programmes of care using instrumental variables methods. All the equations prove to be well specified. They suggest that the cost of a life year saved in cancer is about 13,100 pounds, and in circulation about 8000 pounds. These results challenge the widely held view that health care has little marginal impact on health. From a policy perspective, they can help set priorities by informing resource allocation across programmes of care. They can also help health technology agencies decide whether their cost-effectiveness thresholds for accepting new technologies are set at the right level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.12.002.abstractZh: 迄今为止，关于医疗保健支出与健康结果之间的关联强度，实证证据并不明确。本文利用295个英国初级保健信托机构提供的项目预算数据，对两个特定护理项目——癌症和循环系统疾病——的关联进行了建模。文中提出了一个理论模型，该模型要求决策者根据每个护理项目的健康产出函数，在固定预算内分配资源，以最大化社会福祉。由此得出每个护理项目的支出方程和健康结果方程。这些方程通过工具变量方法对两个护理项目进行了估算。所有方程都被证明是明确且有效的。研究结果表明，在癌症领域，每节省一年生命所需的成本约为13,100英镑，而在循环系统疾病领域则约为8,000英镑。这些结果挑战了“医疗保健对健康的边际影响很小”这一普遍观点。从政策角度来看，这些结果有助于通过指导资源在护理项目间的分配来设定优先事项。同时，它们还可以帮助健康技术机构判断其接受新技术的成本效益阈值是否设定得恰当。

abstract.text: Using an interrupted time series design and a census of births in California over a 6-year period, we show that state and federal laws passed in the late 1990s designed to increase the length of postpartum hospital stays reduced considerably the fraction of newborns that were discharged early. The law had little impact on re-admission rates for privately insured, vaginally delivered newborns, but reduced re-admission rates for privately insured c-section-delivered and Medicaid-insured vaginally delivered newborns by statistically significant amounts. Our calculations suggest the program was not cost saving.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2007.12.003.abstractZh: 通过采用中断时间序列设计，并对加利福尼亚州6年间的出生数据进行普查，我们发现，1990年代末通过的旨在延长产后住院时间的州法和联邦法律，显著减少了提前出院的新生儿比例。该法律对私人保险覆盖、经阴道分娩的新生儿的再入院率影响较小，但对私人保险覆盖、经阴道分娩且由Medicaid承保的新生儿的再入院率产生了显著的影响。我们的计算表明，该计划并未带来成本节约效果。

abstract.text: This article estimates the mortality cost of smoking using the first labor market estimates of the value of statistical life by smoking status. The value of statistical life is $7 million for both smokers and nonsmokers. Using this value in conjunction with the increase in the mortality risk over the life cycle due to smoking, the value of statistical life by age and gender, and information on the number of packs smoked over the life cycle, the private mortality cost of smoking is $222 per pack for men and $94 per pack for women in $2006, based on a 3% discount rate. At discount rates of 15% or more, the cost decreases to under $25 per pack.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.01.001.abstractZh: 本文利用首个关于吸烟状态对生命价值影响的劳动力市场估算结果，计算了吸烟的死亡成本。结果显示，无论是吸烟者还是非吸烟者，生命价值的损失均为700万美元。结合吸烟在整个生命周期内导致的死亡风险增加、按年龄和性别划分的生命价值，以及吸烟者在生命周期内所吸烟包数量的信息，计算得出2006年男性吸烟的私人死亡成本为每包222美元，女性为每包94美元，折现率为3%。当折现率达到15%或更高时，这一成本将降至每包25美元以下。

abstract.text: I study the impact of the Orphan Drug Act (ODA), which established tax incentives for rare disease drug development. I examine the flow of new clinical drug trials for a large set of rare diseases. Among more prevalent rare diseases, the ODA led to a significant and sustained increase in new trials. The impact for less prevalent rare diseases was limited to an increase in the stock of drugs. Tax credits can stimulate R & D; yet because they leave revenue margins unaffected, tax credits appear to have a more limited impact on private innovation in markets with smaller revenue potential.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.01.002.abstractZh: 我研究了《孤儿药法案》对罕见病药物研发的影响，该法案为罕见病药物的研发提供了税收优惠。我考察了针对大量罕见病的新临床试验的进展情况。在较为常见的罕见病中，《孤儿药法案》显著且持续地促进了新试验的开展。而对于较少见的罕见病而言，其影响仅限于药物库存的增加。税收抵免可以刺激研发活动；但由于它们不会影响收入空间，因此对于收入潜力较小的市场来说，税收抵免对私人创新的促进作用较为有限。

abstract.text: We use the implementation of a new prospective payment system (PPS) for inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) to investigate the effect of changes in marginal and average reimbursement on costs. The results show that the IRF PPS led to a significant decline in costs and length of stay. Changes in marginal reimbursement associated with the move from a cost-based system to a PPS led to a 7-11% reduction in costs. The elasticity of costs with respect to average reimbursement ranged from 0.26 to 0.34. Finally, the IRF PPS had little or no impact on mortality or the rate of return to community residence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.01.003.abstractZh: 我们采用新的预付制（PPS）对住院康复设施进行了实施研究，以探讨边际和平均报销变化对成本的影响。研究结果表明，住院康复设施的预付制显著降低了成本和住院时间。从基于成本的制度转变为预付制后，边际报销的变化使成本降低了7-11%。成本对平均报销的弹性范围在0.26到0.34之间。最后，住院康复设施的预付制对死亡率或重返社区的速度几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: Light trucks have doubled their share of the vehicle fleet from 1980 to 2004. This paper examines the effects of this increase on traffic safety, combining estimates from a state-level panel data set with an accident-level micro-data set. The results suggest that a one-percentage point increase in light truck share raises annual traffic fatalities by 0.34%, or 143 deaths per year. Of this increase, approximately one-fifth accrue to the light trucks' own occupants, and the remaining four-fifths accrue to the occupants of other vehicles and pedestrians. Using standard value of life figures, the implied Pigovian tax is approximately 3850 dollars per light truck sold. Overall, light trucks pose a significant hazard to other users of the highway system but on average provide no additional protection to their own occupants.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.001.abstractZh: 从1980年到2004年，轻型卡车在车辆总数中的占比翻了一番。本文通过结合一个州级面板数据集与事故级微观数据集的估计数据，探讨了这一变化对交通安全的影响。研究结果表明，轻型卡车占比每增加一个百分点，年度交通事故死亡人数将增加0.34%，即每年增加143人死亡。其中，约五分之一的增加死亡人数由轻型卡车驾驶员承担，其余四分之五的增加死亡人数则由其他车辆的驾驶员和行人承担。按照标准的生命价值计算，由此产生的庇古税约为每销售一辆轻型卡车需支付3850美元。总体而言，轻型卡车对其他道路使用者的安全构成了重大威胁，但平均而言，它们并未为自身的驾驶员提供额外的保护。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of insurance on the probability of an individual incurring 'high' annual health expenses using data from three household surveys. All come from China, a country where providers are paid fee-for-service according to a schedule that encourages the overprovision of high-tech care and who are only lightly regulated. We define annual spending as 'high' if it exceeds a threshold of local average income and as 'catastrophic' if it exceeds a threshold of the household's own per capita income. Our estimates allow for different thresholds and for the possible endogeneity of health insurance (we use instrumental variables and fixed effects). Our main results suggest that in all three surveys health insurance increases the risk of high and catastrophic spending. Further analysis suggests that this is due to insurance encouraging people to seek care when sick and to seek care from higher-level providers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.002.abstractZh: 我们分析了保险对个体年度健康支出“高”的概率的影响，数据来自三项家庭调查。所有数据均来自中国，该国的医疗服务提供者按照一种鼓励过度提供高科技医疗服务的付费制度获得报酬，且相关监管较为宽松。我们将年度支出定义为“高”，如果其超过当地平均收入的某个阈值；而将其定义为“灾难性”，则必须超过家庭人均收入的某个阈值。我们的估计结果允许使用不同的阈值，并考虑了健康保险可能存在的内生性问题（我们使用了工具变量和固定效应模型）。主要结果表明，在三项调查中，健康保险都会增加支出达到“高”或“灾难性”水平的风险。进一步分析表明，这一现象是由于保险促使人们在生病时寻求医疗帮助，并倾向于从更高级别的医疗服务提供者那里获得治疗。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the causal effect of teenage childbearing on smoking, drinking and body size using a sample of Australian twins and their relatives. Fixed effects estimates on samples of siblings, all twin pairs and identical twin pairs show that teenage mothers smoke more during their lives. Teen mothers tend to have a higher probability of being overweight, especially if they are older than 40 years. Their spouses are more likely to smoke and drink more. The quality of the spouse seems to be an important mechanism through which teenage childbearing affects subsequent maternal health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.005.abstractZh: 本文通过澳大利亚双胞胎及其亲属的样本，分析了青少年生育对吸烟、饮酒和体型的影响。对兄弟姐妹、所有双胞胎对以及同卵双胞胎对样本的固定效应估计显示，青少年时期的母亲在生命过程中吸烟更多。青少年时期的母亲更容易超重，尤其是年龄超过40岁的人。她们的配偶也更有可能吸烟和饮酒。配偶的质量似乎是影响青少年生育对后续母亲健康的重要因素。

abstract.text: Public health agencies around the world have renewed efforts to increase the incidence and duration of breastfeeding. Maternity leave mandates present an economic policy that could help achieve these goals. We study their efficacy, focusing on a significant increase in maternity leave mandates in Canada. We find very large increases in mothers' time away from work post-birth and in the attainment of critical breastfeeding duration thresholds. We also look for impacts of the reform on self-reported indicators of maternal and child health captured in our data. For most indicators we find no effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.006.abstractZh: 全球各地的公共卫生机构重新努力提升母乳喂养的发生率和持续时间。产假规定作为一种经济政策，可能有助于实现这些目标。我们研究了其效果，重点关注加拿大对产假规定的加强。我们发现，母亲产后离开工作的时间以及达到关键母乳喂养时间标准的比例都有显著增长。我们还研究了这一改革对数据中反映的母亲和儿童健康自我报告指标的影响。对于大多数指标，我们没有发现任何影响。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of extra health insurance coverage beyond a National Health System on the demand for several health services. Traditionally, the literature has tried to deal with the endogeneity of the private (extra) insurance decision by finding instrumental variables. Since a priori instrumental variables are hard to find we take a different approach. We focus on the most common health insurance plan in Portugal, ADSE, which is given to all civil servants and their dependents. We argue that this insurance is exogenous, i.e., not correlated with the beneficiaries' health status. This identifying assumption allows us to estimate the impact of having ADSE coverage on the demand for three different health services using a matching estimator technique. The health services used are number of visits, number of blood and urine tests, and the probability of visiting a dentist. Results show large positive effects of ADSE coverage for number of visits and tests among the young (18-30 years old) but only the latter is statistically significantly different from zero. The effects represent 21.8% and 30% of the average number of visits and tests for the young. On the contrary, we find no evidence of moral hazard on the probability of visiting a dentist.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.007.abstractZh: 我们估计了国家健康体系之外的额外健康保险覆盖对多种健康服务需求的影响。传统上，相关文献试图通过寻找工具变量来解决私人（额外）保险决策的内生性问题。由于事先很难找到合适的工具变量，我们采取了不同的方法。我们重点关注葡萄牙最常见的健康保险计划——ADSE，该保险覆盖所有公务员及其家属。我们认为这种保险是外生的，即与受益人的健康状况无关。这一识别假设使我们能够使用匹配估计技术来估计拥有ADSE覆盖对三种不同健康服务需求的影响。所研究的健康服务包括就诊次数、血液和尿液检测次数以及看牙医的概率。结果显示，ADSE覆盖对年轻人群（18-30岁）的就诊次数和检测次数有显著的正面影响，但只有后者在统计上显著不同于零。这些影响分别占年轻人群平均就诊次数和检测次数的21.8%和30%。相反，我们没有发现看牙医概率存在道德风险的证据。

abstract.text: Many policy makers continue to advocate and adopt cigarette taxes as a public health measure. Most previous individual-level empirical studies of cigarette demand are essentially static analyses of the relationship between the level of taxes and smoking behavior at a point in time. In this study, we use longitudinal data to examine the dynamics of young adults' decisions about smoking initiation and cessation. We develop a simple model to highlight the distinctions between smoking initiation, cessation, and participation. We show that because smoking participation reflects past decisions regarding initiation and cessation, the price elasticity of smoking participation is a weighted average of corresponding initiation and cessation elasticities, a finding that applies more broadly to other addictive substances as well. The paper's remaining contributions are empirical. We use data from the 1992 wave of the National Education Longitudinal Study, when most of the cohort were high school seniors, and data from the 2000 wave, when they were about 26 years old. The results show that the distinction between initiation and cessation is empirically useful. We also contribute new estimates on the tax-responsiveness of young adult smoking, paying careful attention to the possibility of bias if hard-to-observe differences in anti-smoking sentiment are correlated with state cigarette taxes. We find no evidence that higher taxes prevent smoking initiation, but some evidence that higher taxes are associated with increased cessation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.008.abstractZh: 许多政策制定者继续倡导并采用香烟税作为公共卫生措施。以往大多数关于香烟需求的个体层面实证研究，本质上都是对某一时间点税收水平与吸烟行为之间关系的静态分析。在本研究中，我们使用纵向数据来考察年轻成年人关于吸烟开始和停止的决策动态。我们建立了一个简单模型，以突出吸烟开始、停止和参与之间的区别。我们发现，由于吸烟参与反映了过去关于开始和停止的决策，因此吸烟参与的价格弹性是相应开始和停止弹性加权平均值，这一发现也适用于其他成瘾物质。论文的其余部分都是实证研究。我们使用了1992年《国家教育纵向研究》的数据，当时大多数研究对象是高中毕业生；以及2000年数据，当时他们大约26岁。研究结果表明，区分吸烟开始和停止在实证上是很有意义的。我们还提出了关于年轻成年人吸烟对税收反应的新估计，并仔细考虑了如果难以观察到的反吸烟情绪与州级香烟税相关的可能性所带来的偏差问题。我们没有发现更高的税收会阻止吸烟开始，但有一些证据表明，更高的税收与吸烟停止的增加有关。

abstract.text: As health care costs increase, cost-control mechanisms become more widespread and it is crucial to understand their implications for the health care market. This paper examines the effect that managed care activity (based on the aim to control health care expenditure) has on the adoption of technologies by hospitals. We use a hazard rate model to investigate whether higher levels of managed care market share are associated with a decrease on medical technology adoption during the period 1982-1995. We analyze annual data on 5390 US hospitals regarding the adoption of 13 different technologies. Our results are threefold: first, we find that managed care has a negative effect on hospitals' technology acquisition for each of the 13 medical technologies in our study, and its effect is stronger for those technologies diffusing in the 1990s, when the managed care sector is at its largest. If managed care enrollment had remained at its 1984 level, there would be 5.3%, 7.3% and 4.1% more hospitals with diagnostic radiology, radiation therapy and cardiac technologies, respectively. Second, we find that the rise in managed care leads to long-term reductions in medical cost growth. Finally, we take into account that profitability analysis is one of the main dimensions considered by hospitals when deciding about the adoption of new technologies. In order to determine whether managed care affects technologies differently if they have a different cost-reimbursement ratio (CRR), we have created a unique data set with information on the cost-reimbursement for each of the 13 technologies and we find that managed care enrollment has a considerably larger negative effect on the adoption of less profitable technologies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.009.abstractZh: 随着医疗成本的上升，成本控制机制变得越来越普遍，理解这些机制对医疗市场的影響至关重要。本文探讨了管理式医疗活动（旨在控制医疗支出）对医院技术采用的影响。我们使用风险率模型来研究在1982年至1995年期间，较高的管理式医疗市场份额是否与医疗技术采用的减少有关。我们分析了5390家美国医院在13种不同技术采用方面的年度数据。我们的研究结果有三点：首先，我们发现管理式医疗对研究中的13种医疗技术的获取产生了负面影响，且这种影响在1990年代更为明显，当时管理式医疗市场最为活跃。如果管理式医疗的注册率保持在1984年的水平，那么拥有诊断放射学、放射治疗和心脏技术服务的医院分别会增加5.3%、7.3%和4.1%。其次，我们发现管理式医疗的兴起导致了医疗成本增长的长期下降。最后，考虑到盈利能力分析是医院在决定采用新技术时考虑的主要因素之一，为了确定管理式医疗是否会对成本补偿比率不同的技术产生不同的影响，我们创建了一个包含13种技术成本补偿信息的数据集，并发现管理式医疗的注册率对盈利能力较低的技术的采用产生了更大的负面影响。

abstract.text: Tobacco advertising bans have become commonplace in developed nations but are less prevalent in developing countries. The importance of advertising bans as part of comprehensive tobacco control strategies has been emphasised by the Framework Convention on Tobacco Control which calls for comprehensive bans on tobacco advertising. The empirical literature suggests that comprehensive advertising bans have played a role in reducing consumption in developed countries but that limited policies have not. This paper extends this analysis to include 30 developing countries and finds that bans do play an important role in reducing tobacco consumption in these countries. It finds that both comprehensive as well as limited policies are effective in reducing consumption although comprehensive bans have a far greater impact than limited ones. Furthermore, it finds that advertising bans may be even more effective in the developing world than they are in the developed world.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.010.abstractZh: 在发达国家，烟草广告禁令已经变得普遍，但在发展中国家则较为少见。烟草控制框架公约强调了广告禁令作为全面烟草控制策略的一部分的重要性，该公约要求全面禁止烟草广告。实证研究表明，在发达国家，全面的广告禁令确实有助于减少烟草消费，而有限的政策则未能达到同样的效果。本文将这一分析扩展到30个发展中国家，发现禁令在这些国家确实发挥了重要作用，有助于减少烟草消费。研究结果表明，无论是全面的还是有限的政策，都能有效减少烟草消费，但全面的禁令比有限的政策具有更大的影响力。此外，研究还发现，在发展中国家，广告禁令可能比在发达国家更为有效。

abstract.text: We study the behavioral processes undergirding physician forecasts, evaluating accuracy and systematic biases in estimates of patient survival and characterizing physicians' loss functions when it comes to prediction. Similar to other forecasting experts, physicians face different costs depending on whether their best forecasts prove to be an overestimate or an underestimate of the true probabilities of an event. We provide the first empirical characterization of physicians loss functions. We find that even the physicians subjective belief distributions over outcomes are not well calibrated, with the loss characterized by asymmetry in favor of over-predicting patients' survival. We show that the physicians' bias is further increased by (1) reduction of the belief distributions to point forecasts, (2) communication of the forecast to the patient, and (3) physicians own past experience and reputation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.011.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生预测行为背后的过程，评估了患者生存估计的准确性和系统性偏差，并描述了医生在预测时的损失函数。与其他预测专家一样，医生面临不同的成本，这取决于他们的最佳预测是高估还是低估事件的真实概率。我们首次对医生的损失函数进行了实证分析。我们发现，即使医生对结果的主观信念分布也不够准确，损失表现为对预测患者生存时间的有偏估计。我们还发现，医生的偏差进一步加剧的原因包括：（1）将信念分布简化为点预测；（2）将预测结果告知患者；（3）医生自身的过往经验和声誉。

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship between area general practitioner (GP) supply and individual body mass index (BMI) in England. Individual level BMI is regressed against area whole time equivalent GPs per 1000 population plus a large number of individual and area level covariates. We use instrumental variables (area house prices and age weighted capitation) to allow for the endogeneity of GP supply. We find that that a 10% increase in GP supply is associated with a mean reduction in BMI of around 1kg/m(2) (around 4% of mean BMI). The results suggest that reduced list sizes per GP can improve the management of obesity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.012.abstractZh: 我们研究了英格兰全科医生供应与个体体重指数之间的关系。将个体层面的体重指数与每1000人口对应的全科医生数量以及大量个体和地区层面的协变量进行了回归分析。我们使用工具变量（地区房价和按年龄加权的基本工资）来消除全科医生供应的内生性影响。研究发现，全科医生供应增加10%，体重指数平均降低约1公斤/平方米（约4%的体重指数变化）。结果表明，每位全科医生负责的病例数量减少有助于改善肥胖症的管理。

abstract.text: Research on the effects of publicly reported hospital quality report cards on patient market shares is mixed. Higher-ranking hospitals do not consistently experience increases in market share. We argue that this may be because the report cards do not always convey "news" about quality; in some cases the rankings conform with prior beliefs about quality. We develop a structural model of the "news" in report cards and estimate the model using data from New York State in 1989-1991. We show hospitals with negative news in the original 1990 report cards experienced a decrease in market share, but that a misspecified model might continue to find no report card effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.03.001.abstractZh: 关于公开报道的医院质量报告卡对患者市场份额影响的研究结果并不一致。排名较高的医院并不总能获得市场份额的增加。我们认为，这可能是因为这些报告卡并不总是传达有关质量的“新闻”；在某些情况下，排名与人们对质量的先前认知相符。我们建立了一个关于报告卡中“新闻”的结构模型，并使用1989-1991年纽约州的数据对该模型进行了估计。结果显示，在1990年原始报告卡中带有负面信息的医院，其市场份额有所下降，但一个设计不当的模型可能会继续发现报告卡没有产生任何影响。

abstract.text: This paper compares program expenditure and treatment quality of stroke and cardiac patients between 1997 and 2000 across hospitals of various ownership types in Taiwan. Because Taiwan implemented national health insurance in 1995, the analysis is immune from problems arising from the complex setting of the U.S. health care market, such as segmentation of insurance status or multiple payers. Because patients may select admitted hospitals based on their observed and unobserved characteristics, we employ instrument variable (IV) estimation to account for the endogeneity of ownership status. Results of IV estimation find that patients admitted to non-profit hospitals receive better quality care, either measured by 1- or 12-month mortality rates. In terms of treatment expenditure, our results indicate no difference between non-profits and for-profits index admission expenditures, and at most 10% higher long-term expenditure for patients admitted to non-profits than to for-profits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.03.002.abstractZh: 本文比较了1997年至2000年间台湾不同所有制类型的医院中中风和心脏病患者的治疗费用及治疗质量。由于台湾在1995年实施了国家医疗保险制度，因此该分析不受美国医疗保健市场复杂环境所带来的问题影响，例如保险状态的分割或多重支付者等问题。由于患者可能会根据观察到的或未观察到的特征来选择入住的医院，我们采用工具变量估计方法来处理所有制状态的内生性问题。工具变量估计的结果表明，入住非营利性医院的患者能够获得更好的治疗质量，这可以从1个月或12个月的死亡率来衡量。在治疗费用方面，我们的结果显示非营利性医院和营利性医院在入院费用上没有差异，而且入住非营利性医院的患者长期费用最多仅比营利性医院高出10%。

abstract.text: The underlying reasons for gender differences in smoking behavior, and thus for the recent trends, are not well understood. Using a sample of 8592 Swedish adolescents aged 15-18, this paper contributes to the literature by exploring gender differences in smoking risk perceptions and in the responses to the latter. The results show significant gender differences in the perception of smoking mortality risk and in the perception of the addictiveness of smoking. Girls perceive the mortality risk of smoking as significantly greater than boys do, but they also perceive the addictiveness of cigarettes as less. These results persist after controlling for a wide range of background characteristics, including smoking risk information sources. Moreover, the findings suggest that while smoking information from sources such as teachers, pals, and own search, affect smoking mortality perceptions in a significant and positive manner among boys, no such effects are obtained among girls. Finally, our results show that both boys and girls take both the addictiveness and mortality risk of smoking into account when making their smoking decision. Moreover, the magnitude of the response is similar among boys and girls. This is in contrast to the general belief that females dislike risks to a greater extent than males.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.03.003.abstractZh: 关于性别差异在吸烟行为中的根本原因，以及由此导致的近期趋势，目前尚不清楚。本文以8592名15-18岁的瑞典青少年为样本，通过探讨性别差异在吸烟风险认知及对吸烟风险认知的反应方面的情况，为相关文献做出了贡献。研究结果显示，在吸烟致死风险认知以及吸烟成瘾性的认知方面，存在显著的性别差异。女孩认为吸烟的致死风险比男孩高得多，但她们对吸烟成瘾性的感知则较低。这些结果在控制了一系列背景特征后依然成立，包括吸烟风险信息来源等因素。此外，研究结果表明，虽然来自教师、朋友和自身搜索等渠道的吸烟信息对男孩的吸烟致死风险认知有显著的正面影响，但女孩并未出现类似的效应。最后，我们的研究还表明，男孩和女孩在做出吸烟决策时都会考虑吸烟的成瘾性和致死风险，且两者在反应强度上相似。这与普遍认为女性比男性更厌恶风险的观点相悖。

abstract.text: The optimal allocation of a public health care budget across treatments must take account of the way in which care is rationed within treatments since this will affect their marginal value. We investigate the optimal allocation rules for public health care systems where user charges are fixed and care is rationed by waiting. The optimal waiting time is higher for treatments with demands more elastic to waiting time, higher costs, lower charges, smaller marginal welfare loss from waiting by treated patients, and smaller marginal welfare losses from under-consumption of care. The results hold for a wide range of welfarist and non-welfarist objective functions and for systems in which there is also a private health care sector. They imply that allocation rules based purely on cost effectiveness ratios are suboptimal because they assume that there is no rationing within treatments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.03.004.abstractZh: 在公共医疗保健预算的最优分配中，必须考虑治疗内部的治疗分配方式，因为这会影响治疗的边际价值。我们研究了在用户收费固定且治疗通过等待来分配的情况下，公共医疗保健系统的最优分配规则。对于需求对等待时间弹性较大、成本较高、收费较低、接受治疗的患者等待带来的边际福利损失较小，以及治疗不足带来的边际福利损失较小的治疗来说，最优等待时间更长。这些结果适用于各种福利主义和非福利主义目标函数，也适用于包含私人医疗保健部门的系统。这些结果表明，仅基于成本效益比进行分配规则制定的方法是不理想的，因为这种方法假设治疗内部没有分配。

abstract.text: Recently, several authors have proposed the use of linear regression models in cost-effectiveness analysis. In this paper, by modelling costs and outcomes using patient and Health Centre covariates, we seek to identify the part of the cost or outcome difference that is not attributable to the treatment itself, but to the patients' condition or to characteristics of the Centres. Selection of the covariates to be included as predictors of effectiveness and cost is usually assumed by the researcher. This behaviour ignores the uncertainty associated with model selection and leads to underestimation of the uncertainty about quantities of interest. We propose the use of Bayesian model averaging as a mechanism to account for such uncertainty about the model. Data from a clinical trial are used to analyze the effect of incorporating model uncertainty, by comparing two highly active antiretroviral treatments applied to asymptomatic HIV patients. The joint posterior density of incremental effectiveness and cost and cost-effectiveness acceptability curves are proposed as decision-making measures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.03.005.abstractZh: 近期，一些学者提出了在成本效益分析中使用线性回归模型的建议。本文通过利用患者和卫生中心的相关变量来建模成本和结果，旨在确定成本或结果差异中那些并非由治疗本身引起，而是与患者状况或卫生中心特征相关的部分。选择作为效果和成本预测变量的相关变量通常是研究者自行假设的。这种行为忽略了模型选择所带来的不确定性，从而导致对感兴趣量的不确定性被低估。我们建议采用贝叶斯模型平均法作为处理这种模型不确定性的机制。本文利用一项临床试验的数据来分析纳入模型不确定性后的效果，通过比较两种针对无症状HIV患者的高效抗逆转录病毒疗法来进行分析。我们提出了增量效果和成本以及成本效益可接受性的联合后验密度作为决策依据。

abstract.text: We test whether the heightened mortality after the death of a spouse represents correlation or causation by examining the heterogeneity in the bereavement effect based on the spouse's cause of death. Some causes of death are correlated with socioeconomic characteristics while others are not. Equality in the bereavement effect across these two types of death would signal a causal relationship while no bereavement effect for uncorrelated causes of death would indicate an omitted variables bias. Results indicate that the observed effect for women is subject to an omitted variables bias but the estimates for men indicate a causal relationship.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.04.001.abstractZh: 我们通过考察基于配偶死亡原因导致的丧亲效应的异质性，来测试配偶死亡后死亡率的上升是相关性还是因果关系。某些死亡原因与社会经济特征相关，而另一些则无关。如果这两种类型的死亡在丧亲效应上具有相似性，则表明存在因果关系；而如果相关死亡原因没有表现出丧亲效应，则表明存在遗漏变量偏差。研究结果表明，对于女性而言，观察到的效应受到遗漏变量偏差的影响，但男性数据的估计结果则表明存在因果关系。

abstract.text: A positive relationship between socio-economic status (SES) and health, the "health-wealth gradient", is repeatedly found in many industrialized countries. This study analyzes competing explanations for this gradient: causal effects from health to wealth (health causation) and causal effects from wealth to health (wealth or social causation). Using six biennial waves of couples aged 51-61 in 1992 from the US Health and Retirement Study, we test for causality in panel data models incorporating unobserved heterogeneity and a lag structure supported by specification tests. In contrast to tests relying on models with only first order lags or without unobserved heterogeneity, these tests provide no evidence of causal wealth health effects. On the other hand, we find strong evidence of causal effects from both spouses' health on household wealth. We also find an effect of the husband's health on the wife's mental health, but no other effects from one spouse's health to health of the other spouse.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.04.002.abstractZh: 在许多工业化国家中，社会经济地位与健康状况之间存在正相关关系，即“健康-财富梯度”。本研究分析了这一梯度的多种解释：从健康到财富的因果效应（健康因果效应）以及从财富到健康的因果效应（财富或社会因果效应）。我们使用了1992年美国健康与退休研究中的51-61岁夫妇的六次双年数据，通过面板数据模型检验了这些因果关系，并考虑了未观测异质性和滞后结构的影响，这些检验得到了支持性结果。与仅依赖一阶滞后或无未观测异质性的模型相比，这些检验并未发现财富对健康有因果效应的证据。另一方面，我们发现配偶健康状况对家庭财富有显著的因果效应。我们还发现丈夫的健康状况对妻子的心理健康有影响，但配偶健康状况对另一方健康状况没有其他影响。

abstract.text: Using a dynamic panel model of child anthropometrics from China, the effect of an in-yard water source on child health was measured. Changes in within-community averages of household access to in-yard water were used as the instrument for changes in access to in-yard water sources. Further, to address the concern of non-random placements of water projects, correlations between changes in disease symptoms and community-level changes in access to in-yard water sources were examined. It was found that access to in-yard water sources improved child health only when mothers were relatively well educated.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.04.004.abstractZh: 本研究利用中国儿童人体测量数据的动态面板模型，测量了庭院水源对儿童健康的影响。通过家庭获取庭院水源的社区内部平均值的变化，作为庭院水源获取变化的具体指标。此外，为了应对水源项目位置非随机分布的问题，还研究了疾病症状变化与社区层面庭院水源获取变化之间的相关性。研究发现，只有当母亲受教育程度较高时，庭院水源的获取才能改善儿童的健康状况。

abstract.text: This note's aim is to investigate the sensitivity of Christakis and Fowler's claim [Christakis, N., Fowler, J., 2007. The spread of obesity in a large social network over 32 years. The New England Journal of Medicine 357, 370-379] that obesity has spread through social networks. It is well known in the economics literature that failure to include contextual effects can lead to spurious inference on "social network effects." We replicate the NEJM results using their specification and a complementary dataset. We find that point estimates of the "social network effect" are reduced and become statistically indistinguishable from zero once standard econometric techniques are implemented. We further note the presence of estimation bias resulting from use of an incorrectly specified dynamic model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.04.005.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨Christakis和Fowler提出的观点[Christakis, N., Fowler, J., 2007. 肥胖在大型社交网络中的传播过程：32年间的观察。《新英格兰医学杂志》357卷，370-379页]中关于肥胖通过社交网络传播的说法的敏感性。在经济学文献中，众所周知，如果不考虑情境效应，可能会对“社交网络效应”产生错误的推断。我们采用他们的模型设定和补充数据集重新验证了《新英格兰医学杂志》的研究结果。我们发现，一旦采用标准的计量经济学技术，对“社交网络效应”的点估计值会减小，并且与零几乎没有统计学上的区别。此外，我们还注意到，由于使用了错误设定的动态模型，导致了估计偏差的存在。

abstract.text: This study is the first to estimate peer effects for adolescent weight. We use data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health (Add Health) and define peer groups using nominated friends within schools. Endogenous peer groups are accounted for using a combination of school fixed effects, instrumental variables, and alternative definitions of peers (i.e., grade-level peers). Mean peer weight is correlated with adolescent weight, even after controlling endogenous peer groups. The impact of peer weight is larger among females and adolescents with high body mass index. The results are consistent with social multipliers for adolescent overweight policies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.003.abstractZh: 本研究首次对青少年体重的同伴效应进行了估算。我们采用了《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，并通过学校内被提名的好友来定义同伴群体。通过结合学校固定效应、工具变量以及不同的同伴定义方法（如同年级同伴），我们考虑了内生性同伴群体的影响。即使控制了内生性同伴群体，同伴体重的平均值仍然与青少年体重存在相关性。同伴体重的影响在女性和体重指数较高的青少年中更为显著。研究结果与青少年超重政策的社会乘数效应一致。

abstract.text: Global ratings, such as those based on consumer satisfaction, are a commonly used form of report on the performance of health plans and providers. A simple averaging of the global rating by plan members leads to a problem: it gives a plan greater incentives to improve services used by low-cost members than services used by high-cost members. This paper presents a formal model of consumer formation of global ratings and the incentives these rating convey to plans. We use this model to characterize weights on consumer respondents to correct the incentive problem. We implement our proposed solution using data from the Consumer Assessments of Health Care Providers and Systems (CAHPS) and the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey (MCBS). Our correction is low-cost, easily implemented on an on-going basis, and insensitive to assumptions about why health plans care about quality ratings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.004.abstractZh: 全球评级，如基于消费者满意度的评级，是评估健康计划和医疗服务提供者绩效的常见方式。对计划成员进行全球评级的简单平均处理会引发一个问题：它使得计划更有动力去改进低成本成员使用的服务，而不是高成本成员使用的服务。本文提出了一个关于消费者形成全球评级的正式模型，以及这些评级对计划产生的激励作用。我们利用该模型来为消费者调查对象分配权重，以纠正这一激励问题。我们采用《消费者对医疗保健提供者和系统的评估》和《医疗保险当前受益人调查》的数据来实现我们的解决方案。我们的修正方法成本低廉，易于持续实施，并且不受关于健康计划为何重视质量评级的假设的影响。

abstract.text: Following major reforms of the British National Health Service (NHS) in 1990, the roles of purchasing and providing health services were separated, with the relationship between purchasers and providers governed by contracts. Using a mixed multinomial logit analysis, we show how this policy shift led to a selection of contracts that is consistent with the predictions of a simple model, based on contract theory, in which the characteristics of the health services being purchased and of the contracting parties influence the choice of contract form. The paper thus provides evidence in support of the practical relevance of theory in understanding health care market reform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.005.abstractZh: 在1990年对英国国民健康服务系统进行重大改革后，医疗服务采购与提供职能被分离，采购方与提供方之间的关系由合同来规范。通过混合多项逻辑回归分析，我们展示了这一政策转变如何导致合同形式的选择符合基于合同理论的简单模型的预测。该模型认为，所采购的医疗服务特性以及合同各方的特点会影响合同形式的选择。因此，本文为理论在理解医疗市场改革中的实际意义提供了证据支持。

abstract.text: Although it is well known theoretically that physicians respond to financial incentives, the empirical evidence is quite mixed. Using the 2004 Canadian National Physician Survey, we analyze the number of patient visits per week provided by family physicians in alternative forms of remuneration schemes. Overwhelmingly, fee-for-service (FFS) physicians conduct more patient visits relative to four other types of remuneration schemes examined in this paper. We find that family physicians self-select into different remuneration regimes based on their personal preferences and unobserved characteristics; OLS estimates plus the estimates from an IV GMM procedure are used to tease out the magnitude of the selection and incentive effects. We find a positive selection effect and a large negative incentive effect; the magnitude of the incentive effect increases with the degree of deviation from a FFS scheme. Knowledge of the extent to which remuneration schemes affect physician output is an important consideration for health policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.006.abstractZh: 虽然理论上众所周知，医生会对经济激励作出反应，但实证证据却相当不一。通过2004年加拿大全国医生调查的数据，我们分析了家庭医生在多种薪酬制度下每周接待的患者数量。绝大多数按服务收费的医生，与本文研究的其他四种薪酬制度相比，接待的患者数量更多。我们发现，家庭医生会根据个人偏好和未观察到的特征，选择不同的薪酬制度；我们使用OLS估计值和工具变量GMM程序得到的估计值，来揭示选择效应和激励效应的大小。我们发现存在正向的选择效应和较大的负向激励效应；激励效应的大小随着偏离按服务收费制度的程度而增加。了解薪酬制度对医生工作量的影响程度，是制定健康政策时需要考虑的重要因素。

abstract.text: In most health care systems where a prospective payment system is implemented, an outlier payment is used to cover the hospitals' unusually high costs. When the hospital chooses its cost reduction effort before observing a patient's severity, we show that the best outlier payment is based on the realized cost when the hospital exerts the first best level of effort, for any level of severity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.007.abstractZh: 在大多数实施预期支付制度的医疗保健系统中，会使用异常支付来弥补医院异常高的成本。当医院在观察患者的病情严重程度之前就选择成本削减措施时，我们发现，对于任何病情严重程度，最佳异常支付应基于医院付出最优努力时的实际成本。

abstract.text: Although previous research has found that sexually active teens are more likely to suffer from depression, it is not clear whether this association is causal or spurious in nature. This study uses data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health to examine whether virginity status affects self-esteem and depression. For males, fixed effects and instrumental variables (IV) estimates provide little evidence that sex is causally related to psychological well-being. In contrast, IV estimates indicate that sexually active female adolescents are at increased risk of exhibiting the symptoms of depression relative to their counterparts who are not sexually active. Comparing the psychological well-being of females who used contraception at last intercourse with that of virgins suggests that these effects may be ameliorated, but not eliminated, by contraceptive use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.008.abstractZh: 尽管先前的研究发现，性活跃期的青少年更容易患上抑郁症，但尚不清楚这种关联是否具有因果关系或仅仅是偶然现象。本研究利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，探讨贞洁状况是否会影响自尊心和抑郁症的发生。对于男性而言，固定效应和工具变量估计结果并未显示性别与心理福祉之间存在因果关系。相反，工具变量估计结果显示，与未性活跃期的同龄人相比，性活跃期的女性青少年出现抑郁症症状的风险更高。比较在最后一次性行为时使用避孕措施的女性与处女的心理福祉，可以发现使用避孕措施可能会减轻这些影响，但并不能完全消除它们。

abstract.text: This paper performs new tests of the QALY model when health varies over time. Our tests do not involve confounding assumptions and are robust to violations of expected utility.
