The results support the use of QALYs at the aggregate level, i.e. in economic evaluations of health care. At the individual level, there is less support for QALYs. The individual data are, however, largely consistent with a more general QALY-type model that remains tractable for applications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.009.abstractZh: 本文对QALY模型进行了新的检验，考虑了健康状况随时间变化的情况。我们的检验不涉及混杂假设，并且对期望效用的违反具有鲁棒性。研究结果支持在整体层面上使用QALY模型，即在医疗服务的经济评估中。在个体层面，对QALY模型的支持较少。然而，个体数据总体上与一种更通用的QALY型模型一致，该模型在应用上仍然具有可行性。

abstract.text: While cost-effectiveness (CE) analysis has provided a guide to allocating often scarce resources spent on medical technologies, less emphasis has been placed on the effect of such criteria on the behavior of innovators who make health care technologies available in the first place. A better understanding of the link between innovation and cost-effectiveness analysis is particularly important given the large role of technological change in the growth in health care spending and the growing interest of explicit use of CE thresholds in leading technology adoption in several Westernized countries. We analyze CE analysis in a standard market context, and stress that a technology's cost-effectiveness is closely related to the consumer surplus it generates. Improved CE therefore often clashes with interventions to stimulate producer surplus, such as patents. We derive the inconsistency between technology adoption based on CE analysis and economic efficiency. Indeed, static efficiency, dynamic efficiency, and improved patient health may all be induced by the cost-effectiveness of the technology being at its worst level. As producer appropriation of the social surplus of an innovation is central to the dynamic efficiency that should guide CE adoption criteria, we exemplify how appropriation can be inferred from existing CE estimates. For an illustrative sample of technologies considered, we find that the median technology has an appropriation of about 15%. To the extent that such incentives are deemed either too low or too high compared to dynamically efficient levels, CE thresholds may be appropriately raised or lowered to improve dynamic efficiency.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.010.abstractZh: 虽然成本效益分析为分配通常用于医疗技术的稀缺资源提供了指导，但较少关注这些标准对最初开发医疗技术的创新者的行为影响。鉴于技术变革在医疗支出增长中的重要作用，以及多个西方化国家在引领技术采用过程中明确使用成本效益阈值的兴趣日益增加，更好地理解创新与成本效益分析之间的联系尤为重要。我们在标准市场背景下分析了成本效益分析，并强调技术的成本效益与其产生的消费者剩余密切相关。因此，改进成本效益分析往往与刺激生产者剩余的干预措施（如专利制度）相冲突。我们发现，基于成本效益分析的技术采用与经济效率之间存在不一致性。实际上，静态效率、动态效率以及患者健康的改善都可能因技术的成本效益处于最低水平而发生。由于生产者对创新社会剩余的吸收对于指导成本效益分析中的采用标准至关重要，我们通过现有的成本效益估计来推断这种吸收情况。对于所考虑的技术样本，我们发现中位技术的吸收率约为15%。如果这种激励措施被认为相对于动态效率水平过低或过高，那么可以适当提高或降低成本效益阈值以提高动态效率。

abstract.text: We conduct a large-scale economics experiment paired with a survey to examine the association between individual risk preference and health-related behaviors among adults aged 18-87 years. Risk preference is measured by the lottery choice experiment designed by Holt and Laury [Holt, C.A., Laury, S.K., 2002. Risk aversion and incentive effects. The American Economic Review 92(5), 1644-1655]. Controlling for subject demographic and economic characteristics, we find that risk aversion is negatively and significantly associated with cigarette smoking, heavy drinking, being overweight or obese, and seat belt non-use. In additional specifications, we find that risk aversion is negatively and significantly associated with the likelihood a subject engaged in any of five risky behaviors and the number of risky behaviors reported.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.011.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项大规模的经济学实验，并配合调查，以研究18至87岁成年人个体风险偏好与健康相关行为之间的关联。风险偏好是通过Holt和Laury设计的彩票选择实验来测量的[Holt, C.A., Laury, S.K., 2002. 风险厌恶与激励效应. 美国经济评论 92(5), 1644-1655]。在控制受试者的人口统计和经济特征后，我们发现风险厌恶与吸烟、酗酒、超重或肥胖以及不使用安全带之间存在负相关和显著关联。在进一步的分析中，我们发现风险厌恶与受试者从事任何五种风险行为的可能性以及报告的风险行为数量也存在负相关和显著关联。

abstract.text: Self-reported data collected via surveys are a key input into a wide range of research conducted by economists. It is well known that such data are subject to measurement error that arises when respondents are asked to recall past utilisation. Survey designers must determine the length of the recall period and face a trade-off as increasing the recall period provides more information, but increases the likelihood of recall error. A statistical framework is used to explore this trade-off. Finally we illustrate how optimal recall periods can be estimated using hospital use data from Sweden's Survey of Living Conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.012.abstractZh: 通过调查收集的自报数据是经济学家进行各种研究的重要输入来源。众所周知，这类数据存在测量误差，这种误差通常出现在受访者被要求回忆过去使用情况时。调查设计者必须确定回忆期的长度，并面临一个权衡：延长回忆期可以提供更多信息，但也会增加回忆错误的可能性。本文采用统计框架来探讨这一权衡问题。最后，我们通过瑞典生活状况调查中的医院使用数据，展示了如何估算最优的回忆期。

abstract.text: This paper offers evidence that welfare time limits contributed to a deterioration of infant health. We use the fact that the dates at which TANF recipients were first subject to timing out varied by state. We show that by 2000 there was a marked difference in TANF duration spells depending on whether the state employed the 60-month Federally imposed time limit, or a shorter limit, differences that were not present under AFDC. There were significant increases in infant mortality when time limits became binding in a state. These increases occurred primarily among mothers who could have plausibly timed-out of TANF: poorly educated and unmarried women with at least one previous live-birth. There is some evidence that the population of mothers affected by time limits were less likely to seek prenatal care in the first trimester, suggesting a possible role for reduced medical care in explaining the deterioration in infant health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.05.013.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明福利时间限制导致了婴儿健康的恶化。我们利用了TANF受助者首次面临时间限制的具体日期因州而异这一事实。研究表明，到2000年时，TANF持续时间的差异明显，这取决于该州是否采用了联邦规定的60个月时间限制，还是更短的限制期限。这种差异在AFDC政策下并不存在。当时间限制在某一州生效时，婴儿死亡率显著上升。这些上升主要发生在那些可能合理地提前终止TANF福利的母亲中：受教育程度较低且未婚、至少有过一次活产经历的妇女。有一些证据表明，受时间限制影响的母亲在孕早期不太可能寻求产前护理，这表明医疗服务的减少可能在解释婴儿健康的恶化中起到了作用。

abstract.text: It has been known for centuries that the rich and famous have longer lives than the poor and ordinary. Causality, however, remains trenchantly debated. The ideal experiment would be one in which extra status could somehow be dropped upon a sub-sample of individuals while those in a control group of comparable individuals received none. This paper attempts to formulate a test in that spirit. It collects 19th-century birth data on science Nobel Prize winners. Correcting for potential biases, we estimate that winning the Prize, compared to merely being nominated, is associated with between 1 and 2 years of extra longevity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.001.abstractZh: 几个世纪以来，人们都知道富人和名人的寿命比穷人和普通人要长。然而，这种因果关系仍然存在争议。理想的实验应该是将额外的社会地位以某种方式给予一部分个体，而对照组中的相似个体则没有任何这种待遇。本文试图按照这一思路进行实验。文章收集了19世纪科学诺贝尔奖得主的出生数据。经过潜在偏见的校正后，我们估计，与仅仅被提名相比，获得诺贝尔奖与额外1到2年的寿命延长有关。

abstract.text: We explore the hierarchy of two instruments, waiting time and coinsurance for medical treatment, for optimally solving the tradeoff between the economic gains from risk sharing and the losses from moral hazard. We show that the optimal waiting time is zero, given that the coinsurance rate is optimally set.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.002.abstractZh: 我们探讨了两种工具在解决风险分担带来的经济收益与道德风险造成的损失之间的权衡问题时的层级关系，这两种工具分别是等待时间和共同保险。研究表明，在共同保险费率被最优设定的情况下，最优等待时间为零。

abstract.text: Survey-based health research is in a boom phase following an increased amount of health spending in OECD countries and the interest in ageing. A general characteristic of survey-based health research is its diversity. Different studies are based on different health questions in different datasets; they use different statistical techniques; they differ in whether they approach health from an ordinal or cardinal perspective; and they differ in whether they measure short-term or long-term effects. The question in this paper is simple: do these differences matter for the findings? We investigate the effects of life-style choices (drinking, smoking, exercise) and income on six measures of health in the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) between 1992 and 2002: (1) self-assessed general health status, (2) problems with undertaking daily tasks and chores, (3) mental health indicators, (4) BMI, (5) the presence of serious long-term health conditions, and (6) mortality. We compare ordinal models with cardinal models; we compare models with fixed effects to models without fixed-effects; and we compare short-term effects to long-term effects. We find considerable variation in the impact of different determinants on our chosen health outcome measures; we find that it matters whether ordinality or cardinality is assumed; we find substantial differences between estimates that account for fixed effects versus those that do not; and we find that short-run and long-run effects differ greatly. All this implies that health is an even more complicated notion than hitherto thought, defying generalizations from one measure to the others or one methodology to another.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.003.abstractZh: 基于调查的健康研究在经合组织国家健康支出增加以及人们对老龄化问题的关注下正处于繁荣阶段。基于调查的健康研究的一个共同特点是其多样性。不同的研究基于不同的健康问题，使用不同的数据集；采用不同的统计技术；在从序数或基数角度研究健康问题时也有所不同；在衡量短期或长期影响方面也存在差异。本文的问题很简单：这些差异对研究结果是否有影响？我们研究了生活方式选择（饮酒、吸烟、锻炼）和收入对美国健康与退休研究中的六个健康指标的影响，这些研究的时间跨度为1992年至2002年：(1)自我评估的一般健康状况；(2)日常任务和家务活动中的困难；(3)心理健康指标；(4)体重指数；(5)严重长期健康问题的存在情况；以及(6)死亡率。我们比较了序数模型和基数模型；比较了有固定效应的模型与没有固定效应的模型；还比较了短期效应和长期效应。我们发现不同因素对我们选择的健康指标的影响存在相当大的差异；我们发现假设是序数还是基数很重要；我们发现考虑固定效应的估计值与不考虑固定效应的估计值之间存在显著差异；并且我们发现短期效应和长期效应存在很大差异。所有这些都表明，健康是一个比以往认为的更为复杂的概念，无法从一个指标推广到另一个指标，也无法使用一种方法推广到另一种方法。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between local labor market conditions and several measures of health and health behaviors for a sample of working-aged men living in the 58 largest metropolitan areas in the United States. We find evidence of procyclical relationships for weight-related health and mental health for men with low ex ante employment probabilities. Separate estimates suggest worsening labor market conditions lead to weight gains and reduced mental health among African-American men and lower mental health among less-educated males. Among our findings, those related to mental health are most pronounced.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了当地劳动力市场状况与美国58个最大都市区中工作年龄男性在健康及健康行为方面的若干指标之间的关系。我们发现，对于就业前景较低的男性来说，与体重相关的健康问题和心理健康问题呈现出顺周期性。单独的分析表明，劳动力市场的恶化会导致非洲裔美国男性的体重增加和心理健康状况下降，而受教育程度较低的男性则会出现较低的心理健康水平。在我们的研究结果中，与心理健康相关的问题最为明显。

abstract.text: We study the social interaction of non-smokers and smokers as a sequential game, incorporating insights from social psychology and experimental economics into an economic model. Social norms affect human behavior such that non-smokers do not ask smokers in their midst to stop smoking, even though the disutility from smoking exceeds the utility from social interaction. Overall, the level of smoking is inefficient when tolerating smoking is the social norm. The introduction of smoking and non-smoking areas does not overcome this specific inefficiency. We conclude that smoking bans may represent a required (second-best) policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.005.abstractZh: 我们研究非吸烟者与吸烟者之间的社会互动，将其视为一个序贯博弈，并将社会心理学和实验经济学的见解融入经济模型中。社会规范会影响人类行为，使得非吸烟者不会要求身边的吸烟者停止吸烟，尽管吸烟带来的不适超过了社交互动带来的益处。总体而言，当容忍吸烟成为社会规范时，吸烟的普及程度是低效的。引入吸烟区和非吸烟区并不能克服这种特定的低效现象。我们得出结论，禁烟措施可能是一种必要的（次优）政策。

abstract.text: This paper develops an empirical strategy to estimate whether subsidies to private medical insurance are self-financing in countries where public and private insurance coexist and the latter covers the same treatments as the former. We construct a simulation routine based on a micro-econometric discrete choice model that allows us to evaluate the impact of premium changes on the utilization of outpatient and inpatient health care services. As an application, we estimate the budgetary effects of scrapping a subsidy from the purchase of individual private policies, using micro-data from Catalonia. Our results suggest that the subsidy is not self-financing. This result is driven by the fact that private medical insurance holders make concurrent use of public and private services, and by the price inelasticity of the demand for private policies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.006.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种实证策略，用于评估在公共保险与私人保险并存且后者提供与前者相同的医疗服务的情况下，对私人医疗保险的补贴是否能够实现自我融资。我们基于微观计量经济学离散选择模型构建了一个模拟程序，以评估保费变化对门诊和住院医疗服务利用的影响。作为应用实例，我们利用加泰罗尼亚地区的数据，估算取消个人私人保险购买补贴的预算影响。我们的研究结果表明，这种补贴并未实现自我融资。这一结果主要源于私人医疗保险持有者同时利用公共和私人服务，以及私人保险需求的价格无弹性特性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the persistence in health limitations for individuals within the member states of the European Union. We use the full eight waves of data available in the European Community Household Panel (ECHP) to explore the relative contributions of state dependence, unobserved heterogeneity and socioeconomic characteristics, in particular income, education and activity status, and how these vary across countries. We focus on binary measures of health limitations, constructed from the answers to the question: "Are you hampered in your daily activities by any physical or mental health problem, illness or disability?". Dynamic non-linear panel data models are specified and estimated using both pooled and random effects probit and logit models together with complementary log-log models. The random effects probit specifications are preferred. Results reveal high state dependence of health limitations, which remains after controlling for measures of socioeconomic status. There is heterogeneity in the socioeconomic gradient across countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.06.007.abstractZh: 本文研究了欧盟成员国内个体在健康限制方面的持续性问题。我们利用欧洲共同体家庭面板调查中的全部八波数据，探讨了国家依赖性、未观测的异质性以及社会经济特征（尤其是收入、教育和活动状况）的相对贡献，以及这些因素在不同国家之间的变化。我们关注的是基于“您是否因任何身体或心理健康问题、疾病或残疾而在日常活动中受到阻碍”这一问题的回答而构建的二元健康限制指标。我们采用动态非线性面板数据模型，并同时使用汇总效应和随机效应Probit模型、Logit模型以及补充性的Log-log模型进行估计。其中，随机效应Probit模型更为适用。研究结果表明，健康限制的依赖性较高，即使在控制了社会经济状况指标后依然如此。此外，不同国家之间的社会经济梯度存在异质性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of expanding public health insurance eligibility for older children. Using data from the National Health Interview Surveys from 1986 to 2005, we first show that although income continues to be an important predictor of children's health status, the importance of income for predicting health has fallen for children 9-17 in recent years. We then investigate the extent to which the dramatic expansions in public health insurance coverage for these children in the past decade are responsible for the decline in the importance of income. We find that while eligibility for public health insurance unambiguously improves current utilization of preventive care, it has little effect on current health status. However, we find some evidence that Medicaid eligibility in early childhood has positive effects on future health. This may indicate that adequate medical care early on puts children on a better health trajectory, resulting in better health as they grow.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了扩大老年儿童公共健康保险覆盖范围的效应。通过1986至2005年的全国健康调查数据，我们首先发现，尽管收入仍然是预测儿童健康状况的重要因素，但近年来对于9至17岁的儿童来说，收入对健康状况预测的重要性已经下降。接着，我们探讨了过去十年中，这些儿童公共健康保险覆盖范围的显著扩大在多大程度上导致了收入重要性下降。我们发现，虽然获得公共健康保险资格无疑提高了当前对预防保健的利用，但对当前健康状况的影响却很小。不过，我们发现了一些证据表明，早期儿童时期获得医疗补助资格对未来的健康状况有积极影响。这可能表明，早期获得足够的医疗护理有助于儿童在成长过程中保持更好的健康状况。

abstract.text: The conventional theory of optimal coinsurance rates for health insurance with moral hazard indicates that coinsurance should vary with the price responsiveness or price-elasticity of demand for different medical services. An alternative theory called "value-based cost sharing" indicates that coinsurance should be lower for services with higher (marginal) benefits relative to costs. This paper reconciles the two views. It shows that, if patient demands are based on correct information, optimal coinsurance is the same under either theory. If patient demands differ from informed demands, optimal coinsurance depends both on information imperfection and price responsiveness. Value-based cost sharing can be superior to providing information (even if the cost of information is minimal) when patient demands fall short of informed demands. An extended numerical example illustrates these points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.003.abstractZh: 传统的关于健康保险最优共保费率的理論指出，共保费率应随不同医疗服务的需求价格响应性或价格弹性而变化。另一种被称为“价值基础的成本分担”的理论则认为，对于相对于成本而言具有更高（边际）效益的服务，共保费率应更低。本文对这两种观点进行了调和。研究表明，如果患者的需求基于正确的信息，那么无论采用哪种理论，最优共保费率都是相同的。如果患者的需求与知情需求存在差异，那么最优共保费率既取决于信息的不完全性，也取决于需求的价格响应性。当患者的需求低于知情需求时，价值基础的成本分担方式可能优于提供信息的方式（即使信息的成本极低）。文中通过一个扩展的数值示例进一步说明了这些观点。

abstract.text: Traditionally aversion to health inequality is modelled through a concave utility function over health outcomes. Bleichrodt et al. [Bleichrodt, H., Diecidue E., Quiggin J., 2004. Equity weights in the allocation of health care: the rank-dependent QALY model. Journal of Health Economics 23, 157-171] have suggested a "dual" approach based on the introduction of explicit equity weights. The purpose of this paper is to analyze how priorities in health care are determined in the framework of these two models. It turns out that policy implications are highly sensitive to the choice of the model that will represent aversion to health inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.004.abstractZh: 传统上，对健康不平等的厌恶是通过对健康结果的凹形效用函数来建模的。Bleichrodt等人[Bleichrodt, H., Diecidue E., Quiggin J., 2004. 在医疗分配中引入明确的公平权重：基于等级依赖的QALY模型。《健康经济学杂志》23, 157-171]提出了一种基于明确公平权重的“双重”方法。本文旨在分析在这两个模型框架下，医疗优先事项是如何确定的。结果表明，政策含义对代表对健康不平等厌恶的模型选择非常敏感。

abstract.text: We investigate whether education induces individuals to have healthy lifestyle. To test for causality we instrument education by high school availability and birth order using data of Korean men; to account for correlations among health behaviors, we estimate a quadvariate probit model using simulated MLE. Our results indicate that an increase in education induces individuals to exercise regularly, and to get regular health checkups. We find, however, that education has little effect on smoking or drinking. We also discover that unobserved determinants of health behaviors are correlated, especially between smoking and drinking, and between exercising and getting health checkups.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了教育是否能够促使个体养成健康的生活方式。为了检验因果关系，我们通过高中教育的可获得性以及出生顺序这一变量来作为工具变量，以韩国男性的数据为基础进行研究；为了考虑健康行为之间的相关性，我们使用模拟最大似然法估计了一个双变量probit模型。研究结果表明，教育水平的提高能够促使个体定期锻炼并定期进行健康检查。然而，我们发现教育对吸烟和饮酒的影响较小。此外，我们还发现健康行为的一些未观察到的决定因素之间存在相关性，尤其是在吸烟和饮酒之间，以及锻炼和健康检查之间。

abstract.text: Many governments allocate public funds to individuals who need long-term care (LTC) services as a result of chronic illnesses and functional problems. In this paper, I investigate the effects of two common eligibility criteria of LTC programs: means-tested and health-based programs. I find that publicly provided health-based LTC crowds out the medical spending among low health individuals. Furthermore, means-tested programs lead to higher initial spending on medical care and consumption goods among middle-wealth individuals. The welfare implications of these programs also depend critically upon the individuals' initial wealth and health status. Interestingly, it is possible for health-based programs to be less costly than means-tested programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.008.abstractZh: 许多政府向因慢性疾病和功能问题而需要长期护理服务的个人提供公共资金。在本文中，我研究了长期护理项目的两个常见资格标准：基于经济状况的评估和基于健康状况的评估。我发现，由公共部门提供的基于健康状况的长期护理服务会挤占低收入人群的医疗支出。此外，基于经济状况的评估项目会导致中等财富人群在医疗护理和消费商品上的初始支出增加。这些项目的福利影响也严重取决于个人的初始财富和健康状况。有趣的是，基于健康状况的项目可能比基于经济状况的项目成本更低。

abstract.text: This paper presents an application of the Duclos et al. [Duclos, J.-Y., Jalbert, V., Araar A., 2003. Classical horizontal inequity and reranking: an integrated approach. Research on Economic Inequality 10, 65-100] decomposition to an analysis of the 1998 Swiss health system financing. We see that in addition to measuring horizontal inequality in the classical sense, this decomposition is more efficient and flexible than earlier ones. It is also pointed out that methods involving a nonparametric estimation lead to asymptotically biased vertical and horizontal effects. A procedure to estimate this bias is given. Finally, it is shown that despite a major reform, health system financing is still very regressive and social health insurance is more regressive than direct financing.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.009.abstractZh: 本文应用Duclos等人[Duclos, J.-Y., Jalbert, V., Araar A., 2003. 经典水平不平等与重新排序：一种综合方法。经济不平等研究 10, 65-100]的分解方法来分析1998年瑞士的卫生系统融资情况。研究发现，除了能够测量经典意义上的水平不平等外，这种分解方法比以往的方法更为高效和灵活。此外，研究还指出，涉及非参数估计的方法会导致垂直和水平效应存在渐近偏差。文中给出了估计这种偏差的方法。最后，研究表明，尽管进行了重大改革，卫生系统融资仍然非常递减，而社会医疗保险的递减程度甚至超过了直接融资。

abstract.text: We analyse how physicians respond to contractual changes and incentives within a multitasking environment. In 1999 the Quebec government (Canada) introduced an optional mixed compensation (MC) system, combining a fixed per diem with a partial (relative to the traditional fee-for-service (FFS) system) fee for services provided. We combine panel survey and administrative data on Quebec physicians to evaluate the impact of this change in incentives on their practice choices. We highlight the differentiated impact of incentives on various dimensions of physician behaviour by considering a wide range of labour supply variables: time spent on seeing patients, time devoted to teaching, administrative tasks or research, as well as the volume of clinical services and average time per clinical service. Our results show that, on average, the reform induced physicians who changed from FFS to MC to reduce their volume of (billable) services by 6.15% and to reduce their hours of work spent on seeing patients by 2.57%. Their average time spent per service increased by 3.81%, suggesting a potential quality-quantity substitution. Also the reform induced these physicians to increase their time spent on teaching and administrative duties (tasks not remunerated under the fee-for-service system) by 7.9%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.010.abstractZh: 我们分析了医生在多任务环境下的对合同变化和激励措施的反应。1999年，加拿大魁北克政府引入了可选的混合薪酬制度，将固定每日津贴与相对于传统按服务收费制度的部分服务费用相结合。我们通过面板调查和行政数据来评估这一激励变化对医生执业选择的影响。我们通过考虑一系列劳动力供应变量，如用于看诊的时间、用于教学、行政任务或研究的时间，以及临床服务的数量和每次临床服务的平均时间，来突出激励措施对不同医生行为维度的差异化影响。我们的结果显示，平均而言，从按服务收费制度转向混合薪酬制度的医生，其可计费服务的数量减少了6.15%，看诊时间减少了2.57%。每次服务的平均时间增加了3.81%，这表明可能存在质量与数量的替代关系。此外，这一改革还促使这些医生增加了用于教学和管理任务的时间（这些任务在按服务收费制度下是不计报酬的），增加了7.9%。

abstract.text: Previous work has shown that the income gradient in child health for the United States becomes steeper with age. This paper shows a similar pattern using the 1996-2005 Medical Expenditure Panel Surveys (MEPS). A framework is also presented to evaluate cumulative and contemporaneous income effects through the use of baseline health controls. The analysis shows that poor health is more persistent in older children, and that the income gradient is substantially flattened over age groups when controlling for baseline health. However, even when controlling for baseline health, there remains a stronger effect from income on the health of adolescents. These results may reflect a cumulative effect from income that explains much of the strengthening association between income and health before adolescence, with a remaining stronger contemporaneous association in that age group. The analysis is unable to identify a major role of chronic conditions or injuries in these relationships.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.012.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，美国的儿童健康状况随年龄增长而呈现更陡峭的收入梯度。本文利用1996-2005年的医疗支出调查数据，展示了类似的趋势。研究还提出了一个框架，通过基线健康控制来评估累积性和同时期的收入效应。分析结果显示，在较大的儿童群体中，健康状况的恶化更为持久；而在控制基线健康状况后，收入对健康的梯度效应则明显减弱。然而，即使控制了基线健康状况，收入对青少年健康的影响仍然较为显著。这些结果可能反映了收入的累积效应，解释了在青春期之前，收入与健康之间的关联之所以增强的原因，而在该年龄段，这种关联仍然较为显著。分析未能发现慢性疾病或伤害在这些关系中的重要作用。

abstract.text: We propose an innovative method for the decomposition of factors associated with inequalities in the use of health care. We analyze individual data and make use of micro-simulations to evaluate the effect of heterogeneity of individual behaviors on inequality in access to care. Our study employs methods that, unlike earlier work, permits evaluation of heterogeneity of individual behaviors. We provide an application of this method by decomposing inequality of health care use in France in 1998. We show that half of the inequity in access to care is due to the heterogeneity of behaviors relative to the rank of individuals in the income distribution. This approach reconciles Oaxaca-like decompositions of inequality, focused on outcome gaps, with analyses involving decompositions of inequality by factors, focused on inequity indices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.013.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种创新的方法，用于分解与医疗保健使用不平等相关的因素。我们分析了个体数据，并利用微观模拟来评估个体行为异质性对医疗获取不平等的影响。我们的研究方法与以往的工作不同，能够评估个体行为的异质性。我们通过分解1998年法国医疗保健使用的不平等现象来应用这种方法。我们发现，医疗获取不平等的一半是由于个体在收入分布中的排名所对应的行为异质性造成的。这种方法将关注于结果差距的不平等分解方法，与关注于不平等指数因素分解的分析方法相结合。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of Medicare HMO penetration on the medical care expenditures incurred by Medicare fee-for-service (FFS) enrollees. We find that increasing penetration leads to reduced spending on FFS beneficiaries. In particular, our estimates suggest that the increase in HMO penetration during our study period led to approximately a 7% decline in spending per FFS beneficiary. Similar models for various measures of health care utilization find penetration-induced reductions consistent with our spending estimates. Finally, we present evidence that suggests our estimated spending reductions are driven by beneficiaries who have at least one chronic condition.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.014.abstractZh: 本文研究了医疗保险管理组织（HMO）的普及程度对医疗保险按服务收费计划参保者医疗支出的影响。研究发现，HMO的普及程度提高会导致按服务收费计划的参保者支出减少。具体而言，我们的估计表明，在研究期间，HMO普及程度的增加导致每个按服务收费计划的参保者的支出减少了约7%。对于各种医疗利用指标的类似模型分析也发现，HMO普及程度提高所导致的支出减少与我们的估计结果一致。最后，我们有证据表明，这种支出减少是由那些至少有一种慢性疾病的参保者所驱动的。

abstract.text: Because self-reported health status [SRHS] is an ordered response variable, inequality measurement for SRHS data requires a numerical scale for converting individual responses into a summary statistic. The choice of scale is however problematic, since small variations in the numerical scale may reverse the ordering of a given pair of distributions of SRHS data in relation to conventional inequality indices such as the variance. This paper introduces a parametric family of inequality indices, founded on an inequality ordering proposed by Allison and Foster [Allison, R.A., Foster, J., 2004. Measuring health inequalities using qualitative data. Journal of Health Economics 23, 505-524], which satisfy a suitable invariance property with respect to the choice of numerical scale. Several key members of the parametric family are also derived, and an empirical application using data from the Swiss Health Survey illustrates the proposed methodology.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.015.abstractZh: 由于自我报告的健康状况是一个有序响应变量，因此对SRHS数据的不平等程度进行测量需要一种数值尺度，以将个体回答转化为汇总统计指标。然而，选择数值尺度存在问题，因为数值尺度的微小变化可能会改变SRHS数据对之间的排序，这与传统的不平等指数（如方差）的排序方式不同。本文介绍了一组基于Allison和Foster提出的不平等排序原则的参数化不平等指数，这些指数能够适应不同的数值尺度选择，并满足适当的不变性属性。文中还推导出了该参数化指数族的几个关键成员，并通过瑞士健康调查的数据实例说明了所提出的方法论。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Patients' perceptions of their care, especially in the hospital setting, are not well known. Data from the Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (HCAHPS) survey provide a portrait of patients' experiences in U.S. hospitals. METHODS: We assessed the performance of hospitals across multiple domains of patients' experiences. We examined whether key characteristics of hospitals that are thought to enhance patients' experiences (i.e., a high ratio of nurses to patient-days, for-profit status, and nonacademic status) were associated with a better experience for patients. We also examined whether a hospital's performance on the HCAHPS survey was related to its performance on indicators of the quality of clinical care. RESULTS: We found moderately high levels of satisfaction with care (e.g., on average, 67.4% of a hospital's patients said that they would definitely recommend the hospital), with a high degree of correlation among the measures of patients' experiences (Cronbach's alpha, 0.94). As compared with hospitals in the bottom quartile of the ratio of nurses to patient-days, those in the top quartile had a somewhat better performance on the HCAHPS survey (e.g., 63.5% vs. 70.2% of patients responded that they "would definitely recommend" the hospital; P<0.001). Hospitals with a high level of patient satisfaction provided clinical care that was somewhat higher in quality for all conditions examined. For example, those in the top quartile of HCAHPS ratings performed better than those in the bottom quartile with respect to the care that patients received for acute myocardial infarction (actions taken to provide appropriate care as a proportion of all opportunities for providing such actions, 95.8% vs. 93.1% in unadjusted analyses; P<0.001) and for pneumonia (90.5% vs. 88.6% in unadjusted analyses, P<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: This portrait of patients' experiences in U.S. hospitals offers insights into areas that need improvement, suggests that the same characteristics of hospitals that lead to high nurse-staffing levels may be associated with better experiences for patients, and offers evidence that hospitals can provide both a high quality of clinical care and a good experience for the patient.

10.1056/nejmsa0804116.abstractZh:
背景：患者对护理的感知，尤其是在医院环境中，尚未得到充分了解。医院消费者对医疗服务提供者和系统的评估（HCAHPS）调查提供了美国医院患者体验的画像。  
方法：我们评估了医院在多个患者体验领域的表现。我们研究了被认为能提升患者体验的医院关键特征（如护士与患者日数的高比例、营利性质以及非学术性质）是否与更好的患者体验相关。我们还研究了医院在HCAHPS调查中的表现与其临床护理质量指标之间的关系。  
结果：我们发现患者对护理的满意度较高（例如，平均有67.4%的患者表示一定会推荐该医院），各患者体验指标之间存在高度相关性（Cronbach's alpha值为0.94）。与护士与患者日数比例最低的四分位医院相比，最高四分位医院的HCAHPS调查表现稍好（例如，63.5%的患者表示“一定会推荐”该医院，而最低四分位医院这一比例为70.2%；P<0.001）。满意度较高的医院提供的临床护理质量也相对较高。例如，在急性心肌梗塞的护理方面，最高四分位医院的表现在所有检查指标中均优于最低四分位医院（采取适当护理措施的占比，95.8% vs. 93.1%；P<0.001）；在肺炎护理方面也是如此（90.5% vs.在未经调整的分析中，这一比例为88.6%，P<0.001）。结论：对美国医院患者体验的描绘揭示了需要改进的领域，表明导致护士配备数量较高的医院特征可能与更好的患者体验相关，并证明了医院能够同时提供高质量的临床护理和良好的患者体验。

abstract.text: What conditions cause major policy changes under representative government? This article addresses that question by providing a theoretically grounded analysis of a massive policy change: the New Deal. It explains how the economic problems of the early 1930s initiated changes on several dimensions of policy: federal spending, labor market regulation, and civil rights. The article concludes by considering the broader lessons learned from the political economy of the New Deal.

10.1086/528999.abstractZh: 哪些条件会导致代议制政府下的重大政策变革？本文通过理论分析，探讨了这一问题，具体聚焦于一次重大的政策变革——新政。文章解释了20世纪30年代初期经济问题如何引发了政策在多个方面的变革，包括联邦政府支出、劳动力市场监管以及公民权利等方面。最后，文章总结了从新政的政治经济实践中得出的更广泛启示。

abstract.text: We study the optimal inflation tax in an economy with heterogeneous agents subject to nonlinear taxation of labor income. We find that the Friedman rule is Pareto efficient when combined with a nondecreasing labor income tax. In addition, the optimum for a utilitarian social welfare function lies on this region of the Pareto frontier. The welfare costs from inflation are bounded below by the area under the demand curve.

10.1086/529397.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有异质代理人的经济体系中，在劳动收入受到非线性征税的情况下，最优的通胀税问题。我们发现，当结合一个非递减的劳动收入税时，弗里德曼规则是帕累托有效的。此外，对于功利主义社会福利函数而言，最优解位于帕累托边界的该区域内。通货膨胀带来的福利成本被需求曲线下的面积所限制。

abstract.text: In 1989, the government of Mexico City introduced a program, Hoy No Circula, that bans most drivers from using their vehicles one weekday per week on the basis of the last digit of the vehicle's license plate. This article measures the effect of the driving restrictions on air quality using high-frequency measures from monitoring stations. Across pollutants and specifications there is no evidence that the restrictions have improved air quality. Evidence from additional sources indicates that the restrictions led to an increase in the total number of vehicles in circulation as well as a change in composition toward high-emissions vehicles.

10.1086/529398.abstractZh: 1989年，墨西哥城政府实施了一项名为“Hoy No Circula”的计划，规定大多数司机每周有一个工作日不使用自己的车辆，这一规定依据的是车辆车牌号的最后一位数字。本文通过监测站的高频数据来评估这一驾驶限制对空气质量的影响。无论是从污染物种类还是具体指标来看，都没有证据表明这一限制措施改善了空气质量。来自其他来源的证据表明，这一限制措施导致车辆总数增加，同时车辆组成也转向了高排放车辆。

abstract.text: We analyze, from a theoretical perspective, the impact of innovations in birth control technology on intrahousehold allocation of resources. We consider a model of frictionless matching on the marriage market in which men, as well as women, differ in their preferences for children; moreover, men, unlike women, must marry to enjoy fatherhood. We show that more efficient birth control technologies generally increase the "power," hence the welfare, of all women, including those who do not use them. This "empowerment" effect requires that the new technology be available to single women. An innovation reserved to married women may result in a "disempowerment" effect.

10.1086/529409.abstractZh: 我们从理论角度分析了避孕技术创新对家庭内部资源分配的影响。我们考虑了一个无摩擦的婚姻市场匹配模型，在这个模型中，男性和女性在子女偏好上存在差异；此外，与女性不同，男性必须结婚才能享受为人父的幸福。我们发现，更高效的避孕技术通常会提升所有女性的“权力”，从而提高她们的福祉，包括那些不使用这些技术的女性。这种“赋能”效应要求新的技术必须可供未婚女性使用。而仅针对已婚女性的创新技术则可能导致“去赋能”的效果。

abstract.text: In this article, we analyze the implications of price-setting restrictions for the conduct of cyclical fiscal and monetary policy. We consider standard monetary economies that differ in the price-setting restrictions imposed on the firms. We show that, independently of the degree or type of price stickiness, it is possible to implement the same efficient set of allocations and that each allocation in that set is implemented with policies that are also independent of the price stickiness. In this sense, environments with different price-setting restrictions are equivalent.

10.1086/533504.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了价格设定限制对周期性财政政策和货币政策实施的影响。我们考虑了不同价格设定限制下的标准货币经济模型。研究表明，无论价格粘性的程度或类型如何，都可以实施相同的有效资源配置方案，而该方案中的每一种资源配置方式都可以通过与价格粘性无关的政策来实施。从这个意义上说，具有不同价格设定限制的环境实际上是等效的。

abstract.text: We provide evidence of advantageous selection in the Medigap insurance market and analyze its sources. Conditional on controls for Medigap prices, those with Medigap spend, on average, $4,000 less on medical care than those without. But if we condition on health, those with Medigap spend $2,000 more. The sources of this advantageous selection include income, education, longevity expectations, and financial planning horizons, as well as cognitive ability. Conditional on all these factors, those with higher expected medical expenditures are more likely to purchase Medigap. Risk preferences do not appear as a source of advantageous selection; cognitive ability is particularly important.

10.1086/587623.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于Medigap保险市场中的有利选择证据，并分析了其来源。在控制了Medigap价格因素后，拥有Medigap保险的人平均在医疗方面的支出比没有该保险的人少4000美元。但是，如果考虑到健康状况，拥有Medigap保险的人在医疗方面的支出会多出2000美元。这种有利选择的来源包括收入、教育水平、寿命预期、财务规划期限，以及认知能力。在考虑所有这些因素的情况下，预期医疗支出较高的群体更有可能购买Medigap保险。风险偏好似乎并不是有利选择的来源；而认知能力则尤为重要。

abstract.text: We examine the consequences of vote buying, assuming this practice were allowed and free of stigma. Two parties compete in a binary election and may purchase votes in a sequential bidding game via up-front binding payments and/or campaign promises (platforms) that are contingent on the outcome of the election. We analyze the role of the parties' and voters' preferences in determining the winner and the payments to voters.

10.1086/587624.abstractZh: 我们研究了投票贿赂的后果，假设这种行为是被允许的，并且不会受到道德谴责。在二元选举中，两个政党通过预先的约束性支付和/或基于选举结果的竞选承诺，在连续竞价游戏中购买选票。我们分析了各方选民的偏好在决定胜选者和向选民支付补偿金方面的作用。

abstract.text: This paper examines hours worked in continental Europe and the United States from 1956 to 2003. The empirical work establishes two results. First, hours worked in Europe decline by almost 45 percent compared to the United States over this period. Second, this decline is almost entirely accounted for by the fact that Europe develops a much smaller market service sector than the United States. A simple model of time allocation is used to understand these patterns. I find that relative increases in taxes and technological catch-up can account for most of the differences between the European and American time allocations over this period.

10.1086/588029.abstractZh: 本文研究了1956年至2003年间欧洲大陆和美国的工作时长情况。实证分析得出了两个重要结论：首先，在此期间，欧洲的工作时长相比美国减少了近45%。其次，这一减少几乎完全是由于欧洲的市场服务行业规模远小于美国所致。通过简单的时间分配模型可以解释这些现象。我研究发现，在此期间，税收的相应增加以及技术水平的提升可以解释欧洲与美国在工作时长分配上的大部分差异。

abstract.text: We characterize and measure a long-term risk-return trade-off for the valuation of cash flows exposed to fluctuations in macroeconomic growth. This trade-off features risk prices of cash flows that are realized far into the future but continue to be reflected in asset values. We apply this analysis to claims on aggregate cash flows and to cash flows from value and growth portfolios by imputing values to the long-run dynamic responses of cash flows to macroeconomic shocks. We explore the sensitivity of our results to features of the economic valuation model and of the model cash flow dynamics.

10.1086/588200.abstractZh: 我们描述了并量化了宏观经济增长波动对现金流估值所带来的长期风险与回报之间的权衡。这种权衡表现为，虽然现金流的风险价值会在遥远的未来实现，但仍然会持续反映在资产价值中。我们将这一分析应用于对总体现金流的估值，以及来自价值和增长投资组合的现金流估值，通过估算现金流对宏观经济冲击的长期动态响应来得出估值结果。我们探讨了研究结果对经济估值模型特征以及模型现金流动态特性的敏感性。

abstract.text: This paper presents new evidence on why unemployment insurance (UI) benefits affect search behavior and develops a simple method of calculating the welfare gains from UI using this evidence. I show that 60 percent of the increase in unemployment durations caused by UI benefits is due to a "liquidity effect" rather than distortions on marginal incentives to search ("moral hazard") by combining two empirical strategies. First, I find that increases in benefits have much larger effects on durations for liquidity-constrained households. Second, lump-sum severance payments increase durations substantially among constrained households. I derive a formula for the optimal benefit level that depends only on the reduced-form liquidity and moral hazard elasticities. The formula implies that the optimal UI benefit level exceeds 50 percent of the wage. The "exact identification" approach to welfare analysis proposed here yields robust optimal policy results because it does not require structural estimation of primitives.

10.1086/588585.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于失业保险福利为何会影响求职行为的新证据，并提出了一种简单的方法来计算利用这些证据得出的福利收益。我指出，由于失业保险福利导致的失业持续时间延长，有60%的原因是由于“流动性效应”，而非对求职边际激励的扭曲（“道德风险”）。通过结合两种实证策略，我发现福利增加对受流动性限制的家庭的失业持续时间影响更大。此外，一次性遣散费也会显著延长受流动性限制家庭的失业持续时间。我推导出一个公式，用于确定最优福利水平，该公式仅依赖于简化的流动性与道德风险弹性系数。该公式表明，最优失业保险福利水平超过工资的50%。这里提出的“精确识别”方法在福利分析中能够得出稳健的最优政策结果，因为它不需要对基础变量进行结构性估计。

abstract.text: We develop an analytically tractable Phillips curve based on state-dependent pricing. We consider a local approximation around a zero inflation steady state and introduce infrequent idiosyncratic shocks. The resulting Phillips curve is a simple variant of the conventional time-dependent Calvo formulation with important differences. First, the model is able to match the micro evidence on the magnitude and timing of price adjustments. Second, our state-dependent model exhibits greater flexibility in the aggregate price level than the time-dependent model. With real rigidities present, however, our model can exhibit nominal stickiness similar to a conventional time-dependent model.

10.1086/589522.abstractZh: 我们基于状态依赖定价机制，开发了一个分析上可行的菲利普斯曲线模型。我们考虑了在零通胀稳态附近的局部近似情况，并引入了罕见的特异性冲击。由此得到的菲利普斯曲线是传统时间依赖型Calvo公式的简单变体，但存在重要差异。首先，该模型能够匹配关于价格调整幅度和时机的微观证据。其次，我们的状态依赖模型在总体价格水平上的灵活性高于时间依赖模型。然而，在存在实际刚性的情况下，我们的模型仍能表现出类似于传统时间依赖模型的名义粘性。

abstract.text: We present a model of nonbalanced growth based on differences in factor proportions and capital deepening. Capital deepening increases the relative output of the more capital-intensive sector but simultaneously induces a reallocation of capital and labor away from that sector. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model, we show that nonbalanced growth is consistent with an asymptotic equilibrium with a constant interest rate and capital share in national income. For plausible parameter values, the model generates dynamics consistent with U.S. data, in particular, faster growth of employment and slower growth of output in less capital-intensive sectors, and aggregate behavior consistent with the Kaldor facts.

10.1086/589523.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于要素比例差异和资本深化效应的非平衡增长模型。资本深化会提高资本密集型部门的相对产出，但同时会导致资本和劳动力的重新分配，使其从该部门转移出去。通过构建一个双部门的一般均衡模型，我们发现非平衡增长与具有恒定利率和国民收入中资本份额的渐近均衡状态是一致的。在合理的参数取值下，该模型所模拟的经济发展趋势与美国的数据相符，特别是资本密集型部门就业增长较快，而产出增长较慢，整体经济行为也与Kaldor的理论预测一致。

abstract.text: The well-known association between height and earnings is often thought to reflect factors such as self esteem, social dominance, and discrimination. We offer a simpler explanation: height is positively associated with cognitive ability, which is rewarded in the labor market. Using data from the US and the UK, we show that taller children have higher average cognitive test scores, and that these test scores explain a large portion of the height premium in earnings. Children who have higher test scores also experience earlier adolescent growth spurts, so that height in adolescence serves as a marker of cognitive ability.

10.1086/589524.abstractZh: 众所周知，身高与收入之间存在正相关关系，这通常被认为与自尊心、社会地位和歧视等因素有关。我们提供了一种更简单的解释：身高与认知能力呈正相关，而认知能力在劳动力市场中会得到回报。通过美国和英国的数据分析，我们发现较高的儿童在认知测试中的平均分数更高，而这些分数能够解释身高与收入之间的较大差异。此外，分数较高的儿童在青少年时期会经历更快的生长突增，因此青少年时期的身高可以作为认知能力的标志。

abstract.text: I exploit the large variation across U.S. cities and through time in the relative size of the low-skilled immigrant population to estimate the causal effect of immigration on prices of nontraded goods and services. Using an instrumental variables strategy, I find that, at current immigration levels, a 10 percent increase in the share of low-skilled immigrants in the labor force decreases the price of immigrant-intensive services, such as housekeeping and gardening, by 2 percent. Wage equations suggest that lower wages are a likely channel through which these effects take place. However, wage effects are significantly larger for low-skilled immigrants than for low-skilled natives, implying that the two are imperfect substitutes.

10.1086/589756.abstractZh: 我利用美国各城市以及不同时期低技能移民人口比例的大差异，来估算移民对非贸易商品和服务价格的影响。通过工具变量分析，我发现，在当前移民水平下，低技能移民在劳动力中的比例每增加10%，就会使诸如家务和园艺等需要大量移民劳动力的服务价格下降2%。工资方程表明，较低的工资可能是这些效应传导的途径。然而，低技能移民的工资效应比低技能本土居民的要大得多，这表明两者并非完全替代品。

abstract.text: I model endogenous horizontal and vertical product differentiation with arbitrarily many heterogeneous firms. Firms are asymmetric in that they differ in their marginal costs. I prove that under an equilibrium refinement, all economically relevant firm outcomes are uniquely determined across all strict subgame perfect Nash equilibria. There are two central results. First, a firm's price, market share, and profit are independent of its neighbors' marginal costs, conditional on the average marginal cost in the market. Second, more productive firms are more isolated, all else equal. In particular, the distance between two firms is strictly decreasing in their average marginal cost.

10.1086/589891.abstractZh: 我模拟了由任意多个异质性企业构成的内生性水平与垂直产品分化现象。这些企业在边际成本上存在差异，因此属于不对称企业。我证明了在均衡细化条件下，所有具有经济意义的企业结果都可以在所有严格子博弈完美纳什均衡中唯一确定。有两个核心结论：首先，在平均边际成本不变的情况下，企业的价格、市场份额和利润与其邻近企业的边际成本无关。其次，在其他条件相同的情况下，生产效率更高的企业会更加孤立。具体来说，两家企业之间的距离会随着它们平均边际成本的降低而严格减少。

abstract.text: This paper uses the randomization of families to child protection investigators to estimate causal effects of foster care on adult crime. The analysis uses a new data set that links criminal justice data to child protection data in Illinois, and I find that investigators affect foster care placement. Children on the margin of placement are found to be two to three times more likely to enter the criminal justice system as adults if they were placed in foster care. One innovation describes the types of children on the margin of placement, a group that is more likely to include African Americans, girls, and young adolescents.

10.1086/590216.abstractZh: 本文通过随机分配家庭中的儿童给儿童保护调查员，来估计寄养对成人犯罪的影响。分析使用了一个新的数据集，该数据集将刑事司法数据与伊利诺伊州的儿童保护数据联系起来。研究发现，调查员确实会影响儿童的寄养安排。那些处于寄养边缘的儿童，如果被安置在寄养环境中，成年后进入刑事司法系统的可能性是其他儿童的二到三倍。文中还描述了处于寄养边缘的儿童类型，这类儿童更可能包括非裔美国人、女孩以及年轻青少年。

abstract.text: Why didn't the Japanese miracle take place before World War II? The culprit we identify is a barrier that kept prewar agricultural employment constant. Using a standard neoclassical two-sector growth model, we show that the barrier-induced sectoral distortion and an ensuring lack of capital accumulation account well for the depressed output level. Without the barrier, Japan's prewar GNP per worker would have been at least about a half of that of the United States, not about a third as in the data. The labor barrier existed because, we argue, the prewar patriarchy forced the son designated as heir to stay in agriculture.

10.1086/591804.abstractZh: 为什么日本的奇迹没有在第二次世界大战之前出现？我们认为，造成这一情况的罪魁祸首是一道阻碍农业就业稳定的障碍。通过采用标准的新古典两部门增长模型，我们发现这种障碍导致的部门性扭曲以及缺乏资本积累是导致产出水平低迷的主要原因。如果没有这一障碍，日本的战前人均国民生产总值至少会是美国水平的一半，而不是数据中所显示的约三分之一。我们认为，这种劳动障碍的存在是因为战前的父权制度迫使被指定为继承人的儿子继续留在农业领域。

abstract.text: This article examines tax evasion in the diesel fuel market. Diesel fuel used for on-road purposes is taxed, while other uses are untaxed, creating an incentive for firms and individuals to evade on-road diesel taxes by purchasing untaxed diesel fuel and then using it for on-road use. We examine the effects of a federal regulatory innovation in October 1993, the addition of red dye to untaxed diesel fuel at the point of distribution, which significantly lowered the cost of regulatory enforcement. We find that sales of diesel fuel rose 26 percent following the regulatory change, while sales of heating oil, which is an untaxed perfect substitute, fell by a similar amount. The effect on sales was higher in states with higher tax rates and in states likely to have higher audit costs. We also find evidence that heating oil sales were less responsive to demand factors, such as temperature, prior to the dye program, indicating that a significant fraction of predye sales was illegitimate. Furthermore, we find a pattern of price and tax elasticities consistent with innovation in new evasion techniques subsequent to the regulatory change. Finally, we estimate that the elasticity of tax revenues with respect to the tax rate was 0.60 prior to the dye program yet would have been 0.85 in the absence of evasion.

10.1086/591805.abstractZh: 本文探讨了柴油燃料市场中的逃税现象。用于道路行驶的柴油燃料需要缴纳税赋，而其他用途的柴油燃料则无需纳税，这促使企业和个人通过购买无需纳税的柴油燃料并将其用于道路行驶来逃避税赋。我们研究了1993年10月一项联邦监管创新的影响，即在分配环节向无需纳税的柴油燃料中添加红色染料，这一举措显著降低了监管执法的成本。研究发现，在监管改革实施后，柴油燃料的销量增加了26%，而作为无需纳税的替代品的取暖油的销量则减少了类似幅度。在税率较高的州以及审计成本较高的州，这种影响更为显著。此外，我们还发现，在添加红色染料之前，取暖油的销量对温度等需求因素的响应较低，这表明相当一部分销量是非法的。此外，我们发现，在监管改革之后，价格和税收弹性与新的逃税手段的创新趋势一致。最后，我们估计，在添加红色染料之前，税收与税率的弹性为0.60，而在没有逃税行为的情况下，这一弹性应为0.85。

abstract.text: We analyze the introduction of highly subsidized, universally accessible child care in Quebec, addressing the impact on child care utilization, maternal labor supply, and family well-being. We find strong evidence of a shift into new child care use, although some crowding out of existing arrangements is evident. Maternal labor supply increases significantly. Finally, the evidence suggests that children are worse off by measures ranging from aggression to motor and social skills to illness. We also uncover evidence that the new child care program led to more hostile, less consistent parenting, worse parental health, and lower-quality parental relationships.

10.1086/591908.abstractZh: 我们分析了魁北克引入高度补贴、全民可获得的儿童保育服务的情况，探讨了这一政策对儿童保育利用、母亲劳动力供应以及家庭福祉的影响。我们发现，新的儿童保育服务确实带来了使用上的转变，尽管也出现了对现有安排的一些替代现象。母亲劳动力供应显著增加。此外，有证据表明，儿童在从攻击性到运动能力、社交技能再到健康状况等方面都出现了恶化。我们还发现，新的儿童保育计划导致了更敌对、更不稳定的育儿方式，母亲的健康状况恶化，以及亲子关系质量的下降。

abstract.text: This paper considers the profit-maximization problem of a firm that must make sunk investments in long-lived assets to produce output. It is shown that if per-period accounting income is calculated using a simple and natural allocation rule for investment, called the relative replacement cost (RRC) rule, under a broad range of plausible circumstances, the firm can choose the fully optimal sequence of investments over time simply by choosing a level of investment each period in order to maximize the next period's accounting income. Furthermore, in a model in which shareholders delegate the investment decision to a better-informed manager, it is shown that if accounting income based on the RRC allocation rule is used as a performance measure for the manager, robust incentives are created for the manager to choose the profit-maximizing sequence of investments, regardless of the manager's own personal discount rate or other aspects of the manager's personal preferences.

10.1086/591909.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业在必须进行长期投资以生产产出时的利润最大化问题。研究表明，如果在多种合理情况下，采用一种简单且自然的投资分配规则——相对重置成本规则来计算每期的会计收益，企业只需在每个时期选择适当的投资水平，就能实现下一期会计收益的最大化，从而选择完全最优的投资顺序。此外，在一个股东将投资决策委托给更了解情况的经理的模型中，如果以基于相对重置成本分配规则的会计收益作为对经理绩效的衡量标准，那么无论经理自身的折现率或个人偏好如何，都会激励经理选择能够最大化利润的投资顺序。

abstract.text: I explore the efficiency properties of a competitive search model with match-specific private information and limited commitment on the workers' side. In a static setting the competitive search equilibrium is constrained efficient, whereas in a dynamic setting it is constrained inefficient whenever the initial unemployment rate is different from its steady-state level. Inefficiency arises because the workers' outside option becomes endogenous and affects the severity of the distortion due to the informational friction. This generates a novel externality: firms offering contracts at a given time do not internalize their effect on the outside option of workers hired in previous periods.

10.1086/591910.abstractZh: 我研究了具有特定匹配信息且对工人约束有限的竞争搜索模型的效率特性。在静态环境中，竞争搜索均衡是受限有效的；而在动态环境中，当初始失业率与其稳态水平不同时，该均衡则表现为受限无效的。无效性产生的原因在于，工人的外部选择变得内生化，从而影响了由于信息摩擦导致的扭曲程度。这产生了一个新的外部性：企业在特定时间提供的合同并未将他们对之前雇用工人的外部选择的影响内部化。

abstract.text: Define the riskiness of a gamble as the reciprocal of the absolute risk aversion (ARA) of an individual with constant ARA who is indifferent between taking and not taking that gamble. We characterize this index by axioms, chief among them a "duality" axiom that, roughly speaking, asserts that less risk-averse individuals accept riskier gambles. The index is positively homogeneous, continuous, and subadditive; respects first- and second-order stochastic dominance; and for normally distributed gambles is half of variance/mean. Examples are calculated, additional properties are derived, and the index is compared with others.

10.1086/591947.abstractZh: 将赌博的风险性定义为个体在恒定风险厌恶度下，对是否进行该赌博持中立态度时的绝对风险厌恶度的倒数。我们通过一系列公理来描述这一指标，其中最重要的一个公理是“双重性”公理，大致而言，该公理表明风险厌恶程度较低的个体更倾向于接受风险较高的赌博。该指标具有正齐次性、连续性以及次可加性；同时遵循一阶和二阶随机优势原则；对于正态分布的赌博结果，其风险性等于方差与均值的一半。文中还给出了具体的例子，推导出了该指标的其它性质，并与其他指标进行了比较。

abstract.text: This paper uses social networks to identify information transfer in security markets. We focus on connections between mutual fund managers and corporate board members via shared education networks. We find that portfolio managers place larger bets on connected firms and perform significantly better on these holdings relative to their nonconnected holdings. A replicating portfolio of connected stocks outperforms nonconnected stocks by up to 7.8 percent per year. Returns are concentrated around corporate news announcements, consistent with portfolio managers gaining an informational advantage through the education networks. Our results suggest that social networks may be important mechanisms for information flow into asset prices.

10.1086/592415.abstractZh: 本文利用社交网络来识别证券市场的信息传递情况。我们重点关注共同教育网络下，共同基金管理者与企业董事会成员之间的联系。研究发现，投资组合管理者更倾向于投资与自身有联系的企业，并且在这些投资上的表现明显优于那些没有联系的企业。由这些联系企业组成的投资组合，其年均表现优于非联系企业，高出7.8个百分点。收益情况集中在企业新闻公告期间，这表明投资组合管理者通过教育网络获得了信息优势。我们的研究结果表明，社交网络可能是信息流入资产价格的重要机制。

abstract.text: We test the predictions from Becker's (1957) seminal work on employer prejudice and find that relative black wages (a) vary negatively with the prejudice of the "marginal" white in a state, (b) vary negatively with the prejudice in the lower tail of the prejudice distribution but are unaffected by the prejudice of the most prejudiced persons in a state, and (c) vary negatively with the fraction of a state that is black. Our estimates suggest that one-quarter of the racial wage gap is due to prejudice, with nontrivial consequences for black lifetime earnings.

10.1086/593073.abstractZh: 我们验证了贝克尔（1957年）关于雇主偏见的研究结果，发现以下现象：a) 黑人工资与某个州中“边缘”白人的偏见呈负相关；b) 黑人工资与偏见分布较低端的白人偏见也呈负相关，但不受该州偏见最严重人群的影响；c) 黑人工资与某个州中黑人比例呈负相关。我们的估计表明，种族工资差距中有四分之一是由偏见造成的，这对黑人的终身收入有着不可忽视的影响。

abstract.text: Using data from rural Bangladesh, we explore the hypothesis that women attain less schooling as a result of social and financial pressure to marry young. We isolate the causal effect of marriage timing using age of menarche as an instrumental variable. Our results indicate that each additional year that marriage is delayed is associated with 0.22 additional year of schooling and 5.6 percent higher literacy. Delayed marriage is also associated with an increase in use of preventive health services. In the context of competitive marriage markets, we use the above results to obtain estimates of the change in equilibrium female education that would arise from introducing age of consent laws.

10.1086/593333.abstractZh: 通过收集孟加拉国农村地区的数据，我们探讨了这样一个假设：由于社会和经济压力，女性往往被迫在年轻时结婚，从而导致她们接受教育的年限减少。我们利用初潮年龄作为工具变量，来研究婚姻时间的延迟对教育年限的影响。研究结果表明，婚姻时间每延迟一年，女性的教育年限就会增加0.22年，识字率也会提高5.6%。此外，婚姻时间的延迟还与预防性健康服务的使用增加有关。在竞争激烈的婚姻市场中，我们利用上述研究结果，估算了引入同意年龄法律后，女性教育水平的变化情况。

abstract.text: This paper examines the implications of regulatory change for input mix and technology choices of regulated industries. We study the increase in the relative price of labor faced by U.S. hospitals that resulted from the move from full cost to partial cost reimbursement under the Medicare Prospective Payment System (PPS) reform. Using the interaction of hospitals’ pre‐PPS Medicare share of patient days with the introduction of PPS, we document substantial increases in capital‐labor ratios and declines in labor inputs following PPS. Most interestingly, we find that PPS seems to have encouraged the adoption of a range of new medical technologies.

10.1086/595014.abstractZh: 本文探讨了监管变革对受监管行业投入组合和技术选择的影响。我们研究了在Medicare预期支付系统改革下，从全额成本补偿转向部分成本补偿后，美国医院面临的劳动力相对价格上升情况。通过研究医院在PPS改革前的Medicare患者日数占比与PPS引入之间的互动关系，我们发现PPS实施后，资本与劳动力的比例显著上升，而劳动力投入则有所下降。最引人注目的是，我们发现PPS似乎促进了多种新型医疗技术的采用。

abstract.text: Insolvency practitioners from 88 countries describe how debt enforcement will proceed against an identical hotel about to default on its debt. We use the data on time, cost, and the likely disposition of the assets (preservation as a going concern vs. piecemeal sale) to construct a measure of the efficiency of debt enforcement in each country. This measure is strongly correlated with per capita income and legal origin and predicts debt market development. Several characteristics of debt enforcement procedures, such as the structure of appeals and availability of floating charge finance, influence efficiency.

10.1086/595015.abstractZh: 来自88个国家的破产管理人描述了针对一家即将陷入债务违约的相同酒店如何进行债务执行。我们利用关于时间、成本以及资产可能的处置方式（作为持续经营企业保留还是分批出售）的数据，来衡量每个国家债务执行的效率。这一指标与人均收入和法律渊源有显著相关性，并能预测债务市场的发展。债务执行程序的若干特征，如上诉结构以及浮动抵押融资的可用性，都会影响执行效率。

abstract.text: A big power is facing a small power that may have developed weapons of mass destruction. The small power can create strategic ambiguity by refusing arms inspections. We study the impact of strategic ambiguity on arms proliferation and welfare. Strategic ambiguity is a substitute for actually acquiring weapons: ambiguity reduces the incentive for the small power to invest in weapons, which reduces the threat of arms proliferation. But strategic ambiguity hides information, and this can lead to costly mistakes. Cheap-talk messages can be used to trigger inspections when such mistakes are particularly costly. Tough messages that trigger inspections always imply a greater risk of arms proliferation.

10.1086/595016.abstractZh: 一个强大的国家正面临一个可能拥有大规模杀伤性武器的弱小国家。这个弱小国家可以通过拒绝武器检查来制造战略模糊性。我们研究了战略模糊性对武器扩散和福利的影响。战略模糊性实际上是一种替代手段，它降低了弱小国家投资武器的动机，从而减少了武器扩散的威胁。然而，战略模糊性会隐藏信息，这可能导致代价高昂的错误。当这种错误特别昂贵时，可以通过发送警告性的信息来触发检查。而强制性的检查则意味着武器扩散的风险更大。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of ambiguous and contested land rights on investment and productivity in agriculture in Akwapim, Ghana. We show that individuals who hold powerful positions in a local political hierarchy have more secure tenure rights and that as a consequence they invest more in land fertility and have substantially higher output. The intensity of investments on different plots cultivated by a given individual corresponds to that individual's security of tenure over those specific plots and, in turn, to the individual's position in the political hierarchy relevant to those specific plots.

10.1086/595561.abstractZh: 我们研究了加纳阿夸皮姆地区，土地权利的不明确性和争议性对农业投资及生产力的影响。研究发现，在地方政治体系中占据重要位置的个体，其土地所有权更为稳固，因此他们会在土地肥力方面投入更多资金，进而实现更高的产出。一个个体所耕种的不同地块上的投资强度，与该个体对这些特定地块的所有权稳定性密切相关，而这一稳定性又与该个体在相关政治体系中的地位息息相关。

abstract.text: We use a novel research design to empirically detect the effect of social interactions on labor market outcomes. Using Census data on residential and employment locations, we examine whether individuals residing in the same city block are more likely to work together than those in nearby blocks. We find evidence of significant social interactions. The estimated referral effect is stronger when individuals are similar in sociodemographic characteristics. These findings are robust across specifications intended to address sorting and reverse causation. Further, the increased availability of neighborhood referrals has a significant impact on a wide range of labor market outcomes.

10.1086/595975.abstractZh: 我们采用了一种新颖的研究设计，以实证方式检测社交互动对劳动力市场结果的影响。通过利用人口普查数据中的居住和就业位置信息，我们研究了居住在同一街区的人们是否比居住在邻近街区的人们更有可能一起工作。我们发现存在显著的社交互动现象。当个体在社会人口学特征上相似时，推荐效应更为显著。这些发现在不同假设条件下依然成立，这些假设旨在解决排序问题和反向因果关系的问题。此外，社区内社交互动的增加对多种劳动力市场结果产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory in which increases in female labor force participation and reductions in the gender-wage gap are generated as part of a single process of demographic transition, initially characterized by reductions in mortality and fertility. The paper suggests a relationship between gains in life expectancy and changes in the role of women in society that has not been identified before in the literature. Mortality reductions affect the incentives of individuals to invest in human capital and to have children, with implications for female labor force participation and the wage differential between men and women. The paper also presents some empirical evidence to support the predictions of the theory.

10.1086/596102.abstractZh: 本文提出一种理论，认为女性劳动力参与率的提高和性别工资差距的缩小是人口转型过程中的一个共同结果，而人口转型最初的特征是死亡率和生育率的下降。该理论揭示了预期寿命的增加与女性在社会中角色变化之间的关系，这一关系在现有文献中尚未被充分探讨。死亡率的下降会影响个人对人力资本投资和生育的意愿，从而影响女性劳动力参与率以及男女之间的工资差异。此外，本文还提供了一些实证证据来支持该理论的预测。

abstract.text: AIMS: To investigate the long-term clinical outcome (up to 30 years) after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery and to assess the life expectancy (LE) among subgroups of patients. METHODS AND RESULTS: We analysed the 30-year outcome of the first 1041 consecutive patients in our institution (age at operation 53 years, 88% male) who underwent venous CABG between 1971 and 1980. During follow-up, every 5-7 years follow-up status was obtained by reviewing the hospital records and from general practitioners and civil registries. Data were collected on death and repeat coronary revascularization procedures. Follow-up was complete in 98%. Median follow-up was 29 years (26-36 years). The cumulative 10-, 20-, and 30-year survival rates were 77%, 40%, and 15%, respectively. Overall, 623 coronary re-interventions were performed in 373 patients (36%). The cumulative 10-, 20-, and 30-year freedom from death and coronary re-intervention rates were 60%, 20%, and 6%, respectively. Age [hazard ratio (HR) 1.04/year], extent of vessel disease (VD) (two-VD HR 1.4; three-VD HR 1.9), left main disease (HR 1.6) and impaired left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) (HR 1.8) were independent predictors of mortality. We were able to assess the exact LE by calculating the area under the Kaplan-Meier curves. Overall LE after first CABG was 17.6 years. LE in patients with one-, two-, and three-VD was 21.4, 18.8, and 15.4 years, respectively (P < 0.0001). Patients with impaired LVEF had a significant shorter LE than patients with normal LVEF (13.9% vs. 19.3%; P < 0.0001). CONCLUSION: This 30-year follow-up study comprises the almost complete life cycle after CABG surgery. Overall median LE was 17.6 years. As the majority of the patients (94%) needed a repeat intervention, we conclude that the classic venous bypass technique is a useful but palliative treatment of a progressive disease.

10.1093/eurheartj/ehn530.abstractZh: 目的：研究冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）手术后的长期临床结果（长达30年），并评估不同患者亚组的预期寿命。方法和结果：我们分析了1971年至1980年间在我们机构接受静脉CABG的1041名连续患者的30年结果（手术时年龄53岁，88%为男性）。在随访期间，通过查阅医院记录以及全科医生和民事登记数据，每5-7年获取一次随访情况。收集了死亡和重复冠状动脉血运重建手术的数据。98%的患者完成了随访，中位随访时间为29年（26-36年）。10年、20年和30年的累积生存率分别为77%、40%和15%。总体而言，在373名患者中发生了623次冠状动脉再介入手术（占36%）。10年、20年和30年的无死亡和冠状动脉再介入的累积生存率分别为60%、20%和6%。年龄[风险比（HR）1.04/年]、血管病变程度（两处病变的HR为1.4；三处病变的HR为1.9）、左主干病变（HR为1.6）以及左心室射血分数降低（LVEF）受损（HR为1.8）是独立的死亡预测因素。我们通过计算Kaplan-Meier曲线下的面积来准确评估预期寿命。首次CABG后的总体预期寿命为17.6年。有一处、两处和三处病变的患者预期寿命分别为21.4年、18.8年和15.4年（P < 0.0001）。左心室射血分数受损的患者预期寿命明显短于左心室射血分数正常的患者（13.9% vs. 19.3%；P < 0.0001）。结论：这项为期30年的随访研究涵盖了CABG手术后的几乎完整生命周期。总体中位预期寿命为17.6年。由于大多数患者（94%）需要再次干预，我们得出结论，经典的静脉旁路技术是一种有用的、但只能缓解这种进展性疾病的姑息性治疗方法。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: We examined the impact of state Medicaid payment rates and case-mix reimbursement on direct care staffing levels in US nursing homes. METHODS: We used a recent time series of national nursing home data from the Online Survey Certification and Reporting system for 1996-2004, merged with annual state Medicaid payment rates and case-mix reimbursement information. A 5-category response measure of total staffing levels was defined according to expert recommended thresholds, and examined in a multinomial logistic regression model. Facility fixed-effects models were estimated separately for Registered Nurse (RN), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), and Certified Nurse Aide (CNA) staffing levels measured as average hours per resident day. RESULTS: Higher Medicaid payment rates were associated with increases in total staffing levels to meet a higher recommended threshold. However, these gains in overall staffing were accompanied by a reduction of RN staffing and an increase in both LPN and CNA staffing levels. Under case-mix reimbursement, the likelihood of nursing homes achieving higher recommended staffing thresholds decreased, as did levels of professional staffing. Independent of the effects of state, market, and facility characteristics, there was a significant downward trend in RN staffing and an upward trend in both LPN and CNA staffing. CONCLUSIONS: Although overall staffing may increase in response to more generous Medicaid reimbursement, it may not translate into improvements in the skill mix of staff. Adjusting for reimbursement levels and resident acuity, total staffing has not increased after the implementation of case-mix reimbursement.

10.1097/mlr.0b013e3181484197.abstractZh: 目的：我们研究了州级医疗补助支付率与病例组合报销对美国养老院直接护理人员配置水平的影响。方法：我们使用了1996-2004年间来自在线调查认证与报告系统的全国养老院数据，并将其与各州的医疗补助支付率和病例组合报销信息相结合。根据专家推荐的阈值，定义了总人员配置的5类指标，并在多项逻辑回归模型中进行了分析。分别针对注册护士、执业护士和认证护理助理的人员配置情况，计算了平均每日每名居民所需的护理人员数量。结果：较高的医疗补助支付率与满足更高推荐阈值所需的总人员配置增加相关。然而，这种整体人员配置的改善伴随着注册护士人员数量的减少，以及执业护士和认证护理助理人员数量的增加。在病例组合报销制度下，养老院达到更高推荐人员配置阈值的可能性降低，专业护理人员的数量也减少了。除了州级、市场和设施特征的影响外，注册护士人员数量显著减少，而执业护士和认证护理助理人员数量则呈现上升趋势。结论：尽管随着医疗补助报销政策的放宽，整体人员配置可能会增加，但这并不一定意味着员工技能组合的改善。在调整了报销水平和居民病情严重程度后，实施病例组合报销制度后，总人员配置并未增加。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: This study uses empirical data to study changes in the structure and use of HMO hospital provider networks in California. STUDY DESIGN: Data from California HMOs are used to test whether there have been structural changes in HMO size, geographic coverage, hospital network design, and patient channeling for inpatient care over the period 1999-2003. METHODS: Three different measures of HMO network breadth, access, and channeling were analyzed between 1999 and 2003. Actual patient admission data linked to health plan code variables are used to identify inpatient hospital discharges covered by each HMO in California and to which hospital each HMO sends its patients in each year between 1999 and 2003. RESULTS: Despite consolidation in the total number of HMOs, the share of all hospital admissions accounted for by HMOs remained substantial. In terms of network breadth, there were minimal changes over time in the percent of available hospitals included in HMO networks. There was a slight increase in distance traveled for HMO' patient who were admitted, the opposite of what would be expected if networks were being broadened. Finally, channeling, as measured by the concentration of a payers' patients within its network hospitals did not change significantly. CONCLUSIONS: We found little evidence that there have been systematic changes in either the structure or use of HMO hospital networks in California between 1999 and 2003, suggesting that these factors played a limited role in explaining the return of growth in health care costs.

10.1097/mlr.0b013e3181589bcb.abstractZh:
目的：本研究利用实证数据来研究加利福尼亚州HMO医院网络的结构和使用变化。  
研究设计：使用加利福尼亚州HMO的数据，检验在1999年至2003年期间，HMO的规模、地理覆盖范围、医院网络设计以及住院患者的转诊方式是否存在结构性变化。  
方法：分析了1999年至2003年间HMO网络的范围、可及性和转诊方式三个不同的指标。通过实际的患者入院数据，结合健康计划代码变量，确定每个HMO在加利福尼亚州覆盖的住院病人，以及每年这些病人被转送到哪些医院。  
结果：尽管HMO的总数有所减少，但HMO所负责的医院入院比例仍然相当高。在网络范围方面，被HMO网络包含的可用医院的比例变化不大。对于被转送的HMO患者而言，转送距离略有增加，这与网络扩大所预期的情况相反。最后，从支付者患者的集中度来看，HMO网络医院内部的转诊方式并没有显著变化。  
结论：我们发现，在1999年至2003年间，加利福尼亚州HMO医院网络的结构和使用方面几乎没有系统性变化，这表明这些因素在解释医疗保健成本的增长中扮演的角色有限。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: A single composite measure calculated from individual quality indicators (QIs) is a useful measure of hospital performance and can be justified conceptually even when the indicators are not highly correlated with one another. OBJECTIVE: To compare 2 basic approaches for calculating a composite measure: an extension of the most widely-used approach, which weights individual indicators based on the number of people eligible for the indicator (referred to as denominator-based weights, DBWs), and a Bayesian hierarchical latent variable model (BLVM). METHODS: Using data for 15 QIs from 3275 hospitals in the Hospital Compare database, we calculated hospital ranks using several versions of DBWs and 2 BLVMs. Estimates in 1 BLVM were driven by differences in variances of the QIs (BLVM1) and estimates in the other by differences in the signal-to-noise ratios of the QIs (BLVM2). RESULTS: There was a high correlation in ranks among all of the DBW approaches and between those approaches and BLVM1. However, a high correlation does not necessarily mean that the same hospitals were ranked in the top or bottom quality deciles. In general, large hospitals were ranked in higher quality deciles by all of the approaches, though the effect was most apparent using BLVM2. CONCLUSIONS: Both conceptually and practically, hospital-specific DBWs are a reasonable approach for calculating a composite measure. However, this approach fails to take into account differences in the reliability of estimates from hospitals of different sizes, a big advantage of the Bayesian models.

10.1097/mlr.0b013e31817893dc.abstractZh: 背景：从各个质量指标计算得出的单一综合指标是衡量医院绩效的有效方式，即使这些指标之间并非高度相关，这一概念上也是合理的。目的：比较两种计算综合指标的基本方法：一种是扩展最常用的方法，该方法根据指标适用的人员数量来加权指标（称为基于分母的权重）；另一种是贝叶斯层次潜在变量模型。方法：使用Hospital Compare数据库中的15个指标数据，对3275家医院进行了排名计算，分别使用了几种版本的基于分母的权重和两种贝叶斯层次潜在变量模型。一种贝叶斯层次潜在变量模型的估计结果受到指标方差差异的影响，另一种则受到指标信号与噪声比率差异的影响。结果：所有基于分母的权重方法之间以及这些方法与贝叶斯层次潜在变量模型1之间的排名存在高度相关性。然而，高度相关性并不一定意味着相同的医院会处于最高或最低的质量等级。总体而言，大型医院在所有方法中的排名都较高，但这一效应在使用贝叶斯层次潜在变量模型2时最为明显。结论：从概念上和实际操作来看，针对特定医院的基于分母的权重是一种合理的综合指标计算方法。然而，这种方法未能考虑到不同规模医院在估计可靠性方面的差异，而贝叶斯模型则具有这一优势。

abstract.text: A general equilibrium search model makes layoff costs affect the aggregate unemployment rate in ways that depend on equilibrium proportions of frictional and structural unemployment that in turn depend on the generosity of government unemployment benefits and skill losses among newly displaced workers. The model explains how, before the 1970s, lower flows into unemployment gave Europe lower unemployment rates than the United States and also how, after 1980, higher durations have kept unemployment rates in Europe persistently higher than in the United States. These outcomes arise from the way Europe's higher firing costs and more generous unemployment compensation make its unemployment rate respond to bigger skill losses among newly displaced workers. Those bigger skill losses also explain why U.S. workers have experienced more earnings volatility since 1980 and why, especially among older workers, hazard rates of gaining employment in Europe now fall sharply with increases in the duration of unemployment.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00816.x.abstractZh: 一种一般均衡搜索模型表明，裁员成本会影响总体失业率，而这一影响取决于摩擦性失业和结构性失业的均衡比例，而这些比例又受到政府失业救济金规模和新失业工人技能损失的影响。该模型解释了在1970年代之前，欧洲较低的失业率是由于较低的失业人数，而非美国。同时，1980年之后，较长的失业持续时间使得欧洲的失业率持续高于美国。这些现象源于欧洲较高的裁员成本和更慷慨的失业补偿政策，使得失业率对新失业工人更大的技能损失更加敏感。此外，更大的技能损失也解释了为什么自1980年以来，美国工人的收入波动性增加，尤其是在老年工人中，欧洲在失业持续时间增加的情况下，获得新工作的风险显著降低。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of revealed preferences over one’s own and others’monetary payo¤s. We introduce “more altruistic than”(MAT), a partial ordering over preferences, and interpret it with known parametric models. We also introduce and illustrate “more generous than ” (MGT), a partial ordering over opportunity sets. Several recent discussions of altruism focus on two player extensive form games of complete information in which the …rst mover (FM) chooses a more or less generous opportunity set for the second mover (SM). Here reciprocity can be formalized as the assertion that an MGT choice by the FM will elicit MAT preferences in the SM and, furthermore, that the e¤ect on preferences is stronger for acts of commision than acts of ommision by FM. We state and prove propositions on the observable consequences of these assertions. Then we test those propositions using existing data from investment games with dictator controls and Stackelberg games and new data from Stackelberg mini-games. The test results provide support for the theory of revealed altruism.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00817.x.abstractZh: 本文发展了一种关于个体对自己和他人金钱报酬的显性偏好理论。我们引入了“更利他”（MAT）这一偏好上的偏序关系，并用已知的参数模型对其进行解释。我们还引入了“更慷慨”（MGT）这一机会集上的偏序关系，并对其进行了说明和例证。近期关于利他主义的讨论主要集中在完全信息下的两人广泛形式博弈中，其中第一个行动者（FM）会为第二个行动者（SM）选择一个更慷慨或较不慷慨的机会集。在这里，互惠可以被形式化为这样的断言：FM的MGT选择会在SM中引发MAT偏好，并且，对于FM的承诺行为而言，对偏好的影响比承诺行为更为显著。我们提出了这些断言的可观察后果，并对此进行了证明。随后，我们使用带有独裁者控制的投资博弈以及Stackelberg博弈的现有数据，以及来自Stackelberg小型博弈的新数据，对这些命题进行了测试。测试结果为显性利他主义理论提供了支持。

abstract.text: We study how professional players and college students play zero-sum two-person strategic games in a laboratory setting. We first ask professionals to play a 2 × 2 game that is formally identical to a strategic interaction situation that they face in their natural environment. Consistent with their behavior in the field, they play very close to the equilibrium of the game. In particular, (i) they equate their strategies' payoffs to the equilibrium ones and (ii) they generate sequences of choices that are serially independent. In sharp contrast, however, we find that college students play the game far from the equilibrium predictions. We then study the behavior of professional players and college students in the classic O'Neill 4 × 4 zero-sum game, a game that none of the subjects has encountered previously, and find the same differences in the behavior of these two pools of subjects. The transfer of skills and experience from the familiar field to the unfamiliar laboratory observed for professional players is relevant to evaluate the circumstances under which behavior in a laboratory setting may be a reliable indicator of behavior in a naturally occurring setting. From a cognitive perspective, it is useful for research on recognition processes, intuition, and similarity as a basis for inductive reasoning.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00818.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了专业运动员和大学生在实验室环境中如何玩零和两人策略游戏。首先，我们要求专业运动员玩一个2×2的游戏，这个游戏在形式上与他们在实际环境中面临的策略互动情况完全相同。与他们在现实环境中的行为一致，他们几乎达到了游戏的均衡点。具体来说，(i)他们将策略的收益等同于均衡点收益；(ii)他们产生的选择序列是序列独立的。然而，与实际情况截然不同的是，我们发现大学生在游戏中偏离了均衡预测的结果。接着，我们研究了专业运动员和大学生在经典的O'Neill 4×4零和游戏中的行为，这个游戏是受试者们之前从未接触过的。我们发现这两组受试者的行为也存在同样的差异。专业运动员从熟悉的领域转移到不熟悉的实验室环境中的技能和经验，对于评估实验室环境中的行为是否可以作为自然环境中行为的可靠指标具有重要意义。从认知角度来看，这对于研究识别过程、直觉以及相似性作为归纳推理的基础非常有用。

abstract.text: There are typically multiple equilibrium outcomes in the Crawford–Sobel (CS) model of strategic information transmission. This paper identifies a simple condition on equilibrium payoffs, called NITS (no incentive to separate), that selects among CS equilibria. Under a commonly used regularity condition, only the equilibrium with the maximal number of induced actions satisfies NITS. We discuss various justifications for NITS, including perturbed cheap-talk games with nonstrategic players or costly lying. We also apply NITS to other models of cheap talk, illustrating its potential beyond the CS framework.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00819.x.abstractZh: 在Crawford–Sobel（CS）战略信息传输模型中，通常存在多个均衡结果。本文提出了一种关于均衡收益的简单条件，称为NITS（无分离激励），该条件用于区分CS模型中的不同均衡。在常用的规律性条件下，只有具有最大诱导行动数的均衡满足NITS条件。我们讨论了NITS的各种解释，包括包含非战略参与者或代价高昂的谎言的扰动型廉价谈话游戏。此外，我们还将NITS应用于其他廉价谈话模型，展示了其在CS框架之外的潜在应用价值。

abstract.text: Experimental studies have found that a decision maker prefers spreading good and bad outcomes evenly over time. We propose, in an axiomatic framework, a new model of discount factors that captures this preference for spread. The model provides a refinement of the discounted utility model while maintaining dynamic consistency. The derived discount factors incorporate gain/loss asymmetry recursively: the difference between average future utility and current utility defines a gain or a loss, and gains are discounted more than losses. This notion of utility smoothing can induce a preference for spread: if bad outcomes are concentrated on future periods, moving one of the bad outcomes to today would be beneficial because such an operation eliminates a large loss and replaces it with a small gain.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00820.x.abstractZh: 实验研究表明，决策者更倾向于将好坏结果在时间内均匀分配。我们在一个公理化的框架内提出了一个新的折扣因子模型，该模型能够捕捉到这种对分布方式的偏好。该模型在保持动态一致性的同时，对折扣效用模型进行了改进。所推导出的折扣因子递归地考虑了收益与损失的差异：未来平均效用与当前效用之间的差值决定了是收益还是损失，且收益的折扣程度高于损失。这种效用平滑的概念可以引导出对分布的偏好：如果糟糕的结果集中在未来时期，那么将其中一个糟糕的结果转移到今天会是有益的，因为这样的操作可以消除较大的损失，并替换为较小的收益。

abstract.text: The conventional heteroskedasticity-robust (HR) variance matrix estimator for cross-sectional regression (with or without a degrees-of-freedom adjustment), applied to the fixed-effects estimator for panel data with serially uncorrelated errors, is inconsistent if the number of time periods T is fixed (and greater than 2) as the number of entities n increases. We provide a bias-adjusted HR estimator that is √nT-consistent under any sequences (n T ) in which n and/or T increase to ∞. This estimator can be extended to handle serial correlation of fixed order.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00821.x.abstractZh: 对于具有序列非相关误差的面板数据，传统的异方差稳健方差矩阵估计量（无论是否进行自由度调整）在时间周期数量T固定（且大于2）的情况下，随着实体数量n的增加而不一致。我们提出了一种经过偏差调整的HR估计量，该估计量在任何序列(n, T)中都是√nT一致的，其中n和/或T可以增加到无穷大。该估计量还可以扩展以处理固定阶数的序列相关性问题。

abstract.text: In time series regressions with nonparametrically autocorrelated errors, it is now standard empirical practice to use kernel-based robust standard errors that involve some smoothing function over the sample autocorrelations. The underlying smoothing parameter b, which can be defined as the ratio of the bandwidth (or truncation lag) to the sample size, is a tuning parameter that plays a key role in determining the asymptotic properties of the standard errors and associated semiparametric tests. Small-b asymptotics involve standard limit theory such as standard normal or chi-squared limits, whereas fixed-b asymptotics typically lead to nonstandard limit distributions involving Brownian bridge functionals. The present paper shows that the nonstandard fixed-b limit distributions of such nonparametrically studentized tests provide more accurate approximations to the finite sample distributions than the standard small-b limit distribution. In particular, using asymptotic expansions of both the finite sample distribution and the nonstandard limit distribution, we confirm that the second-order corrected critical value based on the expansion of the nonstandard limiting distribution is also second-order correct under the standard small-b asymptotics. We further show that, for typical economic time series, the optimal bandwidth that minimizes a weighted average of type I and type II errors is larger by an order of magnitude than the bandwidth that minimizes the asymptotic mean squared error of the corresponding long-run variance estimator. A plug-in procedure for implementing this optimal bandwidth is suggested and simulations confirm that the new plug-in procedure works well in finite samples.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00822.x.abstractZh: 在具有非参数自相关误差的时间序列回归中，现在标准的经验做法是使用基于核的稳健标准误差，这些误差涉及对样本自相关性的某种平滑处理。潜在的平滑参数b可以定义为带宽（或截断滞后）与样本大小的比率，它是一个调节参数，在决定标准误差及其相关半参数检验的渐近性质方面起着关键作用。小b渐近性涉及标准极限理论，如标准正态或卡方极限，而固定b渐近性通常会导致涉及布朗桥函数的非标准极限分布。本文表明，这种非标准固定b极限分布下的非参数学生化检验能够比标准小b极限分布提供更准确的有限样本分布近似。特别是，通过同时使用有限样本分布和非标准极限分布的渐近展开，我们确认基于非标准极限分布展开的二阶修正临界值在标准小b渐近性下也是二阶正确的。我们进一步表明，对于典型的经济时间序列，最小化I型错误和II型错误加权平均的最优带宽比最小化相应长期方差估计量的渐近均方误差的最优带宽要大一个数量级。文中提出了一种实现这一最优带宽的插值方法，模拟结果表明这种新的插值方法在有限样本情况下表现良好。

abstract.text: While the literature on nonclassical measurement error traditionally relies on the availability of an auxiliary data set containing correctly measured observations, we establish that the availability of instruments enables the identification of a large class of nonclassical nonlinear errors-in-variables models with continuously distributed variables. Our main identifying assumption is that, conditional on the value of the true regressors, some "measure of location" of the distribution of the measurement error (e.g., its mean, mode, or median) is equal to zero. The proposed approach relies on the eigenvalue-eigenfunction decomposition of an integral operator associated with specific joint probability densities. The main identifying assumption is used to "index" the eigenfunctions so that the decomposition is unique. We propose a convenient sieve-based estimator, derive its asymptotic properties, and investigate its finite-sample behavior through Monte Carlo simulations.

10.1111/j.0012-9682.2008.00823.x.abstractZh: 虽然关于非经典测量误差的文献通常依赖于一个包含正确测量观测值的辅助数据集，但我们证明了仪器的可用性使得能够识别一大类具有连续分布变量的非经典非线性误差变量模型。我们的主要识别假设是：在真实回归量值条件下，测量误差分布的某种“位置度量”（例如其均值、众数或中位数）等于零。所提出的方法依赖于与特定联合概率密度相关的积分算子的特征值-特征函数分解。主要识别假设被用来“索引”特征函数，以确保分解的唯一性。我们提出了一种方便的筛选法估计量，推导了其渐近性质，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了其有限样本行为。

abstract.text: I analyze the effects of competition on process innovation and product introduction and obtain robust results that hold for a range of market structures and competition modes. It is found that increasing the number of firms tends to decrease cost reduction expenditure per firm, whereas increasing the degree of product substitutability, with or without free entry, increases it—provided that the average demand for product varieties does not shrink. Increasing market size increases cost reduction expenditure per firm and has ambiguous effects on the number of varieties offered, while decreasing the cost of entry increases the number of entrants and varieties but reduces cost reduction expenditure per variety. The results are extended to other measures of competitive pressure and to investment in product quality. The framework and results shed light on empirical strategies to assess the impact of competition on innovation.
