10.1111/j.1467-6451.2008.00356.x.abstractZh: 我分析了竞争对流程创新和产品引入的影响，并获得了在多种市场结构和竞争模式下依然有效的稳健结果。研究发现，增加企业数量往往会降低每企业的成本降低支出；而提高产品可替代性程度，无论是否存在自由进入机制，都会增加成本降低支出——前提是产品种类的平均需求不会减少。市场规模的扩大会增加每企业的成本降低支出，但对产品种类数量的影響则不明确；而降低进入成本则会增加进入者数量和产品种类，但会降低每种类的成本降低支出。这些结果还扩展到了其他竞争压力指标以及产品品质方面的投资。该框架和结果为评估竞争对创新的影响提供了实证策略的参考。

abstract.text: The Coase conjecture (1972) is the proposition that a durable-goods monopolist, who sells over time and can quickly reduce prices as sales are made, will price at marginal cost. We show that an arbitrarily small deviation from Coase's assumptions—a deviation that applies in almost any practical application—results in the failure of that conjecture. In particular, we examine that conjecture in a model where there is a vanishingly small cost for production (or sales) capacity, and the seller may augment capacity in every period. In the “gap case”, any positive capacity cost ensures that in the limit, as the size of the gap and the time between sales periods shrink, the monopolist obtains profits identical to those that would prevail when she could commit ex ante to a fixed capacity. Those profits are at least 29.8% of the full static monopoly optimum.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00457.x.abstractZh: 科斯猜想（1972年）认为，一个长期销售耐用品的垄断者，如果能够迅速降低价格，那么其定价将等于边际成本。我们指出，即使对科斯假设进行极小的偏离——这种偏离几乎适用于任何实际情境——也会导致该猜想的失败。具体来说，我们在一个生产（或销售）能力成本极低的情况下检验了这一猜想。在“缺口情况”下，任何正的产能成本都会使得垄断者在销售间隔缩短的情况下获得与预先确定固定产能时相同的利润。这些利润至少占完全静态垄断最优解的29.8%。

abstract.text: This paper shows how record-value theory, a branch of statistics that deals with the timing and magnitude of extreme values in sequences of random variables, can be used to recover features of the wage offer distribution in conventional search models. Using National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) wage data, I show that the data are not compatible with specifications for the offer distribution characterized by extreme negative skewness. In addition, I show that my approach can be used to construct a bound on the returns to job seniority. My results suggest that job seniority plays only a minor role in the wage growth of the workers surveyed in the NLSY.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00459.x.abstractZh: 本文展示了记录值理论这一统计学分支如何用于分析随机变量序列中极端值的时机和幅度，从而揭示传统搜索模型中工资分配特征。通过美国国家青年纵向调查的数据，我发现这些数据与以极端负偏度为特征的工资分配模型不兼容。此外，我的方法还可以用来确定工作资历对工资增长的制约范围。研究结果表明，在NLSY调查中的工人工资增长中，工作资历的作用相对较小。

abstract.text: We study the earning structure and the equilibrium assignment of workers to firms in a model in which workers have social preferences, and skills are perfectly substitutable in production. Firms offer long-term contracts, and we allow for frictions in the labour market in the form of mobility costs. The model delivers specific predictions about the nature of worker flows, about the characteristics of workplace skill segregation, and about wage dispersion both within and across firms. We show that long-term contracts in the presence of social preferences associate within-firm wage dispersion with novel “internal labour market” features such as gradual promotions, productivity-unrelated wage increases, and downward wage flexibility. These three dynamic features lead to productivity-unrelated wage volatility within firms.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00460.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个模型中工人的收入结构以及他们向企业分配的均衡情况，该模型假设工人具有社会偏好，且技能在生产中完全可以替代。企业提供长期合同，同时我们允许劳动力市场存在流动成本等摩擦因素。该模型对工人流动的性质、工作场所技能隔离的特征以及企业内部和跨企业的工资差异做出了具体预测。研究表明，在存在社会偏好的情况下，长期合同使得企业内部的工资差异与一些新的“内部劳动力市场”特征相关联，例如逐步晋升、与生产力无关的工资增长以及工资向下的灵活性。这三种动态特征导致了企业内部与生产力无关的工资波动。

abstract.text: This paper examines the construction equipment resale market to assess whether equipment produced by the world's largest manufacturer of construction machinery, Caterpillar, experienced lower product quality in facilities that underwent contract disputes during the 1990's. Analysis of auction data reveals that resale market participants significantly discounted machines produced in these dispute-affected facilities. Additionally, pieces of equipment produced in facilities undergoing unrest were resold more often, received worse appraisal reports, and had lower list prices. Taken together, the evidence supports the hypothesis that workmanship at dispute-affected facilities declined and that the resulting impact on the economic quality of the equipment produced was significant. The dispute was associated with at least $400 million in lost service flows due to inferior quality equipment alone.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00461.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了建筑设备转售市场，以评估全球最大的建筑机械制造商卡特彼勒生产的设备在20世纪90年代因合同纠纷而受到影响的设施中，产品的质量是否有所下降。对拍卖数据的分析显示，转售市场的参与者显著降低了这些受纠纷影响的设施生产的设备的价格。此外，在发生动荡的设施生产的设备更常被转售，获得的评估报告较差，且标价也较低。综合来看，这些证据表明，受纠纷影响的设施的生产工艺质量下降，这对所生产设备的经济质量产生了显著影响。仅因质量不佳的设备，该纠纷就导致了至少4亿美元的服务损失。

abstract.text: A large body of theoretical work has explored the channels through which vertical contracts can induce efficiency improvements. However, it is also important to study vertical contracts empirically in order to gain insight into the relative size of different types of efficiency gains. In this paper, I empirically analyse a contractual innovation in the vertically separated video rental industry. Prior to 1998, video stores obtained inventory from movie distributors using simple linear-pricing contracts. In 1998, revenue-sharing contracts were widely adopted. I investigate the effect of the introduction of revenue-sharing contracts on firms' profits and consumer welfare. I analyse a new panel data set of home video retailers that includes information on individual retailers' contract and inventory choices, as well as rentals and contract terms for 246 movie titles and 6137 retailers in the U.S. during each week of 1998 and 1999 and the first half of 2000. A structural econometric model of firms' behaviour is developed that describes the nature of firms' contract choices. Estimates from this model indicate that both upstream and downstream profits increase by 10% under the revenue-sharing contract for popular titles. For less popular titles, the effects can be even larger. I also estimate that consumers benefit when revenue-sharing contracts are adopted.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00462.x.abstractZh: 大量理论研究探讨了纵向合同如何促进效率提升的机制。然而，通过实证研究来研究纵向合同同样重要，这有助于我们了解不同类型效率提升的相对规模。在本文中，我实证分析了垂直分离的视频租赁行业中的合同创新。在1998年之前，视频商店通过简单的线性定价合同从电影发行商处获取库存。1998年，收益共享合同被广泛采用。我研究了收益共享合同的引入对企业和消费者福利的影响。我分析了一个新的家庭视频零售商面板数据集，该数据集包含了个体零售商的合同和库存选择信息，以及1998年、1999年和2000年上半年美国246部电影和6137家零售商的租赁和合同条款。我建立了一个描述企业合同选择行为的结构经济计量模型。模型估计结果显示，对于受欢迎的电影，收益共享合同使上下游利润分别增加了10%。对于不太受欢迎的电影，这种影响可能更大。我还估计，采用收益共享合同时，消费者也会从中受益。

abstract.text: We develop a monopolistically competitive model of trade with firm heterogeneity—in terms of productivity differences—and endogenous differences in the “toughness” of competition across markets—in terms of the number and average productivity of competing firms. We analyse how these features vary across markets of different size that are not perfectly integrated through trade; we then study the effects of different trade liberalization policies. In our model, market size and trade affect the toughness of competition, which then feeds back into the selection of heterogeneous producers and exporters in that market. Aggregate productivity and average mark-ups thus respond to both the size of a market and the extent of its integration through trade (larger, more integrated markets exhibit higher productivity and lower mark-ups). Our model remains highly tractable, even when extended to a general framework with multiple asymmetric countries integrated to different extents through asymmetric trade costs. We believe this provides a useful modelling framework that is particularly well suited to the analysis of trade and regional integration policy scenarios in an environment with heterogeneous firms and endogenous mark-ups.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00463.x.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个具有企业异质性的垄断竞争贸易模型——这种异质性体现在生产率差异上，而市场竞争的“激烈程度”则取决于竞争企业的数量和平均生产率。我们分析了这些特征在不同规模的市场中的变化，这些市场并未通过贸易实现完全整合；随后，我们研究了不同贸易自由化政策的影响。在我们的模型中，市场规模和贸易程度会影响市场竞争的激烈程度，而这一影响又会反过来影响市场中异质生产者和出口商的选择。因此，总体生产率和平均加价率会受到市场规模及其通过贸易整合程度的双重影响（规模更大、整合程度更高的市场表现出更高的生产率和更低的加价率）。我们的模型仍然具有高度的可操作性，即使扩展到包含多个通过不对称贸易成本进行不同程度整合的不对称国家的通用框架中。我们认为，这一模型框架对于分析具有异质企业和内生加价率的贸易与区域整合政策情景非常适用。

abstract.text: We examine racial preferences in dating. We employ a Speed Dating experiment that allows us to directly observe individual decisions and thus infer whose preferences lead to racial segregation in romantic relationships. Females exhibit stronger racial preferences than males. The richness of our data further allows us to identify many determinants of same-race preferences. Subjects' backgrounds, including the racial composition of the ZIP code where a subject grew up and the prevailing racial attitudes in a subject's state or country of origin, strongly influence same-race preferences. Older subjects and more physically attractive subjects exhibit weaker same-race preferences.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00465.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了约会中的种族偏好问题。我们通过“快速约会”实验来观察个体的决策行为，从而推断哪些偏好导致了恋爱关系中的种族隔离。女性比男性表现出更强的种族偏好。我们数据的丰富性还使我们能够识别出许多影响同种族偏好的因素。受试者的背景，包括他们成长所在邮编区的种族构成，以及他们所在州或国家的主流种族态度，都强烈影响着同种族偏好。年龄较大和外貌更吸引人的受试者表现出较弱的同种族偏好。

abstract.text: It is commonly believed that prices in secondary financial markets play an important allocational role because they contain information that facilitates the efficient allocation of resources. This paper identifies a limitation inherent in this role of prices. It shows that the presence of a feedback effect from the financial market to the real value of a firm creates an incentive for an uninformed trader to sell the firm's stock. When this happens the informativeness of the stock price decreases, and the beneficial allocational role of the financial market weakens. The trader profits from this trading strategy, partly because his trading distorts the firm's investment. We therefore refer to this strategy as manipulation. We show that trading without information is profitable only with sell orders, driving a wedge between the allocational implications of buyer and seller initiated speculation, and providing justification for restrictions on short sales.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00467.x.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，次级金融市场的价格在资源配置中发挥着重要作用，因为它们包含了有助于资源有效分配的信息。本文指出了这种价格作用的一个局限性。研究表明，金融市场对实体企业价值的反馈效应会促使不知情的交易者出售企业的股票。在这种情况下，股票价格的信息含量降低，金融市场在资源配置中的积极作用也会减弱。交易者通过这种交易策略获利，部分原因是他们的交易行为扭曲了企业的投资决策。因此，我们将这种策略称为操纵行为。我们指出，在缺乏信息的情况下，只有卖出订单才能带来利润，这导致买卖双方引发的投机行为在资源配置上的影响出现差异，也为对卖空行为的限制提供了依据。

abstract.text: A community's culture is defined by the preferences and equilibrium behaviours of its members. Contacts among communities alter individual cultures through two interrelated mechanisms: behavioural adaptations driven by pay-offs to coordination, and preference changes shaped by socialization and self-persuasion. This paper explores the workings of these mechanisms through a model of cultural integration in which preferences and behaviours vary continuously. It identifies a broad set of conditions under which cross-cultural contacts promote cultural hybridization. The analysis suggests that policies to support social integration serve to homogenize preferences across communities, thereby undermining a key objective of multiculturalism. Yielding fresh insights into strategies pursued to influence cultural trends, it also shows that communities benefit from having other communities adjust their behaviours.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00469.x.abstractZh: 一个社区的文化是由其成员的偏好和均衡行为所定义的。社区之间的交流通过两种相互关联的机制来改变个体文化：一种是由收益驱动的适应性行为，另一种是由社会化和自我说服所塑造的偏好变化。本文通过一个文化整合模型来探讨这些机制的工作原理，该模型中的偏好和行为是连续变化的。文章指出，在一系列条件下，跨文化交流可以促进文化融合。分析表明，支持社会整合的政策会促使不同社区之间的偏好趋于一致，从而破坏了多元文化主义的一个关键目标。本文还提供了对影响文化趋势的策略的新见解，并表明社区可以从其他社区调整其行为中获益。

abstract.text: Commitment is typically modelled by assigning to one of the players the ability to take an initial binding action. The weakness of this approach is that the fundamental question of who has the opportunity to commit cannot be addressed, as it is assumed. This paper presents a framework in which commitment power arises endogenously from the fundamentals of the model. We construct a finite dynamic game in which players are given the option to change their minds as often as they wish, but pay a switching cost if they do so. We show that for games with two players and two actions there is a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium with a simple structure. This equilibrium is independent of the order and timing of moves and is robust to other protocol specifications. Moreover, despite the perfect information nature of the model and the costly switches, strategic delays may arise in equilibrium. The flexibility of the model allows us to apply it to various environments. In particular, we study an entry deterrence situation. Its equilibrium is intuitive and illustrative of how commitment power is endogenously determined.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00470.x.abstractZh: 承诺通常是通过赋予某一方采取行动的能力来建模的。这种方法的缺点是，关于谁有机会做出承诺这一基本问题无法得到解决，因为这一假设是默认的。本文提出了一个框架，其中承诺能力是从模型的基本要素中内生产生的。我们构建了一个有限动态博弈，其中玩家可以随意改变主意，但这样做需要支付转换成本。我们证明，对于有两个玩家和两种行为的博弈，存在一个具有简单结构的唯一子博弈完美均衡。这个均衡与行动的顺序和时机无关，并且对其他协议规范具有鲁棒性。此外，尽管模型具有完美信息特性且转换成本较高，但在均衡状态下仍可能出现策略性延迟。该模型的灵活性使我们能够将其应用于各种环境。特别是，我们研究了一个进入威慑情境。其均衡是直观的，并说明了承诺能力是如何内生确定的。

abstract.text: We analyse the design of decision rules by a principal who faces an informed but biased agent and who is unable to commit to contingent transfers. The contracting problem reduces to a delegation problem in which the principal commits to a set of decisions from which the agent chooses his preferred one. We characterize the optimal delegation set and perform comparative statics on the principal's willingness to delegate and the agent's discretion. We also provide conditions for interval delegation to be optimal and show that they are satisfied when the agent's preferences are sufficiently aligned. Finally, we apply our results to the regulation of a privately informed monopolist and to the design of legislatives rules.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00471.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了面对一个知情但存在偏见的一方的主体的决策规则设计，该主体无法承诺进行条件性转移。契约问题可以简化为委托问题，即主体承诺执行一组决策，而代理人则从中选择他偏好的决策。我们描述了最优委托集合，并对主体愿意委托的程度以及代理人的自由裁量权进行了比较静态分析。我们还提出了区间委托最优的条件，并表明当代理人的偏好足够一致时，这些条件得到满足。最后，我们将我们的研究结果应用于对私人知情垄断者的监管以及立法规则的制定。

abstract.text: Many decisions involve both imprecise probabilities and intractable states of the world. Objective expected utility assumes unambiguous probabilities; subjective expected utility assumes a completely specified state space. This paper analyses a third domain of preference: sets of consequential lotteries. Using this domain, we develop a theory of objective ambiguity without explicit reference to any state space. We characterize a representation that integrates a non-linear transformation of first-order expected utility with respect to a second-order measure. The concavity of the transformation and the weighting of the measure capture ambiguity aversion. We propose a definition for comparative ambiguity aversion.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2007.00473.x.abstractZh: 许多决策涉及不精确的概率和难以处理的世界状态。客观期望效用假设概率具有明确性；主观期望效用则假设世界状态空间是完全确定的。本文分析了第三种偏好领域：后果组合彩票。利用这一领域，我们发展了一种无需明确引用任何状态空间的客观模糊性理论。我们描述了一种将一阶期望效用进行非线性变换的表示方法，该变换以二阶度量为基础。这种变换的凹性以及度量的权重分配体现了模糊性厌恶。我们还提出了比较模糊性厌恶的定义。

abstract.text: We introduce peer effects in the costs of human capital acquisition into a model of statistical dis-crimination in labour markets. This creates a link between the level of segregation in social networks and racial disparities in job assignment and wages. We show that this relationship is characterized by disconti-nuities: there is a threshold level of segregation below which negative stereotypes become unsustainable, and steady-state skill levels can change dramatically. This change can work in either direction: skill levels may either rise or fall in both groups. Which of these outcomes arises depends on the population share of the disadvantaged group and on the distribution of the costs of human capital investments. We also examine the effects of affirmative action policies in the presence of peer effects and provide conditions under which such policies eliminate negative stereotypes. 1.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00468.x.abstractZh: 我们将人力资本获取成本中的同伴效应引入到劳动力市场统计歧视的模型中。这揭示了社交网络中的隔离程度与种族在就业分配和工资上的差异之间的联系。我们发现，这种关系具有不连续性：存在一个隔离程度的阈值，低于这个阈值，负面刻板印象将变得不可持续，而稳定状态下的技能水平也可能发生显著变化。这种变化可以向两个方向发展：两个群体的技能水平都可能上升或下降。具体哪种结果出现取决于弱势群体的人口比例以及人力资本投资成本的分配情况。我们还研究了在同伴效应存在的情况下，平权行动政策的效果，并提出了这些政策消除负面刻板印象的条件。

abstract.text: We examine an economy in which the cost of consuming some goods can be reduced by making commitments that reduce flexibility. We show that such consumption commitments can induce consumers with risk-neutral underlying utility functions to be risk averse over small variations in income, but sometimes to seek risk over large variations. As a result, optimal employment contracts will smooth wages conditional on being employed, but may incorporate a possibility of unemployment.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00472.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个经济体系，在该体系中，某些商品的消费成本可以通过减少灵活性来降低。我们发现，这种消费承诺可以促使具有风险中性基础效用函数的消费者在收入发生较小变动时表现出风险厌恶，但在收入发生较大变动时则可能会寻求风险。因此，最优的雇佣合同会在就业条件下使工资保持稳定，但也可能包含失业的可能性。

abstract.text: A recent and extensive literature has pioneered the summing of squared observed intra-daily returns, “realized variance”, to estimate the daily integrated variance of financial asset prices, a traditional object of economic interest. We show that, in the presence of market microstructure noise, realized variance does not identify the daily integrated variance of the frictionless equilibrium price. However, we demonstrate that the noise-induced bias at very high sampling frequencies can be appropriately traded off with the variance reduction obtained by high-frequency sampling and derive a mean-squared-error (MSE) optimal sampling theory for the purpose of integrated variance estimation. We show how our theory naturally leads to an identification procedure, which allows us to recover the moments of the unobserved noise; this procedure may be useful in other applications. Finally, using the profits obtained by option traders on the basis of alternative variance forecasts as our economic metric, we find that explicit optimization of realized variance's finite sample MSE properties results in accurate forecasts and considerable economic gains.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00474.x.abstractZh: 近期大量文献提出了一种方法，即通过对每日观测到的平方回报进行求和，得到“实现方差”，以此来估计金融资产价格的日综合方差，这是经济学研究中的一个传统课题。我们发现，在市场微观结构噪声存在的情况下，实现方差并不能准确反映无摩擦均衡价格的日综合方差。然而，我们证明了在非常高的采样频率下，噪声引起的偏差可以通过高频采样获得的方差减少来适当抵消，并推导出了用于综合方差估计的平均平方误差最优采样理论。我们的理论自然引导出一种识别方法，该方法能够恢复未观测噪声的矩；这种程序在其他应用中也可能具有实用性。最后，以期权交易者基于不同方差预测所获得的收益作为我们的经济指标，我们发现对实现方差的有限样本平均平方误差属性进行显式优化，可以带来准确的预测和显著的经济效益。

abstract.text: This paper shows that standard international business cycle models can be reconciled with the empirical evidence on the lack of consumption risk sharing. First, we show analytically that with incomplete asset markets productivity disturbances can have large un-insurable effects on wealth, depending on the value of the trade elasticity and shock persistence. Second, we investigate these findings quantitatively in a model calibrated to the U.S. economy. With the low trade elasticity estimated via a method of moments procedure, the consumption risk of productivity shocks is magnified by high terms of trade and real exchange rate (RER) volatility. Strong wealth effects in response to shocks raise the demand for domestic goods above supply, crowding out external demand and appreciating the terms of trade and the RER. Building upon the literature on incomplete markets, we then show that similar results are obtained when productivity shocks are nearly permanent, provided the trade elasticity is set equal to the high values consistent with micro-estimates. Under both approaches the model accounts for the low and negative correlation between the RER and relative (domestic to foreign) consumption in the data the Backus Smith puzzle.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00475.x.abstractZh: 本文表明，标准的国际商业周期模型可以与关于消费风险共享缺失的实证证据相调和。首先，我们从分析上表明，在资产市场不完整的条件下，生产率冲击会对财富产生较大的不可保险影响，这取决于贸易弹性的值以及冲击的持续性。其次，我们通过一个针对美国经济的模型来定量研究这些发现。通过矩估计方法得出的低贸易弹性表明，生产率冲击带来的消费风险会因高贸易条件和实际汇率的波动而加剧。对冲击的强烈财富效应会导致对国内商品的需求超过供给，从而挤出外部需求，并提升贸易条件和实际汇率。基于关于不完全市场的文献，我们进一步表明，当生产率冲击几乎是永久性的时，只要贸易弹性设定为与微观估计值一致的高值，就能得到类似的结果。在这两种情况下，模型都解释了数据中实际汇率与相对消费（国内与国外消费）之间的低负相关关系，即Backus Smith悖论。

abstract.text: We study an infinitely repeated first-price auction with common values. We focus on one-sided incomplete information, in which one bidder learns the objects' value, which itself does not change over time. Learning by the uninformed bidder occurs only through observation of the bids. The proprietary information is eventually revealed, and the seller extracts essentially the entire rent (for large discount factors). Both players' pay-offs tend to 0 as the discount factor tends to 1. However, the uninformed bidder does relatively better than the informed bidder. We discuss the case of two-sided incomplete information and argue that, under a Markovian refinement, the outcome is pooling as information is revealed only insofar as it does not affect prices.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00476.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有共同价值的无限重复第一价格拍卖。我们关注的是单边信息不完备的情况，在这种情况下，一个出价者只能了解物品的价值，而这些价值不会随时间改变。不知情的出价者只能通过观察其他出价来了解物品的价值。最终，所有信息都会被揭示出来，卖家基本上可以获取全部的租金（尽管折扣因子很大）。随着折扣因子趋近于1，双方的收益都趋向于0。然而，不知情的出价者仍然比知情出价者表现得更好。我们讨论了双边信息不完备的情况，并认为在马尔可夫改进条件下，当信息揭示的程度仅影响到价格时，结果就是双方共享信息。

abstract.text: This paper solves for the profit-maximizing strategy of a durable-goods monopolist when incoming demand varies over time. We first characterize the consumers' optimal purchasing decision by a cut-off rule. We then show that, under a monotonicity condition, the profit-maximizing cut-offs can be derived through a myopic algorithm, which has an intuitive marginal revenue interpretation. Consumers' ability to delay creates an asymmetry in the optimal price path, which exhibits fast increases and slow decreases. This asymmetry creates an upward bias in the level of prices, pushing them above the price charged by a firm facing the average level of demand. The optimal policy outperforms renting and can be implemented by a time-consistent best-price provision.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00478.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了在需求随时间变化的情况下，耐用商品垄断者如何实现利润最大化策略。我们首先通过截止规则来描述消费者的最优购买决策。然后，在单调性条件下，我们通过一个近视算法推导出利润最大化的最优截止点，该算法具有直观的边际收益解释。消费者能够延迟购买行为，导致最优价格路径出现不对称现象，即价格快速上升而缓慢下降。这种不对称性使得价格水平出现上升趋势，使其高于面对平均需求水平的企业的定价。最优策略优于租赁方式，并且可以通过时间一致的最佳价格提供来实现。

abstract.text: The influential Krugman-Flood-Garber (KFG) model of balance of payment crises assumes that a fixed exchange rate is abandoned if and only if international reserves reach a critical threshold value. From a positive standpoint, the KFG rule is at odds with many episodes in which the central bank has plenty of international reserves at the time of abandonment. We study the optimal exit policy and show that from a normative standpoint, the KFG rule is generally suboptimal. We consider a model in which the fixed exchange rate regime has become unsustainable due to an unexpected increase in government spending. We show that when there are no exit costs, it is optimal to abandon immediately. When there are exit costs, the optimal abandonment time is a decreasing function of the size of the fiscal shock. For large fiscal shocks, immediate abandonment is optimal. Our model is consistent with evidence suggesting that many countries exit fixed exchange rate regimes with still plenty of international reserves in the central bank's vault.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00479.x.abstractZh: 有影响力的Krugman-Flood-Garber（KFG）国际收支危机模型认为，只有当国际储备达到临界阈值时，才会放弃固定汇率制度。从积极的角度来看，KFG规则与许多中央银行在放弃固定汇率制度时仍拥有大量国际储备的情况并不一致。我们研究了最优退出政策，并表明从规范的角度来看，KFG规则通常是不理想的。我们考虑了一个模型，其中固定汇率制度因政府支出意外增加而变得不可持续。我们发现，在没有退出成本的情况下，立即放弃是最优选择。当存在退出成本时，最优放弃时间取决于财政冲击的大小。对于较大的财政冲击，立即放弃是最优选择。我们的模型与一些证据一致，这些证据表明许多国家在仍拥有大量国际储备的情况下就放弃了固定汇率制度。

abstract.text: We develop an assignment theory to analyse the volume and composition of foreign direct investment (FDI). Firms conduct FDI by either engaging in greenfield investment or in cross-border acquisitions. Cross-border acquisitions involve firms trading heterogeneous corporate assets to exploit complementarities, while greenfield FDI involves setting up a new production division in the foreign country. In equilibrium, greenfield FDI and cross-border acquisitions coexist within the same industry, but the composition of FDI between these modes varies with firm and country characteristics. Firms engaging in greenfield investment are systematically more efficient than those engaging in cross-border acquisitions. Furthermore, most FDI takes the form of cross-border acquisitions when production-cost differences between countries are small, while greenfield investment plays a more important role for FDI from high-cost into low-cost countries. These results capture important features of the data.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00480.x.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种任务理论来分析外国直接投资（FDI）的规模和构成。企业通过进行绿地投资或跨国收购来进行 FDI。跨国收购涉及企业交易不同的企业资产以利用互补性，而绿地 FDI则涉及在外国国家设立一个新的生产部门。在均衡状态下，绿地 FDI和跨国收购在同一行业中共存，但这两种模式之间的 FDI 构成会随企业和国家的特征而变化。进行绿地投资的企业比进行跨国收购的企业系统性地更高效。此外，当各国之间的生产成本差异较小时，大多数 FDI 以跨国收购的形式出现；而对于从高成本国家向低成本国家进行 FDI 时，绿地投资则起着更重要的作用。这些结果反映了数据中的重要特征。

abstract.text: Commitment failure lies at the core of incomplete contract theory, yet its quantitative significance has rarely been assessed. Using detailed plot-level data from rural Pakistan, we find that non-contractible investment is underprovided on tenanted land, even after controlling for the endogeneity of leasing decisions. Our evidence also indicates that moral hazard in investment effort alone cannot explain this inefficiency. Instead, imperfect commitment appears to be the driving mechanism, since even plots taken on fixed rent contracts where all the rent is paid upfront receive lower investment than owner-cultivated plots. We further show that a considerable portion of the variation in tenancy duration, and hence in the security of tenure, is due to heterogeneity across landlords. One interpretation of this finding is that landlord reputation is important in mitigating hold-up.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00481.x.abstractZh: 承诺失败是不完全契约理论的核心问题，但其定量意义却很少被评估。通过利用巴基斯坦农村地区的详细地块级数据，我们发现即使在控制了租赁决策的内生性之后，租赁土地上的不可契约投资仍然不足。我们的证据还表明，仅投资努力中的道德风险无法解释这种低效率现象。相反，不完善的承诺似乎是驱动这一问题的机制，因为即使是在固定租金合同下、所有租金都预先支付的地块，其投资水平也低于由业主直接耕种的地块。我们进一步指出，租赁期限的差异，以及因此导致的租赁保障的差异，在很大程度上是由地主之间的异质性造成的。这一发现的一种解释是，地主的声誉在缓解拖欠行为方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: This paper studies collective-action games in which the production of a public good requires teamwork. A leading example is a threshold game in which provision requires the voluntary participation of m out of n players. Quantal-response strategy revisions allow play to move between equilibria in which a team successfully provides, and an equilibrium in which the collective action fails. A full characterization of long-run play reveals the determinants of success; these include the correlation between players' costs of provision and their valuations for the good. The addition of an extra “bad apple” player can “spoil the barrel” by destabilizing successful teams and so offers a rationale for limiting the pool of possible contributors.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00482.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种集体行动博弈，其中公共产品的提供需要团队合作。一个典型的例子是阈值博弈，在这种博弈中，需要n个参与者中有m个自愿参与，才能成功提供产品。量子响应策略的修改使得博弈可以在团队成功提供产品和集体行动失败的两种均衡之间转换。对长期博弈的完整描述揭示了成功的关键因素，其中包括参与者提供产品的成本与他们对该产品的估值之间的相关性。增加一个“害群之马”的参与者，可能会破坏成功的团队，因此有必要限制可能的贡献者数量。

abstract.text: Multiple banking is a common characteristic of the corporate lending, particularly of medium-sized and large firms. However, if the firms are facing distress, multiple lenders may have serious coordination problems, as has been argued in the theoretical literature. In this paper we analyse the problems of multiple banking in borrower distress empirically. We rely on a unique panel data set that includes detailed credit-file information on distressed lending relationships in Germany. In particular, it includes information on “bank pools”, a legal institution aimed at coordinating lender interests in distress. We find that the existence of small pools increases the probability of workout success and that this effect reverses when pools become large. We identify major determinants of pool formation, in particular the number of banks, the distribution of lending among banks, and the severity of the distress.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00483.x.abstractZh: 多重银行关系是企业贷款的一个常见特征，尤其是在中等规模和大型企业中。然而，如果这些企业面临困境，多重贷款机构可能会遇到严重的协调问题，这一点在理论文献中已有论述。本文通过实证分析探讨了在借款人陷入困境时多重银行关系所带来的问题。我们依赖一个独特的面板数据集，该数据集包含了德国陷入困境的贷款关系的详细信用档案信息。特别是，该数据集包含了“银行池”的相关信息，这是一种旨在协调困境中贷款机构利益的法律制度。我们发现，小型银行池的存在会增加贷款重组成功的概率，而当银行池规模扩大时，这种效应则会减弱。我们还确定了形成银行池的主要决定因素，包括银行数量、银行之间的贷款分配情况以及困境的严重程度。

abstract.text: This paper considers an optimal taxation environment where household income is private information, and the government randomly audits and punishes households found to be underreporting. We prove that the optimal mechanism derived using standard mechanism design techniques has a bad equilibrium (a tax riot) where households underreport their incomes, precisely because other households are expected to do so as well. We then consider three alternative approaches to designing a tax scheme when one is worried about bad equilibria.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00484.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个最优税收环境，其中家庭收入是私人信息，政府会随机审计和惩罚那些被发现有漏报行为的家庭。我们证明，使用标准机制设计技术得出的最优机制会导致一个不良均衡（即税收骚乱），在这种情况下，家庭会故意少报收入，正是因为预期其他家庭也会如此。接着，我们探讨了在担心出现不良均衡时，设计税收方案的三种替代方法。

abstract.text: Characteristics models have been found to be useful in many areas of economics. However, their empirical implementation tends to rely heavily on functional form assumptions. In this paper we develop a revealed preference approach to characteristics models. We derive the necessary and sufficient empirical conditions under which data on the market behaviour of heterogeneous, price-taking consumers are non-parametrically consistent with the consumer characteristics model. Where these conditions hold, we show how information may be recovered on individual consumers' marginal valuations of product attributes. In some cases, marginal valuations are point identified, and in other cases, we can only recover bounds. Where the conditions fail, we highlight the role which the introduction of unobserved product attributes can play in rationalizing the data. We implement these ideas using consumer panel data on the Danish milk market.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00485.x.abstractZh: 特征模型在经济学许多领域都被证明是有用的。然而，它们的实证应用往往严重依赖于函数形式的假设。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于揭示偏好的特征模型方法。我们推导出了数据市场行为异质性、接受价格消费者的数据与非参数一致于消费者特征模型所需的必要条件。在这些条件成立的情况下，我们展示了如何获取关于个体消费者对产品属性边际估值的信息。在某些情况下，边际估值是可以点识别的，而在其他情况下，我们只能获得估值的范围。当这些条件不成立时，我们强调了引入未观察到的产品属性在数据合理化中的作用。我们运用丹麦牛奶市场的消费者面板数据来实施这些想法。

abstract.text: This paper describes a new continuous-time principal-agent model, in which the output is a diffusion process with drift determined by the agent's unobserved effort. The risk-averse agent receives consumption continuously. The optimal contract, based on the agent's continuation value as a state variable, is computed by a new method using a differential equation. During employment, the output path stochastically drives the agent's continuation value until it reaches a point that triggers retirement, quitting, replacement, or promotion. The paper explores how the dynamics of the agent's wages and effort, as well as the optimal mix of short-term and long-term incentives, depend on the contractual environment.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00486.x.abstractZh: 本文描述了一个新的连续时间主体-代理人模型，在该模型中，产出是一个具有由代理人未观察到的努力所决定的漂移的扩散过程。风险厌恶的代理人持续获得消费收益。基于代理人的持续价值作为状态变量，最优契约通过一种使用微分方程的新方法计算得出。在雇佣期间，产出路径随机驱动代理人的持续价值，直到达到触发退休、辞职、替换或晋升的临界点。本文探讨了代理人的工资和努力动态，以及短期和长期激励的最佳组合，如何取决于合同环境。

abstract.text: Many individuals simultaneously have significant credit card debt and money in the bank. The credit card debt puzzle is as follows: given high interest rates on credit cards and low rates on bank accounts, why not pay down debt? While some economists go to elaborate lengths to explain this, we argue it is a special case of the rate of return dominance puzzle from monetary economics. We extend standard monetary theory to incorporate consumer debt, which is interesting in its own right since developing models where money and credit coexist is a long-standing challenge. Our model is quite tractable—for example, it readily yields nice existence and characterization results—and helps put into context recent discussions of consumer debt.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00487.x.abstractZh: 许多个人同时背负着巨额信用卡债务，并且银行账户中的资金也相当可观。信用卡债务的难题在于：鉴于信用卡的高利率和银行账户的低利率，为何不偿还债务呢？虽然一些经济学家试图详细解释这一现象，但我们认为这是货币经济学中“回报率主导性难题”的一个特例。我们将标准货币理论扩展到包含消费者债务的情况，这本身就是一个有趣的研究方向，因为建立货币与信贷共存的模型一直是一个长期存在的挑战。我们的模型相当易于处理——例如，它能够轻易地得出存在性和特征化结果——并且有助于理解最近关于消费者债务的讨论。

abstract.text: Are politicians motivated by policy outcomes or by the perks of office? To shed light on this important question, I develop a simple model of two candidate electoral competitions in which candidates may be either office or policy motivated. In a second departure from standard formulations, the model incorporates both campaign and post-election behaviour of candidates. In this environment, I find that office-motivated candidates are favoured in electoral competition but that their advantage is limited by the electoral mechanism itself and policy-motivated candidates win a significant fraction of elections. More importantly, I show that the competitive interaction among candidates of different motivations affects the incentives of all candidates—both office and policy motivated—and that this competition affects policy outcomes. I also extend the model to explore the decision of citizens to enter politics and show that in all equilibria policy-motivated citizens compose a majority of the candidate pool.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00488.x.abstractZh: 政治家是受政策结果驱动，还是受职位的诱惑而行动？为了解答这一重要问题，我构建了一个简单的模型，模拟了两名候选人在选举中的竞争情况，其中候选人可能出于职位或政策的动机而行动。与标准模型不同，该模型同时考虑了候选人在竞选期间和选举后的行为。研究发现，出于职位动机的候选人在选举中更受青睐，但他们的优势受到选举机制本身的限制；而出于政策的动机的候选人在选举中仍占有相当大的优势。更重要的是，我发现不同动机的候选人在竞争中的互动会影响所有候选人的激励因素——无论是出于职位还是政策的动机——而这种竞争也会影响政策结果。此外，我还扩展了模型，探讨了公民参与政治的决策过程，发现在所有均衡状态下，出于政策的动机的公民构成了候选人池中的多数。

abstract.text: We investigate identification in semi-parametric binary regression models, y = 1(xβ+υ+ε > 0) when υ is either discrete or measured within intervals. The error term ε is assumed to be uncorrelated with a set of instruments z, ε is independent of υ conditionally on x and z, and the support of −(xβ + ε) is finite. We provide a sharp characterization of the set of observationally equivalent parameters β. When there are as many instruments z as variables x, the bounds of the identified intervals of the different scalar components βk of parameter β can be expressed as simple moments of the data. Also, in the case of interval data, we show that additional information on the distribution of υ within intervals shrinks the identified set. Specifically, the closer the conditional distribution of υ given z is to uniformity, the smaller is the identified set. Point identified is achieved if and only if υ is uniform within intervals.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00490.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了半参数二元回归模型中的识别问题，即 y = 1(xβ+υ+ε > 0)，其中 υ 可以是离散的，也可以是在区间内测量的。误差项 ε 假设与一组工具变量 z 不相关，且在条件 x 和 z 下 ε 与 υ 独立，同时 −(xβ + ε) 的支持域是有限的。我们给出了观测等价参数 β 集合的精确描述。当工具变量 z 的数量与变量 x 的数量相等时，参数 β 的不同标量分量 βk 的识别区间的界限可以用数据的简单矩来表示。此外，在区间数据的情况下，我们表明关于 υ 在区间内分布的其他信息会缩小识别集合的大小。具体来说，给定 z 的条件下 υ 的条件分布越接近均匀性，识别集合就越小。当且仅当 υ 在区间内均匀分布时，才能实现点识别。

abstract.text: In this paper we study how a benevolent government that cannot commit to future policy should trade off the costs and benefits of public expenditure. We characterize and solve for Markov-perfect equilibria of the dynamic game between successive governments. The characterization consists of an inter-temporal first-order condition (a “generalized Euler equation”) for the government, and we use it both to gain insight into the nature of the equilibrium and as a basis for computations. For a calibrated economy, we find that when the only tax base available to the government is capital income—an inelastic source of funds at any point in time—the government still refrains from taxing at confiscatory rates. We also find that when the only tax base is labour income the Markov equilibrium features less public expenditure and lower tax rates than the Ramsey equilibrium.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00491.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了一个无法承诺未来政策的仁慈政府如何权衡公共支出的成本和收益。我们描述了连续政府之间动态博弈的马尔可夫完美均衡，并解决了这一均衡问题。描述过程包括一个跨时序的一阶条件（即“广义欧拉方程”），我们利用这一条件来理解均衡的本质，并作为计算的基础。对于一个经过校准的经济体系，我们发现，当政府唯一的税收来源是资本收入——这种资金来源在任何时候都是缺乏弹性的——政府仍然会避免以没收性的税率征税。我们还发现，当唯一的税收来源是劳动收入时，马尔可夫均衡下的公共支出较少，税率也低于拉姆齐均衡。

abstract.text: This paper analyses theoretically and empirically the relationship between military conflicts and trade. We show that the conventional wisdom that trade promotes peace is only partially true even in a model where trade is economically beneficial, military conflicts reduce trade, and leaders are rational. When war can occur because of the presence of asymmetric information, the probability of escalation is lower for countries that trade more bilaterally because of the opportunity cost associated with the loss of trade gains. However, countries more open to global trade have a higher probability of war because multilateral trade openness decreases bilateral dependence to any given country and the cost of a bilateral conflict. We test our predictions on a large data set of military conflicts on the 1950–2000 period. Using different strategies to solve the endogeneity issues, including instrumental variables, we find robust evidence for the contrasting effects of bilateral and multilateral trade openness. For proximate countries, we find that trade has had a surprisingly large effect on their probability of military conflict.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00492.x.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实证角度分析了军事冲突与贸易之间的关系。我们发现，尽管在贸易具有经济利益的模型中，贸易促进和平的观点只是部分正确的，但军事冲突确实会减少贸易，而领导者通常具有理性行为。当由于信息不对称导致战争发生时，双边贸易较多的国家因失去贸易收益而产生的机会成本较低，因此战争升级的概率较低。然而，对全球贸易更为开放的国家则更容易发生战争，因为多边贸易开放降低了与任何特定国家的双边依赖关系以及双边冲突的成本。我们在1950至2000年期间的大量军事冲突数据基础上验证了这些预测。通过采用不同的策略解决内生性问题，包括使用工具变量法，我们发现了双边贸易开放与多边贸易开放对军事冲突概率的不同影响。对于邻近国家而言，我们发现贸易对其军事冲突概率产生了显著的影响。

abstract.text: The timing of elections is flexible in many countries. We study this optimization by first creating a Bayesian learning model of a mean-reverting political support process. We then explore optimal electoral timing, modelling it as a renewable American option with interacting waiting and stopping values. Inter alia, we show that the expected longevity is a convex, then concave, function of the support. Finally, we calibrate our model to the post-1945 Labour-Tory U.K. rivalry. Our story quite well explains when the elections were called. We also show that election options approximately double the expected time in power in the current streak.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00493.x.abstractZh: 许多国家的选举时间安排具有灵活性。我们通过首先构建一个均值回归的政治支持过程的贝叶斯学习模型来研究这种优化问题。然后，我们将选举时间安排建模为一个可更新的美国期权，其中包含了等待和停止的价值。我们证明，支持的预期持续时间是一个凸函数，随后变为凹函数。最后，我们将模型校准到1945年后的英国工党和保守党的竞争情况。我们的模型很好地解释了选举何时举行。我们还发现，选举方案大约使执政时间的预期翻倍。

abstract.text: This paper studies the welfare properties of competitive equilibria in an economy with financial frictions hit by aggregate shocks. In particular, it shows that competitive financial contracts can result in excessive borrowing ex ante and excessive volatility ex post. Even though from a first-best perspective the equilibrium always displays under-borrowing, from a second-best point of view excessive borrowing can arise. The inefficiency is due to the combination of limited commitment in financial contracts and the fact that asset prices are determined in a spot market. This generates a pecuniary externality that is not internalized in private contracts. The model provides a framework to evaluate preventive policies, which can be used during a credit boom to reduce the expected costs of a financial crisis.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00494.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了在受到整体冲击影响的金融摩擦经济中，竞争均衡的福利属性。具体而言，研究表明，竞争性的金融合约可能导致事前过度借贷和事后的过度波动。尽管从最优视角来看，均衡总是表现为借贷不足，但从次优视角来看，仍可能出现过度借贷的情况。这种低效率源于金融合约中有限承诺的特点，以及资产价格在现货市场中的确定方式。这些因素产生了一种货币外部性，这种外部性并未在私人合约中得到体现。该模型为评估预防性政策提供了框架，这些政策可以在信贷繁荣期间实施，以降低金融危机的预期成本。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a model in which rational vot-ers select news sources with ideological positions similar to their own. We nd that extreme media outlets do not in uence polit-ical outcomes, and that new entry always increases the chance that political parties adopt the policy favored by the median voter. A slightly partisan media outlet, which is trusted by the supporters of a party, is more eective than a completely cen-trist one in inducing the party to adopt less partisan policies. In a commercial media market, voter welfare is typically higher under duopoly than under monopoly. JEL classication. D72, L82

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00495.x.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一个模型，其中理性选民选择与自己意识形态立场相似的新闻来源。我们发现，极端媒体机构并不会影响政治结果，而且新进入市场的媒体机构总能增加政党采纳中间选民所青睐政策的几率。一个略微带有党派倾向的媒体机构，如果受到某党支持者的信任，其促使该党采纳非党派政策的效果会比完全中立的媒体机构更为显著。在商业媒体市场中，双头垄断下的选民福利通常高于垄断状态。JEL分类：D72, L82

abstract.text: This paper considers the estimation problem in dynamic games with finite actions. we derive the equation system that characterizes the markovian equilibria. the equilibrium equation system enables us to characterize conditions for identification. we consider a class of asymptotic least squares estimators defined by the equilibrium conditions. this class provides a unified framework for a number of well-known estimators including those by Hotz and Miller (1993) and by Aguirregabiria and Mira (2002). We show that these estimators differ in the weight they assign to individual equilibrium conditions. We derive the efficient weight matrix. A Monte Carlo study illustrates the small sample performance and computational feasibility of alternative estimators.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00496.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了具有有限行动的动态博弈中的估计问题。我们推导出了表征马尔可夫均衡的方程组。该均衡方程组使我们能够确定识别条件。我们考虑了一类由均衡条件定义的渐近最小二乘估计量。这类估计量为许多著名的估计量提供了一个统一的框架，包括Hotz和Miller（1993年）以及Aguirregabiria和Mira（2002年）提出的估计量。我们指出，这些估计量在赋予各个均衡条件的权重上有所不同。我们还推导出了有效权重矩阵。蒙特卡洛研究展示了这些替代估计量在小样本情况下的性能以及计算可行性。

abstract.text: A bank determines whether potential borrowers are creditworthy, that is, whether they meet the bank's credit or lending standards. In making this determination, each bank is in competition with other banks, but without knowing the competitor banks' credit standards. The resulting unique form of competition leads to endogenous credit cycles, periodic “credit crunches”. Empirical tests of this repeated bank lending game are constructed based on parameterizing public information about relative bank performance that is at the root of banks' beliefs about rival banks' lending standards. The relative performance of rival banks has predictive power for subsequent lending in the credit card market, where we can identify the main competitors. At the macroeconomic level, the relative bank performance of commercial and industrial loans is an autonomous source of macroeconomic fluctuations. In an asset pricing context, the relative bank performance is a priced risk factor for both banks and non-financial firms. The factor coefficients for non-financial firms are decreasing with size, consistent with smaller firms being more bank dependent.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00497.x.abstractZh: 银行会判断潜在借款人的信用状况，即他们是否符合银行的信用或贷款标准。在做出这一判断时，每家银行都与其他银行竞争，但银行并不了解竞争对手的信用标准。这种独特的竞争形式导致了内生性的信用周期，即周期性的“信用紧缩”。基于公开信息对银行相对表现进行参数化处理的实证测试表明，竞争对手的信用标准对后续贷款行为具有预测作用，尤其是在信用卡市场中，我们可以识别出主要的竞争对手。在宏观经济层面，商业银行在工业贷款方面的相对表现是宏观经济波动的一个独立来源。在资产定价背景下，银行的相对表现成为银行和非金融企业的风险因素之一。非金融企业的风险系数随着企业规模的增加而下降，这与小型企业更依赖银行融资的事实相符。

abstract.text: Using data on one-shot games, we investigate whether players' actions can be viewed as responses to underlying expectations about their opponent's behaviour. In our laboratory experiments, subjects play a set of 14 two-person 3×3 games and state beliefs about which actions they expect their opponents to play. The data sets from the two tasks are largely inconsistent. Rather, we find evidence that the subjects perceive the games differently when they (i) choose actions and (ii) state beliefs—their stated beliefs reveal deeper strategic thinking than their actions. On average, they fail to best respond to their own stated beliefs in almost half of the games. The inconsistency is confirmed by estimates of a unified statistical model that jointly uses the actions and the belief statements. There, we can control for decision noise and formulate a statistical test that rejects consistency. Effects of the belief elicitation procedure on subsequent actions are mostly insignificant.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00498.x.abstractZh: 通过研究一次性博弈的数据，我们探讨了玩家的行为是否可以被视为对对手行为预期的反应。在我们的实验室实验中，参与者进行了一组14场两人之间的3×3博弈，并陈述了他们对对手可能采取行动的预期。这两项实验的数据结果存在较大差异。我们发现，当参与者在(i)选择行动时以及(ii)陈述信念时，他们对博弈的感知有所不同——他们的陈述信念揭示了比行动更为深入的策略思考。平均而言，在几乎一半的博弈中，他们未能充分响应自己的陈述信念。这一不一致性通过联合使用行动和信念陈述的统一定性模型得到了验证。在该模型中，我们可以控制决策噪声，并构建出一个能够拒绝一致性假设的统计检验。信念引导程序对后续行动的影响大多并不显著。

abstract.text: This paper studies the advertising agency industry in Manhattan to infer networking benefits among agencies in close spatial proximity. We use economic census data that allow us to distinguish locations at a fine level of geographic detail, so as to infer the strong effect on productivity of having more near advertising agency neighbours. Paying close attention to identification issues, we show, however, that there is extremely rapid spatial decay in the benefits of more near neighbours, even in the close quarters of southern Manhattan, a finding that is new to the literature. This suggests that high density of similar commercial establishments is important in enhancing local productivity for those industries found in large cities, where information sharing plays a critical role. Our results indicate that the benefits of more near neighbours are largely capitalized into rents rather than wages, challenging an existing literature, which estimates wage equations alone to infer agglomeration benefits. New York County, or Manhattan, accounts for 24 % of advertising agency receipts in the U.S. Years ago the popular image had large agencies on Madison Avenue generating this business. But today there are over 1000 agencies in different clusters spread over the southern half of Manhattan. In clustering, advertising is known for the key role that networking plays in the operation of agencies, where interviews suggest that informal networking for exchange of ideas

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00499.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了曼哈顿的广告代理行业，以推断地理位置相近的代理之间的网络效应。我们使用了经济普查数据，这些数据使我们能够精确到地理细节来区分不同地点，从而推断出拥有更多邻近广告代理对生产力的积极影响。然而，在解决身份识别问题的同时，我们发现，即使在曼哈顿南部的密集区域，邻近代理带来的好处也呈现出极快的空间衰减趋势，这一发现是文献中的新见解。这表明，在大型城市中，类似商业设施的密集分布对于提升当地生产力至关重要，因为信息共享在这些地方起着关键作用。我们的研究结果表明，邻近代理带来的好处主要体现在租金而非工资中，这挑战了现有文献中仅通过工资方程来推断集聚效应的观点。纽约县或曼哈顿占美国广告代理收入的24%。多年前，人们普遍认为麦迪逊大道上的大型代理机构是这一行业的支柱。但如今，曼哈顿南部有超过1000家代理机构分布在不同的区域。在代理行业，网络效应在运作中起着关键作用，访谈表明，非正式的交流对于思想交换非常重要。

abstract.text: This paper considers structural non-parametric random utility models for continuous choice variables with unobserved heterogeneity. We provide sufficient conditions on random preferences to yield reduced-form systems of non-parametric stochastic demand functions that allow global invertibility between demands and non-separable unobserved heterogeneity. Invertibility is essential for global identification of structural consumer demand models, for the existence of well-specified probability models of choice and for the non-parametric analysis of revealed stochastic preference. We distinguish between new classes of models in which heterogeneity is separable and non-separable in the marginal rates of substitution, respectively.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00500.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了具有未观测异质性的连续选择变量的结构非参数随机效用模型。我们提出了随机偏好条件的充分条件，以得到非参数随机需求函数的简化形式，这些函数允许需求之间的全局可逆性，并能够处理不可分的未观测异质性。可逆性对于全局识别结构消费者需求模型、确保选择概率模型的良好指定以及进行非参数分析至关重要。我们区分了两类模型：一类是异质性在边际替代率中可分的模型，另一类是异质性不可分的模型。

abstract.text: This research argues that the differential effect of international trade on the demand for human capital across countries has been a major determinant of the distribution of income and population across the globe. In developed countries the gains from trade have been directed towards investment in education and growth in income per capita, whereas a significant portion of these gains in less developed economies have been channeled towards population growth. Cross-country regressions establish that indeed trade has positive effects on fertility and negative effects on education in non-OECD economies, while inducing fertility decline and human capital formation in OECD economies.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00501.x.abstractZh: 本研究认为，国际贸易对各国人力资本需求的差异效应是全球收入和人口分布的主要决定因素。在发达国家，贸易带来的收益主要用于教育投资以及人均收入的增长，而在欠发达国家，这些收益的很大一部分被用于人口增长。跨国回归分析表明，在非OECD经济体中，贸易确实对生育率有积极影响，但对教育有负面影响；而在OECD经济体中，贸易则导致生育率下降和人力资本形成。

abstract.text: In their paper “Information Acquisition in Financial Markets” (this journal, 2000), Barlevy and Veronesi present a model of a one-period financial market, and claim that for an open set of parameter values, the value of information increases with the mass of informed agents. That claim is shown here to be false. The property of strategic substitution is robust in their model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00502.x.abstractZh: 在《金融市场中的信息获取》一文中（该期刊，2000年），Barlevy和Veronesi提出了一个单期金融市场的模型，并声称对于一组开放的参数值，信息价值会随着知情代理人的数量增加而增加。然而，这里的分析表明这一说法是错误的。在他们的模型中，策略性替代的特性是稳健的。

abstract.text: We study the formation of a ruling coalition in non-democratic societies where institutions do not enable political commitments. Each individual is endowed with a level of political power. The ruling coalition consists of a subset of the individuals in the society and decides the distribution of resources. A ruling coalition needs to contain enough powerful members to win against any alternative coalition that may challenge it, and it needs to be self-enforcing, in the sense that none of its subcoalitions should be able to secede and become the new ruling coalition. We present both an axiomatic approach that captures these notions and determines a (generically) unique ruling coalition and the analysis of a dynamic game of coalition formation that encompasses these ideas. We establish that the subgame-perfect equilibria of the coalition formation game coincide with the set of ruling coalitions resulting from the axiomatic approach. A key insight of our analysis is that a coalition is made self-enforcing by the failure of its winning subcoalitions to be self-enforcing. This is most simply illustrated by the following example: with “majority rule”, two-person coalitions are generically not self-enforcing and consequently, three-person coalitions are self-enforcing (unless one player is disproportionately powerful). We also characterize the structure of ruling coalitions. For example, we determine the conditions under which ruling coalitions are robust to small changes in the distribution of power and when they are fragile. We also show that when the distribution of power across individuals is relatively equal and there is majoritarian voting, only certain sizes of coalitions (e.g. with majority rule, coalitions of size 1, 3, 7, 15, etc.) can be the ruling coalition.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00503.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在非民主社会中，当制度无法支持政治承诺时，如何形成执政联盟的问题。每个个体都拥有一定的政治权力。执政联盟由社会中的一部分个体组成，负责决定资源的分配。一个执政联盟需要包含足够强大的成员，以战胜任何可能挑战它的替代联盟，并且需要具有自我维持能力，即其下属联盟中没有任何一个能够脱离并成为新的执政联盟。我们提出了一种公理化的方法，该方法能够捕捉这些概念，并确定一个（通常）唯一的执政联盟，同时分析了包含这些思想的联盟形成动态博弈。我们证明了联盟形成博弈的子博弈完美均衡与由公理化方法得出的执政联盟集合是一致的。我们分析的一个关键发现是，一个联盟之所以能够自我维持，是因为其获胜的下属联盟未能实现自我维持。这一结论可以通过以下例子来简单说明：在“多数规则”下，两人联盟通常不具备自我维持能力，而三人联盟则具有自我维持能力（除非其中一个玩家具有不成比例的强大力量）。我们还描述了执政联盟的结构。例如，我们确定了执政联盟在权力分配发生微小变化时的稳健性条件，以及它们何时会变得脆弱。我们还表明，在个体之间的权力分配相对平等且采用多数投票制的情况下，只有某些规模的联盟（例如，在多数规则下，规模为1、3、7、15等的联盟）可以成为执政联盟。

abstract.text: Living with risk can lead to anticipatory feelings such as anxiety or hopefulness. Such feelings can affect the choice between lotteries that will be played out in the future—choice may be motivated not only by the (static) risks involved but also by the desire to reduce anxiety or to promote savouring. This paper provides a model of preference in a three-period setting that is axiomatic and includes a role for anticipatory feelings. It is shown that the model of preference can accommodate intuitive patterns of demand for information such as information seeking when a favourable outcome is very likely and information aversion when it is more likely that the outcome will be unfavourable. Behavioural meaning is given to statements such as “individual 1 is anxious” and “2 is more anxious than 1”. Finally, the model is differentiated sharply from the classic model due to Kreps and Porteus.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00504.x.abstractZh: 面对风险，人们可能会产生期待感，如焦虑或希望。这种情感会影响对未来可能发生的彩票游戏的抉择——这种抉择可能不仅仅是由所涉及的风险驱动的，还可能出于减轻焦虑或增加享受的意愿。本文提出了一个在三个时期框架内的偏好模型，该模型具有公理性质，并考虑了期待感的作用。研究表明，该偏好模型能够适应一些直观的需求模式，例如当结果很可能出现时，人们会寻求信息；而当结果不太可能出现时，人们则会对信息产生厌恶。对于诸如“个体1感到焦虑”和“个体2比个体1更焦虑”这样的陈述，该模型赋予了行为上的意义。最后，该模型与Kreps和Porteus提出的经典模型有显著区别。

abstract.text: In criminal organizations, diffusing information widely throughout the organization might lead to greater internal efficiency (in particular, since these organizations are self-sustaining, through enhancing trust). However, this may come at the cost of leaving the organization more vulnerable to external threats such as law enforcement. We consider the implications of this trade-off and characterize the optimal information structure, rationalizing both “hierarchical” structures and organization in cells. Then, we focus on the role of the external authority, characterize optimal detection strategies, and discuss the implications of different forms of enforcement on the internal structure of the organization and policy. Finally, we discuss a number of applications and extensions.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00508.x.abstractZh: 在犯罪组织中，将信息广泛传播到整个组织内部可能会提高内部效率（尤其是因为这些组织是自我维持的，通过增强信任来实现）。然而，这样做可能会使组织更容易受到执法等外部威胁的影响。我们考虑了这种权衡所带来的影响，并描述了最优的信息结构，使得“层级化”结构和单元式组织都能得到合理化。接着，我们关注外部权威的作用，描述了最优的检测策略，并讨论了不同形式的执法对组织内部结构和政策的影响。最后，我们讨论了一些应用和扩展情况。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for modelling choice in the presence of framing effects. An extended choice function assigns a chosen element to every pair (A, f) where A is a set of alternatives, and f is a frame. A frame includes observable information that is irrelevant in the rational assessment of the alternatives, but nonetheless affects choice. We relate the new framework to the classical model of choice correspondence. Conditions are identified under which there exists either a transitive or a transitive and complete binary relation R such that an alternative x is chosen in some (A, f) iff x is R-maximal in the set A. We then demonstrate that the framework of choice correspondence misses information, which is essential to economic modelling, and which is incorporated in the extended choice function.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00510.x.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个用于建模存在框架效应下的选择的框架。扩展的选择函数将每个对(A, f)分配一个选定的元素，其中A是备选方案集，f是框架。框架包含一些在理性评估备选方案时无关的信息，但这些信息仍然会影响选择。我们将这一新框架与传统的选择对应模型联系起来。我们确定了存在一种传递或传递且完备的二元关系R的条件，即在某些(A, f)中选择了备选方案x，当且仅当x在集合A中是R-最大的。然后我们证明了选择对应框架遗漏了对于经济建模至关重要的信息，而这些信息被包含在扩展的选择函数中。

abstract.text: Do parents have preferences over the gender of their children, and if so, does this have negative consequences for daughters versus sons? In this paper, we show that child gender affects the marital status, family structure, and fertility of a significant number of American families. Overall, a first-born daughter is significantly less likely to be living with her father compared to a first-born son. Three factors are important in explaining this gap. First, women with first-born daughters are less likely to marry. Strikingly, we also find evidence that the gender of a child in utero affects shotgun marriages. Among women who have taken an ultrasound test during pregnancy, mothers who have a girl are less likely to be married at delivery than those who have a boy. Second, parents who have first-born girls are significantly more likely to be divorced. Third, after a divorce, fathers are much more likely to obtain custody of sons compared to daughters. These three factors have serious negative income and educational consequences for affected children. What explains these findings? In the last part of the paper, we turn to the relationship between child gender and fertility to help sort out parental gender bias from competing explanations for our findings. We show that the number of children is significantly higher in families with a first-born girl. Our estimates indicate that first-born daughters caused approximately 5500 more births per year, for a total of 220,000 more births over the past 40 years. Taken individually, each piece of empirical evidence is not sufficient to establish the existence of parental gender bias. But taken together, the weight of the evidence supports the notion that parents in the U.S. favour boys over girls.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00514.x.abstractZh: 父母是否对子女的性别有偏好？如果有，这种偏好是否会对女儿和儿子产生不同的负面影响？本文研究表明，子女的性别显著影响美国许多家庭的婚姻状况、家庭结构和生育情况。总体而言，长女与长子相比，与父亲同住的可能性要低得多。造成这种差异的有三个重要因素。首先，拥有长女的女性结婚的可能性较低。值得注意的是，我们还发现，胎儿性别会影响婚姻方式。在进行过超声波检查的孕妇中，生下女孩的母亲在分娩时结婚的可能性低于生下男孩的母亲。其次，拥有长女的父母离婚的可能性显著更高。第三，离婚后，父亲获得儿子抚养权的可能性远高于女儿。这三个因素对受影响儿童的收入和教育状况产生了严重的负面影响。这些发现背后的原因是什么？在论文的最后部分，我们探讨了子女性别与生育率之间的关系，以帮助区分父母性别偏见与其他可能的解释。研究表明，拥有长女的家庭子女数量显著多于其他家庭，过去40年间，长女导致的出生人数增加了约5500人，总计增加了220,000人。单独来看，这些实证证据不足以证明存在父母性别偏见。但综合来看，这些证据支持这样一种观点：美国的父母更倾向于选择男孩而非女孩。

abstract.text: To remain competitive, an organization must both respond to information about its environment and coordinate its activities. We analyse how the allocation of decision rights within an organizational hierarchy influences the organization's ability to solve such problems of coordinated adaptation when information is both soft and distributed inside the organization and the organizational participants behave strategically. The results show that, contrary to the common intuition, the performance differential between centralized and decentralized decision-making is non-monotone in the importance of coordination. Further, both these common structures are dominated by asymmetric structures in sufficiently asymmetric environments (such as a small division developing a new product in the presence of a large division with an established product). Finally, if the incentive conflicts between the participants can be made sufficiently small, centralized decision-making is always dominated by decentralized decision-making.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00518.x.abstractZh: 为了保持竞争力，一个组织必须既响应其环境信息，又协调其活动。我们分析了组织层级中决策权的分配如何影响组织解决协调适应问题的能力，尤其是在信息在组织内部呈软态且分布不均，且组织参与者采取战略行为的情况下。研究结果表明，与普遍直觉相反，集中式与分散式决策之间的性能差异在协调的重要性方面并非单调的。此外，在足够不对称的环境中（例如一个小部门在已有产品的大部门存在的情况下开发新产品），这两种常见结构都会被不对称结构所主导。最后，如果参与者之间的激励冲突能够被充分缓解，那么集中式决策总是会被分散式决策所取代。

abstract.text: We study preferences over menus which can be represented as if the agent selects an alternative from a menu and experiences regret if her choice is ex post inferior. Since regret arises from comparisons between the alternative selected and the other available alternatives, our axioms reflect the agent's desire to limit her options. We prove that our representation is essentially unique. We also introduce two measures of comparative regret attitudes and relate them to our representation. Finally, we explore the formal connection between the present work and the literature on temptation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00834.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了关于菜单的偏好问题，这种偏好可以表现为：代理人从菜单中选择一个选项，如果其选择事后表现不佳，就会感到后悔。由于后悔源于对所选选项与其他可用选项之间的比较，我们的公理反映了代理人希望限制其选择范围的愿望。我们证明了这种表示方式本质上是唯一的。我们还引入了两种比较后悔态度的度量方法，并将它们与我们的表示方式联系起来。最后，我们探讨了本研究与关于诱惑的文献之间的形式性联系。

abstract.text: Much evidence suggests that people are heterogeneous with regard to their abilities to make rational, forward-looking decisions. This raises the question as to when the rational types are decisive for aggregate outcomes and when the boundedly rational types shape aggregate results. We examine this question in the context of a long-standing and important economic problem: the adjustment of nominal prices after an anticipated monetary shock. Our experiments suggest that two types of bounded rationality—money illusion and anchoring—are important behavioral forces behind nominal inertia. However, depending on the strategic environment, bounded rationality has vastly different effects on aggregate price adjustment. If agents' actions are strategic substitutes, adjustment to the new equilibrium is extremely quick, whereas under strategic complementarity, adjustment is both very slow and associated with relatively large real effects. This adjustment difference is driven by price expectations, which are very flexible and forward-looking under substitutability but adaptive and sticky under complementarity. Moreover, subjects' expectations are also considerably more rational under substitutability.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00836.x.abstractZh: 大量证据表明，人们在做出理性、具有前瞻性的决策方面存在差异。这引发了这样一个问题：在何时理性类型对总体结果起决定性作用，而在何时有限理性类型对总体结果产生影响。我们在一个长期存在且重要的经济问题背景下研究了这个问题：在预期货币冲击后名义价格的调整。我们的实验表明，两种有限理性现象——货币幻觉和锚定效应——是名义惯性背后的重要行为因素。然而，根据战略环境的不同，有限理性对总体价格调整的影响也大相径庭。如果代理人的行为属于战略替代关系，那么对新均衡的调整会非常迅速；而在战略互补关系下，调整则非常缓慢，并且会产生相对较大的实际影响。这种调整差异是由价格预期驱动的，在替代关系下，价格预期非常灵活且具有前瞻性；而在互补关系下，价格预期则具有适应性且难以改变。此外，在替代关系下，受试者的预期也更为理性。

abstract.text: We study a model of lumpy investment wherein establishments face persistent shocks to common and plant-specific productivity, and nonconvex adjustment costs lead them to pursue generalized (S, s) investment rules. We allow persistent heterogeneity in both capital and total factor productivity alongside low-level investments exempt from adjustment costs to develop the first model consistent with the cross-sectional distribution of establishment investment rates. Examining the implications of lumpy investment for aggregate dynamics in this setting, we find that they remain substantial when factor supply considerations are ignored, but are quantitatively irrelevant in general equilibrium. The substantial implications of general equilibrium extend beyond the dynamics of aggregate series. While the presence of idiosyncratic shocks makes the time-averaged distribution of plant-level investment rates largely invariant to market-clearing movements in real wages and interest rates, we show that the dynamics of plants' investments differ sharply in their presence. Thus, model-based estimations of capital adjustment costs involving panel data may be quite sensitive to the assumption about equilibrium. Our analysis also offers new insights about how nonconvex adjustment costs influence investment at the plant. When establishments face idiosyncratic productivity shocks consistent with existing estimates, we find that nonconvex costs do not cause lumpy investments, but act to eliminate them.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00837.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有不连续投资的模型，在该模型中，企业面临持续性的共同生产力和特定工厂生产力的冲击，且非凸调整成本促使它们遵循广义的(S, s)投资规则。我们允许资本和全要素生产率存在持续的异质性，并允许低水平的投资免于调整成本，从而构建出第一个与工厂投资率横截面分布一致的模型。在考察不连续投资对这一环境总体动态的影响时，我们发现，当忽略要素供应因素时，这些影响仍然显著，但在一般均衡中则几乎无关紧要。一般均衡的显著影响不仅限于总体动态。虽然特异性冲击使得工厂层面的投资率时间平均分布对实际工资和利率的市场清算变动基本不变，但我们发现，在特异性冲击存在的情况下，工厂投资的动态会显著不同。因此，基于模型的资本调整成本估计可能会非常敏感于关于均衡的假设。我们的分析还提供了关于非凸调整成本如何影响工厂投资的新见解。当企业面临与现有估计一致的特异性生产力冲击时，我们发现非凸成本并不会导致不连续投资，反而会消除这些不连续投资。

abstract.text: Previous research has argued that debt financing affects equity-holders' investment decisions, producing substantial inefficiency. This paper shows that the size of this inefficiency depends on the degree of investment reversibility. In a dynamic model of financing and investment, the paper provides an upper bound for the inefficiency produced by debt financing. The upper bound is decreasing in the degree of investment reversibility and is zero when investment is perfectly reversible.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00838.x.abstractZh: 先前的研究指出，债务融资会影响股权持有者的投资决策，从而导致严重的效率低下。本文表明，这种效率低下的程度取决于投资的可逆性。在一个动态融资和投资模型中，本文为债务融资所引发的效率低下提供了一个上限。该上限随着投资可逆性的增加而降低，当投资完全可逆时，该上限为零。

abstract.text: We study a Monte Carlo algorithm for computing marginal and stationary densities of stochastic models with the Markov property, establishing global asymptotic normality and OP(n–1/2) convergence. Asymptotic normality is used to derive error bounds in terms of the distribution of the norm deviation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00839.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种蒙特卡洛算法，用于计算具有马尔可夫性质的随机模型的边际密度和稳态密度，并证明了全局渐近正态性和OP(n–1/2)收敛性。通过渐近正态性，可以推导出以范数偏差分布为参数的误差界限。

abstract.text: This paper studies a general model of holdup in a setting encompassing the models of Segal (1999) and Che and Hausch (1999) among others. It is shown that if renegotiation is modeled as an infinite-horizon noncooperative bargaining game, then, with a simple initial contract, an efficient equilibrium will generally exist. The contract is robust in the sense that it does not depend on fine details of the model. The contract gives authority to one party to set the terms of trade and gives the other party a nonexpiring option to trade at these terms. The difference from standard results arises because the initial contract ensures that the renegotiation game has multiple equilibria; the multiplicity of continuation equilibria can be used to enforce efficient investment.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00844.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个涵盖Segal（1999年）和Che与Hausch（1999年）等模型的一般性博弈模型中的博弈延迟现象。研究表明，如果将重新谈判建模为一个无限时域的非合作讨价还价游戏，那么通过简单的初始契约，通常会存在一个有效的均衡状态。该契约具有鲁棒性，即它不依赖于模型的细节。该契约赋予一方设定交易条件的权力，同时给予另一方一个无限期的选择权，以这些条件进行交易。与标准结果的不同之处在于，初始契约确保了重新谈判游戏存在多个均衡状态；这些持续均衡的多重性可以用来促进有效的投资。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic Bertrand game in which prices are publicly observed and each firm receives a privately observed cost shock in each period. Although cost shocks are independent across firms, within a firm costs follow a first-order Markov process. We analyze the set of collusive equilibria available to firms, emphasizing the best collusive scheme for the firms at the start of the game. In general, there is a trade-off between productive efficiency, whereby the low-cost firm serves the market in a given period, and high prices. We show that when costs are perfectly correlated over time within a firm, if the distribution of costs is log-concave and firms are sufficiently patient, then the optimal collusive scheme entails price rigidity: firms set the same price and share the market equally, regardless of their respective costs. When serial correlation of costs is imperfect, partial productive efficiency is optimal. For the case of two cost types, first-best collusion is possible if the firms are patient relative to the persistence of cost shocks, but not otherwise. We present numerical examples of first-best collusive schemes.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00845.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个动态伯特兰博弈，其中价格被公开公布，每家公司每期都会收到一个私密的成本冲击。尽管成本冲击在不同公司之间是独立的，但在公司内部，成本遵循一阶马尔可夫过程。我们分析了公司可选择的勾结均衡，重点研究了博弈开始阶段对公司最有利的合作方案。通常，生产效率与高价格之间存在权衡：低成本公司能在特定时期为市场提供服务，而高价格则可能导致其他问题。我们指出，当公司内部成本随时间完全相关时，如果成本分布呈对数凹形，并且公司具有足够的耐心，那么最优的合作方案要求价格固定：无论各自的成本如何，公司都会设定相同的价格并平等分享市场。当成本之间的序列相关性不完美时，部分生产效率才是最优的。对于两种成本类型的情况，如果公司能够忍受成本冲击的持续性，那么最优合作是可能的，否则则不可能。我们给出了最优合作方案的数值示例。

abstract.text: We show that a simple "reputation-style" test can always identify which of two experts is informed about the true distribution. The test presumes no prior knowledge of the true distribution, achieves any desired degree of precision in some fixed finite time, and does not use "counterfactual" predictions. Our analysis capitalizes on a result of Fudenberg and Levine (1992) on the rate of convergence of supermartingales.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00846.x.abstractZh: 我们证明，一个简单的“声誉风格”测试总能识别出两位专家中哪一位了解真实的分布。该测试假设对真实分布没有先验知识，能在某个固定的有限时间内达到任何期望的精确度，并且不使用“反事实”预测。我们的分析基于Fudenberg和Levine在1992年关于超马尔可夫过程收敛速率的研究成果。

abstract.text: We consider a cross-calibration test of predictions by multiple potential experts in a stochastic environment. This test checks whether each expert is calibrated conditional on the predictions made by other experts. We show that this test is good in the sense that a true expert—one informed of the true distribution of the process—is guaranteed to pass the test no matter what the other potential experts do, and false experts will fail the test on all but a small (category I) set of true distributions. Furthermore, even when there is no true expert present, a test similar to cross-calibration cannot be simultaneously manipulated by multiple false experts, but at the cost of failing some true experts.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00847.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在随机环境下，多个潜在专家的预测进行交叉校准测试的情况。该测试旨在检验每个专家是否能够在其他专家的预测基础上进行校准。我们发现，这种测试是有效的：一个真正了解过程真实分布的专业人士，无论其他潜在专家的行为如何，都能通过测试；而虚假的专业人士则会在除少数（属于第一类）真实分布外的情况失败测试。此外，即使不存在真正了解过程真实分布的专业人士，类似于交叉校准的测试也无法被多个虚假专家同时操纵，但会导致一些真正专家失败。

abstract.text: We design experiments to jointly elicit risk and time preferences for the adult Danish population. Since subjects are generally risk averse, we find that joint elicitation provides estimates of discount rates that are significantly lower than those found in previous studies and more in line with what would be considered as a priori reasonable rates. The statistical specification relies on a theoretical framework that involves a latent trade-off between long-run optimization and short-run temptation. Estimation of this specification is undertaken using structural, maximum likelihood methods. Our main results based on exponential discounting are robust to alternative specifications such as hyperbolic discounting. These results have direct implications for attempts to elicit time preferences, as well as debates over the appropriate domain of the utility function when characterizing risk aversion and time consistency.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00848.x.abstractZh: 我们设计了实验，旨在共同获取丹麦成年人群体的风险偏好和时间偏好信息。由于受试者通常具有风险厌恶倾向，我们发现联合获取这些信息所得到的折现率明显低于以往研究的结果，并且更符合人们认为的先验合理折现率。该统计方法的理论基础涉及长期优化与短期诱惑之间的潜在权衡。估计过程采用结构最大似然方法。基于指数折现模型得出的主要结果，即使采用双曲折现等其他模型规格，依然保持稳定。这些结果对时间偏好的获取以及关于效用函数适用范围的讨论具有直接意义，尤其是在描述风险厌恶和时间一致性时。

abstract.text: We study the provision of dynamic incentives to self-interested politicians who control the allocation of resources in the context of the standard neoclassical growth model. Citizens discipline politicians using elections. We show that the need to provide incentives to the politician in power creates political economy distortions in the structure of production, which resemble aggregate tax distortions. We provide conditions under which the political economy distortions persist or disappear in the long run. If the politicians are as patient as the citizens, the best subgame perfect equilibrium leads to an asymptotic allocation where the aggregate distortions arising from political economy disappear. In contrast, when politicians are less patient than the citizens, political economy distortions remain asymptotically and lead to positive aggregate labor and capital taxes.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00849.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在标准新古典增长模型背景下，为控制资源分配的自私政治家提供动态激励的问题。公民通过选举来约束政治家的行为。我们发现，为执政政治家提供激励的需求会导致生产结构中的政治经济扭曲，这些扭曲类似于总体税收扭曲。我们提出了条件，在这些条件下，政治经济扭曲在长期内会持续存在或消失。如果政治家像公民一样有耐心，那么最优的子博弈完美均衡将导致一种渐近的分配结果，其中由政治经济引起的总体扭曲会消失。相反，如果政治家不如公民有耐心，政治经济扭曲将持续存在，并导致总体劳动和资本税呈正值。

abstract.text: Any opinions expressed here are those of the author(s) and not those of the institute. Research disseminated by IZA may include views on policy, but the institute itself takes no institutional policy positions. The Institute for the Study of Labor (IZA) in Bonn is a local and virtual international research center and a place of communication between science, politics and business. IZA is an independent nonprofit company supported by Deutsche Post World Net. The center is associated with the University of Bonn and offers a stimulating research environment through its research networks, research support, and visitors and doctoral programs. IZA engages in (i) original and internationally competitive research in all fields of labor economics, (ii) development of policy concepts, and (iii) dissemination of research results and concepts to the interested public. IZA Discussion Papers often represent preliminary work and are circulated to encourage discussion. Citation of such a paper should account for its provisional character. A revised version may be available directly from the author. IZA Discussion Paper No. 2842

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00857.x.abstractZh: 本文所表达的观点属于作者个人意见，并不代表研究所的立场。IZA传播的研究内容可能包含对政策的看法，但研究所本身并不采取任何官方政策立场。位于波恩的劳工研究所是一个本地及虚拟的国际研究中心，也是科学、政治与商业之间的交流平台。IZA是一家独立的非营利组织，由德国邮政世界网络提供支持。该中心与波恩大学合作，通过研究网络、研究支持以及访问者和博士项目，为研究人员提供富有活力的研究环境。IZA致力于：(i)在劳动经济学所有领域开展原创且具有国际竞争力的研究；(ii)开发政策理念；(iii)将研究成果和理念传播给感兴趣的公众。IZA讨论论文通常代表初步研究成果，会进行分发以鼓励讨论。引用此类论文时应注明其初步性质。经过修订的版本可直接由作者提供。IZA讨论论文第2842号

abstract.text: This paper studies the asymptotic behavior of Fisher's information for a Lévy process discretely sampled at an increasing frequency. As a result, we derive the optimal rates of convergence of efficient estimators of the different parameters of the process and show that the rates are often nonstandard and differ across parameters. We also show that it is possible to distinguish the continuous part of the process from its jumps part, and even different types of jumps from one another.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00858.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了在不断增加采样频率的情况下，Lévy过程的Fisher信息量的渐近行为。在此基础上，我们推导了过程不同参数高效估计量的最优收敛速率，并发现这些速率通常是非标准的，且不同参数之间的速率也有所不同。此外，我们还证明了可以区分过程的连续部分与跳跃部分，甚至可以区分不同类型的跳跃。

abstract.text: We combine choice data in the ultimatum game with the expectations of proposers elicited by subjective probability questions to estimate a structural model of decision making under uncertainty. The model, estimated using a large representative sample of subjects from the Dutch population, allows both nonlinear preferences for equity and expectations to vary across socioeconomic groups. Our results indicate that inequity aversion to one's own disadvantage is an increasing and concave function of the payoff difference. We also find considerable heterogeneity in the population. Young and highly educated subjects have lower aversion for inequity than other groups. Moreover, the model that uses subjective data on expectations generates much better in- and out-of-sample predictions than a model which assumes that players have rational expectations.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00860.x.abstractZh: 我们将最后通牒游戏中的选择数据与通过主观概率问题所引发的提议者的预期相结合，以估计在不确定性下的决策结构模型。该模型基于荷兰人口中的大量代表性样本进行估计，能够同时反映不同社会经济群体对公平的非线性偏好以及预期的变化。我们的研究结果表明，对自身不利的不公平厌恶程度与收益差异呈递增且凹函数关系。此外，我们发现人群中存在着显著的异质性现象。年轻且受教育程度较高的群体对不公平的不厌恶程度低于其他群体。而且，使用主观预期数据的模型在样本内和样本外的预测效果都要优于假设参与者具有理性预期的模型。

abstract.text: We prove existence of equilibrium in a continuous-time securities market in which the securities are potentially dynamically complete: the number of securities is at least one more than the number of independent sources of uncertainty. We prove that dynamic completeness of the candidate equilibrium price process follows from mild exogenous assumptions on the economic primitives of the model. Our result is universal, rather than generic: dynamic completeness of the candidate equilibrium price process and existence of equilibrium follow from the way information is revealed in a Brownian filtration, and from a mild exogenous nondegeneracy condition on the terminal security dividends. The nondegeneracy condition, which requires that finding one point at which a determinant of a Jacobian matrix of dividends is nonzero, is very easy to check. We find that the equilibrium prices, consumptions, and trading strategies are well-behaved functions of the stochastic process describing the evolution of information. We prove that equilibria of discrete approximations converge to equilibria of the continuous-time economy.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00861.x.abstractZh: 我们证明了在连续时间证券市场中均衡的存在性，该市场中的证券具有潜在的动态完备性：证券数量至少比独立不确定性来源的数量多一个。我们证明，候选均衡价格过程的动态完备性可以从对模型经济原语的温和外生假设中得出。我们的结果是普遍性的，而非一般的：候选均衡价格过程的动态完备性和均衡的存在性取决于信息在布朗过滤中的揭示方式，以及关于期末证券股息的温和外生非退化条件。该非退化条件要求找到一个点，使得股息的雅可比矩阵的某个行列式不为零，这个条件很容易验证。我们发现，均衡价格、消费量和交易策略都是描述信息演变的随机过程的良好函数。我们证明，离散近似的均衡会收敛到连续时间经济中的均衡。

abstract.text: Consider two agents who learn the value of an unknown parameter by observing a sequence of private signals. The signals are independent and identically distributed across time but not necessarily across agents. We show that when each agent's signal space is finite, the agents will commonly learn the value of the parameter, that is, that the true value of the parameter will become approximate common knowledge. The essential step in this argument is to express the expectation of one agent's signals, conditional on those of the other agent, in terms of a Markov chain. This allows us to invoke a contraction mapping principle ensuring that if one agent's signals are close to those expected under a particular value of the parameter, then that agent expects the other agent's signals to be even closer to those expected under the parameter value. In contrast, if the agents' observations come from a countably infinite signal space, then this contraction mapping property fails. We show by example that common learning can fail in this case.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2008.00862.x.abstractZh: 考虑两个代理人，他们通过观察一系列私人信号来学习一个未知参数的价值。这些信号在时间上相互独立且分布相同，但不一定在代理人之间具有相同的分布。我们证明，当每个代理人的信号空间是有限的时，这些代理人通常会共同学习到该参数的价值，也就是说，该参数的真实价值将成为共同的认知。这一论证的关键步骤是，将一个代理人信号的期望值，在考虑另一个代理人信号的情况下，用马尔可夫链来表示。这使我们能够运用收缩映射原理，确保如果一个代理人的信号接近于在某一参数值下预期的信号，那么该代理人预期另一个代理人的信号也会更加接近于该参数值下预期的信号。相反，如果代理人的观测信号来自一个可数无限的信号空间，那么这种收缩映射性质就不成立了。我们通过例子表明，在这种情况下，共同学习可能无法实现。

abstract.text: A s reviewed in part I of this report, 1 primary PCI without antecedent fibrinolytic therapy has become widely accepted as the preferred reperfusion modality for patients with ST-segment-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) presenting at suitably equipped tertiary facilities.However, primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is not offered at Ն50% of US hospitals, and many of those that do are unable to offer primary PCI as an around-the-clock service.Primary PCI also is less widely available in many other countries than in the United States.Thus, fibrinolytic therapy continues to be administered to many patients with STEMI.2,3 Given the relatively low rates of successful reperfusion with fibrinolysis, 4,5 revascularization often is required afterward, the indications for and outcomes of which are critically evaluated here.The impact of individual operator and institutional volumes on PCI outcomes is reviewed.Evidencebased recommendations for selecting among the various reperfusion therapy options are then offered for the patients with STEMI presenting at centers with and without interventional capabilities, with distinctions drawn where the evidence-based recommendations in this article differ substantially from recently updated task force guidelines of the American College of Cardiology (ACC) and American Heart Association (AHA).5 Finally, recent and ongoing investigations to further improve outcomes after catheter-based reperfusion therapy are summarized.
