10.1257/aer.98.2.310.abstractZh: 长期以来，房屋所有权作为一种增加家庭财富的方式，其效用一直被认可。近年来，房屋所有权被推崇为改善低收入和中等收入家庭财务状况的重要策略。然而，这一策略并非没有风险，因为房屋所有权会在多个层面上给家庭带来潜在问题。本文重点探讨了房屋所有权策略可能有效的条件。其重要贡献在于对房屋所有权风险的深入分析，通过研究不同社区中房屋被收回的情况来评估这些风险。根据当前人口调查数据，在1994年至2006年间，处于第一和第二收入四分位数的家庭，其房屋所有权率分别上升了11.1%和12.9%。这一比例超过了普通人群的10.3%的增长幅度，部分原因是由于以下几个因素：首先，低收入和中等收入家庭的收入、教育和财富在这段时间内都有显著增长（Arthur B. Kennickell 2006），这增加了他们拥有资产和信贷的机会。

abstract.text: A household’s vehicle purchases are among its largest expenditure outlays. Moreover, unlike housing purchases, which a typical household may make once or twice over a lifetime, a household may well buy several cars over the same interval. The magnitude and relative frequency of vehicle purchases suggest that differential treatment by race in the vehicle market may have important implications for differences in wealth and financial wellbeing by race. Yet, whereas a robust literature in economics has studied virtually all aspects of racial treatment in the housing market, corresponding work about vehicles has been relatively sparse, with most work focusing on racial differences in prices paid (Pinelopi Goldberg (1996) and Fiona Scott-Morton, Florian Zettelmeyer, and Jorge Silva-Risso (2003)). Very little previous attention has been paid to whether there is differential racial treatment in another important outcome in the vehicle market: the interest rates that households pay on the loans used to purchase vehicles.1 Calculations using data from the Survey of Consumer Finances indicate that loans for vehicle purchases are primarily obtained from one of two sources. Roughly two-thirds of vehicle loans originate from the traditional banking sector: commercial banks, savings institutions, or credit unions. Vehicle manufacturers finance the remaining one-third of auto

10.1257/aer.98.2.315.abstractZh: 家庭的车辆购买是其最大开支之一。与住房购买不同，一个典型的家庭可能在一生中只购买一两辆汽车，而车辆购买则可能在相同的时间内购买多辆汽车。车辆购买的规模和相对频率表明，在车辆市场上对不同种族的差异化对待可能对不同种族之间的财富和财务状况产生重要影响。然而，尽管经济学领域有大量的研究涉及住房市场上种族差异的各个方面，但关于车辆市场的类似研究相对较少，大多数研究集中在种族在车辆价格支付上的差异上（Pinelopi Goldberg (1996) 和 Fiona Scott-Morton、Florian Zettelmeyer 以及 Jorge Silva-Risso (2003)）。此前很少有研究关注车辆市场上另一个重要结果：家庭在购买车辆时所支付的贷款利率是否存在种族差异。根据《消费者金融调查》的数据计算，车辆购买贷款主要来自两个渠道。大约三分之二的车辆贷款来自传统的银行部门：商业银行、储蓄机构或信用合作社。车辆制造商则负责为剩余的三分之一的车辆贷款提供资金。

abstract.text: For over three centuries and across the globe, lottery-linked savings (LLS) programs have offered individuals the opportunity to save, and in lieu of paying traditional interest, have given savers periodic chances to win money or prizes. Despite their long history, LLS programs are relatively unstudied by scholars. In this paper, I detail an LLS program that the UK government has offered continuously since 1956, the UK Premium Bond (PB) program. PBs guarantee holders risk-free return of nominal principal. In aggregate, they pay a market-related return, distributed to holders each month by a lottery like mechanism. Premium bonds are popular savings vehicles in the UK. Over £31.1 billion of PBs were outstanding as of March 2006, and public reports suggest that they were held by between 22 percent and 40 percent of UK citizens. The 60.2 million residents of the UK had £517 invested in PBs per capita. If held in the banking sector, PB holdings would have accounted for 3.9 percent of household sterling deposits in UK financial institutions. LLS programs, such as PBs, are fascinating not just because of their size, but because of their appeal to nonsavers, especially low-income families. Mauro Guillen and Adrian Tschoegl (2002, reviewing LLS programs in Latin America, concluded: “The bankers we spoke with believe that [LLS] are especially successful with low income depositors, and in cases where there are lots of people outside the banking system.” In South Africa, a new LLS program raised over 1.2 billion rand and enrolled 750,000 participants across a wide spectrum of the economy in two years. In the United Kingdom, while PBs are held by about the same fraction of the population holding stocks, PBs have a stronger appeal to lower-income British households. PBs are held by a larger fraction of British households than are stocks and shares for all households, except those earning over £52,000 annually (Department for Work and Pensions 2007). Are PB holders saving, gambling, or engaging in both activities? This question is not just academic, because national laws and regulations in many countries bar private LLS programs on the basis that they are prohibited gambling activities. For example, in South Africa, the government has tried to shut down the popular LLS program mentioned above; in the United States, these programs would violate state lottery laws and federal banking regulations. In this paper, I analyze the time series of net sales of the PB program and conclude that the program appears to be a hybrid of gambling and savings, but with a clear savings element.

10.1257/aer.98.2.321.abstractZh: 三个多世纪以来，全球范围内，与彩票相关的储蓄计划为个人提供了储蓄的机会，并且无需支付传统利息，而是让储户定期有机会赢得金钱或奖品。尽管历史悠久，但学者们对这类储蓄计划的研究相对较少。本文详细介绍了英国政府自1956年以来持续实施的英国优质债券计划。该计划为持有者提供无风险的本金回报，总体上支付与市场相关的回报，并通过类似彩票的机制每月分配给持有者。优质债券是英国受欢迎的储蓄工具。截至2006年3月，英国有超过311亿英镑的优质债券在流通，公开报告显示，这些债券被22%到40%的英国公民持有。英国有6020万居民每人投资了517英镑的优质债券。如果这些债券由银行部门持有，它们将占英国金融机构家庭英镑存款的3.9%。像优质债券这样的储蓄计划之所以引人注目，不仅因为其规模，还因为它们对非储蓄者，尤其是低收入家庭的吸引力。Mauro Guillen和Adrian Tschoegl在2002年回顾拉丁美洲的储蓄计划时指出：“我们与银行人士交谈后认为，这类计划对低收入储户特别有效，尤其是在银行系统之外有大量人群的情况下。”在南非，一项新的储蓄计划在两年内筹集了超过12亿兰特，吸引了750,000名来自经济各个领域的参与者。在英国，虽然持有优质债券的人口比例与持有股票的人口比例相当，但这些债券对低收入英国家庭更具吸引力。与所有家庭相比，英国有更大比例的家庭持有私人贷款计划，但年收入超过52,000英镑的家庭除外（英国工作与养老金部，2007年）。这些私人贷款计划的持有者是在储蓄、赌博，还是同时参与这两种行为呢？这个问题不仅仅是学术上的探讨，因为许多国家的法律法规禁止私人贷款计划，认为这些活动属于赌博行为。例如，在南非，政府曾试图关闭上述受欢迎的私人贷款计划；在美国，这类计划会违反州级彩票法律和联邦银行法规。在本文中，我分析了私人贷款计划净销售的时间序列数据，并得出结论：该计划似乎是一种结合了储蓄和赌博元素的混合模式，但其中储蓄元素占主导地位。

abstract.text: This paper presents new stylized facts on the distribution of the home bias at the fund level. We find (i) a large heterogeneity in the degree of home bias across mutual funds; (ii) a positive correlation between the size of funds and home bias; and (iii) a positive correlation between the size of funds, the number of foreign countries and the number of sectors in which they invest. These facts constitute a challenge for existing theories.

10.1257/aer.98.2.333.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于基金层面本土偏好分布的新发现。我们发现：(i)不同共同基金之间的本土偏好程度存在较大差异；(ii)基金规模与本土偏好之间存在正相关性；(iii)基金规模、投资的外国国家数量以及投资行业数量之间也存在正相关性。这些发现对现有理论提出了挑战。

abstract.text: Is the 2007-2008 U.S. sub-prime mortgage financial crisis truly a new and different phenomena? Our examination of the longer historical record finds stunning qualitative and quantitative parallels to 18 earlier post-war banking crises in industrialized countries. Specifically, the run-up in U.S. equity and housing prices (which, for countries experiencing large capital inflows, stands out as the best leading indicator in the financial crisis literature) closely tracks the average of the earlier crises. Another important parallel is the inverted v-shape curve for output growth the U.S. experienced as its economy slowed in the eve of the crisis. Among other indicators, the run-up in U.S. public debt and is actually somewhat below the average of other episodes, and its pre-crisis inflation level is also lower. On the other hand, the United States current account deficit trajectory is worse than average. A critical question is whether the U.S. crisis will prove similar to the most severe industrialized-country crises, in which case growth may fall significantly below trend for an extended period. Or will it prove like one of the milder episodes, where the recovery is relatively fast? Much will depend on how large the shock to the financial system proves to be and, to a lesser extent, on the efficacy of the subsequent policy response.

10.1257/aer.98.2.339.abstractZh: 2007-2008年的美国次贷金融危机是否真是一种全新的现象？通过对更长期历史数据的分析，我们发现其性质和程度与18次工业化国家战后发生的银行危机有着惊人的相似之处。具体来说，美国股票和房价的上涨（对于资本流入较大的国家而言，这被认为是金融危机文献中最好的领先指标）与这些早期危机的平均水平高度一致。另一个重要的相似之处是，在危机前夕，美国的经济增长呈现出倒V形曲线。在其他指标方面，美国的公共债务增长实际上略低于其他时期的平均水平，危机前的通货膨胀水平也较低。另一方面，美国的经常账户赤字趋势比平均水平更为严重。一个关键问题是，美国的危机是否会类似于工业化国家中最严重的危机，在这种情况下，经济增长可能会显著低于趋势水平，并持续一段时间。或者，它是否会像一些较为温和的危机那样，恢复速度相对较快？这一切将取决于对金融系统的冲击程度，以及随后政策响应的有效性。

abstract.text: Some 35 years ago the Club of Rome published a book that sold more than 30 million copies across 30 different translations (Donella Meadows et al. 1972). The book predicted the collapse of modern society if population growth, resource depletion, and pollution proceeded unabated. More recently, the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment echoed similar sentiments, documenting the loss of vital ecosystem services and predicting a dismal future unless drastic measures were taken. The underlying causes of our rapacious attitude towards the Earth has been conjectured to be linked to several factors, including Homo Sapiens ’ selfishness and lack of empathy for other humans and other species. The selfishness hypothesis has been studied extensively in experiments. One popular approach is to use variants of the simple prisoners ’ dilemma game. For example, public goods experiments, which are n-person simultaneous move games, are designed to make individual contributions to the public good yield positive externalities, but non-contribution is a dominant strategy. A typical result in this setting is that subjects are sensitive to free-riding incentives, but nonetheless cooperate at a level that cannot be fully explained by the selfishness assumption. Results from this class of games point to an interesting asymmetry between play across women and men—women appear more socially minded than men (see Catherine Eckel and Philip Grossman, forthcoming, and Rachel Croson and Gneezy, 2008, for a review). Relatedly, nonexperimental evidence provides support for the hypothesis that gender-specific preferences

10.1257/aer.98.2.376.abstractZh: 大约35年前，罗马俱乐部出版了一本书，该书以30种不同语言版本销售了超过3000万册（Donella Meadows等人，1972年）。该书预测，如果人口增长、资源枯竭和污染问题持续恶化，现代社会将会崩溃。最近，《千年生态系统评估》也表达了类似的观点，指出重要生态系统服务的丧失，并预测除非采取紧急措施，否则未来将十分糟糕。我们对地球贪婪的态度背后的原因被推测与多种因素有关，包括智人的自私性以及对其他人类和其他物种缺乏同情心。自私性假说在实验中得到了广泛研究。一种常用的方法是使用简单囚徒困境游戏的变体。例如，公共物品实验是一种多人同时行动的游戏，旨在使个人对公共物品的贡献产生积极的外溢效应，但不参与贡献则是一种主导策略。在这种情境下，受试者对搭便车行为的激励非常敏感，但仍然会以一种无法完全用自私性假设来解释的水平进行合作。这类游戏的结果表明，男女之间的行为存在有趣的不对称性——女性似乎比男性更具备社会意识（参见Catherine Eckel和Philip Grossman即将发表的论文，以及Rachel Croson和Gneezy在2008年的研究综述）。此外，非实验性证据也支持性别特异性偏好这一假设。

abstract.text: Hurricane Katrina displaced approximately 650,000 people and destroyed or severely damaged 217,000 homes along the Gulf Coast. Damage was especially severe in New Orleans, and the return of displaced residents to this city has been slow. The fraction of households receiving mail (which, in the absence of reliable population estimates, is a good indicator for returns) was 49.5 percent in August 2006, and 66.0 percent in June 2007 (Greater New Orleans Community Data Center, 2007). Low-income minority families appear to have been slower than others to return (William H. Frey and Audrey Singer, 2006). In this paper, we examine the determinants of returning to New Orleans in the 18 months after the hurricane. The data come from a study of low-income parents?mainly African American women?who were enrolled in a community college intervention prior to the hurricane. Although the sample is not representative of the pre-Katrina population of the city, it nonetheless is of great interest. The relatively slow return of low income, primarily African American, residents is a politically charged issue. One (extreme) view is that the redevelopment plans are designed to discourage low-income minority residents from returning. A quite different view is that members of this group have found better opportunities outside of New Orleans, and do not want to return. Because few data sets trace individuals from before to after the hurricane, this debate has taken place largely without the benefit of evidence.

10.1257/aer.98.2.38.abstractZh: 飓风卡特里娜导致约65万人流离失所，并摧毁或严重损坏了墨西哥湾沿岸的217,000栋房屋。新奥尔良的破坏尤为严重，流离失所的居民返回该城市的进程十分缓慢。在2006年8月，接受邮件的家庭比例为49.5%，而在2007年6月则上升至66.0%（Greater New Orleans Community Data Center, 2007）。低收入少数族裔家庭似乎比其他家庭更难以返回城市（William H. Frey和Audrey Singer, 2006）。本文研究了飓风过后18个月内居民返回新奥尔良的决定因素。数据来自一项针对低收入父母——主要是非洲裔女性——的研究，这些人在飓风前参加了社区学院的干预项目。尽管样本并不能代表飓风前该市的整体人口，但它仍然具有很大的研究价值。低收入、主要是非洲裔居民返回城市的速度较慢，这一问题是政治敏感的话题。一种观点认为，重建计划旨在阻止低收入少数族裔居民返回城市；另一种观点则认为，这些居民在纽约市外找到了更好的机会，因此不愿返回。由于很少有数据集能够追踪个人在飓风前后的变化，这一争论大多缺乏实证支持。

abstract.text: A consistent finding in the poverty literature is the diminution of the impact of the macroeconomy on official poverty rates in the United States since the early 1980s. Up until then, measures of aggregate economic activity (real GDP growth or the unemployment rate) had a more substantial influence on the poverty rate. Most recently, this fact has been documented by Hilary W. Hoynes, Marianne E. Page, and Ann Huff Stevens (2006, HPS hereafter). Kevin Lang (2007) notes that much has changed since the early 1980s with respect to antipoverty policy and labor market factors that affect poverty status. Important changes include the transition from cash to in-kind transfers, the stagnation in real median earnings, rising earnings inequality, and the increase in female-headed households. Nevertheless, after considering several factors that influence poverty, including wage growth, inequality, and female employment, HPS conclude their analysis of poverty trends with the view that explanation of the change in the response of poverty to macroeconomic indicators remains an open issue. This paper examines whether traction may be gained on this issue by enhancing our understanding of the volatility of poverty rates. Specifically, we examine the volatility of poverty rates over time and across demographic groups. To the extent that poverty rate variability is associated with the risk of poverty incidence, it is shown that certain eras have exposed members of particular demographic groups to more poverty risk than others. Then, we contrast the volatility of poverty rates to that of aggregate economic activity. Margaret M. McConnell and Gabriel Perez-Quiros (2000), among others, present evidence that the volatility of real GDP has been significantly Poverty Volatility and Macroeconomic Quiescence

10.1257/aer.98.2.392.abstractZh: 在贫困研究领域中，一个一致的结论是，自20世纪80年代初以来，美国宏观经济对官方贫困率的影响逐渐减弱。在此之前，总体经济活动指标（如实际GDP增长或失业率）对贫困率的影响更为显著。Hilary W. Hoynes、Marianne E. Page和Ann Huff Stevens在2006年的研究证实了这一事实。Kevin Lang在2007年指出，自20世纪80年代初以来，针对贫困的政策以及影响贫困状况的劳动力市场因素已经发生了很大变化。这些变化包括从现金转移转向实物转移、实际中位数收入的停滞、收入不平等的加剧以及女性户主家庭数量的增加。然而，在考虑了影响贫困的多个因素后，包括工资增长、不平等和女性就业状况，HPS认为，解释贫困对宏观经济指标反应的变化仍然是一个未解决的问题。本文旨在探讨通过提高我们对贫困率波动性的理解，是否可以找到解决这一问题的途径。具体来说，我们研究了贫困率随时间以及不同人口群体之间的波动性。如果贫困率的变异性与贫困发生的风险相关，那么某些时期某些人口群体面临的贫困风险会高于其他时期。然后，我们将贫困率的波动性与总体经济活动的波动性进行了对比。Margaret M. McConnell和Gabriel Perez-Quiros等人提供的证据表明，实际GDP的波动性与贫困的波动性之间存在显著关联。

abstract.text: Although poverty research has a very long history in the social sciences, serious debate on the sufficiency of economic growth to eliminate poverty was rekindled by the inception of the “War on Poverty” by the Kennedy and Johnson Administrations during the early 1960s. Forty years later, the measurement of growth’s effect on poverty remains an important input to the policy question of whether, how much, and how govern­ ment efforts should address poverty reduction. Early work by Henry J. Aaron (1967) found that poverty among certain groups seemed highly sensitive to economic growth, while other groups were barely affected. Subsequent researchers have realized that poverty has a spa­ tial as well as a demographic dimension, and more recent work has examined poverty by “race and region” using disaggregated time series. The present study further refines the examination of poverty by racial/ethnic group and region by investigating the impact of economic progress on poverty across black, Hispanic, and white populations measured over 35 years at the level of the census region. To our knowledge, this is the first research to study all three of these groups using regional data. A regional analysis is important because the North, Midwest, South, and West have had different industrial structures and different economic histories over the last three decades. As shown in Figure 1, regional poverty rates of blacks and Hispanics relative to whites are quite different. Moreover, regional differences exist in the levels and growth rates of real per capital GDP, in the secular decline in manufac­ turing, and in the pattern of the unemployment rate. In addition to economic events, we control Non-White Poverty and Macroeconomy: The Impact of Growth

10.1257/aer.98.2.398.abstractZh: 尽管贫困研究在社会科学领域有着悠久的历史，但关于经济增长是否足以消除贫困的严肃讨论，是在1960年代初期肯尼迪和约翰逊政府发起“反贫困战争”时重新引发的。四十年后，衡量经济增长对贫困的影响仍然是对政策问题的重要考量，即政府应该采取何种措施、力度多大以及如何治理贫困。亨利·J·亚伦在1967年的早期研究发现，某些群体的贫困状况对经济增长非常敏感，而其他群体则几乎没有受到影响。后续的研究者意识到，贫困具有空间性和人口统计学特征，而最近的研究则通过分时段的数据来研究“种族和地区”对贫困的影响。本研究进一步通过种族/族裔群体和地区来细化对贫困的研究，考察了35年间黑人群体、西班牙裔群体和白人群体在人口普查区域层面的经济进步对贫困的影响。据我们所知，这是首次使用区域数据来研究这三个群体的研究。进行区域分析非常重要，因为过去三十年中，北方、中西部、南方和西部地区的工业结构和经济历史各不相同。如图1所示，黑人和西班牙裔相对于白人的贫困率存在显著差异。此外，实际人均GDP的水平与增长率、制造业的长期衰退以及失业率模式等方面也存在地区差异。除了经济因素外，我们还考虑了非白人群体的贫困问题以及宏观经济：经济增长的影响。

abstract.text: Since women began entering the workforce in large numbers in the latter half of the twen? tieth century, they have faced important and difficult trade-offs between family and work. One such trade-off involves the timing of fer? tility. Biological constraints such as declining fecundity by age encourage early childbearing. However, researchers have found evidence of a wage premium to delay. Amalia Miller (2007) uses miscarriages as a source of variation in the timing of first birth, and finds an additional year of delay is associated with a 3 percent increase in wage rates and a 10 percent increase in earnings. David Ellwood, Ty Wilde, and Lily Batchelder (2004) show that wage profiles for high-skilled women flatten out at the point of the first birth, resulting in' significantly greater lifetime earn? ing for delayers.1 Understanding the causes of this wage pre? mium is essential to understanding the choices working women face and the decisions they make. This paper examines how much of the delay premium can be explained by differ? ences in human capital among early and late child bearers. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY), I find a raw return of approximately 3 percent per year of delay for hourly wages in 2003. Using the full NLSY panel and a fixed-effects framework, I show that there is a wage penalty to motherhood that increases with time since the birth, and that these penalties are greatest for high-skilled women. However, this effect is attenuated for women who delay childbirth. Next, I show that there are significant differ? ences in women's observable characteristics by age at first birth. Women who delay are more skilled, more educated, more likely to be in pro? fessional or managerial careers, and have more experience?even conditional on completed fer? tility. I return to estimating the return to delay, adjusting wages for differences in observable characteristics. I find that as much as 90 percent of the return to delay can be explained by differ? ences in observable characteristics. Education, experience, and age at first marriage have the most explanatory power. These results support a human capital theory for the delay premium.

10.1257/aer.98.2.403.abstractZh: 自20世纪下半叶女性开始大量进入劳动力市场以来，她们在家庭与工作之间面临着重要且复杂的权衡。其中一个权衡涉及生育时间的选择。生理因素，如随着年龄增长生育能力下降，促使女性较早生育。然而，研究人员发现，推迟生育会带来工资溢价。Amalia Miller（2007）以流产作为生育时间变化的来源，发现推迟一年会使工资率增加3%，收入增加10%。David Ellwood、Ty Wilde和Lily Batchelder（2004）指出，高技能女性的工资曲线在首次生育时趋于平稳，这意味着推迟生育的女性一生中的收入会显著增加。了解这种工资溢价的原因对于理解职业女性面临的抉择和做出的决策至关重要。本文探讨了这种生育时间延迟的溢价有多少可以通过早期和晚期生育者之间的人力资本差异来解释。利用全国青年纵向调查的数据，我发现2003年每小时工资的延迟生育每年带来的回报约为3%。通过完整的全国青年纵向调查数据及固定效应模型分析，我发现母亲身份会带来工资损失，且这种损失随着生育时间的延长而加剧，对于高技能女性来说这种损失更为显著。不过，对于推迟生育的女性来说，这种影响有所减弱。此外，我还发现女性在首次生育时的年龄特征存在显著差异。推迟生育的女性通常技能更高、教育程度更高、更有可能从事专业或管理类职业，并且即使已经完成了生育工作，她们的经验也更为丰富。我再次对延迟的回报进行了估算，并调整了工资以反映可观察特征的差异。我发现，高达90%的延迟回报可以通过可观察特征的差异来解释。教育程度、经验和初婚年龄对这些差异的解释力最强。这些结果支持了延迟溢价属于人力资本理论的观点。

abstract.text: Previous evidence suggests that the gender composition of a family's children--specifically, the presence of sons--affects a number of parental behaviors, including marriage formation, marriage disruption, and living arrangements. Using the March Current Population Survey from 1988 to 2006, this paper examines whether girls are at a double disadvantage in terms of living in single mother homes, and in the likelihood of receiving child support from absent fathers. The findings show that girls are indeed more likely to live in single mother homes and boys are overrepresented in married parent homes with a father or stepfather, and in single father families. However, the child support results suggest if anything that single mothers are slightly disadvantaged by having sons.

10.1257/aer.98.2.408.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，家庭中子女的性别构成——尤其是儿子的存在——会影响多种父母行为，包括婚姻的形成、婚姻的破裂以及居住安排。本文利用1988年至2006年的March当前人口调查数据，探讨了女孩在单亲家庭中的居住情况以及从缺席的父亲那里获得子女抚养费的几率方面是否处于双重劣势。研究结果表明，女孩确实更有可能居住在单亲家庭，而男孩则更常出现在有父亲或继父的已婚父母家庭中，以及单亲家庭中。不过，关于子女抚养费的调查结果表明，单亲家庭因有儿子而略微处于不利地位。

abstract.text: Many older US households have done little or no planning for retirement, and there is a substantial population that seems to undersave for retirement. Of particular concern is the relative position of older women, who are more vulnerable to old-age poverty due to their longer longevity. This paper uses data from a special module we devised on planning and financial literacy in the 2004 Health and Retirement Study. The evidence indicates that women display much lower levels of financial literacy than the older population as a whole. In addition, women who are less financially literate are also less likely to plan for retirement and be successful planners. These findings have important implications for

10.1257/aer.98.2.413.abstractZh: 许多美国老年家庭在退休规划方面几乎没有进行任何规划，还有相当数量的人似乎为退休储蓄不足。特别值得关注的是老年女性的相对状况，由于她们的寿命更长，因此更容易陷入老年贫困。本文使用了我们在2004年健康与退休研究中关于规划和金融素养的专项数据。研究结果表明，女性的金融素养水平远低于老年人口整体水平。此外，金融素养较低的女性也不太可能进行退休规划，也难以成为成功的规划者。这些发现具有重要的意义。

abstract.text: The continuing depreciation of the dollar against other major currencies, coupled with concerns about the impact of China’s exchange-rate policy on domestic prices, has spurred new interest in the exchange-rate pass-through literature. A recent study by economists at the Board of Governors attracted wide attention by documenting a steady decline over the past decade in the pass-through of exchange rates into U.S. import prices. This finding was later challenged by a study published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (see Mario Marazzi et al (2005) versus Rebecca Hellerstein, Deirdre Daly, and Christina Marsh (2006)), which demonstrated that the finding of such a decline depends crucially on the specification of the pass-through regression, and in particular the inclusion of commodity prices. This exchange highlights the need to understand the structural determinants of exchange rate pass-through, not only because such understanding is important when trying to forecast future pass-through patterns, but also because it provides guidance regarding the specification of the appropriate reduced-form regression, and more generally, measurement of pass-through. The increased availability of micro data on prices and quantities means that research uncov-ering these determinants is more promising than ever. This paper lays out a structural approach

10.1257/aer.98.2.423.abstractZh: 美元持续贬值，与其他主要货币相比，再加上对中国汇率政策对国内价格影响的担忧，使得人们对汇率传递理论产生了新的兴趣。美国联邦储备委员会的经济学家们最近的一项研究引起了广泛关注，该研究记录了过去十年中汇率对美国进口价格传递的稳步下降。然而，纽约联邦储备银行发表的一项研究对这一发现提出了质疑（参见Mario Marazzi等人（2005年）与Rebecca Hellerstein、Deirdre Daly和Christina Marsh（2006年）的论文），该研究表明，这种下降的确定性很大程度上取决于汇率传递回归模型的设定，特别是是否包含商品价格因素。这一研究强调了理解汇率传递的结构性决定因素的必要性，这不仅对于预测未来的传递模式非常重要，而且也为确定合适的简化形式回归模型以及衡量传递效应提供了指导。随着关于价格和数量微观数据的日益丰富，研究这些决定因素的前景比以往任何时候都要光明。本文提出了一种结构性分析方法。

abstract.text: We use data from the Current Population Survey collected both before and after Hurricane Katrina to estimate the impact of Katrina on the labor market outcomes of evacuees. Our estimates are based on a difference-in-differences strategy that compares evacuees to residents of Katrina-affected areas prior to Katrina, with non-evacuees and residents of areas that were unaffected by Katrina as a control group. We estimate that Katrina had substantial effects on the labor market outcomes of evacuees over the 13-month period immediately following Katrina. However, our estimates suggest that the effects of Katrina diminished substantially over time as evacuees recovered from the hurricane and adjusted to new economic and social conditions. Evacuees who did not return to their pre-Katrina areas have fared much worse in the labor market than have those who returned. Differences in individual and family characteristics account for some of the differences in outcomes between returnees and non-returnees. However, we present evidence that non-returnees have fared much worse in the labor market primarily because they came from areas that experienced greater housing damage due to the storm and thus were more likely to be displaced from their jobs. We are grateful to seminar participants at the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Society of Labor Economists meetings, and the Southern Economic Association meetings for useful comments. The views expressed in this paper are solely those of the authors and do not reflect the views of the Bureau of Labor Statistics. 1 I.

10.1257/aer.98.2.43.abstractZh: 我们利用了在卡特里娜飓风前后收集的当前人口调查数据，来估算飓风对撤离人员劳动力市场结果的影响。我们的估算基于差异-差异策略，将撤离人员与卡特里娜飓风发生前的受影响地区的居民进行比较，并将未撤离人员和未受飓风影响的地区居民作为对照组。我们估计，卡特里娜飓风在飓风发生后的13个月期间，对撤离人员的劳动力市场结果产生了显著影响。然而，我们的估算表明，随着撤离人员从飓风的影响中恢复并适应新的经济和社会条件，飓风的影响逐渐减弱。没有返回卡特里娜飓风发生前地区的撤离人员在劳动力市场上的表现比返回者要差得多。个体和家庭特征的差异解释了返回者与未返回者之间结果的一些差异。然而，我们的证据表明，未返回者在劳动力市场上的表现更差，主要是因为他们来自遭受更大房屋损坏的地区，因此更有可能失去工作。我们感谢劳工统计局、劳动经济学家协会以及南方经济协会会议的与会者提供的宝贵意见。本文所表达的观点仅代表作者个人观点，并不代表劳工统计局的观点。1 I.

abstract.text: This paper studies how prices comove across products, firms and locations to gauge the relative importance of retailer versus manufacturer-level shocks in determining prices. I make use of a large panel data set on prices for a cross-section of retailers in the U.S. I analyze prices at the barcode or “Universal Product Code ” (UPC) level for individual stores. I find that only 16 % of the variation in prices is common across stores selling an identical product. 65 % of the price variation is common to stores within a particular retail chain (but not across retail chains), while 17 % is completely idiosyncratic to the store and product. Product categories with frequent temporary “sales ” exhibit a disproportionate amount of completely idiosyncratic price variation. My results suggest that most of the observed price variation arises from retail-level rather than manufacturer-level demand and supply shocks. However, the behavior of prices is difficult to relate to observed variation in costs and demand at the retail level. This suggests that retail prices may vary largely as a consequence of dynamic pricing strategies on the part of retailers or manufacturers, rather than static demand and supply shocks.

10.1257/aer.98.2.430.abstractZh: 本文研究了不同产品、企业和地理位置之间的价格变动情况，以评估零售商与制造商层面的冲击在决定价格方面的重要性。我使用了美国零售企业价格的大型面板数据集，分析了单个商店的条形码或“通用产品代码”级别的价格。研究发现，只有16%的价格差异是同一产品在不同商店之间的共性。65%的价格差异是特定零售连锁内商店之间的共性（而非不同零售连锁之间），而17%的价格差异完全属于单个商店和产品的特性。经常进行临时“促销”的产品类别表现出不成比例的大量完全独特的价格差异。我的研究结果表明，观察到的大部分价格差异源于零售层面而非制造商层面的需求和供应冲击。然而，价格的变化难以与零售层面实际的成本和需求变化联系起来。这表明，零售价格的变化很大程度上可能是由零售商或制造商的动态定价策略所决定的，而非静态的需求和供应冲击所致。

abstract.text: Recent years have seen substantial progress in our understanding of pricing decisions at the micro level. Access to large scale data sources on prices at the level of individual products has given us rich information on how frequently prices change, by what magnitudes, and how the aggregation of price changes in individual firms maps into aggregate inflation (see, among many others, Mark Bils and Peter J. Klenow 2005). These facts about price movements are a key input in recent quantitative models of the aggregate effects of nominal rigidities (e.g. Mikhail Golosov and Robert E. Lucas 2007). In this paper, we use both the new facts and the new quantitative models to revisit an old question, namely, that of quantifying the welfare benefits of low inflation. Our model includes two channels through which steady-state inflation affects welfare. The first channel is based on the presence of nominal rigidities, which induce fluctuations in relative prices between products whose prices adjust, and products whose prices remain fixed, thus distorting the composition of output away from efficiency, and lowering aggregate productivity and welfare. These relative price distortions are eliminated when inflation is zero, so that the need for price adjustment is eliminated. This argument is at the core of a large literature on optimal

10.1257/aer.98.2.438.abstractZh: 近年来，我们在微观层面的定价决策理解上取得了显著进展。通过获取关于单个产品价格的大规模数据来源，我们获得了丰富的信息，包括价格变化的频率、变化幅度，以及单个企业价格变化的累积如何转化为总体通货膨胀（参见Mark Bils和Peter J. Klenow 2005年的研究）。这些关于价格变动的事实是近期关于名义刚性总体效应的定量模型的关键输入（例如Mikhail Golosov和Robert E. Lucas 2007年的研究）。在本文中，我们既利用了这些新发现，也运用了新的定量模型，重新审视了一个古老的问题，即如何量化低通货膨胀带来的福利收益。我们的模型包括两个渠道，通过这两个渠道，稳态通货膨胀会影响福利。第一个渠道基于名义刚性的存在，这种刚性导致价格调整的产品与价格固定的产品之间的相对价格出现波动，从而扭曲了产出的构成，降低了总体生产力和福利。当通货膨胀为零时，这些相对价格的扭曲会被消除，因此也就不需要进行价格调整了。这一论点是关于最优通货膨胀政策的大量文献的核心内容。

abstract.text: We explore the implications of models with increasing returns, endogenous variety and firm-level heterogeneity for the quantification of the gains from trade. We first focus on the impact of trade liberalization on imported variety by analyzing the experience of Costa Rica from 1986 to 1992. We find that although liberalization triggered a sizable increase in variety, the resulting welfare gains were small because of strong heterogeneity across imported goods. Upon trade liberalization, the new varieties are imported in small quantities, and hence contribute little to welfare. We then present a model with firm-level increasing returns, differentiated goods, monopolistic competition, endogenous variety and free entry to show that total variety (domestic plus imported) can either increase, decrease or remain constant with trade liberalization. More importantly, the gains from trade do not depend on what happens to total variety. In fact, we find that, conditional on the estimated elasticities of trade with respect to trade costs, models with increasing returns, endogenous variety, free or restricted entry, and firm-level heterogeneity have exactly the same implications for welfare gains from trade liberalization as traditional models.

10.1257/aer.98.2.444.abstractZh: 我们探讨了具有递增收益、内生多样性以及企业层面异质性模型对贸易收益量化影响的研究。首先，我们通过分析哥斯达黎加在1986至1992年的贸易自由化经验，来探讨贸易自由化对进口商品多样性的影响。我们发现，尽管自由化引发了商品多样性的显著增加，但由于进口商品之间的强烈异质性，由此带来的福利收益却很小。在贸易自由化之后，新引入的商品数量很少，因此对福利的贡献微乎其微。随后，我们提出了一个包含企业层面递增收益、差异化商品、垄断竞争、内生多样性以及自由进入机制的模型，以说明随着贸易自由化，总商品多样性（包括国内商品和进口商品）可能会增加、减少或保持不变。更重要的是，贸易收益并不取决于总商品多样性的变化。事实上，根据对贸易成本与贸易关系的估计弹性，具有递增收益、内生多样性、自由或限制进入机制以及企业层面异质性的模型，对于贸易自由化带来的福利收益的影响，与传统模型完全一致。

abstract.text: 1 A large empirical literature has documented that firm-level differences in productivity, size, ownership status and other characteristics are crucial to understanding differences in firms ’ decisions to export. The evidence strongly supports the self selection of more productive firms into export markets but there has been more mixed evidence on the subsequent feedback effects of exporting on the future path of firm productivity. Several recent papers have introduced a new dimension into this export-productivity relationship: firm-level investments in productivity-enhancing activities such as R&D. James A.

10.1257/aer.98.2.451.abstractZh: 大量实证文献表明，企业层面的生产力、规模、所有权状况等特征的差异对于理解企业出口决策的差异至关重要。这些证据强烈支持更有生产力的企业被自我选择进入出口市场，但关于出口对企业未来生产力发展影响的反馈效应，研究结果则存在分歧。一些近期的研究引入了这一出口与生产力关系中的新维度：企业层面在提高生产力方面的投资，如研发活动。James A.

abstract.text: This paper looks at the predictions of a standard heterogeneous firm model regarding the exports of firms across markets in response to a particular trade policy experiment and compares these predictions to the data. A unique feature of our data is that it has information on the exports of the same firm to different markets which allows us to look for a new set of predictions of such models. We argue that while certain predictions seem consistent with the data, others are not. We then describe the patterns found in the data and argue that firm and market specific demand shocks help explain a number of these anomalies. These parsimoniously capture factors, like business contacts or networks, or even fashion shocks, that make buyers more attracted to one firm rather than another in a particular market.

10.1257/aer.98.2.457.abstractZh: 本文探讨了标准异质企业模型关于企业在特定贸易政策实验下跨市场出口行为的预测结果，并将这些预测与实际数据进行了比较。我们数据的独特之处在于，它包含了同一企业在不同市场的出口信息，这使我们能够提出新的模型预测。我们发现，虽然某些预测与数据相符，但另一些则并不如此。随后，我们描述了数据中发现的模式，并认为企业及市场特定的需求冲击有助于解释这些异常现象。这些因素包括商业联系或网络，甚至时尚冲击等，它们使得买家在特定市场中更倾向于选择某一家企业而非另一家企业。

abstract.text: Research across a number of disciplines has highlighted the role of early life health and circumstance in determining health and economic outcomes at older ages. Nutrition in utero and in infancy may set the stage for the chronic disease burden that an individual will face in middle age. Childhood health may also have significant effects on economic outcomes in adulthood. Collectively, a set of childhood health measures can account for a large fraction of the explained variance in employment and social status observed among a British cohort followed from birth into adulthood.

10.1257/aer.98.2.463.abstractZh: 多项学科研究强调了早期生活健康与状况在决定老年时期健康与经济成果方面的作用。胎儿期和婴儿期的营养状况可能会影响个体在中年时期所面临的慢性疾病负担。儿童时期的健康状况也可能对成年后的经济成果产生重要影响。总体而言，一系列儿童健康指标可以解释英国一个从出生到成年阶段观察到的就业和社会地位变化中的大部分变异。

abstract.text: I explore the relationship between the distribution of adult heights and the distribution of income. It has previously been argued (a) that average adult height may depend negatively on income inequality; (b) that some measure of inequality in adult heights is informative about inequality in income; and (c) that differences in heights between groups are informative about the allocation of resources between the groups. I argue on theoretical grounds that, except in very special cases, height inequality is unlikely to indicate income inequality, but that (a) and (c) are plausible and worth serious investigation. I use data from the third round of India's National Fertility and Health survey to explore these issues. The most important findings concern sexual dimorphism in heights between adult Indian men and women. Consistent with improvements in material living conditions and in the epidemiological environment, both men and women are becoming taller over time, but the rate of increase is three times faster for men than for women, which is strongly suggestive of increasing relative discrimination against women in nutrition or healthcare. Sexual dimorphism is more marked in places where there is a high ratio of missing women which is consistent both with spatial differences in discrimination and with accounts in evolutionary biology of sexual dimorphism. I find no consistent relationship between either average heights or the inequality in heights and inequality in consumption.

10.1257/aer.98.2.468.abstractZh: 我探讨了成年身高分布与收入分布之间的关系。先前的研究指出：(a) 平均成年身高可能与收入不平等呈负相关；(b) 成年身高不平等的某种衡量标准能够反映收入不平等的情况；(c) 不同群体之间的身高差异能够反映资源在群体间的分配情况。从理论角度分析，除了非常特殊的情况外，身高不平等不太可能表明收入不平等，但(a)和(c)两点是合理的，值得深入研究。我使用了印度第三次全国生育与健康调查的数据来探讨这些问题。最重要的发现是，成年印度男性与女性之间的身高性别差异。随着物质生活条件和流行病学环境的改善，男女的身高都在增长，但男性的身高增长速度比女性快三倍，这强烈暗示了在营养或医疗保健方面对女性的歧视日益严重。在女性缺失比例较高的地区，身高性别差异更为明显，这与空间上的歧视差异以及进化生物学中对身高性别差异的解释相一致。我没有发现平均身高或身高不平等与消费不平等之间存在一致的关系。

abstract.text: In this paper I review evidence on the long-run relation between height and economic development in Italy. I ask three questions: What are the long-run trends of mean height and real incomes in Italy? What do we know about height dispersion? What other aspects of the distribution of height changed with economic development?

10.1257/aer.98.2.475.abstractZh: 在本文中，我回顾了关于意大利身高与经济发展之间长期关系的证据。我提出了三个问题：意大利的平均身高和实际收入在长期趋势上如何？我们对身高分布的变化情况了解多少？随着经济的发展，身高分布的其他方面又发生了哪些变化？

abstract.text: In a wide variety of settings, spiteful preferences would constitute an obstacle to cooperation, trade, and thus economic development. This paper shows that spiteful preferences - the desire to reduce another's material payoff for the mere purpose of increasing one's relative payoff - are surprisingly widespread in experiments conducted in one of the least developed regions in India (Uttar Pradesh). In a one-shot trust game, the authors find that a large majority of subjects punish cooperative behavior although such punishment clearly increases inequality and decreases the payoffs of both subjects. In experiments to study coordination and to measure social preferences, the findings reveal empirical patterns suggesting that the willingness to reduce another's material payoff - either for the sake of achieving more equality or for the sake of being ahead - is stronger among individuals belonging to high castes than among those belonging to low castes. Because extreme social hierarchies are typically accompanied by a culture that stresses status-seeking, it is plausible that the observed social preference patterns are at least partly shaped by this culture. Thus, an exciting question for future research is the extent to which different institutions and cultures produce preferences that are conducive or detrimental to economic development.

10.1257/aer.98.2.494.abstractZh: 在多种多样的情境下，恶意偏好会成为合作、贸易以及经济发展的障碍。本文指出，在印度最不发达的地区之一——北方邦进行的实验中，这种出于增加自身相对收益而减少他人物质收益的恶意偏好现象极为普遍。在一场一次性信任游戏中，研究者发现绝大多数参与者会惩罚合作行为，尽管这种惩罚显然会加剧不平等，并降低双方的利益。在关于协调和社会偏好的实验中，研究结果揭示了这样的现象：无论是为了追求更公平的分配，还是为了占据优势地位，人们减少他人物质收益的意愿在属于高种姓的人群中更为强烈，而在低种姓的人群中则相对较弱。由于极端的社会等级制度通常伴随着一种强调地位追求的文化，因此观察到的社会偏好模式至少部分是由这种文化所塑造的。因此，未来研究的一个有趣问题是：不同的制度和文化在多大程度上会产生有利于或不利于经济发展的偏好。

abstract.text: Ahmedabad, India’s sixth largest city, saw widespread religious violence in 2002. Using detailed neighborhood level data we show that riot incidence is positively predicted by a neighborhood’s proximity to the, by now largely derelict, textile mills. Mill neighborhoods also exhibit higher levels of religious integration, a fact we trace to the historical religious heterogeneity in the mill worker population and lower mobility. We suggest that these lower mobility rates are related to low and controlled rents in mill neighborhoods. The pattern of violence is consistent with the view that residents, or property developers in the city, exploited an environment of heightened religious tensions to engage in a resource war. 1

10.1257/aer.98.2.505.abstractZh: 印度第六大城市阿姆哈拉巴德在2002年发生了广泛的宗教暴力事件。通过详细的社区级数据分析，我们发现暴乱的发生与社区距离那些现已基本废弃的纺织厂的距离呈正相关。纺织厂所在的社区还表现出更高的宗教融合程度，这一特点源于纺织厂工人群体中历史上存在的宗教多样性以及较低的流动性。我们认为，这种较低的流动性与纺织厂社区租金低廉且管理严格有关。暴力事件的模式与这样一种观点一致：当地居民或房地产开发商利用宗教紧张局势，开展了一场资源争夺战。

abstract.text: While terrorist attacks are relatively infrequent, Gary Becker and Yona Rubinstein (2008) provide evidence that they generate a disproportionate amount of stress and fear, suggesting that the indirect effects may be far more reaching than the direct effects. The international organization Medecins Sans Frontieres (2006) claims that the physiological effect of civil conflict is Colombian’s worst public health problem. This paper is the first attempt to measure the effect of prenatal psychological stress due to terrorism on child birth outcomes. The medical literature indicates that prenatal stress increases levels of CorticotrophinReleasing Hormone (CRH), which regulates the duration of pregnancy and fetal maturation and thus increases the risk of adverse birth outcomes (Pathik D. Wadhwa et al. 1993, among others). There is also evidence that birth outcomes are most sensitive to maternal stress in early stages of pregnancy (Laura M. Glynn et al. 2001). This study finds that the intensity of random landmine explosions during a woman’s first trimester of pregnancy has a significant negative impact on child birth weight. This finding persists when mother fixed effects are included, suggesting that neither observable nor unobservable characteristics of the mothers are driving the results. I use a large dataset, comprising approximately 4 million births in Colombia from 1998 to 2003, which enables me to observe multiple births by the same mother and gives strong statistical power to discern patterns. The data also allow me to link the date of a landmine explosion with the trimester of the pregnancy, and thereby to identify the stage of pregnancy Stress and Birth Weight: Evidence from Terrorist Attacks

10.1257/aer.98.2.511.abstractZh: 虽然恐怖袭击相对罕见，但Gary Becker和Yona Rubinstein（2008）的研究表明，恐怖袭击会引发大量的压力和恐惧，其间接影响可能比直接影响更为深远。国际救援组织“无国界医生”（2006）指出，内战的生理效应是哥伦比亚最严重的公共卫生问题。本文首次尝试测量恐怖主义导致的产前心理压力对儿童出生结果的影响。医学文献表明，产前压力会增加促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素的水平，而该激素调节妊娠持续时间和胎儿成熟过程，从而增加不良出生结果的风险（Pathik D. Wadhwa等人，1993年等）。还有证据表明，出生结果对母体压力最为敏感，尤其是在妊娠早期（Laura M. Glynn等人，2001年）。本研究发现，女性在妊娠第一孕期遭遇随机地雷爆炸的强烈程度会对婴儿出生体重产生显著的负面影响。当纳入母亲固定效应后，这一发现仍然成立，表明无论是可观察到的还是不可观察到的母亲特征都不是导致这一结果的原因。我使用了包含约400万例哥伦比亚出生数据的庞大数据集，这使得我可以观察到同一母亲的多胎情况，并具备强大的统计能力来识别模式。这些数据还使我能够将地雷爆炸的日期与妊娠阶段联系起来，从而确定妊娠阶段与出生体重之间的关系。

abstract.text: In a seminal paper, Lena Edlund and Evelyn Korn (2002) introduce a puzzling stylized fact? that prostitution is low-skilled, labor intensive, female, and well paid?and offer a provocative explanation: sex workers draw a compensating differential due to the foregone opportunity to sell their fertility in the marriage market. In so doing, they not only provide the first formal model of occupational choice involving prostitu? tion, they also draw an intriguing link between the labor market and the marriage market that holds for only one occupation. When a woman chooses to become a sex worker, she relinquishes the compensation she would otherwise receive in marriage, since taboos prevent prostitutes from marrying. Thus, even in settings where prostitu? tion is legal, it must draw an earnings premium. Beyond drawing considerable media attention, the richness of the Edlund-Korn model has made

10.1257/aer.98.2.516.abstractZh: 在一篇开创性的论文中，Lena Edlund和Evelyn Korn（2002年）提出了一个令人困惑的假设：卖淫属于低技能、劳动密集型、女性主导且报酬较高的职业。他们提出了一个引人深思的解释：性工作者能够获得额外的补偿，这是因为她们在婚姻市场上可以出售自己的生育能力。通过这种方式，他们不仅首次提出了涉及卖淫的职业选择模型，还揭示了劳动力市场与婚姻市场之间的有趣联系，这种联系仅适用于一种职业。当女性选择成为性工作者时，她放弃了在婚姻中本可以获得的补偿，因为社会禁忌禁止妓女结婚。因此，即使在卖淫合法化的环境中，卖淫仍然需要获得额外的收入。Edlund-Korn模型不仅吸引了媒体的广泛关注，其丰富的内容也具有重要意义。

abstract.text: For two decades, the consensus explanation of the British Industrial Revolution has placed technological change and the supply side at center stage, affording little or no role for demand or overseas trade. Recently, alternative explanations have placed an emphasis on the importance of trade with New World colonies, and the expanded supply of raw cotton it provided. We test both hypotheses using calibrated general equilibrium models of the British economy and the rest of the world for 1760 and 1850. Neither claim is supported. Trade was vital for the progress of the industrial revolution; but it was trade with the rest of the world, not the American colonies, that allowed Britain to export its rapidly expanding textile output and achieve growth through extreme specialization in response to shifting comparative advantage.

10.1257/aer.98.2.523.abstractZh: 二十年来，关于英国工业革命的普遍解释将技术变革和供给方面视为核心因素，而需求或海外贸易则被忽视或不予重视。最近，一些替代性解释强调了与新世界殖民地的贸易以及由此带来的原棉供应增加的重要性。我们使用校准后的通用均衡模型，对1760年和1850年的英国经济及其他地区的状况进行了分析。两种观点均未能得到支持。贸易对工业革命的进展至关重要；但正是与世界的贸易，而非与美洲殖民地的贸易，使得英国能够出口其迅速增长的纺织品，并通过极端专业化来应对比较优势的变化从而实现经济增长。

abstract.text: What has driven trade booms and trade busts in the past century and a half? Was it changes in global output or in the costs of international trade? To address this question, we derive a micro-founded measure of aggregate bilateral trade costs based on a standard model of trade in differentiated goods. These trade costs gauge the difference between observed bilateral trade and frictionless trade in terms of an implied markup on retail prices of foreign goods. Thus, we are able to estimate the combined magnitude of tariffs, transportation costs, and all other macroeconomic frictions that impede international trade but that are inherently difficult to observe. We use this measure to examine the growth of global trade between 1870 and 1913, its retreat from 1921 to 1939, and its subsequent rise from 1950 to 2000. We find that trade cost declines explain roughly 55 percent of the pre–World War I trade boom and 33 percent of the post–World War II trade boom, while a precipitous rise in trade costs explains the entire interwar trade bust.

10.1257/aer.98.2.529.abstractZh: 在过去一个半世纪中，是什么驱动了贸易的繁荣与衰退？是全球产出的变化，还是国际贸易成本的变动？为了解答这个问题，我们基于一个关于差异化商品贸易的标准模型，提出了一个基于微观层面的双边贸易成本衡量指标。这些贸易成本衡量了实际双边贸易与无摩擦贸易之间的差异，具体表现为外国商品零售价格的隐含加价。因此，我们能够估算出关税、运输成本以及所有其他阻碍国际贸易的宏观经济摩擦的总规模，而这些因素往往难以被直接观察到。我们利用这一指标来研究1870年至1913年间全球贸易的增长情况，1921年至1939年间贸易的衰退，以及1950年至2000年间贸易的再次上升。我们发现，贸易成本的下降可以解释第一次世界大战前贸易繁荣的约55%，第二次世界大战后贸易繁荣的33%，而贸易成本的急剧上升则解释了两次世界大战之间的贸易衰退。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use a unique long-run dataset of regulatory constraints on capital account openness to explain stock market correlations. Since stock returns themselves are highly volatile, any examination of what drives correlations needs to focus on long runs of data. This is particularly true since some of the short-term changes in co-movements appear to reverse themselves (Delroy Hunter 2005). We argue that changes in the co-movement of indices have not been random. Rather, they are mainly driven by greater freedom to move funds from one country to another. In related work, Geert Bekaert and Campbell Harvey (2000) show that equity correlations increase after liberalization of capital markets, using a number of case studies from emerging countries. We examine this pattern systematically for the last century, and find it to be most pronounced in the recent past. We compare the importance of capital account openness with one main alternative explanation, the growing synchronization of economic fundamentals. We conclude that greater openness has been the single most important cause of growing correlations during the last quarter of a century, though increasingly correlated economic fundamentals also matter. In the conclusion, we offer some thoughts on why the effects of greater openness appear to be so much stronger today than they were during the last era of globalization before 1914.

10.1257/aer.98.2.535.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用一个独特的长期数据集，该数据集涉及资本账户开放性的监管限制，以此来解释股市之间的相关性。由于股市回报本身具有高度波动性，因此任何关于驱动相关性的因素的研究都需要关注长期数据。这一点尤其重要，因为一些短期内的共同变动似乎会自行逆转（Delroy Hunter 2005）。我们认为，指数共同变动的变化并非随机，而是主要由资金在不同国家之间更自由流动所驱动。在相关的研究中，Geert Bekaert和Campbell Harvey（2000）指出，在资本市场自由化之后，股权相关性会增加，他们通过多个新兴国家的案例研究进行了验证。我们对过去一个世纪这种模式进行了系统性的分析，发现这种趋势在最近的历史时期最为明显。我们将资本账户开放性的重要性与另一个主要解释——经济基本面同步性的增强——进行了比较。我们得出结论，在过去四分之一世纪中，更大的开放性是导致相关性增强的最主要原因，尽管经济基本面的同步性增强也起到了重要作用。在结论部分，我们提出了一些思考，探讨为什么今天更大开放性的影响比1914年之前的全球化时代更为显著。

abstract.text: Since 1969, achievement studies have been conducted in various subjects in elementary and secondary school curricula as part of the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP). Economics has now been added to the list. This study offers a brief description of the NAEP test in economics and presents some findings from the 2006 assessment given to twelfth-grade students who were taking a general economics course. NAEP is mandated by Congress and administered by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) at the US Department of Education. Policy direction and review are under the control of the National Assessment Governing Board (NAGB). For the economics assessment, the National Council on Economic Education, the American Institutes for Research, and the Council of Chief State School Officers developed a content framework for economics in 2001. These organizations established several committees composed of economists, educators, business and government leaders, and testing experts to prepare the assessment framework, subject to final approval by the NAGB. The major decision for the test developers was what economics content should be included in the test. Most economics courses in high schools last for a semester and cover basic microeconomic and/or macroeconomic concepts and applications. Some economics courses are Advanced Placement or honors courses that focus on college-level principles of economics. There are also combined courses in economics with government. A limited amount of economics content also may be taught in such subjects as consumer economics or personal finance, business education or entrepreneurship, history, and government (Walstad 2001). Given these conditions, the framework had to cover the broad range of what high school students might be taught about economics. A decision was made to target the assessment at what would likely be taught in a general economics course for high school students and the document used for content specification was the Voluntary National Content Standards in Economics.

10.1257/aer.98.2.541.abstractZh: 自1969年以来，国家教育进展评估（NAEP）一直在中小学课程中开展各种学科领域的成就研究。如今，经济学也被纳入了评估范围。本研究简要介绍了NAEP经济学测试的内容，并展示了2006年对参加普通经济学课程的十二年级学生进行的评估结果。NAEP由国会授权，由美国教育部下属的国家教育统计中心（NCES）组织实施。政策指导和评估工作则由国家评估管理委员会（NAGB）负责。对于经济学评估，国家经济教育委员会、美国研究机构以及州立学校官员委员会于2001年制定了经济学内容框架。这些机构成立了多个委员会，由经济学家、教育工作者、商业和政府部门领导以及测试专家组成，共同制定评估框架，最终由NAGB批准。测试开发者面临的主要决策是测试中应包含哪些经济学内容。大多数高中的经济学课程为期一个学期，涵盖基本的微观经济和/或宏观经济概念及其应用。一些经济学课程是高级课程或荣誉课程，重点教授大学水平的经济学原理。此外，还有将经济学与政府相关的综合课程。在消费者经济学、个人金融、商业教育或创业、历史以及政府等科目中也可能教授有限的经济学内容（Walstad 2001）。鉴于这些情况，框架必须涵盖高中生可能学习到的广泛经济学内容。决定将评估对象设定为高中学生通常会学习的一般经济学课程内容，而用于内容规范的文件则是《经济学自愿性国家标准》。

abstract.text: This edition of the Test of Understanding of College Economics (TUCE-4) is a revision of a test that was developed 40 years ago, and has a long history of use by teachers and researchers in the economics profession. The previous editions and their uses have been described in earlier studies (e.g., Rendigs Fels 1967; Phillip Saunders, Fels, and Arthur L. Welsh 1981; Saunders 1991) and in research in economic education (e.g., William E. Becker 1997). As with past editions, the TUCE-4 has two main objectives: to offer a reliable and valid assessment instrument for students in principles of economics courses; and to provide norming data for a national sample of students in principles classes so instructors can compare the performance of their students on a pretest and a posttest with this national sample. Separate exams were prepared in microeconomics and macroeconomics. Both exams consist of 30 multiple-choice items and can be administered within the time constraints of a single class period for most course formats. What follows is a description of the revision process, the content and cognitive specifications, the norming sample, and the statistical characteristics of the TUCE-4.

10.1257/aer.98.2.547.abstractZh: 本版《大学经济学理解测试》（TUCE-4）是对40年前开发的测试进行了修订，该测试在经济学领域的教师和研究人员中已有悠久的使用历史。以往各版本及其用途已在早期的研究中有所描述（例如，Rendigs Fels 1967；Phillip Saunders、Fels和Arthur L. Welsh 1981；Saunders 1991），并在经济学教育研究中得到验证（例如，William E. Becker 1997）。与以往版本一样，TUCE-4有两个主要目标：为经济学原理课程的学生提供可靠且有效的评估工具；为全国范围内的经济学原理课程学生提供标准化数据，以便教师能够将这些学生的测试成绩与全国样本进行比较。该测试分为微观经济学和宏观经济学两部分，每部分包含30道选择题，可以在一个课时内完成。以下是对修订过程、内容及认知要求、标准化样本以及TUCE-4统计特征的详细描述。

abstract.text: Susan Athey is an applied theorist who has made important contributions to economic theory, empirical economics, and econometrics. She has built a research program focused on using theory to understand substantive economic issues, especially in industrial organization. She has developed tools and techniques that provide the basis for empirical work grounded in sound economic theory. She has made particularly important advances in developing and applying tools that replace strong functional form assumptions in models with more plausible conditions such as monotonicity, thereby facilitating the development of more robust empirical results.

10.1257/aer.98.2.559.abstractZh: 苏珊·艾赛是一位应用理论家，她在经济理论、实证经济学和计量经济学领域做出了重要贡献。她构建了一个研究项目，专注于利用理论来理解实质性的经济问题，尤其是在产业组织领域。她开发了工具和技术，为基于扎实经济理论的实证研究提供了基础。她在开发和应用能够替代模型中强功能形式假设的工具方面取得了特别重要的进展，这些工具能够采用更合理的条件，如单调性，从而有助于得出更稳健的实证结果。

abstract.text: An earlier study (Barro 2006) applied the Thomas A. Rietz (1988) insight on rare eco? nomic disasters to explain the equity premium and related asset-pricing puzzles. Key param? eters were the probability, p, of disaster and the distribution of disaster sizes, b. In the main analysis, p and the ?-distribution were assumed to be time invariant. An extension to time-vary? ing p is in Xavier Gabaix (2008). Because large macroeconomic disasters are rare, pinning down p and the ?-distribution from historical data requires long time series for many countries, along with the assumption of rough parameter stability over time and across countries. Barro (2006) relied on the long-term international GDP data for 35 countries from Angus Maddison (2003). Using the definition of an economic disaster as a peak-to-trough fall in per capita GDP by at least 15 percent, 60 disas? ters were found, corresponding to p ?* 0.017 per year. The average disaster size was 29 percent, and the empirical size distribution was used to calibrate a model of asset pricing. The underlying asset-pricing theory relates to consumption, C, rather than GDP. This distinc? tion is especially important for wars. For exam? ple, in the United Kingdom during the two world wars, GDP increased while C fell sharply?the difference representing mostly added military spending. Maddison (2003) provides national-accounts information only for GDP. Our initial idea was to add consumption, C, which we measure by personal consumer expenditure because of diffi? culties in separating durables from nondurables in the long-term data. We have not assembled data on government consumption, some of which may substitute for C and, thereby, affect asset pricing. However, this substitution is prob? ably unimportant for military outlays, which are the type of government spending that moves a lot during some disaster events. Maddison (2003) represents a monumental contribution for international studies using long term GDP data. However, although much of the information is sound, close examination revealed many problems. Specifically, Maddison tends to fill in missing data with doubtful assumptions, and this practice is often significant for major crises. As examples, Maddison assumed that Belgium's GDP during WWI and WWII moved with France's; that Mexico's GDP between 1910 and 1920, including the Revolution and Civil War, followed a smooth trend (with no crisis); that GDP for Colombia and Peru over more than a decade moved with the average of Brazil and Chile; and that GDP in Germany for the crucial years 1944-1946 followed a linear trend. There are also some mismatches between original works and published series for GDP in Japan at the end of WWII and Greece during WWII and its Civil War. Given these difficulties, our project expanded to estimating long-term GDP for many countries. The Maddison informa? tion was often usable, but superior estimates can be constructed in many cases. Also, results from recent major long-term national-accounts projects for some countries are now available, including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Greece, Norway, Spain, Sweden, and Taiwan. We are dealing with long-term national accounts data for 41 countries, but the current study applies to the 21 for which we have, thus far, assembled annual data on C and GDP from before WWI to 2006. (See Table 1 for a list of included countries and starting years.) We begin + Discussant: John Campbell, Harvard University.

10.1257/aer.98.2.58.abstractZh: 先前的一项研究（Barro 2006）借鉴了Thomas A. Rietz（1988）关于罕见经济灾难的见解，用以解释股权溢价及相关资产定价问题。关键参数包括灾难发生的概率p以及灾难规模的分布b。在主要分析中，假设p和b的分布是时间不变的。Xavier Gabaix（2008）对时间变化的p进行了扩展研究。由于大型宏观经济灾难极为罕见，从历史数据中确定p和b的分布需要许多国家拥有长期的数据序列，并且需要假设参数在时间和国家之间具有相对稳定的特性。Barro（2006）依赖于Angus Maddison（2003）提供的35个国家的长期国际GDP数据。根据经济灾难的定义，即人均GDP从峰值下降到谷值至少15%，共发现了60次灾难，对应的灾难发生概率为每年0.017。平均灾难规模为29%，而实证规模分布被用来校准资产定价模型。基础资产定价理论与消费C而非GDP相关。这一区别对于战争尤其重要。例如，在两次世界大战期间，英国的GDP有所增长，而消费却大幅下降——这主要是由于军事支出的增加。Maddison（2003）仅提供了GDP的国家账户信息。我们最初的想法是加入消费C这一指标，我们通过个人消费支出来衡量消费，因为长期数据中难以区分耐用品和非耐用品。我们尚未收集政府消费的数据，其中一些数据可能会替代C，从而影响资产定价。然而，这种替代现象是值得考虑的。对于军事开支来说，这些政府支出在某些灾难事件中会大幅波动。Maddison（2003）利用长期GDP数据为国际研究做出了重大贡献。然而，尽管大部分信息都是可靠的，但仔细审查后发现存在许多问题。具体来说，Maddison倾向于用可疑的假设来填补缺失的数据，这种做法在重大危机期间尤为明显。例如，Maddison假设比利时的GDP在第一次世界大战和第二次世界大战期间与法国的GDP同步变化；墨西哥在1910年至1920年间的GDP，包括革命和内战期间，呈平稳趋势（没有危机）；哥伦比亚和秘鲁的GDP在十多年间与巴西和智利的GDP同步变化；德国在1944-1946年的GDP则呈线性趋势。此外，日本在二战结束时的GDP与希腊在二战及其内战期间的GDP之间也存在一些不匹配。鉴于这些困难，我们的项目扩展到了对许多国家的长期GDP进行估算。Maddison的信息通常是可以使用的，但在许多情况下可以构建更精确的估算结果。此外，一些国家的最新长期国民账户项目的结果现已可用，包括阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、希腊、挪威、西班牙、瑞典和台湾。我们正在处理41个国家的长期国民账户数据，但当前的研究适用于我们目前拥有年度数据的21个国家，这些数据涵盖了从第一次世界大战之前到2006年的C和GDP数据。（详见表1，列出包含的国家和起始年份。）我们由哈佛大学的John Campbell担任讨论嘉宾。

abstract.text: Twenty years ago, Thomas A. Rietz (1988) showed that infrequent, large drops in consumption make the theoretical equity premium large. Recent research has resurrected this ‘disaster’explanation of the equity premium puzzle. Robert J. Barro (2006) measures disasters during the XXth century, and …nds that they are frequent and large enough, and stock returns low enough relative to bond returns during disasters, to make this explanation quantitatively plausible. Xavier Gabaix (2007) extends the model to incorporate a time-varying incidence of disasters, and he argues that this simple feature can resolve many asset pricing puzzles. These papers make the simplifying assumption that disasters are permanent. Mathematically, they model log consumption per capita as the sum of a unit root process and a Poisson jump. However a casual look at the data suggests that disasters are often followed by recoveries. The …rst contribution of this paper is to measure recoveries (Section I) and introduce recoveries in the Barro-Rietz model (Section II). I …nd that the e¤ect of recoveries hinges on the intertemporal elasticity of substitution (IES): when the IES is low, recoveries may increase the equity premium implied by the model; but when it is high, the opposite happens. Empirical research in …nance documents that stock returns and excess stock returns are forecastable.

10.1257/aer.98.2.68.abstractZh: 二十年前，托马斯·A·里茨（1988年）指出，消费量的低频、大幅度下降会导致理论上的股权溢价变得较大。最近的研究重新提出了这种“灾难性解释”来解析股权溢价之谜。罗伯特·J·巴罗（2006年）对20世纪期间的灾难进行了研究，并发现这些灾难既频繁又严重，且在灾难期间股票回报相对于债券回报而言较低，这使得这种解释在数量上具有合理性。泽维尔·加巴克斯（2007年）将模型扩展为包含随时间变化的灾难发生率，他认为这一简单特征可以解决许多资产定价问题。这些论文都假设灾难是永久性的。从数学角度来看，他们将人均消费的对数模型描述为单位根过程与泊松跳跃之和。然而，对数据的观察表明，灾难之后往往会有恢复期。本文的第一个贡献是测量恢复期的影响（第一节），并在巴罗-里茨模型中引入恢复因素（第二节）。我发现，恢复期的影响取决于跨期替代弹性：当替代弹性较低时，恢复期可能会增加模型所暗示的股权溢价；而当替代弹性较高时，情况则相反。金融领域的实证研究表明，股票回报和超额股票回报是可以预测的。

abstract.text: The combination of power utility and i.i.d. lognormal consumption growth makes for a benchmark model in which asset prices and expected returns can be found in closed form. Introducing the consumption-based model, John H. Cochrane (2005, 12) writes, “The combination of lognormal distributions and power utility is one of the basic tricks to getting analytical solutions in this kind of model.” A message of this paper is that the lognormality assumption can be relaxed without sacrificing tractability. Working under two assumptions—that there is a representative agent with power utility and that consumption growth is i.i.d.—I introduce, in Section I, a mathematical object (the cumulantgenerating function, or CGF) in terms of which four fundamental quantities that are at the heart of consumption-based asset pricing can be simply expressed. Those quantities are the equity premium, riskless rate, consumption-wealth ratio, and mean consumption growth. The expressions derived relate the fundamentals directly to the cumulants (equivalently, moments) of consumption growth. The lognormal assumption is equivalent to the assumption that all cumulants above the second are zero. If one is in the business of making up stochastic processes, many suggest themselves most naturally in continuous time. Although there is an obvious discrete-time analogue of Brownian motion—a random walk with Normally distributed increments—it is less natural to map Poisson processes, say, into discrete time, and therefore harder to deal with the possibility of jumps in consumption. In Section II, I show that these results carry over to the continuous-time setting. The i.i.d. growth assumption is replaced by its continuous-time analogue: log consumption is a Levy process. Disasters and the Welfare Cost of Uncertainty

10.1257/aer.98.2.74.abstractZh: 功率效用与独立同分布的对数正态消费增长相结合，构成了一个基准模型，在该模型中，资产价格和预期回报可以以封闭形式得到。约翰·H·科克伦在2005年的文章中写道：“对数正态分布与功率效用的结合是这类模型获得解析解的基本技巧之一。”本文的核心理念是，可以放宽对数正态性假设，而不牺牲模型的易处理性。在两种假设下工作——即存在一个具有功率效用的代表性代理人，以及消费增长是独立同分布的——我在第一节中引入了一个数学对象（累积生成函数），通过这个对象可以简洁地表达四个核心变量，这些变量是消费基础资产定价的关键要素。这些变量包括股权溢价、无风险利率、消费与财富比率以及平均消费增长。所推导出的表达式将这些基本变量直接与消费增长的累积量（即矩）联系起来。对数正态假设等同于所有高于二阶的累积量为零的假设。如果人们致力于构建随机过程，那么在连续时间中自然选择的是泊松过程。尽管布朗运动在离散时间中有一个明显的类似物——一种具有正态分布增量的随机游走——但将泊松过程映射到离散时间则较为困难，因此难以处理消费中的跳跃现象。在第二节中，我展示了这些结果也适用于连续时间环境。独立同分布的增长假设被其连续时间类比所替代：对数消费是一个Levy过程。不确定性带来的灾难与福利成本

abstract.text: Methodology Appendix to Burman, Geissler, and Toder, "How Big are Total Individual Income Tax Expenditures and who Benefits from them?"We used the Tax Policy Center (TPC) microsimulation model to estimate tax expenditures and distributional effects.The model calculates tax liabilities for a weighted sample of individual income tax returns and can be used to analyze current law as well as alternative policies that change the tax code, including tax rates, the AMT, exemptions, deductions, and credits.It is based on the 2001 Public Use File (PUF) produced by the Statistics of Income Division (SOI) of the IRS.The PUF includes sample weights that can be used to produce population estimates.The PUF and sample weights are extrapolated to later years based on more recent SOI published data and Congressional Budget Office (CBO) economic projections, and imputations from other data sources of items not reported on tax returns.The model assumes that, conditional on income, deductions, family status, etc., individuals legally minimize their tax owed (for example, by correctly deciding whether to itemize deductions), but it does not incorporate any other types of behavioral responses, such as changes in labor supply, investment or consumption patterns in response to tax incentives.

10.1257/aer.98.2.79.abstractZh: Burman、Geissler和Toder的论文《个人所得税总支出有多大？谁从中受益？》的方法论附录。我们采用了税务政策中心（TPC）的微观模拟模型来估算税收支出及其分配效应。该模型针对加权样本的个人所得税申报表计算税收责任，可用于分析现行法律以及改变税法政策的替代方案，包括税率、AMT、免税项目、扣除项和抵免项。该模型基于美国国税局收入统计部门在2001年制作的公共使用文件（PUF）。PUF中包含可用于生成人口估计的样本权重。PUF和样本权重是根据更近期的SOI发布数据和国会预算办公室（CBO）的经济预测，以及从其他数据来源对税务申报表中未报告的項目进行估算后，推算到后续年份的。该模型假设，在收入、扣除项、家庭状况等条件既定的情况下，个人会合法地最小化其应缴税款（例如，通过正确决定是否逐项扣除），但并未纳入其他类型的行为反应，如劳动供应、投资或消费模式因税收激励而产生的变化。

abstract.text: Federal income tax policy affects the cost of homeownership for many households.Popular discussions of the favorable tax treatment of owner-occupied housing usually focus on the tax-deductibility of mortgage interest and property tax payments, as well as the specialized tax rules that affect housing capital gains.Academic discussions, in contrast, emphasize the exclusion of the imputed rental income on owner-occupied housing as the key tax benefit for homeowners.This paper summarizes the current distribution of the tax benefits associated with the mortgage interest and property tax deductions.It contrasts this with the distribution of tax benefits associated with the current tax regime for imputed rental income relative to one that taxes homeowners as if they were landlords.It also reports how removing either deduction, or taxing homeowners as landlords, would affect the user cost of owner-occupied housing. I. Patterns of Homeownership, Mortgage Borrowing, and Itemization StatusVariation across age and income groups in the tax savings associated with the mortgage interest and property tax deductions results primarily from differences in homeownership rates, itemization rates, and the financing of homes.We illustrate these differences using the sample of nonfarm households in the 2004 Survey of Consumer Finances (SCF).The SCF

10.1257/aer.98.2.84.abstractZh: 联邦所得税政策影响着许多家庭的住房拥有成本。关于自有住房享有优惠税收待遇的普遍讨论，通常集中在抵押贷款利息和财产税支出的税收减免，以及影响住房资本收益的专门税收规则上。相比之下，学术讨论则强调将自有住房的估算租金收入排除在外，作为房主的主要税收优惠。本文总结了与抵押贷款利息和财产税减免相关的税收优惠的当前分配情况。同时，将这种分配与将房主视为房东的现行税收制度下的税收优惠进行了对比。文章还报告了取消其中任何一种减免措施，或将房主视为房东进行征税，将如何影响自有住房的使用成本。I. 住房拥有情况、抵押贷款和分项抵扣状态在抵押贷款利息和财产税减免带来的税收节省方面，不同年龄和收入群体的差异主要源于住房拥有率、分项抵扣率以及房屋融资方式的不同。我们借助2004年消费者金融调查中的非农业家庭样本来说明这些差异。

abstract.text: Erich Muehlegger, Curtis Carlson, and Jay Mackie, provided helpful comments on a preliminary draft. The views expressed herein are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Bureau of Economic Research. NBER working papers are circulated for discussion and comment purposes. They have not been peer-reviewed or been subject to the review by the NBER Board of Directors that accompanies official NBER publications.

10.1257/aer.98.2.90.abstractZh: Erich Muehlegger、Curtis Carlson和Jay Mackie对初稿提出了有益的评论。文中表达的观点仅代表作者个人意见，并不一定反映美国国家经济研究局的观点。NBER工作论文的发布旨在供讨论和评论，这些论文并未经过同行评审，也没有经过NBER董事会的审核，这与正式发布的NBER出版物有所不同。

abstract.text: A large research program in economics has established a persuasive link between institu-tions and economic development. But what does this imply for development policymaking? Can a political leader or aid agency seeking to pro-mote development readily change institutions? This article starts off wildly general, and then moves to specifics. I. The Intellectual History of the World, Part I Every once in a while, it is worthwhile for economists to look up from the details of their specialized research projects to the broader worldview that their research results fit or do not fit. Nowhere is this truer than in the field of institutional economics, which can hardly avoid the big picture as it seeks to understand the determinants of institutions and make policy recommendations about changing them. Two contrasting worldviews coexist in insti-tutional economics, which go all the way back to the eighteenth-century Enlightenment. Let us label these views “top down ” versus “bottom up.” The top down view of institutions sees them as determined by laws written by political leaders Design anD RefoRm of institutions in LDCs anD tRansition eConomies †

10.1257/aer.98.2.95.abstractZh: 在经济学领域，一项大型研究项目已经证明了制度与经济发展之间存在密切的联系。但这对发展政策制定意味着什么呢？一个寻求促进发展的政治领袖或援助机构能否轻易改变制度？本文从宏观角度入手，然后逐步深入到具体细节。第一部分：世界思想史。偶尔，经济学家需要从他们专业研究项目的细节中抽身出来，审视他们的研究成果是否适合或不符合更广阔的视野。在制度经济学领域，这一点尤为明显，因为该领域在试图理解制度的决定因素并提出政策建议以改变制度时，不可避免地需要关注整体格局。在制度经济学中，存在着两种截然不同的世界观，这两种世界观可以追溯到18世纪的启蒙时代。我们将这两种观点分别称为“自上而下”和“自下而上”。自上而下的观点认为，制度是由政治领袖制定的法律所决定的。

abstract.text: This laboratory experiment explores the extent to which impersonal exchange emerges from personal exchange with opportunities for long-distance trade. We design a three-commodity production and exchange economy in which agents in three geographically separated villages must develop multilateral exchange networks to import a good only available abroad. For treatments, we induce two distinct institutional histories to investigate how past experience with property rights affects the evolution of specialization and exchange. We find that a history of unenforced property rights hinders our subjects' ability to develop the requisite personal social arrangements to support specialization and effectively exploit impersonal long-distance trade. (JEL C90, D23, D51, P14)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1009.abstractZh: 这项实验室实验探讨了非个人交换在个人交换的基础上，通过远程贸易机会而出现的程度。我们设计了一个由三种商品构成的生产与交换经济模型，其中三个地理位置分散的村庄中的个体必须发展多边交换网络，以进口国外才有的商品。为了研究不同制度历史对专业化与交换演变的影响，我们设置了两种不同的制度历史情境。研究发现，未强制实施财产权的历史会阻碍实验对象发展必要的个人社会安排，以支持专业化并有效利用非个人的远程贸易。（JEL C90, D23, D51, P14）

abstract.text: Policymakers often prescribe that microfinance institutions increase interest rates to eliminate their reliance on subsidies. This strategy makes sense if the poor are rate insensitive: then microlenders increase profitability (or achieve sustainability) without reducing the poor's access to credit. We test the assumption of price inelastic demand using randomized trials conducted by a consumer lender in South Africa. The demand curves are downward sloping, and steeper for price increases relative to the lender's standard rates. We also find that loan size is far more responsive to changes in loan maturity than to changes in interest rates, which is consistent with binding liquidity constraints. (JEL G21, O16)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1040.abstractZh: 政策制定者通常建议小额信贷机构提高利率，以减少对补贴的依赖。如果贫困人群对利率不敏感，这一策略是有意义的：这样小额信贷机构可以提高盈利能力（或实现可持续性），同时不减少贫困人群获得信贷的机会。我们通过南非一家消费贷款机构进行的随机试验来检验需求无弹性的假设。需求曲线呈下降趋势，且价格上升对利润的影响比贷款机构的标准利率更为显著。我们还发现，贷款规模对贷款期限变化的反应远大于对利率变化的反应，这与流动性约束的存在是一致的。（JEL G21, O16）

abstract.text: I develop a model of daily labor supply where preferences are dependent on a reference daily income level, and I apply this model to data on the labor supply of New York City taxi drivers. I find that there may be a reference level of income on a given day that affects labor supply. However, there is substantial day-to-day variation in a given driver's reference level, and most shifts end before reaching the reference income level. This pattern is inconsistent with an important role for reference-dependent preferences. (JEL J22, L92)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1069.abstractZh: 我开发了一个日常劳动力供给模型，其中偏好取决于一个参考日常收入水平。我将这个模型应用于纽约市出租车司机劳动力供给的数据分析。我发现，在特定的日子里，可能存在一个影响劳动力供给的参考收入水平。然而，每个司机在参考收入水平上的日变化幅度很大，大多数工作班次在达到参考收入水平之前就结束了。这种模式与依赖参考水平的偏好所起的重要作用不符。（JEL J22, L92）

abstract.text: We show that even incomplete public insurance can crowd out private insurance demand. We estimate that Medicaid could explain the lack of private long-term care insurance for about two-thirds of the wealth distribution, even if no other factors limited the market's size. Yet Medicaid provides incomplete consumption smoothing for most individuals. Medicaid's crowd-out effect stems from the large implicit tax (about 60–75 percent for a median-wealth individual) that Medicaid imposes on private insurance. An implication is that public policies designed to stimulate the private insurance market will have limited efficacy as long as Medicaid's large implicit tax remains. (JEL G22, I18, I38)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1083.abstractZh: 我们表明，即使是不完全的公共保险也能挤出私人保险需求。我们估计，即使没有其他因素限制市场规模，Medicaid也能解释大约三分之二的财富分布中缺乏私人长期护理保险的现象。然而，Medicaid为大多数个体提供了不完整的消费平滑性。Medicaid的挤出效应源于其对私人保险施加的巨额隐性税收（对于财富中位数个体而言，约为60-75%）。这意味着，只要Medicaid的巨额隐性税收仍然存在，旨在刺激私人保险市场的公共政策将具有有限的效力。（JEL G22, I18, I38）

abstract.text: We estimate the willingness to pay for reductions in crime risk using the location and move-in dates of sex offenders. We find significant effects of sex offenders' locations that are geographically localized. House prices within 0.1 miles of a sex offender fall by 4 percent on average. We then use this finding to estimate the costs to victims of sexual offenses, and find costs of over $1 million per victim—far greater than previous estimates. However, we cannot reject the alternative hypotheses that individuals overestimate risks posed by offenders or that living near an offender poses significant costs exclusive of crime risk. (JEL K42, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1103.abstractZh: 我们通过调查性犯罪者的居住地点和入住日期，来估算人们愿意为降低犯罪风险所支付的代价。我们发现，性犯罪者的居住地点具有显著的地理分布特征。距离性犯罪者0.1英里范围内的房价平均下降4%。随后，我们利用这一发现来估算性犯罪对受害者造成的成本，结果发现，每个受害者的损失超过100万美元——这一数字远高于之前的估计。然而，我们无法排除另一种假设，即个人可能高估了犯罪者带来的风险，或者居住在犯罪者附近确实会带来额外的成本，这些成本不包括犯罪风险本身。（JEL K42, R23, R31）

abstract.text: A well-known theorem by Herfindahl states that the low-cost nonrenewable resource must be exploited first. Consider resources that are differentiated only by their pollution content. For instance, both coal and natural gas are used to generate electricity, yet coal is more polluting. We show that the ordering of extraction need not be driven by whether a resource is clean or dirty. Coal may be used first, followed by natural gas, and again by coal. Such “vacillation” does not occur under cost heterogeneity. A perverse policy implication is that regulating pollution may accelerate use of the polluting resource. (JEL Q32, Q38, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1128.abstractZh: Herfindahl提出的一个著名定理指出，低成本的不可再生资源必须首先被开发利用。考虑那些仅以污染程度来区分的资源。例如，煤炭和天然气都可用于发电，但煤炭的污染程度更高。我们的研究表明，资源的开发顺序并不一定取决于其清洁程度。煤炭可以优先使用，接着是天然气，然后再使用煤炭。在成本异质性的情况下，这种“犹豫不决”的情况不会发生。一个反常的政策启示是，对污染的监管可能会加速污染资源的利用。（JEL Q32, Q38, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: Decision makers tend to exhibit a higher degree of impatience when considering a delay to an immediate reward than when contemplating an identical delay to an equal future reward. This work argues that diminishing impatience originates from the distinction between the certain present and the risky future. A simple functional representation of preferences, exhibiting time inconsistency when the future is uncertain, is derived. Experimental evidence, which is inconsistent with other formulations that account for diminishing impatience, supports the proposed approach. The new theory uncovers a tight relation between diminishing impatience and well-known behavioral regularities in choice under risk and uncertainty. (JEL D12, D81)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1145.abstractZh: 决策者在考虑延迟获得即时回报时，往往表现出比考虑同等延迟但未来获得同等回报时更高的不耐烦程度。本研究认为，不耐烦程度的降低源于对确定性的当下与风险性未来的区分。文中推导出一种简单的偏好函数表示方式，该表示方式在未来不确定的情况下表现出时间不一致性。实验证据与其他解释不耐烦程度降低的理论观点并不一致，但支持了这一理论方法。新理论揭示了不耐烦程度的降低与在风险和不确定性下的选择中常见的行为规律之间的紧密关系。（JEL D12, D81）

abstract.text: We study how the use of judgment or “add-factors” in macroeconomic forecasting may disturb the set of equilibrium outcomes when agents learn using recursive methods. We examine the possibility of a new phenomenon, which we call exuberance equilibria, in the New Keynesian monetary policy framework. Inclusion of judgment in forecasts can lead to self-fulfilling fluctuations in a subset of the determinacy region. We study how policymakers can minimize the risk of exuberance equilibria. (JEL E17, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1163.abstractZh: 我们研究了在宏观经济预测中运用判断或“附加因素”如何影响均衡结果的设定，特别是当代理人使用递归方法进行学习时。我们探讨了在新凯恩斯主义货币政策框架中可能出现的一种新现象，称之为“繁荣均衡”。在预测中引入判断可能导致确定性区域的一部分出现自我实现的波动。我们研究了政策制定者如何最小化繁荣均衡的风险。（JEL E17, E31, E52）

abstract.text: We reexamine Alan R. Rogers' (1994) analysis of the biological basis of the rate of time preference. Although his basic insight concerning the derivation of the utility function holds up, the functional form he uses does not generate equilibrium evolutionary behavior. Moreover, Rogers relies upon an interior solution for a particular kind of intergenerational transfer. We show such interior solutions need not generally arise. Hence Rogers most striking prediction, namely that the real interest rate should be about 2 percent per annum, does not follow. (JEL D11, D91)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1178.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了Alan R. Rogers在1994年对时间偏好率生物学基础的分析。尽管他关于效用函数推导的基本见解仍然成立，但他所使用的函数形式并不能产生均衡的进化行为。此外，Rogers依赖于一种特定类型的代际转移的内部解。我们表明，这种内部解通常是不必要的。因此，Rogers最引人注目的预测——即实际利率应约为每年2%——并不成立。（JEL D11, D91）

abstract.text: Hatfield and Milgrom (2005) present a unified model of matching with contracts phrased in terms of hospitals and doctors, which subsumes the standard two-sided matching and some package auction models. They show that a stable allocation exists if contracts are substitutes for each hospital. They further claim that if a hospital's preferences violate the substitutes condition, there exist singleton preferences for the other hospitals and doctors such that no stable allocation exists. We show this last claim does not hold in general. We further present a weaker condition that is necessary to guarantee the existence of stable allocations. (JEL C78, D86, J41)

10.1257/aer.98.3.1189.abstractZh: Hatfield和Milgrom在2005年提出了一个统一的匹配与合同模型，该模型以医院和医生为对象，涵盖了标准的双边匹配以及一些包销拍卖模型。他们指出，如果各医院的合同可以相互替代，那么就会存在稳定的分配方案。他们还提出，如果某家医院的偏好违反了替代条件，那么其他医院和医生的偏好就会形成单一偏好，从而无法形成稳定的分配方案。我们证明这一结论并不普遍成立。此外，我们还提出了一种更弱的条件，这个条件对于保证稳定分配方案的存在是必要的。（JEL C78, D86, J41）

abstract.text: The equations on page 153 of “When Does Coordination Require Centralization?,” which appeared in the March 2008 issue of the American Economic Review, failed to print in their entirety. The complete text of Section III, Decision Making, appears below.

10.1257/aer.98.3.1195.abstractZh: 发表于2008年3月《美国经济评论》上的论文《何时需要中央集权？》第153页的方程式未能完整打印。第三部分的完整内容如下：决策制定。

abstract.text: Eric S. Maskin delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2007 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University. He was introduced by Professor Jorgen Weibull, Chairman of the Economics Prize Committee.

10.1257/aer.98.3.567.abstractZh: 埃里克·S·马斯金于2007年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。他的演讲由经济学奖委员会主席约根·韦布尔教授主持。

abstract.text: A pre-recorded version of Leonid Hurwicz' Prize Lecture was presented on 8 December 2007 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University. The lecture was introduced by Professor Jorgen Weibull, Chairman of the Economics Prize Committee.

10.1257/aer.98.3.577.abstractZh: 2007年12月8日，Leonid Hurwicz奖讲座的录像版本在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂举行。讲座由经济学奖委员会主席Jorgen Weibull教授主持开幕。

abstract.text: Economics began with Xenophon=s AOeconomicus @ (c 360 BCE), in which Socrates interviews a model citizen who has two primary concerns. He goes out to his farm in the country to monitor and motivate his workers there. Then he goes back to the city, where his participation in various political institutions is essential for maintaining his rights to own this farm. Such concerns about agents ' incentives and political institutions are also central in economic theory today. But they were not always. Two centuries ago, economics developed as an analytical social science by focusing on production and allocation of material goods, developing methodologies of national-income accounting and price theory. Questions about resource allocation seemed particularly amenable to mathematical analysis, because flows of goods and money are measurable and should satisfy flow-balance equations and no-arbitrage conditions. From this perspective, the classical economic problem was that people's ability to satisfy their desires is constrained by limited resources. The classical economic result was that unrestricted free trade can achieve allocative efficiency, in the sense that reallocating the available resources cannot improve everyone's welfare.

10.1257/aer.98.3.586.abstractZh: 经济学起源于色诺芬的《经济人》（约公元前360年），其中苏格拉底采访了一位模范公民，这位公民有两个主要关切点。他前往乡下的农场，监督并激励那里的工人。之后，他回到城市，参与各种政治机构对于维护他拥有该农场的权利至关重要。关于代理人的激励和政治机构的这些关切，在当今的经济理论中同样占据核心地位。但情况并非一直如此。两个世纪前，经济学作为一门分析性社会科学发展起来，专注于物质商品的生产与分配，并发展出了国民收入核算和价格理论的方法论。关于资源分配的问题似乎特别适合数学分析，因为商品和货币的流动是可以测量的，并且应满足流量平衡方程和无套利条件。从这个角度来看，古典经济问题的核心是人们满足欲望的能力受到有限资源的限制。古典经济学的结论是，无限制的自由贸易可以实现资源配置效率，即重新分配可用资源不会提高每个人的福利。

abstract.text: We investigate the sources of the important shifts in the volatility of US macroeconomic variables in the postwar period. To this end, we propose the estimation of DSGE models allowing for time variation in the volatility of the structural innovations. We apply our estimation strategy to a large-scale model of the business cycle and find that shocks specific to the equilibrium condition of investment account for most of the sharp decline in volatility of the last two decades. (JEL C51, E32)

10.1257/aer.98.3.604.abstractZh: 我们研究了战后时期美国宏观经济变量波动性重大变化的来源。为此，我们提出了一种能够考虑结构性创新波动性随时间变化的DSGE模型估计方法。我们将这一估计策略应用于一个大规模的商业周期模型，发现特定于投资均衡条件的冲击在过去二十年波动性急剧下降中起到了重要作用。（JEL C51, E32）

abstract.text: This paper presents an assignment model of CEOs and firms. The distributions of CEO pay levels and firms' market values are analyzed as the competitive equilibrium of a matching market where talents, as well as CEO positions, are scarce. It is shown how the observed joint distribution of CEO pay and market value can then be used to infer the economic value of underlying ability differences. The variation in CEO pay is found to be mostly due to variation in firm characteristics, whereas implied differences in managerial ability are small and make relatively little difference to shareholder value.
