(JEL G32, M12, M52)

10.1257/aer.98.3.642.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于CEO与公司之间的任务模型。通过分析CEO薪酬水平与公司市值分布，研究了在人才和CEO职位都稀缺的匹配市场中，竞争均衡的形成过程。研究表明，观察到的CEO薪酬与市值之间的联合分布可以用来推断潜在能力差异所带来的经济价值。CEO薪酬的差异主要源于公司特征的变化，而管理能力上的差异则相对较小，对股东价值的影响也较小。（JEL G32, M12, M52）

abstract.text: In several school choice districts in the United States, the student proposing deferred acceptance algorithm is applied after indifferences in priority orders are broken in some exogenous way. Although such a tie-breaking procedure preserves stability, it adversely affects the welfare of the students since it introduces artificial stability constraints. Our main finding is a polynomial-time algorithm for the computation of a student-optimal stable matching when priorities are weak. The idea behind our construction relies on a new notion which we call a stable improvement cycle. We also investigate the strategic properties of the student-optimal stable mechanism. (JEL C78, D82, I21)

10.1257/aer.98.3.669.abstractZh: 在美国的多个学校选择区域，当某些外部因素导致优先级顺序出现平局时，会采用学生延迟接受算法来打破这种平局。尽管这种平局解决方式能够保持系统的稳定性，但它会对学生的福利产生负面影响，因为它引入了人为的稳定约束。我们的主要发现是一种多项式时间算法，用于计算在优先级较弱情况下的学生最优稳定匹配。我们的算法基于一个新概念，我们称之为“稳定改进循环”。我们还研究了学生最优稳定机制的战略特性。（JEL C78, D82, I21）

abstract.text: Recent sovereign defaults are accompanied by interest rate spikes and deep recessions. This paper develops a small open economy model to study default risk and its interaction with output and foreign debt. Default probabilities and interest rates depend on incentives for repayment. Default is more likely in recessions because this is when it is more costly for a risk averse borrower to repay noncontingent debt. The model closely matches business cycles in Argentina predicting high volatility of interest rates, higher volatility of consumption relative to output, and negative correlations of output with interest rates and the trade balance. (JEL E21, E23, E32, E43, F34, O11, O19)

10.1257/aer.98.3.690.abstractZh: 近期的主权违约伴随着利率飙升和严重的经济衰退。本文建立了一个小型开放经济模型，用于研究违约风险及其与产出和外债之间的相互作用。违约概率和利率取决于还款的激励因素。在经济衰退期间，违约的可能性更高，因为对于厌恶风险的借款人来说，偿还非固定债务的成本更高。该模型与阿根廷的经济周期高度吻合，预测利率的波动性较大，消费相对于产出的波动性也较高，同时产出与利率以及贸易平衡之间存在负相关关系。（JEL E21, E23, E32, E43, F34, O11, O19）

abstract.text: We use data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics to investigate how households' portfolio allocations change in response to wealth fluctuations. Persistent habits, consumption commitments, and subsistence levels can generate time-varying risk aversion with the consequence that when the level of liquid wealth changes, the proportion a household invests in risky assets should also change in the same direction. In contrast, our analysis shows that the share of liquid assets that households invest in risky assets is not affected by wealth changes. Instead, one of the major drivers of household portfolio allocation seems to be inertia: households rebalance only very slowly following inflows and outflows or capital gains and losses. (JEL D14, D31)

10.1257/aer.98.3.713.abstractZh: 我们利用收入动态面板研究的数据来探讨家庭投资组合配置如何随着财富波动而变化。持久的习惯、消费承诺和生存水平可能会导致风险厌恶随时间变化，因此当流动资产水平发生变化时，家庭在风险资产上的投资比例也应随之改变。相反，我们的分析表明，家庭在风险资产上的流动资产比例并不受财富变化的影响。相反，家庭投资组合配置的主要驱动因素之一似乎是惯性：家庭在资金流入、流出或资本损益发生后的重新平衡过程非常缓慢。（JEL D14, D31）

abstract.text: The intertemporal elasticity of investment for long-lived capital goods is nearly infinite. Consequently, investment prices should fully reflect temporary tax subsidies, regardless of the investment supply elasticity. Since prices move one-for-one with the subsidy, elasticities can be inferred from quantities alone. This paper uses a recent tax policy—bonus depreciation—to estimate the investment supply elasticity. Investment in qualified capital increased sharply. The estimated elasticity is high—between 6 and 14. There is no evidence that market prices reacted to the subsidy, suggesting that adjustment costs are internal, or that measurement error masks the price changes. (JEL G31, H32)

10.1257/aer.98.3.737.abstractZh: 长期资本货物的投资跨时弹性几乎无限。因此，投资价格应完全反映临时性的税收补贴，而不受投资供应弹性的影响。由于价格与补贴成正比变动，因此可以通过数量来推断弹性。本文采用了一项最新的税收政策——奖励性折旧，来估算投资供应弹性。符合条件的资本投资显著增加。估算出的弹性较高，介于6到14之间。没有证据表明市场价格对补贴有所反应，这表明调整成本是内部产生的，或者测量误差掩盖了价格变化。（JEL G31, H32）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes how US presidential candidates should allocate resources across states to maximize the probability of winning the election, by developing and estimating a probabilistic-voting model of political competition under the Electoral College system. Actual campaigns act in close agreement with the model. There is a 0.9 correlation between equilibrium and actual presidential campaign visits across states, both in 2000 and 2004. The paper shows how presidential candidate attention is affected by the states' number of electoral votes, forecasted state-election outcomes, and forecast uncertainty. It also analyzes the effects of a direct national popular vote for president. (JEL D72)

10.1257/aer.98.3.769.abstractZh: 本文分析了美国总统候选人应如何在不同州分配资源以最大化赢得选举的概率，通过开发并估计一个在选举人团制度下的政治竞争概率投票模型。实际竞选活动与模型结果高度一致。在2000年和2004年，均衡状态与实际总统竞选活动在各州的分布之间存在0.9的相关性。本文还探讨了总统候选人的关注程度如何受到各州选举人票数、预测中的州选举结果以及预测的不确定性影响。同时，文章还分析了直接通过全国普选产生总统的效果。（JEL D72）

abstract.text: Existing studies establish a strong cross-country correlation between income and democracy but do not control for factors that simultaneously affect both variables. We show that controlling for such factors by including country fixed effects removes the statistical association between income per capita and various measures of democracy. We present instrumental-variables estimates that also show no causal effect of income on democracy. The cross-country correlation between income and democracy reflects a positive correlation between changes in income and democracy over the past 500 years. This pattern is consistent with the idea that societies embarked on divergent political-economic development paths at certain critical junctures. (JEL D72, E21)

10.1257/aer.98.3.808.abstractZh: 现有研究证实了收入与民主之间存在强烈的跨国相关性，但这些研究并未考虑同时影响这两个变量的其他因素。我们发现，通过纳入国家固定效应来控制这些因素后，人均收入与各种民主指标之间的统计关联被消除。我们的工具变量估计也表明，收入对民主没有因果效应。收入与民主之间的跨国相关性反映了过去500年间收入变化与民主发展之间的正相关关系。这一模式与这样一种观点一致：社会在某些关键节点上走上了不同的政治-经济发展路径。（JEL D72, E21）

abstract.text: Charles Tiebout's suggestion that people “vote with their feet” for communities with optimal bundles of taxes and public goods has played a central role in local public finance for over 50 years. Using a locational equilibrium model, we derive formal tests of his premise. The model predicts increased population density in neighborhoods experiencing exogenous improvements in public goods and, for large improvements, increased relative mean incomes. We test these hypotheses in the context of changing air quality. Our results provide strong empirical support for the notion that households “vote with their feet” for environmental quality. (JEL H41, H73, Q53, R23)

10.1257/aer.98.3.843.abstractZh: 查尔斯·蒂布特提出的“人们会为了拥有最优税收和公共物品组合而选择居住地”的观点，在50多年的地方公共财政研究中发挥了重要作用。通过区位均衡模型，我们对其假设进行了形式化验证。该模型预测，在公共物品方面出现外部改善的社区，人口密度会上升，且对于较大的改善，相对平均收入也会增加。我们在空气质量变化的背景下对这些假设进行了测试。我们的研究结果为“家庭会根据环境质量选择居住地”这一观点提供了强有力的实证支持。（JEL H41, H73, Q53, R23）

abstract.text: We study information transmission via polling. A policymaker polls constituents, who differ in their information and ideology, to determine policy. Full revelation is an equilibrium in a poll with a small sample, but not with a large one. In large polls, full information aggregation can arise in an equilibrium where constituents endogenously sort themselves into centrists, who respond truthfully, and extremists, who do not. We find polling statistics that ignore strategic behavior yield biased estimators and mischaracterize the poll's margin of error. We construct estimators that account for strategic behavior. Finally, we compare polls and elections. (JEL C42, D83)

10.1257/aer.98.3.864.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过民意调查进行信息传递的过程。政策制定者会向选民进行调查，这些选民在信息和意识形态上存在差异。在样本较小的民意调查中，完全披露信息是一种均衡状态，但在样本较大的情况下则不是。在大规模的民意调查中，完全信息聚合可能出现在一种均衡状态下，即选民会自发分为中间派和极端派，中间派会如实回答，而极端派则不会。我们发现，忽略策略行为的民意调查统计数据会导致估计结果偏差，并错误反映民意调查的误差范围。我们构建了能够考虑策略行为的估计方法。最后，我们比较了民意调查和选举的结果。（JEL C42, D83）

abstract.text: This paper studies matching in vertical networks, generalizing the theory of matching in two-sided markets. It gives sufficient conditions for the existence of stable networks and presents an algorithm for finding two of them. One is the best stable network for the agents on the “upstream” end of an industry. The other is best for the agents on the “downstream” end. The paper describes several properties of the set of stable networks and discusses applications of the theory to the design of matching markets with more than two types of agents and to the empirical analysis of supply chains. (JEL C78, D85, L14) The woollen coat, for example, which covers the day-labourer, as coarse and rough as it may appear, is the produce of the joint labour of a great multitude of workmen. The shepherd, the sorter of the wool, the wool-comber or carder, the dyer, the scribbler, the spinner, the weaver, the fuller, the dresser, with many others, must all join their different arts in order to complete even this homely production. —Adam Smith (1776)

10.1257/aer.98.3.897.abstractZh: 本文研究了垂直网络中的匹配问题，将匹配理论推广到双边市场。文章给出了稳定网络存在的充分条件，并提出了一种算法来寻找其中两个稳定的网络。其中一个是行业“上游”端代理人的最佳稳定网络，另一个则是“下游”端代理人的最佳稳定网络。文章还描述了稳定网络集合的若干特性，并探讨了该理论在设计具有多种类型代理人的匹配市场以及供应链实证分析中的应用。（JEL C78, D85, L14）例如，覆盖日工的外套，尽管看起来粗糙且简陋，却是大量工人共同努力的成果。牧羊人、羊毛分拣工、羊毛梳理工、染色工、记录员、纺纱工、织布工、整饰工，以及其他许多人的共同努力，才使得这种简单的生产得以完成。——亚当·斯密（1776年）

abstract.text: We report 28 new experiment sessions consisting of up to three experience levels to examine the robustness of learning and “error” elimination among participants in a laboratory asset market and its effect on price bubbles. Our answer to the title question is: “yes.” We impose a large increase in liquidity and dividend uncertainty to shock the environment of experienced subjects who have converged to equilibrium, and this treatment rekindles a bubble. However, in replications of that same challenging environment across three experience levels, we discover that the environment yields a rare residual tendency to bubble even in the third experience session. Therefore, a caveat must be placed on the effect of twice-experienced subjects in asset markets: in order for price bubbles to be extinguished, the environment in which the participants engage in exchange must be stationary and bounded by a range of parameters. Experience, including possible “error” elimination, is not robust to major new environment changes in determining the characteristics of a price bubble. (JEL C91, D83)

10.1257/aer.98.3.924.abstractZh: 我们报告了28个新的实验环节，每个环节包含最多三个经验层次，以检验参与者在实验室资产市场中的学习能力和“错误”消除能力的稳健性，以及这种能力对价格泡沫的影响。我们对标题问题的答案是：“是”。我们通过大幅增加流动性及股息不确定性来冲击那些已经趋于均衡的成熟参与者的环境，这一处理方式重新引发了价格泡沫。然而，在将同一具有挑战性的环境进行三个不同经验层次重复实验的过程中，我们发现即使在第三个经验层次中，该环境仍表现出罕见的残余泡沫倾向。因此，对于在资产市场中具有双重经验背景的参与者来说，必须注意：为了消除价格泡沫，参与者进行交易的環境必须是稳定的，并且受到一定参数范围的约束。经验，包括可能的“错误”消除，对于价格泡沫特征的决定并不具有稳健性。（JEL C91, D83）

abstract.text: Five stationary concepts for completely mixed 2x2-games are experimentally compared: Nash equilibrium, quantal response equilibrium, action-sampling equilibrium, payoff-sampling equilibrium (Martin J. Osborne and Ariel Rubinstein 1998), and impulse balance equilibrium. Experiments on 12 games, 6 constant sum games, and 6 nonconstant sum games were run with 12 independent subject groups for each constant sum game and 6 independent subject groups for each nonconstant sum game. Each independent subject group consisted of four players 1 and four players 2, interacting anonymously over 200 periods with random matching. The comparison of the five theories shows that the order of performance from best to worst is as follows: impulse balance equilibrium, payoff-sampling equilibrium, action-sampling equilibrium, quantal response equilibrium, Nash equilibrium. (JEL C70, C91)

10.1257/aer.98.3.938.abstractZh: 对完全混合的2x2博弈的五个静态概念进行了实验比较：纳什均衡、量子响应均衡、动作采样均衡、收益采样均衡（Martin J. Osborne和Ariel Rubinstein，1998年），以及冲动平衡均衡。在12个博弈中进行实验，包括6个恒定和6个非恒定和博弈。每个恒定和博弈有12个独立被试组，每个非恒定和博弈有6个独立被试组。每个独立被试组由4名玩家1和4名玩家2组成，他们在200个周期内以随机匹配的方式匿名互动。对这五个理论的比较结果显示，性能从最好到最差的排序为：冲动平衡均衡、收益采样均衡、动作采样均衡、量子响应均衡、纳什均衡。（JEL C70, C91）

abstract.text: Trade and export, it is argued, spur economic growth. This paper studies the microeconomics of exporting. We build a heuristic model of transactions between exporters and producers and relate it to East India Company (EIC) operations in colonial Bengal. Our model and the historical record stress two difficulties: the exporter and its agents might not uphold payment agreements, and producers might not honor sales contracts. The model shows when procurement succeeds or fails, highlighting the tension between these two hold-up problems. We analyze several cases, including the EIC's cotton textile venture, the famous Opium Monopoly, and present-day contract farming. (JEL D86, F14, N55, N75)

10.1257/aer.98.3.967.abstractZh: 本文认为，贸易和出口能够促进经济增长。本文研究了出口的微观经济学现象。我们构建了一个关于出口商与生产者之间交易的启发式模型，并将其与东印度公司在殖民时期的孟加拉地区的经营活动进行了对比分析。我们的模型以及历史记录揭示了两个主要难题：出口商及其代理人可能不遵守支付协议，而生产者也可能不遵守销售合同。模型展示了采购成功或失败的情况，从而凸显了这两个违约问题之间的紧张关系。我们分析了多个案例，包括东印度公司的棉纺织企业、著名的鸦片垄断贸易以及现代的合同农业模式。（JEL D86, F14, N55, N75）

abstract.text: Desire for social esteem is a source of prosocial behavior. We develop a model in which actors' utility of esteem depends on the audience. In a principal-agent setting, we show that the model can account for motivational crowding out. Control systems and pecuniary incentives erode morale by signaling to the agent that the principal is not worth impressing. The model also offers an explanation for why agents are motivated by unconditionally high pay and by mission-oriented principals. (JEL D01, D82)

10.1257/aer.98.3.990.abstractZh: 对社会认可的渴望是亲社会行为的源泉。我们开发了一个模型，该模型中的行为者获得认可效用的程度取决于其受众。在主体-代理人框架下，我们证明了该模型能够解释动机的挤出现象。控制系统和金钱激励会通过向代理人传递“主体并不值得印象深刻”的信号来削弱其士气。该模型还解释了为什么行为者会受到无条件高报酬和以使命为导向的主体所激励的原因。（JEL D01, D82）

abstract.text: We provide a pricing theory for emerging asset classes, like emerging markets, that are not yet mature enough to be attractive to the general public. We show how leverage cycles can cause contagion, flight to collateral, and issuance rationing in a frequently recurring phase we call the anxious economy. Our model provides an explanation for the volatile access of emerging economies to international financial markets, and for three stylized facts we identify in emerging markets and high yield data since the late 1990s. Our analytical framework is a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous agents, incomplete markets, and endogenous collateral, plus an extension encompassing adverse selection. (JEL D53, G12, G14, G15)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1211.abstractZh: 我们为像新兴市场这样的新兴资产类别提供了一种定价理论，这些资产类别尚未成熟到足以吸引普通公众的兴趣。我们展示了杠杆周期如何导致传染效应、对抵押品的逃避以及发行配给，这些现象在一个我们称之为“焦虑经济”的反复出现的阶段中发生。我们的模型解释了新兴经济体在国际金融市场中不稳定的进入情况，以及自20世纪90年代末以来我们在新兴市场和高收益数据中发现的三个典型现象。我们的分析框架是一个具有异质代理人、不完全市场以及内生抵押品的一般均衡模型，并包含了对逆向选择的扩展。（JEL D53, G12, G14, G15）

abstract.text: We modify the Salop (1979) model of price competition with differentiated products by assuming that consumers are loss averse relative to a reference point given by their recent expectations about the purchase. Consumers' sensitivity to losses in money increases the price responsiveness of demand—and hence the intensity of competition—at higher relative to lower market prices, reducing or eliminating price variation both within and between products. When firms face common stochastic costs, in any symmetric equilibrium the markup is strictly decreasing in cost. Even when firms face different cost distributions, we identify conditions under which a focal-price equilibrium (where firms always charge the same “focal” price) exists, and conditions under which any equilibrium is focal. (JEL D11, D43, D81, L13)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1245.abstractZh: 我们修改了Salop（1979）关于差异化产品价格竞争的模型，假设消费者相对于他们最近的购买预期存在一个损失厌恶点。消费者对金钱损失的敏感度增加了需求对价格的响应程度——因此，在较高相对价格下竞争的强度也会增加，从而减少了或消除了产品内部及产品之间的价格差异。当企业面临共同的随机成本时，在任何对称均衡中，加价率会随着成本的增加而严格下降。即使企业面临不同的成本分布，我们也能确定存在焦点价格均衡的条件（即企业始终收取相同的“焦点”价格），以及任何均衡都是焦点价格均衡的条件。（JEL D11, D43, D81, L13）

abstract.text: I propose a new solution concept—behavioral equilibrium—to study environments with players who are naive, in the sense that they fail to account for the informational content of other players' actions. I apply the framework to certain adverse selection settings and show that, contrary to the existing literature, the adverse selection problem is exacerbated when naive players fail to account for selection. More generally, the main distinguishing feature of the framework is that, in equilibrium, beliefs about both fundamentals and strategies are jointly restricted. Consequently, whether a behavioral bias may arise or not is determined endogenously in equilibrium. (JEL C70, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1269.abstractZh: 我提出了一种新的解决方案概念——行为均衡，用于研究那些缺乏理性思考的玩家所处的环境。这些玩家未能考虑到其他玩家的行为所包含的信息内容。我将这一框架应用于某些逆向选择的情形，并发现与现有文献相反，当缺乏理性思考的玩家未能考虑选择因素时，逆向选择问题会变得更加严重。更一般地说，该框架的主要特点是，在均衡状态下，关于基本面和策略的信念会受到共同限制。因此，是否存在行为偏差这一问题，是由均衡状态内生决定的。（JEL C70, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Language is a powerful coordination device. We generalize the cheap-talk approach to pre-play communication by way of introducing a meaning correspondence between messages and actions, and by postulating two axioms met by natural languages. Players have a lexicographic preference, second to material payoffs, against deviating from the meaning correspondence. Under two-sided communication in generic and symmetric n × n-coordination games, a Nash equilibrium component in such a lexicographic communication game is evolutionarily stable if and only if it results in the unique Pareto efficient outcome of the underlying game. We extend the analysis to one-sided communication in arbitrary finite two-player games. (JEL C72, C73, Z13)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1292.abstractZh: 语言是一种强大的协调工具。我们通过引入消息与行为之间的意义对应关系，并假设自然语言满足两个公理，将廉价交谈的方法推广到预游戏中的沟通。玩家在偏离意义对应关系时，会优先选择物质收益而非其他因素。在通用且对称的n × n协调游戏中，如果这样的词典式沟通游戏中的纳什均衡成分能够导致底层游戏唯一的帕累托有效结果，则该均衡成分在进化上是稳定的。我们将这一分析扩展到任意有限双人游戏中的单边沟通情况。（JEL C72, C73, Z13）

abstract.text: Based on recent neuroscience evidence, we model the brain as a dual-system organization subject to three conflicts: asymmetric information, temporal horizon, and incentive salience. Under the first and second conflicts, we show that the uninformed system imposes a positive link between consumption and labor at every period. Furthermore, decreasing impatience endogenously emerges as a consequence of these two conflicts. Under the first and third conflicts, it becomes optimal to set a consumption cap. Finally, we discuss the behavioral implications of these rules for choice bracketing and expense tracking, and for consumption over the life cycle. (JEL D11, D74, D82, D87, D91)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1312.abstractZh: 基于最新的神经科学证据，我们将大脑建模为一个受三种冲突影响的双重系统组织：信息不对称、时间范围限制以及激励的显著性。在第一个和第二个冲突下，我们表明信息不对称的系统在每个时期都建立了消费与劳动之间的正向联系。此外，由于这两种冲突，减少急躁情绪会内生性地出现。在第一个和第三个冲突下，设定消费上限成为最优选择。最后，我们讨论了这些规则对选择区间划分、费用追踪以及生命周期内消费行为的影响。（JEL D11, D74, D82, D87, D91）

abstract.text: We study the welfare economics of probabilistic patents that are licensed without a full determination of validity. We examine the social value of instead determining patent validity before licensing to downstream technology users, in terms of deadweight loss (ex post) and innovation incentives (ex ante). We relate the value of such pre-licensing review to the patent's strength, i.e., the probability it would hold up in court, and to the per-unit royalty at which it would be licensed. We then apply these results using a game-theoretic model of licensing to downstream oligopolists, in which we show that determining patent validity prior to licensing is socially beneficial. (JEL D82, K11, L24, O34)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1347.abstractZh: 我们研究了在无法完全确定专利有效性的情况下，通过概率性许可所涉及的福利经济学问题。我们探讨了在将专利有效性确定后再进行许可给下游技术用户这一做法的社会价值，从无谓损失（事后）和创新激励（事前）的角度进行了分析。我们将这种预许可审查的价值与专利的胜诉概率以及许可时的单位许可费联系起来。随后，我们运用博弈论模型对下游寡头垄断者进行了分析，结果表明在许可前确定专利有效性具有社会效益。（JEL D82, K11, L24, O34）

abstract.text: This article examines the stock market's changing valuation of corporate patentable assets between 1910 and 1939. It shows that the value of knowledge capital increased significantly during the 1920s compared to the 1910s as investors responded to the quality of technological inventions. Innovation was an important driver of the late 1920s stock market runup, and the Great Crash did not reflect a significant revaluation of knowledge capital relative to physical capital. Although substantial quantities of influential patents were accumulated during the post-crash recovery, high technology firms did not earn significant excess returns over low technology firms for most of the 1930s. (JEL G14, N12, N22, O30)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1370.abstractZh: 本文研究了1910年至1939年间股市对企业可专利资产估值的变动情况。研究表明，与1910年代相比，知识资本的价值在1920年代显著上升，这是因为投资者对技术发明的质量做出了反应。创新是1920年代末股市上涨的重要驱动力，而大崩盘并未导致知识资本相对于物质资本的显著重新估值。尽管在崩盘后的恢复期间积累了大量有影响力的专利，但在1930年代的大部分时间里，高科技企业并未比低技术企业获得显著的超额回报。（JEL G14, N12, N22, O30）

abstract.text: We study whether the effects on registered manufacturing output of dismantling the License Raj—a system of central controls regulating entry and production activity in this sector—vary across Indian states with different labor market regulations. The effects are found to be unequal across Indian states with different labor market regulations. In particular, following delicensing, industries located in states with pro-employer labor market institutions grew more quickly than those in pro-worker environments. (JEL J50, L52,L60, O14, O15, O25)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1397.abstractZh: 我们研究了取消许可证制度——一种监管该行业进入和生产活动的中央控制系统——对印度各州注册制造业产出的影响是否有所不同。研究发现，在劳动市场法规不同的印度各州，这种影响是不平等的。具体而言，在取消许可证制度后，位于支持雇主的劳动市场体制的州内的产业增长速度比那些位于支持工人环境的州内的产业要快。（JEL J50, L52, L60, O14, O15, O25）

abstract.text: We examine the impact of liquidity shocks by exploiting cross-bank liquidity variation induced by unanticipated nuclear tests in Pakistan. We show that for the same firm borrowing from two different banks, its loan from the bank experiencing a 1 percent larger decline in liquidity drops by an additional 0.6 percent. While banks pass their liquidity shocks on to firms, large firms—particularly those with strong business or political ties—completely compensate this loss by additional borrowing through the credit market. Small firms are unable to do so and face large drops in overall borrowing and increased financial distress. (JEL E44, G21, G32, L25)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1413.abstractZh: 我们通过利用巴基斯坦意外核试验引发的银行间流动性变化，来研究流动性冲击的影响。研究表明，对于同一家企业来说，如果向两家不同的银行借款，其中一家银行流动性下降1%，该企业的贷款额将额外下降0.6%。虽然银行会将流动性冲击传导给企业，但大型企业——尤其是那些拥有强大商业或政治关系的企业——能够通过信贷市场进行额外借款来完全弥补这一损失。小型企业则无法做到这一点，其整体借款额会大幅下降，面临更大的财务困境。（JEL E44, G21, G32, L25）

abstract.text: Since Schelling, it has often been assumed that players make use of salient decision labels to achieve coordination. Consistent with previous work, we find that given equal payoffs, salient labels yield frequent coordination. However, given even minutely asymmetric payoffs, labels lose much of their effectiveness and miscoordination abounds. This raises questions about the extent to which the effectiveness of focal points based on label salience persists beyond the special case of symmetric games. The patterns of miscoordination we observe vary with the magnitude of payoff differences in intricate ways that suggest nonequilibrium accounts based on “level-k” thinking and “team reasoning.” (JEL C72, C92)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1443.abstractZh: 自谢林以来，人们通常认为参与者会利用显著的决策标签来实现协调。与以往的研究一致，我们发现在支付相等的条件下，显著的标签能够带来频繁的协调行为。然而，在支付存在微小不对称的情况下，这些标签的有效性大大降低，导致协调行为频繁出现。这引发了关于基于标签显著性的焦点在对称博弈的特殊情况下是否仍然有效的疑问。我们观察到的协调行为偏差模式随着支付差异的大小而呈现出复杂的变化，这表明基于“水平k”思维和“团队推理”的非均衡理论可能并不适用。（JEL C72, C92）

abstract.text: Research in sociology and ethics suggests that individuals adhere to social norms of behavior established by their peers. Within an agency framework, we model endogenous social norms by assuming that each agent's cost of implementing an action depends on the social norm for that action, defined to be the average level of that action chosen by the agent's peer group. We show how endogenous social norms alter the effectiveness of monetary incentives, determine whether it is optimal to group agents in a single or two separate organizations, and may give rise to a costly adverse selection problem when agents' sensitivities to social norms are unobservable. (JEL D23, D82, D86, Z13)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1459.abstractZh: 社会学和伦理学的研究表明，个体遵循由同龄人建立的社会行为规范。在代理框架内，我们通过假设每个代理实施某一行为的成本取决于该行为的社会规范来建模内生社会规范，其中社会规范被定义为代理的同龄人群体所选择的该行为的平均水平。我们展示了内生社会规范如何改变金钱激励的有效性，决定了将代理分组为单一组织还是两个独立组织是否最优，并且当代理对社会规范的敏感性不可观测时，可能会引发代价高昂的逆向选择问题。（JEL D23, D82, D86, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper suggests that the US recovery from the Great Depression was driven by a shift in expectations. This shift was caused by President Franklin Delano Roosevelt's policy actions. On the monetary policy side, Roosevelt abolished the gold standard and—even more importantly—announced the explicit objective of inflating the price level to pre-Depression levels. On the fiscal policy side, Roosevelt expanded real and deficit spending, which made his policy objective credible. These actions violated prevailing policy dogmas and initiated a policy regime change as in Sargent (1983) and Temin and Wigmore (1990). The economic consequences of Roosevelt are evaluated in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with nominal frictions. (JEL D84, E52, E62, N12, N42)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1476.abstractZh: 本文认为，美国从大萧条中复苏的驱动力源于预期的变化。这一变化是由富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福总统的政策行动所引发的。在货币政策方面，罗斯福废除了金本位制，并且更重要的是，他宣布了将物价水平恢复到大萧条前的目标。在财政政策方面，罗斯福增加了实际支出和赤字支出，这使得他的政策目标具有了可信性。这些行动打破了当时的政策教条，并引发了政策制度的变革，正如Sargent（1983）和Temin与Wigmore（1990）所论述的那样。罗斯福的经济影响在一个包含名义摩擦的动态随机一般均衡模型中得到了评估。（JEL D84, E52, E62, N12, N42）

abstract.text: This paper studies the life-cycle labor supply of three cohorts of American women, born in the 1930s, 1940s, and 1950s. We focus on the increase in labor supply of mothers between the 1940s and 1950s cohorts. We construct a life-cycle model of female participation and savings, and calibrate the model to match the behavior of the middle cohort. We investigate which changes in the determinants of labor supply account for the increases in participation early in the life-cycle observed for the youngest cohort. A combination of a reduction in the cost of children alongside a reduction in the wage-gender gap is needed. (JEL D91, J16, J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1517.abstractZh: 本文研究了三个美国女性群体的生命周期劳动力供给情况，她们分别出生于20世纪30年代、40年代和50年代。我们重点关注1940年代至1950年代女性劳动力供给的增加。我们构建了一个关于女性参与和储蓄的生命周期模型，并调整模型以匹配中间群体的行为。我们研究了哪些劳动力供给决定因素的变化导致了最年轻群体在生命周期早期参与率的增加。需要同时降低儿童抚养成本以及缩小工资性别差距。（JEL D91, J16, J22, J31）

abstract.text: This paper provides the first real-world evidence of Giffen behavior, i.e., upward sloping demand. Subsidizing the prices of dietary staples for extremely poor households in two provinces of China, we find strong evidence of Giffen behavior for rice in Hunan, and weaker evidence for wheat in Gansu. The data provide new insight into the consumption behavior of the poor, who act as though maximizing utility subject to subsistence concerns. We find that their elasticity of demand depends significantly, and nonlinearly, on the severity of their poverty. Understanding this heterogeneity is important for the effective design of welfare programs for the poor. (JEL D12, O12).

10.1257/aer.98.4.1553.abstractZh: 本文首次提供了实际生活中的吉芬行为证据，即需求呈上升趋势。通过对中国两个省份的极度贫困家庭的主要食品进行补贴，我们发现湖南地区的居民对大米表现出强烈的吉芬行为，而甘肃地区的小麦则表现出较弱的吉芬行为。这些数据为研究贫困人口的消费行为提供了新的视角，表明贫困人口在追求效用最大化的同时，也受到生存问题的制约。我们发现，他们的需求弹性显著且非线性地依赖于贫困程度的严重性。理解这种异质性对于有效设计针对贫困人口的福利计划至关重要。（JEL D12, O12）

abstract.text: We report evidence that Bitnet adoption facilitated increased research collaboration between US universities. However, not all institutions benefited equally. Using panel data from seven top engineering journals, Bitnet connection records, and institution ranking data, we find that middle-tier universities were the primary beneficiaries; they benefited largely by increasing their collaboration with top-tier schools. Furthermore, we find that the magnitude of this effect is greatest for co-located pairs. Thus, the advent of Bitnet – and likely of subsequent networks – seems to have increased the role of middle-tier universities as producers of new knowledge in the national innovation system. (JEL D85, I23, O31, O33)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1578.abstractZh: 我们发现了一些证据，表明Bitnet的采用促进了美国大学之间的研究合作。然而，并非所有机构都同样受益。通过利用七种顶级工程期刊的面板数据、Bitnet的连接记录以及机构排名数据，我们发现中等水平的大学是主要的受益者；它们主要通过加强与顶级大学的合作而获得收益。此外，我们发现这种效应在位于同一地区的大学之间最为显著。因此，Bitnet的出现——以及后续网络的兴起——似乎增强了中等水平大学在国家创新体系中作为新知识创造者的角色。（JEL D85, I23, O31, O33）

abstract.text: This paper examines the dynamics of violence in the Palestinian-Israeli conflict during the Second Intifada. Using data on the daily number of fatalities between September 2000 and January 2005, we estimate reaction functions for both Israelis and Palestinians and find evidence of Granger causality from Palestinian to Israeli violence, but not vice versa. This finding is consistent using either the incidence or level of fatalities and is robust to the specification of the lag structure and the level of time aggregation. We find no evidence that the Palestinians and Israelis are engaged in a predictable “tit-for-tat” cycle of violence. (JEL D74, H56, O17)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1591.abstractZh: 本文研究了第二次巴勒斯坦-以色列冲突期间暴力的动态变化。通过2000年9月至2005年1月每日死亡人数的数据，我们估算了以色列人和巴勒斯坦人的反应函数，并发现从巴勒斯坦到以色列的暴力之间存在格兰杰因果关系，但反之则不成立。这一发现无论使用死亡人数发生率还是总量，都保持一致，并且不受滞后结构和时间聚合水平的显著影响。我们没有发现巴勒斯坦人和以色列人之间存在可预测的“以暴制暴”循环现象。（JEL D74, H56, O17）

abstract.text: Anne Case et al. (2002), using cross-sectional data, found a positive relationship between children's health and income, with income's protective effect increasing with age. Janet Currie and Mark Stabile (2003), using a panel of Canadian children, found that low- and high-SES children respond similarly to health shocks, but the low-SES children are subject to more shocks as they age. Our study examines this relationship using panel data for US children. We find some support for the latter result of Currie and Stabile, but also evidence that low- and high-SES children respond differently to specific health shocks. (JEL D31, I12, J13)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1605.abstractZh: Anne Case等人（2002年）使用横截面数据发现，儿童健康与收入之间存在正相关关系，且收入的保护效应随年龄增长而增强。Janet Currie和Mark Stabile（2003年）使用加拿大儿童的数据发现，低社会经济地位和高社会经济地位的儿童对健康冲击的反应相似，但低社会经济地位的儿童随着年龄增长更容易受到冲击。我们的研究使用美国儿童的数据来探讨这种关系。我们发现Currie和Stabile的研究结果得到了部分支持，同时也发现了低社会经济地位和高社会经济地位的儿童对特定健康冲击的反应存在差异。（JEL D31, I12, J13）

abstract.text: A principal can observe both the output and input of an agent who works at a job involving multiple tasks. We provide a simple theory that explains why it may be optimal for the principal to use only an output-based incentive contract, even though the principal can monitor the agent's actions perfectly in all but one task and knows exactly which action is optimal for each task. (JEL D82, D86, M54)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1619.abstractZh: 一位负责人可以观察到从事多项任务工作的代理人的产出和投入。我们提出了一个简单的理论，解释了为什么负责人仅使用基于产出的激励合同可能是最优的，尽管负责人可以在除一个任务之外的所有任务中完美地监控代理人的行为，并且确切知道每个任务中哪种行为是最优的。（JEL D82, D86, M54）

abstract.text: Building on previous work by Schelling and Crawford, we study a model of bilateral bargaining in which negotiators can make binding commitments at a low positive cost c. Most of our results concern outcomes that survive iterated strict dominance. If commitment attempts never fail, there are three such outcomes. In two of them, all the surplus goes to one player. In the third, there is a high probability of conflict. If commitment attempts succeed with probability q < 1, the unique outcome that survives iterated strict dominance entails conflict with probability q2. When c = 0, analogous results hold if the requirement of iterated strict dominance is replaced by iterated weak dominance. (JEL C78, D84)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1629.abstractZh: 在Schelling和Crawford先前工作的基础上，我们研究了一个双边讨价还价模型，其中谈判者可以以低的正成本c做出具有约束力的承诺。我们的大部分研究结果涉及在迭代严格支配条件下仍然成立的结果。如果承诺尝试从不失败，那么存在三种这样的结果。其中两种情况下，所有收益都归某一方所有。第三种情况下，发生冲突的概率很高。如果承诺尝试成功的概率为q < 1，那么在迭代严格支配条件下仍然成立的唯一结果意味着冲突发生的概率为q2。当c = 0时，如果迭代严格支配的条件被迭代弱支配条件替代，则同样的结果仍然成立。（JEL C78, D84）

abstract.text: Empirical and experimental evidence suggests different levels of sophistication among families in the Boston Public School student assignment plan. We analyze the preference revelation game induced by the Boston mechanism with sincere players who report their true preferences and sophisticated players who play a best response. We characterize the set of Nash equilibrium outcomes as the set of stable matchings of a modified economy, where sincere students lose priority to sophisticated students. Any sophisticated student weakly prefers her assignment under the Pareto-dominant Nash equilibrium of the Boston mechanism to her assignment under the recently adopted student-optimal stable mechanism. (JEL D82, I21)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1636.abstractZh: 实证和实验证据表明，波士顿公立学校学生分配计划中的家庭之间存在不同的复杂程度。我们分析了由波士顿机制引发的偏好揭示游戏，其中诚实的参与者报告他们的真实偏好，而复杂的参与者则采取最佳响应策略。我们将纳什均衡结果描述为一组稳定的匹配，这些匹配是在修改后的经济体系中实现的，其中诚实的学生会失去对复杂学生的优先权。任何复杂的学生在波士顿机制的帕累托优势纳什均衡下，都会更偏好自己的分配结果，而不是最近采用的学生最优稳定机制下的分配结果。（JEL D82, I21）

abstract.text: When a job-seeker and an employer meet, find a prospective joint surplus, and bargain over the wage, conditions in the outside labor market, including especially unemployment, may have limited influence. The job-seeker's only credible threat during bargaining is to hold out for a better deal. The employer's threat is to delay bargaining. Consequently, the outcome of the bargain depends on the relative costs of delays to the parties, rather than on the payoffs that result from exiting negotiations. Modeling bargaining in this way makes wages less responsive to unemployment. A stochastic model of the labor market with credible bargaining and reasonable parameter values yields larger employment fluctuations than does the standard Mortensen-Pissarides model. (JEL J22, J23, J31, J64)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1653.abstractZh: 当求职者与雇主相遇，寻找潜在的合作点，并就工资及外部劳动力市场状况进行谈判时，尤其是失业率等因素，其影响可能较为有限。求职者在谈判过程中唯一可信的威胁是坚持要求更好的条件；而雇主则可能会推迟谈判。因此，谈判的结果取决于双方因延迟而付出的相对成本，而非从谈判中获得的收益。以这种方式对谈判进行建模，会使工资对失业率的反应减弱。一个具有可信谈判过程和合理参数值的随机劳动力市场模型，其就业波动幅度会比标准的Mortensen-Pissarides模型更大。（JEL J22, J23, J31, J64）

abstract.text: We develop a political economy model where loss aversion and reference dependence are important in shaping people's preferences over trade policy. The policy implications of the augmented model differ in three ways: there is a region of compensating protection, where a decline in the world price leads to an offsetting increase in protection, such that a constant domestic price is maintained; protection following a single negative price shock will be persistent; and irrespective of the extent of lobbying, there will be a deviation from free trade that favors loss-making industries. The augmented model explains protections of the US steel industry since 1980. (JEL F13, F14, L61)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1675.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个政治经济学模型，在该模型中，损失厌恶和参照依赖性在塑造人们对贸易政策的偏好方面起着重要作用。该扩展模型的政策含义有三个方面：存在一个补偿性保护区域，在这个区域中，世界价格的下降会导致保护的相应增加，从而维持国内价格的稳定；在单次负面价格冲击之后，保护措施会持续；无论游说力度如何，都会存在对自由贸易的偏离，这有利于亏损行业的发展。该扩展模型解释了自1980年以来美国钢铁行业的保护措施。（JEL F13, F14, L61）

abstract.text: Recently, a number of authors have argued that the standard search model cannot generate the observed business-cycle-frequency fluctuations in unemployment and job vacancies, given shocks of a plausible magnitude. We propose a new calibration strategy of the standard model that uses data on the cost of vacancy creation and cyclicality of wages to identify the two key parameters –- the value of nonmarket activity and the bargaining weights. Our calibration implies that the model is consistent with the data. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1692.abstractZh: 最近，一些学者认为，标准搜索模型无法解释在合理规模的冲击下，失业率和职位空缺频率的波动现象。我们提出了一种对标准模型进行校准的新策略，该策略利用职位空缺产生的成本以及工资的周期性变化数据，来识别两个关键参数——非市场活动的价值以及议价权重。我们的校准结果表明，该模型与数据是一致的。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64）

abstract.text: By considering a model with identical firms, Krugman (1980) predicts that a higher elasticity of substitution between goods magnifies the impact of trade barriers on trade flows. In this paper, I introduce firm heterogeneity in a simple model of international trade. I prove that the extensive margin and the intensive margin are affected by the elasticity of substitution in exact opposite directions. When the distribution of productivity across firms is Pareto, the predictions of the Krugman model with representative firms are overturned: the impact of trade barriers on trade flows is dampened by the elasticity of substitution, and not magnified. (JEL F12, F13)

10.1257/aer.98.4.1707.abstractZh: Krugman在1980年提出了一个具有相同企业的模型，他预测商品之间较高的替代弹性会放大贸易壁垒对贸易流动的影响。在本文中，我在一个简单的国际贸易模型中引入了企业异质性。我证明了广延边际和集约边际受到替代弹性的影响，但方向完全相反。当企业之间的生产率分布是帕累托最优时，Krugman模型中关于代表性企业的预测被推翻：贸易壁垒对贸易流动的影响因替代弹性的作用而减弱，而非加剧。（JEL F12, F13）

abstract.text: 2007 The central question in a recent paper by J. Peter Neary (2004) concerning real incomes and the Penn World Tables is: what exactly do the numbers mean? This question is important, because these data are widely used in empirical research. More generally, index number data, including indicators of inflation and economic growth, are used so extensively in research throughout the profession, that it indeed seems helpful to understand what they actually indicate. In the literature, two approaches to index numbers are distinguished: the ax-iomatic approach and the economic approach. In this note we would like to discuss the way in which these two approaches differ and how that affects what the numbers mean. In Neary’s paper the difference is described as one between an approach that does and an approach that does not assume that quantities arise from optimizing behaviour. This is in line with a tradition in index number theory that can be traced back to Ragnar Frisch (1936). We will argue that a more accurate descrip-tion is that the difference lies in whether or not optimizing agents, or representative consumers, are assumed to optimize the same utility function. It is exactly this distinction that sets the (different) limitations of both approaches for constructing a meaningful indicator of real income. Those limitations will be described in some detail and being aware of them is helpful for assessing the value of results from both the axiomatic and the economic approach. They also suggest ways in which the two approaches may be complementary for constructing meaningful index numbers. Introducing the Geary-Allen International Accounts (GAIA) system, Neary combines taking the economic approach with judging the resulting indices in view of some axioms. We think that this makes his paper a suitable point of departure for the discussion of how the two approaches handle differences in relative prices on the one hand and differences in preferences on the other. 1

10.1257/aer.98.4.1722.abstractZh: 2007年，J. Peter Neary在2004年发表的一篇关于实际收入与Penn世界表格的论文中提出了核心问题：这些数据究竟意味着什么？这个问题非常重要，因为这些数据在实证研究中被广泛使用。更普遍地说，包括通货膨胀和经济增长指标在内的指数数据在学术界的研究中被广泛使用，因此了解它们实际所指的内容确实很有帮助。在文献中，对指数数据的处理方法被区分为两种：公理化方法和经济方法。在这篇笔记中，我们想讨论这两种方法之间的差异，以及这种差异如何影响这些数据的含义。在Neary的论文中，这种差异被描述为一种方法认为数量来源于优化行为，而另一种方法则不认为数量来源于优化行为。这与指数理论中的一个传统相一致，这一传统可以追溯到Ragnar Frisch（1936年）。我们认为，更准确的描述应该是，这两种方法的区别在于是否假设优化主体或代表性消费者优化相同的效用函数。正是这种区别决定了这两种方法在构建实际收入指标时的不同限制。这些限制将得到详细的描述，了解这些限制有助于评估公理化方法和经济方法的结果价值。此外，这些限制也提示了这两种方法在构建有意义的指数数据方面的互补性。Neary引入了Geary-Allen国际账户体系，将经济方法与基于某些公理对所得指数进行评判结合起来。我们认为，这使得他的论文成为讨论这两种方法如何处理相对价格差异以及偏好差异的合适出发点。

abstract.text: Many employment relationships concede rents to workers. Depending on the political institutions, the presence of such rents allows employers to use the threat of withdrawing them to control their workers' political behavior, such as their votes in the absence of secret ballot. We examine the effects of the introduction of the secret ballot in Chile in 1958 on voting behavior. Before the reforms, localities with more pervasive patron-client relationships tended to exhibit a much stronger support for the right-wing parties, traditionally associated with the landed oligarchy. After the reform, however, this difference across localities completely disappeared. (JEL D72, N46, O13, O15, O17)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1737.abstractZh: 许多雇佣关系中都存在对工人的“租金”分配。根据政治制度的不同，这种租金的存在使得雇主能够利用收回租金的威胁来控制工人的政治行为，例如在没有秘密投票的情况下影响工人的投票选择。我们研究了1958年智利引入秘密投票制度对投票行为的影响。在改革之前，那些存在更为普遍的庇护-客户关系的地区，往往更支持与地主寡头势力相关的右翼政党。然而，改革之后，这种地区间的差异完全消失了。（JEL D72, N46, O13, O15, O17）

abstract.text: This paper exploits the division of Germany after the Second World War and the reunification of East and West Germany in 1990 as a natural experiment to provide evidence for the importance of market access for economic development. In line with a standard new economic geography model, we find that, following division, cities in West Germany close to the East-West German border experienced a substantial decline in population growth relative to other West German cities. We show that the model can account for the quantitative magnitude of our findings and provide additional evidence against alternative possible explanations. (JEL F15, N94, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1766.abstractZh: 本文以二战后德国的分裂以及1990年东西德统一为自然实验，探讨市场准入对经济发展的重要性。根据标准的新经济地理模型，我们发现，分裂后，位于东西德边界附近的西德城市的人口增长相对于其他西德城市而言出现了显著下降。我们的研究表明，该模型能够解释我们发现的量化差异，并为其他可能的解释提供了额外证据。（JEL F15, N94, R12, R23）

abstract.text: German reunification was a large, unexpected shock for East Germans. Exploiting German reunification as a natural experiment, I analyze the validity of the life-cycle consumption model. I derive three stylized features concerning the saving behavior of East versus West Germans after reunification: (i) East Germans have higher saving rates than West Germans; (ii) this East-West gap is increasing in age at reunification; and (iii) for every cohort, this gap is declining over time. I show that a comprehensive life-cycle model can replicate these features. The precautionary saving motive is essential for the success of the model. (JEL D14, D91, E21)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1798.abstractZh: 德国统一对东德人来说是一个巨大的、出乎意料的冲击。我将德国统一视为一个自然实验，分析生命周期消费模型的有效性。我得出了关于统一后东德人与西德人储蓄行为的三个特征：(i) 东德人的储蓄率高于西德人；(ii) 这种东西差距在统一时的年龄上有所扩大；(iii) 对于每一代人群来说，这一差距随着时间的推移而缩小。我证明，一个全面的生命周期模型可以再现这些特征。预防性储蓄动机对于该模型的成功至关重要。(JEL D14, D91, E21)

abstract.text: This paper evaluates an experiment in which individuals in rural Malawi were randomly assigned monetary incentives to learn their HIV results after being tested. Distance to the HIV results centers was also randomly assigned. Without any incentive, 34 percent of the participants learned their HIV results. However, even the smallest incentive doubled that share. Using the randomly assigned incentives and distance from results centers as instruments for the knowledge of HIV status, sexually active HIV-positive individuals who learned their results are three times more likely to purchase condoms two months later than sexually active HIV-positive individuals who did not learn their results; however, HIV-positive individuals who learned their results purchase only two additional condoms than those who did not. There is no significant effect of learning HIV-negative status on the purchase of condoms.

10.1257/aer.98.5.1829.abstractZh: 本文评估了一项实验，实验中，马拉维农村地区的个体被随机分配了货币激励，以在检测后了解自己的HIV检测结果。这些个体被随机分配到不同的HIV检测结果获取地点。在没有激励的情况下，34%的参与者了解了自己的HIV检测结果。然而，即使是最微小的激励也能使这一比例翻倍。利用随机分配的激励和距离检测结果获取地点的因素作为了解HIV状态的指标，研究发现：在得知检测结果后，性活跃且HIV阳性的个体在两个月后购买避孕套的可能性是未得知检测结果的性活跃HIV阳性个体的三倍；不过，得知检测结果的HIV阳性个体仅多购买了两只避孕套。而得知HIV阴性检测结果对购买避孕套的行为并没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper presents findings from an experimental evaluation of Job Corps, the nation's largest training program for disadvantaged youths. The study uses survey data collected over four years and tax data over nine years on a nationwide sample of 15,400 treatments and controls. The Job Corps model has promise; program participation increases educational attainment, reduces criminal activity, and increases earnings for several postprogram years. Based on tax data, however, the earnings gains were not sustained except for the oldest participants. Nonetheless, Job Corps is the only federal training program that has been shown to increase earnings for this population. (JEL I28, I38, J13, J24)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1864.abstractZh: 本文介绍了对Job Corps的实证评估结果，Job Corps是美国针对弱势青年的最大规模培训项目。该研究使用了四年来的调查数据以及九年来的税收数据，样本涵盖了15,400个实验组和对照组。Job Corps模式具有潜力；参与该计划能够提升教育水平、减少犯罪活动，并在项目后的几年内增加收入。然而，根据税收数据，除了年龄最大的参与者外，其他参与者的收入增长并未持续。尽管如此，Job Corps仍是唯一一项被证明能够增加这一群体收入的联邦培训项目。（JEL I28, I38, J13, J24）

abstract.text: This paper examines the link between income and consumption inequality. We create panel data on consumption for the Panel Study of Income Dynamics using an imputation procedure based on food demand estimates from the Consumer Expenditure Survey. We document a disjuncture between income and consumption inequality over the 1980s and show that it can be explained by changes in the persistence of income shocks. We find some partial insurance of permanent shocks, especially for the college educated and those near retirement. We find full insurance of transitory shocks except among poor households. Taxes, transfers, and family labor supply play an important role in insuring permanent shocks. (JEL D12, D31, D91, E21)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1887.abstractZh: 本文探讨了收入与消费不平等之间的联系。我们基于《消费者支出调查》中的食物需求估算数据，利用面板数据研究收入动态研究中的消费情况。研究发现，在1980年代期间，收入与消费不平等之间存在差异，并且这种差异可以通过收入冲击的持续性变化来解释。我们发现，对于受过高等教育的人群和接近退休的人群来说，存在一定程度的永久性冲击的保险机制。除了贫困家庭之外，税收、转移支付和家庭劳动力供给在保障永久性冲击方面发挥着重要作用。（JEL D12, D31, D91, E21）

abstract.text: We study unemployment insurance for workers who sequentially sample job opportunities. We focus on the optimal timing of benefits and the desirability of allowing borrowing and saving. When workers have constant absolute risk aversion, a simple policy is optimal: a constant benefit during unemployment, a constant tax during employment, and free access to a riskless asset. With constant relative risk aversion, optimal policy involves nearly constant benefits; more elaborate policies offer minuscule welfare gains. We highlight two distinct policy roles: ensuring workers have sufficient liquidity to smooth their consumption; and providing unemployment subsidies to insure against uncertain spell duration. (JEL J65)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1922.abstractZh: 我们研究了为依次获得就业机会的工人提供失业保险的问题。我们重点关注福利的最佳发放时机，以及允许借款和储蓄的合理性。当工人具有恒定的绝对风险厌恶时，一个简单的政策是最优的：失业期间提供恒定的福利，就业期间征收恒定的税收，并自由获取无风险资产。而当工人具有恒定的相对风险厌恶时，最优政策涉及几乎恒定的福利；更复杂的政策则只能带来微小的福利改善。我们强调了两种不同的政策作用：一是确保工人有足够的流动性以平滑消费；二是提供失业补贴以应对不确定的失业持续时间。（JEL J65）

abstract.text: Large Japanese banks often engaged in sham loan restructurings that kept credit flowing to otherwise insolvent borrowers (which we call zombies). We examine the implications of suppressing the normal competitive process whereby the zombies would shed workers and lose market share. The congestion created by the zombies reduces the profits for healthy firms, which discourages their entry and investment. We confirm that zombie-dominated industries exhibit more depressed job creation and destruction, and lower productivity. We present firm-level regressions showing that the increase in zombies depressed the investment and employment growth of non-zombies and widened the productivity gap between zombies and non-zombies. (JEL G21, G32, L25)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1943.abstractZh: 日本大型银行经常参与虚假的贷款重组，使信贷继续流向原本已经资不抵债的借款人（我们称之为“僵尸企业”）。我们研究了抑制正常竞争过程对“僵尸企业”的影响，这一过程会导致这些企业裁员并失去市场份额。由“僵尸企业”造成的拥堵降低了健康企业的利润，从而抑制了它们的进入和投资。我们的研究证实，以“僵尸企业”为主导的行业在就业创造和破坏方面表现更差，生产率也更低。我们通过企业层面的回归分析发现，“僵尸企业”的增加抑制了非“僵尸企业”的投资和就业增长，并扩大了“僵尸企业”与非“僵尸企业”之间的生产率差距。（JEL G21, G32, L25）

abstract.text: We propose a theory of the global production process that focuses on tradeable tasks, and use it to study how falling costs of offshoring affect factor prices in the source country. We identify a productivity effect of task trade that benefits the factor whose tasks are more easily moved offshore. In the light of this effect, reductions in the cost of trading tasks can generate shared gains for all domestic factors, in contrast to the distributional conflict that typically results from reductions in the cost of trading goods. (JEL F11, F16)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1978.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种全球生产过程的理论，该理论重点关注可交易的任务，并利用这一理论来研究离岸外包成本下降如何影响源国的要素价格。我们发现，任务交易具有一种生产率效应，这种效应使那些任务更容易被离岸外包的要素受益。考虑到这一效应，降低任务交易成本可以为所有国内要素带来共同收益，这与因降低商品交易成本而通常导致的分配冲突形成对比。（JEL F11, F16）

abstract.text: International relative prices across industrialized countries show large and systematic deviations from relative purchasing power parity. We embed a model of imperfect competition and variable markups in a quantitative model of international trade. We find that when our model is parameterized to match salient features of the data on international trade and market structure in the United States, it can reproduce deviations from relative purchasing power parity similar to those observed in the data because firms choose to price-to-market. We then examine how pricing-to-market depends on the presence of international trade costs and various features of market structure. (JEL F12, F14, F31)

10.1257/aer.98.5.1998.abstractZh: 工业化国家之间的国际相对价格显示出与相对购买力平价之间存在较大且系统的偏差。我们将不完全竞争和可变加价模型纳入国际贸易的定量模型中。我们发现，当我们的模型参数化以匹配美国国际贸易和市场结构数据的显著特征时，它能够再现与数据中观察到的类似偏差，因为这些偏差源于企业选择按市场价格定价。接着，我们研究了按市场价格定价如何取决于国际贸易成本以及市场结构的各种特征。（JEL F12, F14, F31）

abstract.text: We find that prior to World Trade Organization membership, countries set import tariffs 9 percentage points higher on inelastically supplied imports relative to those supplied elastically. The magnitude of this effect is similar to the size of average tariffs in these countries, and market power explains more of the tariff variation than a commonly used political economy variable. Moreover, US trade restrictions not covered by the WTO are significantly higher on goods where the United States has more market power. We find strong evidence that these importers have market power and use it in setting noncooperative trade policy. (JEL F12, F13)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2032.abstractZh: 我们发现，在加入世界贸易组织之前，各国对非弹性供应的进口商品征收的关税比弹性供应的商品高出9个百分点。这种效应的大小与这些国家平均关税的水平相当，而市场力量对关税差异的解释力度超过了常用的政治经济学变量。此外，美国未加入世界贸易组织的贸易限制措施在那些美国拥有更大市场力量的商品上明显更高。我们有强有力的证据表明，这些进口商拥有市场力量，并利用这一力量来制定非合作贸易政策。（JEL F12, F13）

abstract.text: We study the asset pricing implications of Tversky and Kahneman's (1992) cumulative prospect theory, with a particular focus on its probability weighting component. Our main result, derived from a novel equilibrium with nonunique global optima, is that, in contrast to the prediction of a standard expected utility model, a security's own skewness can be priced: a positively skewed security can be “overpriced” and can earn a negative average excess return. We argue that our analysis offers a unifying way of thinking about a number of seemingly unrelated financial phenomena. (JEL D81, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2066.abstractZh: 我们研究了Tversky和Kahneman在1992年提出的累积前景理论对资产定价的影响，特别关注其概率加权成分。我们的主要结论源于一种具有非唯一全局最优解的均衡模型：与标准期望效用模型的预测相反，证券自身的偏度可以被定价；正偏度的证券可能会被“高估”，并可能获得负的平均超额回报。我们认为，我们的分析提供了一种统一的方式来理解许多看似不相关的金融现象。（JEL D81, G11, G12）

abstract.text: Purely forward-looking versions of the New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) generate too little inflation persistence. Some authors add ad hoc backward-looking terms to address this shortcoming. We hypothesize that inflation persistence results mainly from variation in the long-run trend component of inflation, which we attribute to shifts in monetary policy. We derive a version of the NKPC that incorporates a time-varying inflation trend and examine whether it explains the dynamics of inflation. When drift in trend inflation is taken into account, a purely forward-looking version of the model fits the data well, and there is no need for backward-looking components. (JEL E12, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2101.abstractZh: 纯粹前瞻性的新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线模型产生的通胀持续性不足。一些学者通过添加特定的后瞻性项来弥补这一缺陷。我们假设通胀持续性的主要来源是通胀长期趋势成分的变化，这种变化归因于货币政策的调整。我们推导出一个包含时变通胀趋势的NKPC模型版本，并检验其是否能够解释通胀的动态变化。当考虑趋势通胀的漂移时，纯粹前瞻性的模型能够很好地拟合数据，因此不需要后瞻性项。（JEL E12, E31, E52）

abstract.text: Context can influence decisions. This malleability of choice is usually invoked as evidence that people do not maximize stable preference orderings. In a market equilibrium, however, context conveys payoff-relevant information to consumers. Consequently, these consumers rationally violate naïve formulations of standard choice theoretic principles. I identify informational asymmetries under which apparently anomalous behaviors, namely the compromise effect and choice overload, arise as market equilibria. Firms respond to consumers' contextual inference; in case of the compromise effect, a firm may introduce premium loss leaders (expensive goods of overly high quality that increase the demand for other goods). (JEL D11, D83, M31)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2127.abstractZh: 情境可以影响决策。这种选择的灵活性通常被用作证据，表明人们并不追求稳定的偏好排序。然而，在市场均衡中，情境会向消费者传递与收益相关的信息。因此，这些消费者会理性地违反标准选择理论原则。我发现了信息不对称的情境下，看似异常的行为，即妥协效应和选择过载，作为市场均衡出现的情况。企业会对消费者的情境推理作出反应；在妥协效应的情况下，企业可能会引入溢价损失领导者（即价格过高但质量极高的商品，从而增加其他商品的需求）。(JEL D11, D83, M31)

abstract.text: I develop a model of bilateral conversations in which players honestly exchange ideas with their competitors. The key to incentive compatibility is complementarity in the information structure: a player can generate a new insight only if he has access to his counterpart's previous thoughts on a topic. I then examine a social network in which A has a conversation with B, then B has a conversation with C, and so on. Relatively underdeveloped ideas can travel long distances over the network. More valuable ideas, by contrast, tend to remain localized among small groups of agents. (JEL D83)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2150.abstractZh: 我开发了一个双边对话模型，其中参与者会诚实地与竞争对手交流想法。激励兼容性的关键在于信息结构中的互补性：只有当一方能够了解对方在某个话题上的先前想法时，才能产生新的见解。然后，我研究了一个社交网络，在这个网络中，A与B对话，B再与C对话，以此类推。相对较为落后的想法可以通过这个网络传播到较远的距离。相比之下，更有价值的想法往往局限于小范围的群体之中。（JEL D83）

abstract.text: A serious difficulty in determining the importance of credit constraints in education arises because standard data sources do not provide a direct way of identifying which students are credit constrained. This paper differentiates itself from previous work by taking a direct approach, made possible by unique longitudinal data from the Berea Panel Study. The results from our study of Berea College students suggest that, while credit constraints likely play an important role in the drop-out decisions of some students, the large majority of attrition of students from low-income families should be primarily attributed to reasons other than credit constraints. (JEL I21, I22)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2163.abstractZh: 在确定信贷约束对教育的影响方面存在一个严重的问题，因为标准的数据来源无法直接识别出哪些学生存在信贷约束。本文通过采用直接的方法，利用Berea面板研究提供的独特纵向数据，与以往的研究有所不同。我们对Berea学院学生的研究表明，虽然信贷约束可能在一些学生的辍学决定中起着重要作用，但大多数来自低收入家庭的学生辍学的原因主要并非由于信贷约束。 (JEL I21, I22)

abstract.text: A classical theme in social analysis views economic class divisions as the main cause of social conflict. Yet many, if not most of the conflicts we observe today appear to be ethnic in nature. It appears that the "vertical" nature of class divisions is often dominated by the "horizontal" antagonisms across groups delineated by noneconomic markers. This paper highlights the perverse synergy of economic inequality within ethnic groups, and its role in the salience of ethnic conflict. In a model of group formation which allows both class and ethnic groupings to emerge, we show that ethnic, as opposed to class, conflict may be focal, and precisely in the presence of economic inequality. (JEL D72, D74)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2185.abstractZh: 在社会分析中的一个经典观点认为，经济阶级分化是社会冲突的主要原因。然而，我们今天观察到的许多冲突，如果不是大多数，似乎都是基于种族性质的。看来，阶级分化的“垂直”性质往往被由非经济因素划分的群体之间的“水平”对立所主导。本文强调了经济不平等在种族群体内部产生的反常协同效应，以及这种不平等在种族冲突中的突出作用。在一个允许阶级和种族群体同时形成的模型中，我们发现，与阶级冲突相比，种族冲突可能更为突出，而这种现象恰恰发生在经济不平等存在的情况下。（JEL D72, D74）

abstract.text: We test whether good economic conditions and expansionary fiscal policy help incumbents get reelected in a large panel of democracies. We find no evidence that deficits help reelection in any group of countries independent of income level, level of democracy, or government or electoral system. In developed countries and old democracies, deficits in election years or over the term of office reduce reelection probabilities. Higher growth rates over the term raise reelection probabilities only in developing countries and new democracies. Low inflation is rewarded by voters only in developed countries. These effects are both statistically significant and quite substantial quantitatively. (JEL D72, E62, H62, O47)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2203.abstractZh: 我们测试了良好的经济状况和扩张性财政政策是否有助于在位者在众多民主国家中获得连任。我们发现，无论收入水平、民主程度或政府或选举制度如何，赤字并未有助于任何国家的在位者获得连任。在发达国家及老牌民主国家，选举年或任期内的赤字会降低在位者获得连任的概率。而在发展中国家和新民主国家，较高的增长率只会提高在位者获得连任的概率。在发达国家，低通货膨胀率只会受到选民的青睐。这些效应在统计上都是显著的，且数量上相当可观。（JEL D72, E62, H62, O47）

abstract.text: We investigate well-being changes for single mother headed families targeted by recent tax and welfare reforms. Measured income changes sharply differ from consumption changes. We examine disaggregated consumption, time use, and health insurance coverage. Increases in housing and transportation spending mostly account for the rise in consumption in the bottom quintiles. We find modest improvement in housing quality, but the evidence is less strong at the very bottom. The consumption of nonmarket time for those in the bottom half of the consumption distribution falls sharply, indicating a loss in utility for those families if nonmarket time is valued above $3 per hour. (JEL D12, I31, I32, J12, J16)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2221.abstractZh: 我们研究了受近期税收和福利改革影响的单亲家庭中的福祉变化。收入变化与消费变化存在显著差异。我们分析了消费、时间利用以及健康保险覆盖情况。住房与交通支出的增加主要解释了最低五分位群体的消费增长。我们发现住房质量有所改善，但在最底层群体的改善效果较弱。在消费分布的最低部分，非市场时间的消耗显著减少，这表明如果这些家庭的非市场时间价值超过每小时3美元，那么他们的效用将会下降。（JEL D12, I31, I32, J12, J16）

abstract.text: The onset of Medicare eligibility at age 65 leads to sharp changes in the health insurance coverage of the U.S. population. These changes lead to increases in the use of medical services, with a pattern of gains across socioeconomic groups that varies by type of service. While routine doctor visits increase more for groups that previously lacked insurance, hospital admissions for relatively expensive procedures like bypass surgery and joint replacement increase more for previously insured groups that are more likely to have supplementary coverage after 65, reflecting the relative generosity of their combined insurance package under Medicare.

10.1257/aer.98.5.2242.abstractZh: 65岁开始享受医疗保险资格，导致美国人口的医疗保险覆盖情况发生显著变化。这些变化使得医疗服务的使用量增加，不同社会经济群体的受益情况也有所不同，具体取决于服务的类型。对于之前没有保险的人群来说，常规医生就诊的需求增加更为明显；而对于那些在65岁后可能拥有补充保险覆盖的人群来说，如接受搭桥手术和关节置换等相对昂贵的手术，他们住院的需求则增加更多。这反映了他们在医疗保险下的综合保险套餐相对更加慷慨。

abstract.text: The “missing women” phenomenon in many Asian countries has previously been regarded as the result of son preference. However, some studies have argued half of the missing women can be explained by infection with Hepatitis B virus (HBV). We demonstrate that the probability of having a male birth is only slightly higher for HBV mothers than for mothers without HBV. The sex ratio at birth rises for the higher birth order and that in families where the first two children are female. Our findings suggest that HBV status has little impact on the missing women phenomenon. (JEL I12, J16)

10.1257/aer.98.5.2259.abstractZh: 许多亚洲国家的“失踪女性”现象，此前被认为是由于重男轻女观念所致。然而，一些研究指出，其中一半的失踪女性现象可以通过感染乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）来解释。我们的研究表明，HBV感染母亲所生的男孩比例仅略高于未感染HBV的母亲所生的男孩。出生时的性别比例随着出生顺序的递增而上升，尤其是在第一个和第二个孩子都是女性的家庭中。我们的研究结果表明，HBV感染状况对“失踪女性”现象的影响很小。（JEL I12, J16）

abstract.text: The U.S. health system has been described as the most competitive, heterogeneous, inefficient, fragmented, and advanced system of care in the world. In this paper, we consider two questions: First, is the U.S. healthcare system productively efficient relative to other wealthy countries, in the sense of producing better health for a given bundle of hospital beds, physicians, nurses, and other factor inputs? Second, is the United States allocatively efficient relative to other countries, in the sense of providing highly valued care to consumers? For both questions, the answer is most likely no. Although no country can claim to have eliminated inefficiency, the United States has high administrative costs, fragmented care, and stands out with regard to heterogeneity in treatment because of race, income, and geography. The U.S. healthcare system is also more likely to pay for diagnostic tests, treatments, and other forms of care before effectiveness is established and with little consideration of the value they provide. A number of proposed reforms that are designed to ameliorate shortcomings of the U.S. healthcare system, such as quality improvement initiatives and coverage expansions, are unlikely by themselves to reduce expenditures. Addressing allocative inefficiency is a far more difficult task but central to controlling costs.

10.1257/jep.22.4.27.abstractZh: 美国的医疗体系被描述为世界上最具竞争力、异质性最强、效率最低、结构分散且技术先进的医疗体系。在本文中，我们探讨了两个问题：首先，相对于其他富裕国家，美国的医疗体系是否在生产更好的医疗服务方面具有效率，即能否在给定数量的医院床位、医生、护士等要素投入下提供更好的健康服务？其次，美国相对于其他国家，是否在提供高价值医疗服务方面具有效率？对于这两个问题，答案很可能都是否定的。虽然没有任何国家能够宣称已经消除了医疗体系的低效率，但美国存在较高的行政成本、医疗服务的分散性，以及因种族、收入和地理因素导致的治疗异质性问题。此外，美国的医疗体系更有可能在尚未确定诊断测试、治疗及其他形式医疗服务的有效性之前就进行支付，且很少考虑这些服务所带来的价值。一些旨在改善美国医疗体系缺陷的改革措施，如质量改进计划和覆盖范围扩展，本身不太可能减少支出。解决分配效率问题是一项更为艰巨的任务，但却是控制成本的关键。

abstract.text: O modelo da Nova Gestão Pública (NGP) espalhou-se pelo mundo com a promessa de atacar dois males burocráticos: o excesso de procedimentos e a baixa responsabilização dos burocratas frente ao sistema político e à sociedade. A proposta básica foi flexibilizar a administração pública e aumentar a accountability com uma nova forma de provisão dos serviços, baseada na criação de entidades públicas não estatais como as organizações sociais (OS). No Brasil, a experiência reformista se inicia em 1995 com as idéias do Plano Diretor da Reforma do Aparelho do Estado. No campo da saúde, o caso de São Paulo constitui um caso paradigmático para avaliar a implantação da NGP no Brasil. A promessa de maior accountability avançou, mas ainda não alterou o insulamento do Poder Executivo e a baixa capacidade de controle institucional e social sobre ele.

10.1590/s0034-75902008000300007.abstractZh: 新公共管理模式以解决两大官僚主义问题为承诺而风靡全球：程序过度以及官僚对政治体系和社会的责任缺失。其基本构想是通过创建非国家公共实体，如社会组织，来灵活管理公共事务并增强问责性。在巴西，这一改革理念始于1995年，当时《国家机构改革规划》提出了相关设想。在卫生领域，圣保罗的案例为评估新公共管理模式的实施提供了典型范例。虽然问责性有所提升，但行政权力仍然处于孤立状态，其对自身进行制度性和社会性控制的能力依然不足。

abstract.text: This paper examines a mechanism through which workers acquire and maintain competence: task experience. I analyze whether cardiac surgeons who have performed more procedures in the recent past experience an improvement in performance. I use an instrumental variables method that considers exogenous shocks to the procedure volume of CABG surgeons in Florida caused by the exit of other surgeons from the same hospital. I find evidence indicating a strong learning-by-doing effect: performing an additional procedure reduces the probability of patient mortality by 0.14%. This benefit is lower for high volume surgeons, and is partly specific to firm and task settings.

10.2139/ssrn.1129350.abstractZh: 本文探讨了工人获取和保持能力的一种机制：任务经验。我分析了近期进行更多心脏手术的外科医生是否会在表现上有所提升。我采用了一种工具变量分析方法，考虑了由于其他外科医生离开同一医院而导致的佛罗里达州冠状动脉旁路手术量外部冲击。我发现了一个显著的学习效应：额外进行一次手术可以将患者死亡率降低0.14%。对于手术量较大的外科医生来说，这种益处较低，并且部分与医院和任务环境有关。

abstract.text: Waiting times have been a central concern in the English NHS, where care is provided free at the point of delivery and is rationed by waiting time. Pro-market reforms introduced in the NHS in the 1990s were not accompanied by large drops in waiting times. As a result, the English government in 2000 adopted the use of an aggressive policy of targets coupled with the publication of waiting times data at the hospital level and strong sanctions for poor performing hospital managers. This regime has been dubbed targets and terror. We estimate the effect of the English target regime for waiting times for hospital care after 2001 by a comparative analysis with Scotland, a neighbouring country with the same healthcare system that did not adopt the target regime. We estimate difference-in-differences models of the proportion of people on the waiting list who waited over 6, 9 and 12 months. Comparisons between England and Scotland are sensitive to whether published or unpublished data are used but, regardless of the data source, the targets and terror regime in England lowered the proportion of people waiting for elective treatment relative to Scotland.

10.2202/1935-1682.1863.abstractZh: 等待时间一直是英国国家医疗服务体系的核心问题，该体系提供免费医疗服务，并且等待时间被用来进行资源分配。20世纪90年代在NHS引入的市场化改革并没有显著减少等待时间。因此，英国政府在2000年采取了激进的目标政策，并公布了医院级别的等待时间数据，同时对表现不佳的医院管理者实施严厉制裁。这一政策被称为“目标与威慑”。我们通过与苏格兰的比较分析，评估了2001年后英国目标政策对医院等待时间的影响。苏格兰拥有相同的医疗体系，但没有采用类似的目标政策。我们建立了差异差分模型，来估计等待名单上等待时间超过6个月、9个月和12个月的人所占的比例。英格兰和苏格兰之间的比较受到所使用数据是否公开的影响，但无论数据来源如何，英格兰的“目标与威慑”政策确实降低了相对于苏格兰而言，等待选择性治疗的人所占的比例。

abstract.text: One of the most important and vexing issues in health care concerns the cost to improve quality. Unfortunately, quality is difficult to measure and potentially confounded with productivity. Rather than relying on clinical or process measures, we infer quality at hospitals in greater Los Angeles from the revealed preference of pneumonia patients. We then decompose the joint contribution of quality and unobserved productivity to hospital costs, relying on heterogeneous tastes among patients for plausibly exogenous quality variation. We find that more productive hospitals provide higher quality, demonstrating that the cost of quality improvement is substantially understated by methods that do not take into account productivity differences. After accounting for these differences, we find that a quality improvement from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile would increase costs at the average hospital by nearly fifty percent. Improvements in traditional metrics of hospital quality such as risk-adjusted mortality are more modest, indicating that other factors such as amenities are an important driver of both hospital costs and patient choices.

10.3386/w13730.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，一个最重要且令人困扰的问题就是提高质量的成本。不幸的是，质量难以衡量，而且可能与生产力产生混淆。我们并非依赖临床或流程指标来衡量医院的质量，而是从肺炎患者的选择偏好中推断洛杉矶大区的医院质量。接着，我们分解了质量和未观察到的生产力对医院成本的联合影响，利用患者之间的异质偏好来解释质量上的差异。我们发现，生产力更高的医院能够提供更高的质量，这表明那些不考虑生产力差异的方法大大低估了质量改进的成本。在考虑这些差异之后，我们发现，将医院质量从第25百分位提高到第75百分位，平均医院的成本将增加近50%。而传统医院质量指标如风险调整死亡率的改善则较为温和，这表明其他因素如设施条件也是影响医院成本和患者选择的重要因素。

abstract.text: Over time, increases in hours of work per capita have created the intuitively plausible notion that there is less time available to pursue social interactions. The specific question addressed in this paper is the effect of hours of work on social interaction. This is a difficult empirical question since omitted factors could increase both hours of work and social interaction. The approach taken in this paper utilizes an exogenous decline in hours of work in France due to a new employment law. The results clearly show that the employment law reduced hours of work but there is no evidence that the extra hours went to increased social interactions. Although hours of work are not an important determinant of social interaction, human capital is found to be important. The effect of human capital, as measured by education and age, is positive for membership groups but negative for visiting relatives and friends. Also, contrary to expectations, there are no important differences in the determinants of social interaction by gender, marital status or parent status. Finally, a comparison between France and the US show that the response to human capital and other variables are much the same in both nations.

10.3386/w13743.abstractZh: 随着时间的推移，人均工作时间的增加使得人们普遍认为用于社交互动的时间减少了。本文探讨的具体问题是工作时间对社交互动的影响。这是一个复杂的实证问题，因为其他因素可能会同时增加工作时间和社交互动。本文采用的方法是利用法国因新就业法而减少工作时间的外部因素。研究结果表明，该就业法确实减少了工作时间，但没有证据表明额外的工作时间促进了社交互动。尽管工作时间并非社交互动的重要决定因素，但人力资本被认为具有重要意义。根据研究，人力资本对社交互动的影响在会员群体中是积极的，而对拜访亲友则呈负面效应。此外，与预期相反，性别、婚姻状况或父母状况对社交互动的决定因素并没有显著差异。最后，法国和美国之间的比较表明，两国在人力资本及其他变量对社交互动的影响方面存在相似之处。

abstract.text: Standard theories of insurance, dating from Rothschild and Stiglitz (1976), stress the role of adverse selection in explaining the decision to purchase insurance. In these models, higher risk people buy full or near-full insurance, while lower risk people buy less complete coverage, if they buy at all. While this prediction appears to hold in some real world insurance markets, in many others, it is the lower risk individuals who have more insurance coverage. If the standard model is extended to allow individuals to vary in their risk tolerance as well as their risk type, this could explain why the relationship between insurance coverage and risk occurrence can be of any sign, even if the standard asymmetric information effects also exist. We present empirical evidence in five difference insurance markets in the United States that is consistent with this potential role for risk tolerance. Specifically, we show that individuals who engage in risky behavior or who do not engage in risk reducing behavior are systematically less likely to hold life insurance, acute private health insurance, annuities, long-term care insurance, and Medigap. Moreover, we show that the sign of this preference effect differs across markets, tending to induce lower risk individuals to purchase insurance in some of these markets, but higher risk individuals to purchase insurance in others. These findings suggest that preference heterogeneity may be important in explaining the differential patterns of insurance coverage in various insurance markets.

10.3386/w13746.abstractZh: 标准的保险理论，源自罗斯柴尔德和斯蒂格利茨在1976年的研究，强调逆向选择在解释购买保险决策中的作用。在这些模型中，风险较高的人会购买全额或接近全额的保险，而风险较低的人则可能会选择较少的保险覆盖。虽然这一预测在某些现实世界的保险市场中成立，但在许多其他市场中，风险较低的个人反而拥有更多的保险覆盖。如果标准模型能够扩展以考虑个体在风险容忍度和风险类型上的差异，那么就可以解释为什么保险覆盖与风险发生之间的关系可能呈现任何符号，即使标准的不对称信息效应也存在。我们在美国的五个不同保险市场中收集了实证证据，这些证据与风险容忍度的潜在作用一致。具体来说，我们发现，从事高风险行为或不采取风险降低行为的个体，系统性地不太可能持有人寿保险、急性私人健康保险、年金、长期护理保险以及医疗保险补充保险。此外，我们还发现，这种偏好效应的符号在不同市场中有所不同，某些市场中，风险较低的个人更倾向于购买保险，而在其他市场中，风险较高的个人则更倾向于购买保险。这些发现表明，偏好异质性可能在解释不同保险市场中保险覆盖模式的差异方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of Medicare HMO penetration on the medical care expenditures incurred by Medicare fee-for-service enrollees. We find that increasing penetration leads to reduced health care spending on fee-for-service beneficiaries. In particular, a one percentage point increase in Medicare HMO penetration reduces such spending by .9 percent. We estimate similar models for various measures of health care utilization and find penetration-induced reductions, consistent with our spending estimates. Finally, we present evidence that suggests our estimated spending reductions are driven by beneficiaries who have at least one chronic condition.

10.3386/w13747.abstractZh: 本文研究了医疗保险健康维护组织（HMO）的普及程度对医疗保险按服务收费参保者医疗支出的影响。我们发现，HMO普及程度的提高会导致按服务收费参保者的医疗支出减少。具体而言，医疗保险HMO普及程度每提高一个百分点，医疗支出就会减少0.9%。我们对不同的医疗利用指标进行了类似的模型估计，发现HMO普及程度带来的支出减少与我们的估计结果一致。最后，我们有证据表明，估计的支出减少是由至少有一种慢性疾病的参保者所驱动的。

abstract.text: One of the major social policy issues facing the U.S. in the first decade of the 21st century is the large number of Americans lacking health insurance. This article surveys the major economic issues around covering the uninsured. I review the facts on insurance coverage and the nature of the uninsured; focus on explanations for why the U.S. has such a large, and growing, uninsured population; and discuss why we should care if individuals are uninsured. I then focus on policy options to address the problem of the uninsured, beginning with a discussion of the key issues and available evidence, and then turning to estimates from a micro-simulation model of the impact of alternative interventions to increase insurance coverage.

10.3386/w13758.abstractZh: 在21世纪第一个十年里，美国面临的一个主要社会政策问题是大量美国人缺乏健康保险。本文探讨了与未投保人群相关的重大经济问题。我回顾了有关保险覆盖情况以及未投保人群特征的事实；分析了导致美国未投保人群数量庞大且不断增长的原因；并讨论了为什么我们应该关注个人是否未投保的问题。随后，我重点讨论了解决未投保问题的一系列政策方案，首先分析了关键问题和现有证据，然后基于微观模拟模型对增加保险覆盖的替代措施进行了评估。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the association between weight and children's educational achievement, as measured by scores on Peabody Individual Achievement Tests in math and reading, and grade attainment. Data for the study came from the 1979 cohort of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY), which contains a large, national sample of children between the ages of 5 and 12. We obtained estimates of the association between weight and achievement using several regression model specifications that controlled for a variety of observed characteristics of the child and his or her mother, and time-invariant characteristics of the child. Our results suggest that, in general, children who are overweight or obese have achievement test scores that are about the same as children with average weight.

10.3386/w13764.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了体重与儿童教育成就之间的关联，教育成就通过Peabody个人成就测试中的数学和阅读成绩以及年级水平来衡量。研究数据来自1979年进行的全国青年纵向调查，该调查包含了5至12岁之间的大量全国样本儿童。我们通过多种回归模型估计了体重与成就之间的关联，这些模型考虑了儿童及其母亲的各种可观测特征，以及儿童的时间不变特征。研究结果表明，总体而言，超重或肥胖的儿童在成就测试中的成绩与体重正常的儿童大致相同。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate the effect of the tax preference for health insurance on health care spending using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Surveys from 1996-2005. We use the fact that Social Security taxes are only levied on earnings below a statutory threshold to identify the impact of the tax preference. Because employer-sponsored health insurance premiums are excluded from Social Security payroll taxes, workers who earn just below the Social Security tax threshold receive a larger tax preference for health insurance than workers who earn just above it. We find a significant effect of the tax preference, consistent with previous research.

10.3386/w13767.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用1996-2005年的医疗支出调查数据，估算了健康保险税收优惠对医疗支出的影响。我们利用社会保障税仅对低于法定门槛的收入征税这一事实，来识别税收优惠的影响。由于雇主提供的健康保险保费被排除在社会保障工资税之外，因此收入略低于社会保障税门槛的工人，其健康保险税收优惠幅度比收入略高于该门槛的工人更大。我们发现税收优惠存在显著影响，这与先前的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: Three quarters of American children have been exposed to neighborhood violence in their lifetimes. Most of the existing research has concluded that exposure to violence leads to restricted emotional development, aggressive behavior and poor school outcomes. However, this literature fails to account for the fact that children exposed to neighborhood violence are highly disadvantaged in other ways: they are more likely to be black, poor and have poorly educated parents. As such, it is not clear whether exposure to violence or the underlying measures of disadvantage are responsible for the poor child outcomes observed. Using individual survey data on urban youth and their families from Los Angeles, we find that the most violent neighborhoods are also characterized by the highest degree of disadvantage: greatest poverty, highest unemployment, least education. And while living in a violent neighborhood increases the probability of exposure to violence, within violent neighborhoods those personally exposed to street violence are significantly more disadvantaged and are more likely to associate with violent peers than their unexposed neighbors. Once we control for observed and unobserved family disadvantage, the impact of violence declines for some child outcomes, suggesting that underlying disadvantage explains some of the negative outcomes observed, but not all - it is still the case that associating with violent peers is negatively correlated with cognitive test scores. In addition, when we control for underlying differences across families, the relationship between violence and internalizing behavioral problems appears stronger.

10.3386/w13773.abstractZh: 在美国，四分之三的儿童在其一生中曾经历过社区暴力。现有大多数研究认为，接触暴力会导致情感发展受限、行为攻击性增强以及学业成绩不佳。然而，这些研究未能考虑到一个事实：接触社区暴力的儿童在其他方面也处于明显的不利地位：他们更可能是黑人、贫困家庭的孩子，且父母受教育程度较低。因此，目前尚不清楚是暴力本身还是其他潜在的不利因素导致了这些儿童不良的成长结果。通过对洛杉矶城市青年及其家庭进行的个人调查数据分析，我们发现暴力最严重的社区也伴随着最严重的不利条件：贫困程度最高、失业率最高、教育水平最低。虽然生活在暴力社区会增加接触暴力的可能性，但在这些暴力社区中，那些亲身经历过街头暴力的儿童比其他未接触暴力的邻居处于更不利的地位，并且更有可能与暴力同伴交往。在控制了家庭中的显性及隐性不利因素后，暴力对某些儿童成长结果的影响减弱了，这表明潜在的不利因素确实解释了部分负面结果，但并非全部——与暴力同伴交往仍然与认知测试成绩呈负相关。此外，当我们控制了家庭间的差异后，暴力与内化行为问题之间的关系显得更为紧密。

abstract.text: We analyze the role of three aspects of HMO market structure -- HMO penetration, HMO plan concentration, and HMO for-profit share on explaining hospital cost and revenue growth during the HMO expansion period (1994-1999) and backlash period (2000-2005). We find that HMO penetration effects differ over time: a 10 percentage point increase in HMO enrollment leads to 2.5 percent reduction in cost and revenues in the expansion period but only 0.4-1 percent reduction in the backlash period. Furthermore, this HMO backlash effect can be attributed to HMO dis-enrollment as well as the changing nature of HMO product. We find that revenue increases at a slower rate (by about 5 percent) in markets with relatively concentrated HMO markets power and more competitive hospital markets. Finally, increased for-profit HMO presence is associated with smaller cost and revenue growth, and the effect differs between low and high penetration markets.

10.3386/w13775.abstractZh: 我们分析了HMO市场结构的三个方面的作用——HMO的渗透率、HMO计划的集中程度以及HMO的盈利性份额，以解释HMO扩张期（1994-1999年）和反弹期（2000-2005年）内医院成本和收入的增长情况。我们发现，HMO渗透率的效应随时间而变化：在扩张期，HMO注册人数增加10个百分点会导致成本和收入减少2.5%，而在反弹期则仅减少0.4-1%。此外，这种HMO反弹效应可以归因于HMO的退订现象以及HMO产品性质的变化。我们发现，在HMO市场力量相对集中且医院市场竞争较为激烈的市场中，收入的增长速度较慢（约5%）。最后，盈利性HMO的增多与较小的成本和收入增长相关，且这种效应在低渗透率和高渗透率的市场中有所不同。

abstract.text: Labor market regulation can have harmful unintended consequences. In many markets, especially for public sector workers, pay is regulated to be the same for individuals across heterogeneous geographical labor markets. We would predict that this will mean labor supply problems and potential falls in the quality of service provision in areas with stronger labor markets. In this paper we exploit panel data from the population of English acute hospitals where pay for medical staff is almost flat across the country. We predict that areas with higher outside wages should suffer from problems of recruiting, retaining and motivating high quality workers and this should harm hospital performance. We construct hospital-level panel data on both quality - as measured by death rates (within hospital deaths within thirty days of emergency admission for acute myocardial infarction, AMI) - and productivity. We present evidence that stronger local labor markets significantly worsen hospital outcomes in terms of quality and productivity. A 10% increase in the outside wage is associated with a 4% to 8% increase in AMI death rates. We find that an important part of this effect operates through hospitals in high outside wage areas having to rely more on temporary "agency staff" as they are unable to increase (regulated) wages in order to attract permanent employees. By contrast, we find no systematic role for an effect of outside wages of performance when we run placebo experiments in 42 other service sectors (including nursing homes) where pay is unregulated.

10.3386/w13776.abstractZh: 劳动力市场监管可能会带来一些有害的意外后果。在许多市场中，尤其是公共部门员工，薪酬被规定为在不同的地理劳动市场中对个人来说是相同的。我们预计这将导致劳动力供应问题，并可能降低劳动力市场较强的地区的服务质量。在本文中，我们利用了英格兰急性医院的人口面板数据，这些医院的医护人员薪酬在全国范围内几乎保持不变。我们预测，外部工资较高的地区将面临招聘、留住和激励高素质员工的问题，这将损害医院的表现。我们构建了医院层面的面板数据，包括服务质量（以30天内因急性心肌梗死而住院的死亡率来衡量）和生产力。我们发现，较强的本地劳动力市场会显著恶化医院在质量和生产力方面的表现。外部工资增加10%，与急性心肌梗死死亡率增加4%至8%相关。我们发现，这种效应的一个重要部分是通过高外部工资地区的医院不得不依赖临时“代理人员”，因为这些医院无法提高（受监管的）工资来吸引长期员工。相比之下，在42个其他服务行业（包括养老院）中进行安慰剂实验时，我们没有发现外部工资对绩效有系统性影响。

abstract.text: Intimate partner violence is a serious and preventable health problem affecting more than 30 million Americans each year. We use an innovative new research design to describe the frequency and correlates of emergency and crisis intervention services provided by domestic violence programs using safe, non-invasive collection methods. During the 24-hour survey period, 48,350 individuals used the services of primary purpose domestic violence programs, corresponding to a population rate of 16 per 100,000 people. Of these individuals, 14,518 required emergency shelter, 7,989 required transitional housing and 25,843 were provided with non-residential services.
