10.3386/w14270.abstractZh: 我们通过实验室任务对555名受试者的折现率进行了估算，发现这些个体的折现率能够预测个体间在野外行为上的差异（例如，运动、体重指数、吸烟等）。折现率与每种野外行为之间的相关性较小：没有一个超过0.28，许多相关性接近0。然而，折现率至少与数据集中的其他变量一样具有预测能力（例如，性别、年龄、教育水平）。当将野外行为进行聚合后，折现率与野外行为之间的相关性会上升，这些相关性介于0.09到0.38之间。我们提出了一个模型，用以解释为什么特定的跨时间选择行为与折现率之间的相关性较弱，尽管折现率能够稳健地预测跨时间决策的聚合结果。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of informational regulatory approaches by analyzing the impact of smog alerts issued on consecutive days on discretionary outdoor activities in Southern California. Short-run adjustments to transitory risk entail costs that are likely to influence the set of evasive actions pursued by those at risk. Our results confirm that the cost of intertemporally substituting activities is increasing over time: when alerts are issued on two successive days, any response on the first day has largely disappeared by the second day. Small reprieves from alerts, however, reset these costs. Our findings imply that a time-varying decision rule that accounts for multiple day air quality forecasts may improve social welfare.

10.3386/w14271.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过分析连续几天发布的雾霾警报对南加州人们户外活动的影响，来研究信息监管方法的动态变化。对短暂风险的短期调整会带来成本，这些成本可能会影响面临风险的人们所采取的规避行动。我们的研究结果表明，随着时间推移，替代活动的成本在不断增加：当警报连续两天发布时，第一天采取的任何应对措施在第二天基本上已经消失。然而，短暂的警报暂停可以重新降低这些成本。我们的发现表明，采用考虑多日空气质量预报的时变决策规则，可能会提高社会福祉。

abstract.text: We examine peer effects in early education by estimating value added models with school fixed effects that control extensively for individual, family, peer, and teacher characteristics to account for the endogeneity of peer group formation. We find statistically significant and robust spillover effects from preschool on math and reading outcomes, but statistically insignificant effects on various behavioral and social outcomes. Of the behavioral and social effects explored, we find that peer externalizing problems, which most likely capture classroom disturbance, hinder cognitive outcomes. Our estimates imply that ignoring spillover effects significantly understates the social returns to preschool.

10.3386/w14277.abstractZh: 我们通过建立包含学校固定效应的增值模型来研究早期教育中的同伴效应，这些固定效应广泛控制了个体、家庭、同伴和教师特征，以考虑同伴群体形成的内生性。我们发现，学前教育对数学和阅读成绩有显著且稳健的溢出效应，但对各种行为和社会结果的影响则并不显著。在探讨的行为和社会效应中，我们发现同伴的外显问题，很可能表现为课堂上的干扰行为，会阻碍认知发展。我们的估计结果表明，忽略这些溢出效应会显著低估学前教育的社会回报。

abstract.text: A number of researchers point to the anticipation of early death, or a sense of "futurelessness," as a contributing factor to youth crime and violence. Young people who perceive a high probability of early death, it is argued, may have little reason to delay gratification for the promise of future benefits, as the future itself is discounted. Consequently, these young people tend to pursue high-risk behaviors associated with immediate rewards, including crime and violence. Although existing studies lend empirical support to these arguments and show a statistical relationship between anticipated early death and youth crime, this support remains tentative. Moreover, a number of questions remain regarding the interpretation of this relationship, the meanings that offenders attach to the prospect of early death, and the causal mechanisms that link anticipated early death to youth crime. In this paper, we address the limitations of previous studies using a multi-methods approach, involving the analyses of national survey data and in-depth interviews with active street offenders.

10.3386/w14279.abstractZh: 许多研究者指出，对早死的预期或“无未来感”的心态是导致青少年犯罪和暴力行为的一个因素。他们认为，那些认为早死概率较高的年轻人，可能几乎没有理由为了未来的利益而延迟满足感，因为未来本身就被忽视了。因此，这些年轻人倾向于追求与即时回报相关的高风险行为，包括犯罪和暴力行为。尽管现有研究为这些论点提供了实证支持，并显示出预期早死与青少年犯罪之间的统计关联，但这种支持仍然不确定。此外，关于这种关系的解释、犯罪者对于早死前景的理解，以及预期早死与青少年犯罪之间的因果机制，仍有许多问题需要解答。在本文中，我们采用多方法研究方法来解决以往研究的局限性，包括对国家调查数据的分析以及对活跃在街头犯罪的人的深入访谈。

abstract.text: Motivated by widely publicized concerns that there are "too many" plans, we structurally estimate (and validate) an equilibrium model of the Medicare Part D market to study the welfare impacts of two feasible, similar-sized approaches for reducing choice. One reduces the maximum number of firm offerings regionally; the other removes plans providing donut hole coverage - consumers' most valued dimension. We find welfare losses are far smaller when coupled with elimination of a dimension of differentiation, as in the latter approach. We illustrate our findings' relevance under current health care reforms, and consider the merits of instead imposing ex ante competition for entry.

10.3386/w14296.abstractZh: 基于广泛关注的“计划数量过多”问题，我们构建并验证了Medicare Part D市场的均衡模型，以研究两种可行且规模相近的减少选择方案对福利的影响。一种方案是限制各地区的计划数量上限；另一种方案是取消提供“甜甜圈效应”覆盖的计划——这是消费者最看重的特性。研究发现，与后者相比，取消一种差异化特征所带来的福利损失要小得多。我们进一步说明了这些发现在当前医疗改革背景下的相关性，并探讨了通过事前竞争来限制新进入市场的优势。

abstract.text: In light of the recent rise in childhood obesity, the School Breakfast Program (SBP) and National School Lunch Program (NSLP) have received renewed attention. Using panel data on over 13,500 primary school students, we assess the relationship between SBP and NSLP participation and (relatively) long-run measures of child weight. After documenting a positive association between SBP participation and child weight, and no association between NSLP participation and child weight, we present evidence indicating positive selection into the SBP. Allowing for even modest positive selection is sufficient to alter the results, indicating that the SBP is a valuable tool in the current battle against childhood obesity, whereas the NSLP exacerbates the current epidemic.

10.3386/w14297.abstractZh: 鉴于儿童肥胖问题的日益严重，学校早餐计划（SBP）和国家学校午餐计划（NSLP）再次受到了关注。我们利用超过13,500名小学生的面板数据，评估了SBP和NSLP参与情况与儿童体重的（相对）长期变化之间的关系。研究发现，SBP的参与与儿童体重之间存在正相关关系，而NSLP的参与与儿童体重则没有关联。此外，我们还发现了SBP参与对儿童的积极选择效应。即使存在适度的积极选择效应，也足以改变研究结果，这表明SBP是当前对抗儿童肥胖的有效手段，而NSLP则可能加剧当前的肥胖问题。

abstract.text: Subsidies for health insurance for chronically ill, high-cost individuals may increase coverage in the broader population by improving the functioning of insurance markets. In this paper, we assess an historical example of a policy intervention of this sort, the extension of Medicare to the disabled, on the private insurance coverage of non-disabled individuals. We use data on insurance coverage from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics from before and after the extension of Medicare to the disabled to estimate the effect of the program on private insurance coverage rates in the broader population. We find that the insurance coverage of individuals who had a health condition that limited their ability to work increased significantly in states with high versus low rates of disability. Our findings suggest that that subsidizing individuals with high expected health costs is an effective way to increase the private insurance coverage of other high-cost individuals.

10.3386/w14309.abstractZh: 为慢性病患者和高费用人群提供医疗保险补贴，可以通过改善保险市场的运作来提升更广泛人群的保险覆盖水平。在本文中，我们以一个历史性的政策干预案例为研究对象，即医疗保险对残疾人的扩展对非残疾个体的私人保险覆盖程度的影响。我们利用了“收入动态面板研究”项目在医疗保险对残疾人扩展前后的数据，来估算该政策对更广泛人群私人保险覆盖率的影響。研究发现，在残疾率较高的州，因健康状况而限制工作能力的个体的保险覆盖程度显著增加。我们的研究结果表明，对预期健康成本较高的个体提供补贴，是提升其他高费用人群私人保险覆盖度的有效方式。

abstract.text: We analyze Medicare Part D's net effect on elderly out-of-pocket (OOP) costs and use of prescription drugs using a dataset containing 1.4 billion prescription records from Wolters Kluwer Health (WKH). These data span the period December 2004-December 2007 and include pharmacy customers whose age as of 2007 is greater than 57 years. The outcomes we examine are OOP cost per day's supply of a medication, the days of medication supplied per capita, and the number of individuals filling prescriptions. We compare outcomes before vs. after January 2006, for those over age 66 years vs. for those age 58-64 years, adjusting for the under-reporting of certain cash-only transactions in the WKH data. Our results indicate that from 2005-2007, Part D reduced elderly OOP costs per day's supply of medication by 21.7%, and increased elderly use of prescription drugs by 4.7%, implying a price elasticity of demand of -0.22. These effects occurred primarily during the first year of the program. An age- and time-standardized comparison of our quantity results with previous estimates from Walgreens data shows that our findings are 2.6 times as large. We conclude that Part D lowered elderly patients' OOP costs substantially and increased utilization modestly, and note that in comparing results across studies on this topic, magnitudes may vary substantially due to differences in data and methods.

10.3386/w14326.abstractZh: 我们分析了Medicare Part D对老年人自付费用及处方药使用的影响，所使用的数据集来自Wolters Kluwer Health（WKH），包含14亿份处方记录。这些数据涵盖了2004年12月至2007年12月期间，包括2007年时年龄超过57岁的药房客户。我们研究的结果包括：每日用药供应的自付费用、人均用药天数以及开药的人数。我们比较了2006年1月之前与之后的情况，以及66岁以上与58-64岁年龄组的情况，并对WKH数据中某些现金交易被低估的情况进行了调整。研究结果表明，在2005年至2007年间，Part D使老年人的每日用药自付费用减少了21.7%，同时增加了4.7%的处方药使用量，表明需求的弹性为-0.22。这些效应主要出现在该计划的第一年。通过将我们的数量结果与Walgreens数据的先前估计进行比较，我们发现我们的研究结果是其2.6倍。我们得出结论，Part D显著降低了老年患者的自付费用，并适度增加了药物使用量。同时我们注意到，在比较不同研究的结果时，由于数据和方法上的差异，结果可能会有很大差异。

abstract.text: The behavioral revolution in economics has demonstrated that human beings often have difficulty making wise choices. The most widely chronicled difficulties arise for decisions made under conditions of uncertainty, those whose consequences unfold over significant amounts of time, and decisions made in complex environments. Unfortunately, these are precisely the elements involved when individuals choose a health insurance policy, or decide whether to consume health care services. In this paper, we argue that traditional economic models of insurance are woefully insufficient for analyzing the tradeoffs inherent when giving consumers responsibility for making health care choices. We show that behavioral economics provides a stronger normative justification for many features of our existing health care policy than do the models of traditional economics. We then demonstrate that policy analyses of the wide range of subsidies that permeate the health care system change substantially when viewed from the behavioral perspective. In closing, we discuss how recent policy trends can be fruitfully assessed using a behavioral lens.

10.3386/w14330.abstractZh: 行为经济学革命表明，人类在做出明智选择时常常遇到困难。最常被提及的困难出现在不确定性条件下做出的决策上，这些决策的后果需要经历相当长的时间才能显现，以及复杂环境中的决策。不幸的是，这些正是个人在选择健康保险或决定是否消费医疗服务时所面临的挑战。在本文中，我们认为传统的经济模型在分析消费者在医疗选择中面临的权衡问题时显得远远不够。我们指出，行为经济学为现有医疗政策的许多特征提供了更强的规范依据，而传统经济模型则无法做到这一点。此外，我们还证明了从行为经济学的视角来看，对医疗体系中各种补贴的政策分析会发生重大变化。最后，我们讨论了如何利用行为经济学的方法来有效评估最新的政策趋势。

abstract.text: This paper reviews the evidence on the well-known positive association between socioeconomic status and health. We focus on four dimensions of socioeconomic status -- education, financial resources, rank, and race and ethnicity -- paying particular attention to how the mechanisms linking health to each of these dimensions diverge and coincide. The extent to which socioeconomic advantage causes good health varies, both across these four dimensions and across the phases of the lifecycle. Circumstances in early life play a crucial role in determining the co-evolution of socioeconomic status and health throughout adulthood. In adulthood, a considerable part of the association runs from health to socioeconomic status, at least in the case of wealth. The diversity of pathways casts doubt upon theories that treat socioeconomic status as a unified concept.

10.3386/w14333.abstractZh: 本文回顾了关于社会经济地位与健康之间众所周知的正相关关系的证据。我们重点关注社会经济地位的四个维度——教育、财务资源、地位以及种族和民族背景，特别探讨了这些维度与健康之间的关联机制如何存在差异和重合。社会经济优势在多大程度上导致良好的健康状况，这一情况在四个维度以及生命周期的不同阶段都有所不同。早年所处的环境在决定成年后社会经济地位与健康的共同演变过程中起着至关重要的作用。在成年阶段，这种关联在很大程度上是从健康到社会经济地位的传递，至少在财富方面是如此。路径的多样性使得将社会经济地位视为一个统一概念的理论受到质疑。

abstract.text: If human beings care about their relative weight, a form of imitative obesity can emerge (in which people subconsciously keep up with the weight of the Joneses). Using Eurobarometer data on 29 countries, this paper provides cross-sectional evidence that overweight perceptions and dieting are influenced by a person's relative BMI, and longitudinal evidence from the German Socioeconomic Panel that well-being is influenced by relative BMI. Highly educated people see themselves as fatter -- at any given actual weight -- than those with low education. These results should be treated cautiously, and fixed-effects estimates are not always well-determined, but there are grounds to take seriously the possibility of socially contagious obesity.

10.3386/w14337.abstractZh: 如果人类关心自己的相对体重，一种模仿性肥胖现象可能会出现（即人们无意识地效仿他人的体重）。本文利用欧洲晴雨表数据对29个国家进行了研究，发现超重观念和节食行为受到个人相对BMI的影响；同时，德国社会经济面板研究的纵向数据表明，幸福感也受到相对BMI的影响。受过高等教育的人在任何实际体重下都会认为自己比教育程度较低的人更胖。虽然这些结果需要谨慎对待，固定效应估计并不总是非常准确，但确实存在社会传染性肥胖的可能性，这一点值得重视。

abstract.text: Consumerism arises when patients acquire and use medical information from sources apart from their physicians, such as the Internet and direct-to-patient advertising. Consumerism has been hailed as a means of improving quality. This need not be the result. Consumerist patients place additional demands on their doctors' time, thus imposing a negative externality on other patients. Our theoretical model has the physician treat both consumerist and ordinary patient under a binding time budget. Relative to a world in which consumerism does not exist, consumerism is never Pareto improving, and in some cases harms both consumerist and ordinary patients. Data from a large national survey of physicians shows that high levels of consumerism are associated with lower perceived quality. Three different measures of quality were employed. The analysis uses instrumental variables to control for the endogeneity of consumerism. A control function approach is employed, since our dependent variable is ordered and categorical, not continuous.

10.3386/w14350.abstractZh: 消费主义的出现源于患者从医生以外的渠道获取和使用医疗信息，例如互联网和直接面向患者的广告。消费主义被视作提高医疗质量的手段，但这并非必然如此。消费主义的患者会对医生的时间提出额外要求，从而给其他患者带来负面影响。我们的理论模型假设医生在有限的时间预算内同时应对消费主义患者和普通患者。与不存在消费主义的世界相比，消费主义从来不会带来帕累托改进，在某些情况下甚至会对消费主义患者和普通患者都造成危害。一项针对大量医生的全国性调查数据显示，高水平的消费主义与较低的医疗质量感知相关。我们采用了三种不同的质量衡量指标。分析过程中使用了工具变量来控制消费主义的内生性。由于我们的因变量是顺序型和分类型数据，而非连续型数据，因此采用了控制函数方法。

abstract.text: Every year, millions of pounds of toxic chemicals thought to be linked to developmental problems in fetuses and young children are released into the air. In this paper we estimate the effect of these releases on the health of newborns. Using data from the Toxic Release Inventory Program and Vital Statistics Natality and Mortality files, we find significant negative effects of prenatal exposure to toxicants on gestation and birth weight. We also find that several developmental chemicals increase the probability of infant death. The effect is quite sizeable: the reported reductions in cadmium, toluene, and epichlorohydrin releases during the 90s could account for about 3.9 percent of the overall decrease in infant mortality. Our results are robust to several specification checks, such as comparing developmental to non-developmental chemicals, and fugitive air releases to stack air releases.

10.3386/w14352.abstractZh: 每年，数以百万磅计的有毒化学物质被释放到空气中，这些化学物质被认为与胎儿和幼儿的发育问题有关。在本文中，我们估算了这些释放对新生儿健康的影响。通过《有毒物质排放清单计划》和《人口统计出生与死亡数据》的数据，我们发现产前接触有毒物质对妊娠时间和出生体重有显著的负面影响。我们还发现，几种发育相关化学物质会增加婴儿死亡的风险。这种影响相当显著：20世纪90年代报告的镉、甲苯和表氯醇排放量的减少，可能解释了婴儿死亡率总体下降约3.9%的原因。我们的研究结果在多次检验中仍然保持稳定，例如比较发育相关化学物质与非发育相关化学物质，以及间歇性空气排放与固定式排放之间的差异。

abstract.text: We use two different approaches to measure intertemporal preferences. First we employ the classical method of inferring preferences from a series of choices (subjects choose between $X now or $Y in D days). Second we adopt the novel approach of inferring preferences using only response time data from the same choices (how long it takes subjects to choose between $X now or $Y in D days). In principle, the inference from response times should work, since choices between items of nearly equivalent value should take longer than choices between items with substantially different values. We find that choice-based analysis and response-time-based analysis yield nearly identical discount rate estimates. We conclude that response time data sheds light on both our revealed (choice-based) preferences and on the cognitive processes that implement those preferences.

10.3386/w14353.abstractZh: 我们采用两种不同的方法来衡量跨时偏好。首先，我们采用传统的从一系列选择中推断偏好的方法（受试者需要在“现在选择$X”和“D天后选择$Y”之间做出选择）。其次，我们采用一种新颖的方法，仅使用相同选择下的反应时间数据来推断偏好（即受试者选择“现在选择$X”和“D天后选择$Y”所需的时间）。原则上，从反应时间中推断出的偏好应该是有效的，因为价值相近的选择所需的时间应该比价值差异较大的选择要长。我们发现，基于选择的分析和基于反应时间的分析得出的折现率估计结果几乎一致。我们得出结论，反应时间数据不仅揭示了我们的显性偏好，还揭示了实现这些偏好的认知过程。

abstract.text: Recent work shows that peers affect student achievement, but the mechanisms are not well understood. I show that peer behavior is an important mechanism, perhaps more so than ability, by exploiting exogenous timing in diagnosis/treatment of ADD among peers that improves peer behavior while holding peer achievement constant. Improvements in peer behavior increase student achievement. Moreover, resources mitigate the negative effects of peer behavior. These findings imply that the optimal response in the presence of peer effects is not necessarily to reorganize classrooms. Rather, existing institutions can modify peer effects by improving behavior and/or mitigating the impact of poor behavior.

10.3386/w14354.abstractZh: 最近的研究表明，同龄人会影响学生的学业成绩，但其具体机制尚不清楚。我的研究指出，同龄人的行为是一个重要的影响因素，可能比能力更为重要。通过研究同龄人中对注意力缺陷障碍的诊断和治疗时机，我们发现这种时机安排能够改善同龄人的行为，同时保持同龄人的学业成绩不变。同龄行为的改善会提升学生的学业成绩。此外，资源可以缓解同龄行为的负面影响。这些发现意味着，在存在同龄人效应的情况下，最佳的反应方式不一定是重新组织教室。相反，现有的制度可以通过改善行为或减轻不良行为的影响来调节同龄人效应。

abstract.text: One of the most important debates among health economists in rich nations is whether advances in biotechnology will spare their health care systems from a financial crisis. We must consider that prevalence rates of chronic diseases declined during the twentieth century and that this rate of decline has accelerated. However, health care costs may continue to increase even as the age of onset of chronic diseases is delayed, because the proportion of a cohort living to late ages will increase. The accelerating decline in the prevalence of chronic diseases during the course of the twentieth century supports the proposition that increases in life expectancy during the twenty-first century will be fairly large, but the effect on health care in the U.S. will be modest. The income elasticity for health services is calculated at 1.6, meaning that income expenditures on health care in the U.S. are likely to rise from a current level of about 15 percent to about 29 percent of GDP in 2040.

10.3386/w14361.abstractZh: 在富裕国家的健康经济学家之间，最重要的争论之一是关于生物技术的进步是否能够避免他们的医疗保健系统陷入财务危机。我们必须考虑到，在二十世纪期间，慢性疾病的患病率有所下降，而且这种下降的速度有所加快。然而，即使慢性疾病的发病年龄推迟，医疗保健成本仍可能继续上升，因为能够活到高龄的人口比例将会增加。二十世纪期间慢性疾病的患病率不断下降的趋势表明，在二十一世纪，预期寿命的延长将会相当显著，但对美国医疗保健的影响则较为有限。健康服务的收入弹性为1.6，这意味着美国用于医疗保健的开支可能会从目前的约15%上升到2040年的约29%的GDP。

abstract.text: Thousands of gun shows take place in the U.S. each year. Gun control advocates argue that because sales at gun shows are much less regulated than other sales, such shows make it easier for potential criminals to obtain a gun. Similarly, one might be concerned that gun shows would exacerbate suicide rates by providing individuals considering suicide with a more lethal means of ending their lives. On the other hand, proponents argue that gun shows are innocuous since potential criminals can acquire guns quite easily through other black market sales or theft. In this paper, we use data from Gun and Knife Show Calendar combined with vital statistics data to examine the effect of gun shows. We find no evidence that gun shows lead to substantial increases in either gun homicides or suicides. In addition, tighter regulation of gun shows does not appear to reduce the number of firearms-related deaths.

10.3386/w14371.abstractZh: 美国每年都会举办数千场枪械展览。枪支管制倡导者认为，由于枪械展览的销售监管比其他销售方式要宽松得多，因此这类展览更容易让潜在罪犯获得枪支。同样，有人担心枪械展览会通过为考虑自杀的人提供更致命的死亡手段，从而加剧自杀率。另一方面，支持者则认为枪械展览并无害处，因为潜在罪犯可以通过其他黑市交易或盗窃行为轻易获得枪支。在本文中，我们结合《枪械与刀具展览日历》的数据以及人口统计数据，来研究枪械展览的影响。研究发现，枪械展览并未导致枪击杀人事件或自杀事件显著增加。此外，对枪械展览的更严格监管似乎也不会减少与枪支相关的死亡人数。

abstract.text: This paper characterizes the welfare gains from redistributive taxation and social insurance in an environment where the private sector provides partial insurance. We analyze stylized models in which adverse selection, pre-existing information, or imperfect optimization in private insurance markets create a role for government intervention. We derive simple formulas that map reduced-form empirical estimates into quantitative predictions for optimal tax and social insurance policy. Applications to unemployment and health insurance show that taking private market insurance into account matters significantly for optimal benefit levels given existing empirical estimates of the key parameters.

10.3386/w14403.abstractZh: 本文描述了在私营部门提供部分保险的情况下，再分配税收和社会保险所带来的福利收益。我们分析了那些由于逆向选择、信息不完备或私人保险市场优化不足而需要政府干预的模型。我们推导出了简单的公式，可以将基于简化形式的实证估计转化为关于最优税收和社会保险政策的定量预测。对失业和医疗保险的应用表明，在考虑到私人市场保险因素的情况下，最优福利水平会显著受到影响，这一结论基于现有的关键参数实证估计。

abstract.text: This paper uses the National Comorbidity Survey - Replication to estimate the effects of recent psychiatric disorder on employment, hours worked, and earnings. We employ methods proposed in Altonji, Elder and Taber (2005) which use selection on observable traits to provide information regarding selection along unobservable factors. Among males, disorder is associated with reductions of 13-17 percentage points in labor force participation and employment, depending on the sample and the model. Among females, we find smaller, less consistent associations between disorder and labor force participation and employment. There are no effects of disorder on earnings or hours worked among employed individuals.

10.3386/w14404.abstractZh: 本文利用全国共病调查-复制研究来估计近期精神疾患对就业、工作时间和收入的影响。我们采用了Altonji、Elder和Taber在2005年提出的方法，该方法利用可观测特征的选择来提供关于不可观测因素选择的信息。在男性中，精神疾患与劳动力参与率和就业率的下降有关，下降幅度为13-17个百分点，具体取决于样本和模型。在女性中，我们发现精神疾患与劳动力参与率和就业率之间的关联较小且不够一致。对于在职人员而言，精神疾患对收入或工作时间没有显著影响。

abstract.text: It is often argued that cost-sharing -- charging a subsidized, positive price -- or a health product is necessary to avoid wasting resources on those who will not use or do not need the product. We explore this argument through a field experiment in Kenya, in which we randomized the price at which prenatal clinics could sell long lasting anti-malarial insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) to pregnant women. We find no evidence that cost-sharing reduces wastage on those that will not use the product: women who received free ITNs are not less likely to use them than those who paid subsidized positive prices. We also find no evidence that cost-sharing induces selection of women who need the net more: those who pay higher prices appear no sicker than the average prenatal client in the area in terms of measured anemia (an important indicator of malaria). Cost-sharing does, however, considerably dampen demand. We find that uptake drops by 75 percent when the price of ITNs increases from zero to $0.75 (i.e. from 100 to 87.5 percent subsidy), the price at which ITNs are currently sold to pregnant women in Kenya. We combine our estimates in a cost-effectiveness analysis of ITN prices on child mortality that incorporates both private and social returns to ITN usage. Overall, our results suggest that free distribution of ITNs could save many more lives than cost-sharing programs have achieved so far, and, given the large positive externality associated with widespread usage of ITNs, it would likely do so at a lesser cost per life saved.

10.3386/w14406.abstractZh: 人们常常认为，通过收取补贴价格或实施健康产品费用分担机制，可以避免将资源浪费在那些不会使用或不需要的产品上。我们通过肯尼亚的一项实地实验来探讨这一论点。在该实验中，我们随机改变了产前诊所向孕妇出售长效抗疟疾杀虫剂处理蚊帐的价格。我们发现，费用分担并没有减少那些不会使用产品的人的资源浪费：接受免费蚊帐的妇女使用蚊帐的可能性并不低于那些支付补贴价格的人。此外，我们也没有发现费用分担会促使那些更需要蚊帐的妇女选择使用蚊帐：支付较高价格的人在贫血指标方面并不比该地区平均的产前客户更不健康。不过，费用分担确实显著降低了需求。我们发现，当蚊帐的价格从零上升到0.75美元时（即补贴比例从100%下降到87.5%），蚊帐的使用率下降了75%。我们将这些估计结果结合到一项关于蚊帐价格对儿童死亡率影响的成本效益分析中，该分析同时考虑了蚊帐使用的私人和社会回报。总体而言，我们的结果表明，免费分发蚊帐可能比费用分担计划挽救更多的生命，而且，鉴于蚊帐广泛使用的巨大正外部性，这样做可能以更低的每挽救生命成本实现。

abstract.text: Features of Part D gave rise to broad concern that the drug benefit would negatively impact prescription utilization among the six million dual eligible beneficiaries, either during the transition from state Medicaid to Part D coverage, or in the long-run. At the same time, Part D contained other features, such as its auto-enrollment and premium subsidization policies, which were designed to safeguard utilization for this vulnerable group. Using national retail pharmacy claims, we examine the experience of dual eligibles during the first 18 months of Part D. We find no evidence that Part D adversely affected pharmaceutical utilization or out-of-pocket expenditures in the transition period, or in the 18 months subsequent to Part D implementation.

10.3386/w14413.abstractZh: D部分的特点引发了广泛的担忧，即药品福利可能会对600万双重符合条件的受益人在从州级医疗补助计划过渡到D部分覆盖期间，或长期内，处方使用产生负面影响。同时，D部分还包含其他一些特点，例如自动注册和保费补贴政策，这些政策旨在保障这一弱势群体的用药需求。通过全国零售药店的索赔数据，我们研究了双重符合条件的受益人在D部分实施后的前18个月的情况。我们发现，在过渡期间或D部分实施后的18个月内，D部分并未对药品使用或自付支出产生不利影响。

abstract.text: We show how standard consumer and producer theory can be used to estimate welfare in insurance markets with selection. The key observation is that the same price variation needed to identify the demand curve also identifies how costs vary as market participants endogenously respond to price. With estimates of both the demand and cost curves, welfare analysis is straightforward. We illustrate our approach by applying it to the employee health insurance choices at Alcoa, Inc. We detect adverse selection in this setting but estimate that its quantitative welfare implications are small, and not obviously remediable by standard public policy tools.

10.3386/w14414.abstractZh: 我们展示了如何利用标准的消费者和生产者理论来估算具有选择性的保险市场的福利。关键的观察是，用于识别需求曲线的相同价格变化也揭示了市场参与者对价格的内生反应所导致的成本变化。通过同时估算需求曲线和成本曲线，福利分析变得简单明了。我们通过将这种方法应用于Alcoa公司的员工健康保险选择来说明我们的方法。我们发现这种情境中存在逆向选择问题，但估计其带来的福利影响较小，且无法通过标准的公共政策手段来有效解决。

abstract.text: We use the Islamic holy month of Ramadan as a natural experiment in fasting and fetal health. In Michigan births 1989-2006, we find prenatal exposure to Ramadan among Arab mothers results in lower birthweight and reduced gestation length. Exposure to Ramadan in the first month of gestation is also associated with a sizable reduction in the number of male births. In Census data for Uganda, Iraq, and the US we find strong associations between in utero exposure to Ramadan and the likelihood of being disabled as an adult. Effects are particularly large for mental (or learning) disabilities. We also find significant effects on proxies for wealth, earnings, the sex composition of the adult population, and more suggestive evidence of effects on schooling. We find no evidence that negative selection in conceptions during Ramadan accounts for our findings, suggesting that avoiding Ramadan exposure during pregnancy is costly or the long-term effects of fasting unknown.

10.3386/w14428.abstractZh: 我们利用伊斯兰的斋月作为禁食与胎儿健康关系的自然实验。在1989至2006年间密歇根州的出生数据中，我们发现阿拉伯母亲在孕期接触斋月会导致出生体重降低和妊娠时长缩短。在妊娠的第一个月接触斋月还伴随着男性新生儿数量的显著减少。在乌干达、伊拉克和美国的普查数据中，我们发现胎儿时期接触斋月与成年后残疾风险之间存在强烈关联，尤其是与智力或学习障碍相关的风险。我们还发现，这种影响对财富、收入、成年人口的性别构成等变量也有显著影响，并且有证据表明其对教育也有影响。我们没有发现证据表明斋月期间受孕的负面选择能够解释我们的研究结果，这表明在怀孕期间避免接触斋月可能是代价高昂的，或者禁食的长期影响尚不清楚。

abstract.text: We explore the impact on depressive symptoms of deviation in actual labor force behavior at age 62 from earlier expectations. Our sample of 4,241 observations is drawn from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). We examine workers who were less than 62 years of age at the 1992 HRS baseline, and who had reached age 62 by our study endpoint, enabling comparison of actual labor force withdrawal with earlier expectations. Poisson regression were used to estimate the impact of expected full-time work status on depressive symptoms; regressions are estimated separately for those working fulltime at age 62 and those not working fulltime. We found significant effects on depression at age 62 both for full-time workers who expected not to be working full-time, and for participants not working full-time who expected to be doing so. These results hold even after adjustment for earlier depressive symptoms, sociodemographic and other relevant controls. The findings suggest that working longer and retiring earlier than expected each may compromise psychological well-being. The current financial crisis may result in both scenarios as some workers may have to work longer than expected due to the decline in pension and other wealth while others may retire earlier due to job loss.

10.3386/w14435.abstractZh: 我们探讨了实际劳动力行为在62岁时与早期预期偏差对抑郁症状的影响。我们的样本包含4,241个观察数据，这些数据来自健康与退休研究（HRS）。我们研究了在1992年HRS基线时年龄小于62岁的工人，以及到研究终点时已年满62岁的工人，从而能够比较实际劳动力退出情况与早期预期。我们使用泊松回归来估计预期全职工作状态对抑郁症状的影响；同时分别针对62岁时从事全职工作的工人和未从事全职工作的工人进行回归分析。我们发现，对于预期不会从事全职工作的全职工人，以及预期会从事全职工作的非全职工人，在62岁时抑郁症状都有显著的影响。即使在调整了早期抑郁症状、社会人口学因素及其他相关控制变量后，这些结果仍然成立。研究结果表明，工作年限延长和退休时间提前都可能损害心理健康。当前的金融危机可能导致这两种情况的发生：一些工人由于养老金和其他财富的减少而不得不工作更长时间，而另一些工人则因失业而提前退休。

abstract.text: Economists studying innovation and technological change have made significant progress toward understanding firms' profit incentives as drivers of innovation. However, innovative performance in firms should also depend heavily on the pecuniary and nonpecuniary motives of the employees actually working in research and development. Using data on more than 1,700 Ph.D. scientists and engineers, we examine the relationships between individuals' motives (e.g., desire for intellectual challenge, income, or responsibility) and their innovative performance. We find that motives matter, but different motives have very different effects: Motives regarding intellectual challenge, independence, and money have a strong positive relationship with innovative output, whereas motives regarding job security and responsibility tend to have a negative relationship. We also explore possible mechanisms underlying the observed relationships between motives and performance. Although hours worked (quantity of effort) have a strong positive effect on performance, motives appear to affect innovative performance primarily via other dimensions of effort (character of effort). Finally, we find some evidence that the role of motives differs in upstream research versus downstream development.

10.3386/w14443.abstractZh: 研究创新和技术变革的经济学家在理解企业利润激励作为创新驱动因素方面取得了显著进展。然而，企业的创新表现还应很大程度上取决于实际从事研发工作的员工的金钱和非金钱动机。我们利用超过1,700名博士科学家和工程师的数据，研究了个人动机（例如对智力挑战的渴望、收入或责任感）与其创新表现之间的关系。我们发现动机确实重要，但不同的动机会产生截然不同的影响：与智力挑战、独立性和金钱相关的动机与创新成果之间存在强烈的正相关关系，而与工作安全和责任感相关的动机则往往与创新成果呈负相关。我们还探讨了动机与表现之间关系背后的潜在机制。尽管工作小时数（努力程度）对表现有强烈的积极影响，但动机似乎主要通过其他努力维度（努力的性质）来影响创新表现。最后，我们发现动机在上游研究与下游开发中的作用是不同的。

abstract.text: This paper concerns the problem of allocating a binary treatment among a target population based on observed covariates. The goal is to (i) maximize the mean social welfare arising from an eventual outcome distribution, when a budget constraint limits what fraction of the population can be treated and (ii) to infer the dual value, i.e. the minimum resources needed to attain a specific level of mean welfare via efficient treatment assignment. We consider a treatment allocation procedure based on sample data from randomized treatment assignment and derive asymptotic frequentist confidence interval for the welfare generated from it. We propose choosing the conditioning covariates through cross-validation. The methodology is applied to the efficient provision of anti-malaria bed net subsidies, using data from a randomized experiment conducted in Western Kenya. We find that subsidy allocation based on wealth, presence of children and possession of bank account can lead to a rise in subsidy use by about 9 percentage points compared to allocation based on wealth only, and by 17 percentage points compared to a purely random allocation.

10.3386/w14447.abstractZh: 本文探讨了基于观察到的协变量，在目标人群中分配二元处理的问题。目标是：(i) 在预算限制下，最大化最终结果分布所带来的平均社会福利；(ii) 推断双重价值，即通过有效的处理分配，达到特定平均福利水平所需的最小资源。我们考虑了一种基于随机处理分配的样本数据的处理分配程序，并推导出由此产生的社会福利的渐近频率置信区间。我们建议通过交叉验证来选择条件协变量。该方法被应用于西肯尼亚一项随机实验的数据，用于有效提供抗疟疾蚊帐补贴。我们发现，与仅基于财富分配相比，基于财富、子女存在情况以及拥有银行账户的补贴分配可以使补贴使用率提高约9个百分点；而与完全随机分配相比，则可以提高17个百分点。

abstract.text: We analyze the role of search frictions in the market for commercial health insurance. Frictions increase the cost of insurance by enabling insurers to set price above marginal cost, and by creating incentives for inefficiently high levels of marketing. Frictions also lead to price dispersion for identical products and, as a consequence, to increases in the rate of insurance turnover. Our empirical analysis indicates that frictions increase prices enough to transfer 13.2% of consumer surplus from employer groups to insurers (approximately $34.4 billion in 1997), and increase employer group turnover by 64% for the average insurance policy. This heightened turnover reduces insurer incentives to invest in the future health of their policy holders. Our analysis also suggests that a publicly-financed insurance option might improve private insurance markets by reducing distortions induced by search frictions.

10.3386/w14455.abstractZh: 我们分析了搜索摩擦在商业健康保险市场中的作用。这些摩擦通过使保险公司能够设定高于边际成本的价格，以及促使保险公司进行低效的高额营销活动，从而增加了保险成本。此外，这些摩擦还会导致相同产品价格的差异，进而增加保险业务的周转率。我们的实证分析表明，这些摩擦导致的价格上涨足以将13.2%的消费者剩余从雇主群体转移到保险公司（1997年约为344亿美元），并且平均保险单的雇主群体周转率增加了64%。这种较高的周转率降低了保险公司投资保单持有人未来健康状况的积极性。我们的分析还表明，由公共资金支持的保险选项可能会通过减少搜索摩擦引起的扭曲，来改善私人保险市场。

abstract.text: Education beyond traditional ages for schooling is an important source of human capital acquisition among adult women. Welfare reform, which began in the early 1990s and culminated in the passage of the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act in 1996, has promoted work rather than educational acquisition for this group. Exploiting variation in welfare reform across states and over time and using relevant comparison groups, we undertake a comprehensive study of the effects of welfare reform on adult women's educational acquisition. We first estimate effects of welfare reform on high school drop-out of teenage girls, both to improve on past research on this issue and to explore compositional changes that may be relevant for our primary analyses of the effects of welfare reform on the educational acquisition of adult women. We conduct numerous specification checks and explore the mediating role of work. We find robust and convincing evidence that welfare reform significantly decreased the probability of college enrollment among adult women, by at least 20 %. It also appears to have decreased the probability of high school enrollment on the same order of magnitude. These results suggest that the gains from welfare reform in terms of increases in employment and reductions in caseloads have come at a cost in terms of lower educational attainment among adult women at risk for relying on welfare.

10.3386/w14466.abstractZh: 对成年女性而言，超出传统年龄段的学校教育是获取人力资本的重要途径。始于20世纪90年代初的福利改革，最终在1996年通过了《个人责任与工作机会协调法案》，这一改革促使这些女性更倾向于参与工作而非单纯的教育学习。通过对比不同州以及不同时期的福利改革情况，并利用相关的比较组数据，我们对福利改革对成年女性教育获取的影响进行了全面研究。我们首先估算了福利改革对少女高中辍学率的影响，这不仅有助于完善以往关于这一问题的研究，还能帮助我们分析福利改革对成年女性教育获取影响的潜在变化。我们进行了大量的统计检验，并探讨了工作的中介作用。研究发现，福利改革显著降低了成年女性上大学的可能性，降幅至少达到20%。同时，该改革似乎也降低了她们高中入学的可能性，降幅与前者相当。这些结果表明，尽管福利改革在增加就业和减少案件负担方面取得了成效，但代价是成年女性在教育水平上的下降，她们可能不得不依赖福利救济。

abstract.text: In this paper we study identification and estimation of a correlated random coefficients (CRC) panel data model. The outcome of interest varies linearly with a vector of endogenous regressors. The coefficients on these regressors are heterogenous across units and may covary with them. We consider the average partial effect (APE) of a small change in the regressor vector on the outcome (cf., Chamberlain, 1984; Wooldridge, 2005a). Chamberlain (1992) calculates the semiparametric efficiency bound for the APE in our model and proposes a √ N consistent estimator. Nonsingularity of the APE's information bound, and hence the appropriateness of Chamberlain's (1992) estimator, requires (i) the time dimension of the panel ( T ) to strictly exceed the number of random coefficients ( p ) and (ii) strong conditions on the time series properties of the regressor vector. We demonstrate irregular identification of the APE when T = p and for more persistent regressor processes. Our approach exploits the different identifying information in the subpopulations of 'stayers' -- or units whose regressor values change little across periods -- and 'movers' -- or units whose regressor values change substantially across periods. We propose a feasible estimator based on our identification result and characterize its large sample properties. While irregularity precludes our estimator from attaining parametric rates of convergence, it limiting distribution is normal and inference is straightforward to conduct. Standard software may be used to compute point estimates and standard errors. We use our methods to estimate the average elasticity of calorie consumption with respect to total outlay for a sample of poor Nicaraguan households.

10.3386/w14469.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了相关随机系数面板数据模型的识别与估计问题。研究的结果与一组内生回归变量呈线性关系。这些回归变量在不同单位之间的系数是异质的，并且可能存在共变关系。我们考虑了回归变量发生微小变化对结果的平均部分效应（APE）（参见Chamberlain, 1984; Wooldridge, 2005a）。Chamberlain（1992）计算了我们模型中APE的半参数效率界限，并提出了一种√N一致估计量。APE的信息界限的非奇异性，以及Chamberlain（1992）估计量的适用性，要求：（i）面板的时间维度严格大于随机系数的数量；（ii）回归变量时间序列属性满足强条件。我们证明了当T=p时，APE的识别是非规则的，且适用于更持久的回归过程。我们的方法利用了“稳定者”群体与“变动者”群体在识别信息上的差异——前者是指回归变量在时期内的变化较小，后者是指回归变量在时期内的变化较大。我们基于识别结果提出了一个可行的估计量，并描述了其大样本性质。虽然不规则性使得我们的估计量无法达到参数收敛速率，但其分布是正态的，推断过程相对简单。可以使用标准软件来计算点估计和标准误差。我们运用这些方法估计了尼加拉瓜贫困家庭总支出对卡路里消费的平均弹性。

abstract.text: Treatment is highly cost-effective in reducing an individual's substance abuse (SA) and associated harms. However, data from Treatment Episodes (TEDS) indicate that per capita treatment admissions substantially lagged behind increases in heavy drug use from 1992-2007. Only ten percent of individuals with clinical SA disorders receive any treatment, and almost half who forgo treatment point to accessibility and cost constraints as barriers to care. This study investigates the impact of state mental health and SA parity legislation on treatment admission flows and cost-sharing. Fixed effects specifications indicate that mandating comprehensive parity for mental health and SA disorders raises the probability that a treatment admission is privately insured, lowering costs for the individual. Despite some crowd-out of charity care for private insurance, mandates reduce the uninsured probability by a net 2.4 percentage points. States mandating comprehensive parity also see an increase in total treatment admissions. Thus, increasing cost-sharing and reducing financial barriers may aid the at-risk population in obtaining adequate SA treatment. Supply constraints mute effect sizes, suggesting that demand-focused interventions need to be complemented with policies supporting treatment providers. These results have implications for the effectiveness of the 2008 Federal Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act in increasing SA treatment admissions and promoting cost-sharing.

10.3386/w14471.abstractZh: 在减少个人药物滥用及相关危害方面，治疗具有极高的成本效益。然而，从治疗案例数据来看，1992年至2007年间，人均治疗人次的增长远远落后于药物滥用的增加。只有10%的患有临床药物滥用障碍的个体接受了任何治疗，而几乎一半放弃治疗的人将可及性和成本限制视为就医的障碍。本研究探讨了州级心理健康和药物滥用平等立法对治疗人次和费用分担的影响。固定效应分析表明，强制实施心理健康和药物滥用障碍的全面平等政策会增加治疗人次由私人保险承担的概率，从而降低个人的治疗成本。尽管这在一定程度上挤占了私人保险患者的慈善治疗机会，但该政策使无保险的概率降低了2.4个百分点。同时，强制实施全面平等政策的州也见证了治疗人次的增加。因此，增加费用分担和减少财务障碍有助于高风险人群获得适当的治疗。供应限制会减弱这些效应，这表明以需求为中心的干预措施需要辅以支持治疗提供者的政策。这些结果对2008年《联邦心理健康平等与成瘾权益法》在增加药物滥用治疗人次和促进费用分担方面的有效性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Child care subsidies are an important part of federal and state efforts to move welfare recipients into employment. One of the criticisms of the current subsidy system, however, is that it overemphasizes work and does little to encourage parents to purchase high-quality child care. Consequently, there are reasons to be concerned about the implications of child care subsidies for child development. In this paper, we provide a systematic assessment of the impact of subsidy receipt on a wide range of child outcomes. Drawing on rich data from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, we document a negative relationship between child care subsidies and child development. In particular, our results suggest that subsidy receipt in the year before kindergarten lowers reading and math test scores and increases a variety of behavior problems at kindergarten entry. Some of these negative effects persist to the end of kindergarten. A tentative explanation for the poorer outcomes is that subsidized children are more likely to receive intense exposure to low-quality child care.

10.3386/w14474.abstractZh: 儿童保育补贴是联邦和州政府将福利领取者引导进入就业体系的重要举措之一。然而，当前补贴制度的一个批评点在于，它过分强调工作的重要性，而忽视了鼓励家长购买高质量儿童保育服务的作用。因此，有必要关注儿童保育补贴对儿童发展影响的潜在问题。本文系统评估了补贴领取对儿童发展多种因素的影响。基于《早期儿童纵向研究》的丰富数据，我们发现儿童保育补贴与儿童发展之间存在负相关关系。具体而言，研究结果表明，在入幼儿园前一年获得补贴的儿童，其阅读和数学测试成绩下降，同时出现多种行为问题。部分负面效应会持续到幼儿园结束。一种可能的解释是，接受补贴的儿童更有可能接触到质量较低的儿童保育服务。

abstract.text: Previous research has shown a strong connection between birth weight and future child outcomes. But this research has not asked how insults to child health after birth affect long-term outcomes, whether health at birth matters primarily because it predicts future health or through some other mechanism, or whether health insults matter more at some key ages than at others? We address these questions using a unique data set based on public health insurance records for 50,000 children born between 1979 and 1987 in the Canadian province of Manitoba. These children are followed until 2006, and their records are linked to provincial registries with outcomes data. We compare children with health conditions to their own siblings born an average of 3 years apart, and control for health at birth. We find that health problems, and especially mental health problems in early childhood are significant determinants of outcomes linked to adult socioeconomic status.

10.3386/w14482.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，出生体重与儿童未来的健康状况之间存在密切关联。但这类研究并未探讨出生后的健康问题如何影响长期结果——出生时的健康状况是否主要因为能预测未来的健康状况，还是通过其他机制起作用？或者，某些关键年龄阶段的健康问题是否比其他阶段更为重要？我们利用一个独特的数据集来解答这些问题，该数据集基于加拿大曼尼托巴省1979年至1987年间出生的50,000名儿童的公共健康保险记录。这些儿童被跟踪至2006年，他们的记录与省级登记处的结果数据进行了关联。我们比较了有健康问题的儿童与他们的兄弟姐妹，这些兄弟姐妹的出生时间间隔平均为3年，并控制了出生时的健康状况。研究发现，儿童早期的健康问题，尤其是心理健康问题，是影响其成年后的社会经济地位的重要因素。

abstract.text: Practitioners of empirical health economics might be forgiven for paying little heed to the recent 50th anniversary of the publication of one of the most important papers in its methodological heritage: James Tobin's widely-cited 1958 Econometrica paper that developed what later became known as the Tobit estimator. This golden anniversary milestone provides a fitting opportunity to reflect on Tobin's contribution and to assess the role that econometric limited dependent variable modeling has played in empirical health economics. Of primary focus here is how Tobin's estimator came to be and came to take root in empirical health economics. The paper provides a brief history of Tobin's estimator and related methods up through about 1971, discusses the early applications of Tobit and related estimators in health economics, i.e. the "technology diffusion" of Tobit in health economics, and offers some concluding remarks.

10.3386/w14512.abstractZh: 从事实证健康经济学研究的学者或许会忽略最近这一重要论文发表50周年纪念。该论文是詹姆斯·托宾于1958年在《Econometrica》杂志上发表的，其中提出了后来被称为托比特估计量的方法。这一重要的纪念时刻为我们提供了一个反思托宾贡献的机会，并评估计量经济学中有限依赖变量建模在实证健康经济学中的作用。本文主要探讨托比特估计量是如何出现并如何在实证健康经济学中扎根的。文章简要回顾了托比特估计量及相关方法的发展历史，直至1971年左右，并讨论了托比特估计量在健康经济学中的早期应用，即其在健康经济学中的“技术扩散”现象，最后提出了一些结论性的意见。

abstract.text: Although individuals are all endowed with the same time budgets, time use patterns differ owing to heterogeneity in preferences and constraints. In today's health policy arena there is considerable discussion about how to improve health outcomes by increasing levels of physical activity. In this paper, we explore how individuals endowed with different levels of human capital allocate time to physically-demanding activities that we characterize as health-producing behaviors. Our data are drawn from multiple years of the American Time Use Survey (ATUS), which are based on daily time use diaries and include information on detailed physical activity time uses. Since ATUS time use categories are mutually exclusive and exhaustive -- i.e. "multitasking" is not accommodated -- we employ a novel econometric share equation techniques to enforce the adding-up requirement that time use is constrained to 1,440 minutes per day. We find that differential human capital endowments result in different manifestations of how time is used to produce health. While more-educated individuals, e.g., sleep much less than less-educated individuals, they utilize some of the time so liberated to exercise and work more. We find as well that various features of individuals' environments, broadly defined, play important roles in time allocation decisions.

10.3386/w14513.abstractZh: 尽管每个人所拥有的时间都是相同的，但由于偏好和约束条件的差异，人们的时间使用方式却各不相同。在当今的卫生政策领域，关于如何通过增加身体活动量来改善健康结果的讨论十分热烈。在本文中，我们探讨了具有不同人力资本水平的个体如何将时间分配用于我们定义为健康促进行为的身体活动。我们的数据来自多年的美国时间使用调查，这些调查基于每日时间使用记录，并包含详细的身体活动时间信息。由于美国时间使用类别是互斥且全面的——即不包括“多任务处理”——我们采用了一种新颖的计量经济学份额方程技术，以确保时间使用总量不超过每天1440分钟。我们发现，不同的人力资本水平会导致时间用于促进健康的方式有所不同。例如，受教育程度较高的个体睡眠时间比受教育程度较低的个体少得多，但他们会将部分时间用于锻炼和更多的工作。我们还发现，个体所处环境的各种特征在时间分配决策中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We estimate marginal returns to medical care for at-risk newborns by comparing health outcomes and medical treatment provision on either side of common risk classifications, most notably the "very low birth weight" threshold at 1500 grams. First, using data on the census of US births in available years from 1983-2002, we find evidence that newborns with birth weights just below 1500 grams have lower one-year mortality rates than do newborns with birth weights just above this cutoff, even though mortality risk tends to decrease with birth weight. One-year mortality falls by approximately one percentage point as birth weight crosses 1500 grams from above, which is large relative to mean one-year mortality of 5.5% just above 1500 grams. Second, using hospital discharge records for births in five states in available years from 1991-2006, we find evidence that newborns with birth weights just below 1500 grams have discontinuously higher costs and frequencies of specific medical inputs. We estimate a $4,000 increase in hospital costs as birth weight approaches 1500 grams from above, relative to mean hospital costs of $40,000 just above 1500 grams. Taken together, these estimates suggest that the cost of saving a statistical life of a newborn with birth weight near 1500 grams is on the order of $550,000 in 2006 dollars.

10.3386/w14522.abstractZh: 我们通过比较常见风险分类两侧的健康结果和医疗治疗提供情况，来估算对高风险新生儿的医疗保健的边际回报，尤其是“极低出生体重”这一阈值，即1500克。首先，利用1983年至2002年可获得的美国出生人口普查数据，我们发现出生体重略低于1500克的新生儿一年的死亡率低于出生体重略高于此阈值的新生儿，尽管死亡率通常随着出生体重的增加而降低。当出生体重超过1500克时，一年的死亡率大约下降一个百分点，这一降幅相对于1500克以上新生儿的平均一年死亡率5.5%来说相当大。其次，利用1991年至2006年五个州可获得的出生记录，我们发现出生体重略低于1500克的新生儿在特定医疗投入上的成本和频率明显更高。我们估计，当出生体重超过1500克时，医院成本会增加4000美元，而1500克以上新生儿的平均医院成本则为40000美元。综合这些估计结果，我们认为，在2006年的货币价值下，挽救一个出生体重接近1500克的新生儿的生命所需的成本约为550,000美元。

abstract.text: While the effects of low birth weight have long been explored, those of high birth weight have been essentially ignored. Economists have analyzed the negative effects that low birth weight might have on subsequent school outcomes, while taking into account unobserved characteristics that may be common to families with low birth weight babies and negative outcomes in terms of school test scores when children, in addition to labor market income when adults. Today, however, with increasing obesity rates in the United States, high birth weight has become a potential concern, and has been associated in the medical literature with an increased likelihood of becoming an overweight child, adolescent, and subsequently an obese adult. Overweight and obesity, in turn, are associated with a host of negative effects, including lower test scores in school and lower labor market prospects when adults. If studies only focus on low birth weight, they may underestimate the effects of ensuring that mothers receive adequate support during pregnancy. In this study we find that cognitive outcomes are adversely affected not only by low birth weight (<2500 grams) but also by high birth weight (>4500 grams). Our results have policy implications in terms of provision of support for pregnant women.

10.3386/w14524.abstractZh: 虽然低出生体重的影响早已被研究，但高出生体重的影响却基本上被忽视了。经济学家们分析了低出生体重可能对儿童后续学业成绩产生的负面影响，同时考虑了那些可能常见于低出生体重婴儿家庭中的未观测特征，以及这些儿童在学业成绩上的负面影响，以及成年后劳动力市场收入方面的损失。然而，随着美国肥胖率的上升，高出生体重已成为一个潜在的问题，医学文献中将其与成为超重儿童、青少年，最终成为肥胖成年人的可能性增加联系在一起。超重和肥胖又会导致一系列负面后果，包括学业成绩下降和成年后劳动力市场前景不佳。如果研究仅关注低出生体重，可能会低估确保母亲在孕期获得足够支持的重要性。本研究发现，认知成果不仅受到低出生体重（<2500克）的影响，还受到高出生体重（>4500克）的影响。我们的研究结果对于为孕妇提供支持的政策制定具有指导意义。

abstract.text: Since 1995 approximately 325 publications on stature have appeared in the social sciences, which is more than a four-fold increase in the rate of production relative to the period 1977-1994. The expansion occurred in several areas, but especially within economics, indicating that heights are now widely accepted as a useful measure of human welfare. Much of this new work extends beyond the traditional bailiwick of anthropometric history, including biological welfare during economic and political crises; anthropometric influences on wages; the welfare of women relative to men in the contemporary world; the fetal origins hypothesis; and inequality in the developing world. The approach has also expanded within economic history to consider the consequences of empire for colonials; the health of populations lacking traditional measures of social performance; the consequences of smallpox; and very long-term trends in health. Much has also been learned about socioeconomic aspects of inequality, the welfare implications of industrialization, and socioeconomic determinants of stature. The last is a work in progress and one may doubt whether sufficient longitudinal evidence will become available for a complete understanding of the variety and strength of pathways that affect human physical growth.

10.3386/w14536.abstractZh: 自1995年以来，社会科学领域出现了大约325篇关于身高的研究论文，与1977至1994年期间相比，出版数量增加了四倍多。这一增长发生在多个领域，但尤其是在经济学领域，这表明身高现在被广泛认为是衡量人类福利的一个有用指标。这些新研究的范围超出了传统的人体测量学范畴，包括经济和政治危机期间的生物福利、人体测量学对工资的影响、当代世界中女性相对于男性的福利状况、胎儿起源假说，以及发展中国家的不平等问题。研究方法也在经济史领域得到扩展，涉及帝国对殖民者的影响、缺乏传统社会绩效衡量指标的人口健康状况、天花的后果，以及长期健康趋势等方面。关于不平等的社会经济方面、工业化的福利影响以及身高的社会经济决定因素，也取得了许多新的认识。最后一点仍在进行中，人们可能会怀疑是否会有足够的纵向数据来全面了解影响人类身体成长的多种因素及其影响强度。

abstract.text: This paper presents novel empirical evidence on the impact of access to abortion on sex ratios at birth (SRB), excess female mortality (EFM) and fertility in Taiwan. For identification, we exploit plausibly exogenous variation in the availability of sex-selective abortion caused by the legalization of abortion. Our results show that the legalization of abortion accounts for almost all of the observed increase in SRB during the 1980s and decreased EFM by approximately 20%. Approximately ten more female infants survived for every one hundred that were aborted. Interestingly, we find that while abortion reduced overall fertility, it increased fertility for older mothers.

10.3386/w14541.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于堕胎机会对台湾出生性别比例、女性超额死亡率以及生育率影响的新型实证证据。为了进行识别分析，我们利用了堕胎合法化所导致的选择性堕胎机会的潜在外生变化。研究结果表明，堕胎合法化几乎解释了20世纪80年代出生性别比例上升的全部原因，并使女性超额死亡率降低了约20%。每有100名女性婴儿被堕胎，大约有10名女性婴儿得以存活。有趣的是，我们发现虽然堕胎降低了整体生育率，但它却提高了高龄母亲的生育能力。

abstract.text: This paper examines the economic rationale of affordability exemptions in the context of a health insurance mandate. On its face, an affordability exemption makes little sense-- it exempts people from purchasing a good that policymakers believe benefits them. I provide an economic definition of affordability and discuss how it is implemented in the contexts of food, housing, and health care. Affordability standards are frequently used in food and housing policy making, but both empirically and theoretically health care operates quite differently than do these other merit goods. These differences help explain why the use of affordability in health policymaking is so different from its use in these other contexts. I conclude with a discussion of the relationship between mandates and exemptions in other health care systems.

10.3386/w14545.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在健康保险强制规定背景下，可负担性豁免的经济合理性。从表面上看，可负担性豁免似乎毫无意义——它让人们免于购买政策制定者认为对他们有益的商品。我提出了可负担性的经济定义，并讨论了其在食品、住房和医疗保健领域的实施情况。可负担性标准在食品和住房政策制定中经常被使用，但从实证和理论角度来看，医疗保健与其他这些价值商品的情况截然不同。这些差异有助于解释为什么在健康政策制定中运用可负担性标准的方式与其他领域有所不同。最后，我讨论了其他医疗保健系统中强制规定与豁免之间的关系。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between drug price and drug quality and how it varies across two of the most common regulatory regimes in the pharmaceutical market: minimum efficacy standards (MES) and a mix of minimum efficacy standards and price control mechanisms (MES+PC). Through a simple model of adverse selection we model the interaction between firms, heterogeneous buyers and the regulator. The theoretical analysis provides two results. First, an MES regime provides greater incentives to produce high quality drugs. Second, an MES+PC mix reduces the difference in price between the highest and lowest quality drugs on the market. The empirical analysis based on US and Italian data corroborates these results.

10.3386/w14567.abstractZh: 本文探讨了药品价格与药品质量之间的关系，以及这种关系在制药市场两种最常见的监管机制下的变化：最低疗效标准（MES）以及最低疗效标准与价格控制机制的结合（MES+PC）。通过一个简单的逆向选择模型，我们模拟了企业、异质买家与监管机构之间的互动关系。理论分析得出了两个结论：首先，最低疗效标准机制更有助于推动高质量药品的生产；其次，MES+PC机制能够缩小市场上最高质量药品与最低质量药品之间的价格差距。基于美国和意大利数据的实证分析支持了这些结论。

abstract.text: This study uses a human capital model to estimate the societal cost of producing a physician service. Physician human capital consists of the underlying human capital (productivity) of those who become physicians and the job-specific investments (physician training) added to this underlying capital. The value of physicians' underlying human capital is estimated by forecasting an age-earnings profile for doctors based on the characteristics in youth of NLSY cohort participants who subsequently became doctors. Published estimates are used to measure the total cost (wherever paid) of investments in physician training. These data are combined to compute the societal cost per primary care physician visit. The estimated societal cost per primary care physician visit is much higher than the average co-payment per primary care service and generally higher than the current Medicare compensation rate per service unit The private return to primary care physician training is relatively low, in the range of 7-9%. At current levels of supply, the marginal social costs of primary care visits appear to be equal to or greater than marginal social benefits.

10.3386/w14568.abstractZh: 本研究采用人力资本模型来估算提供医生服务的社会成本。医生的人力资本包括成为医生的人们的潜在人力资本（生产力）以及在此基础上额外进行的专业培训投资。通过基于NLSY队列参与者在青年时期的特征，预测医生年龄与收入的关系，从而估算医生潜在人力资本的价值。利用已发布的估算数据来衡量医生培训投资的总成本（无论是否由患者支付）。将这些数据结合起来，计算出每次初级保健医生就诊的社会成本。估算出的每次初级保健医生就诊的社会成本远高于平均的初级保健服务费用分摊标准，并且通常高于当前Medicare的服务单位补偿率。初级保健医生培训的私人回报相对较低，大约在7-9%之间。在当前的供应水平下，初级保健就诊的边际社会成本似乎等于或高于边际社会收益。

abstract.text: Although the vast majority of Americans have private health insurance, researchers focus almost exclusively on public provision. Data on the private insurance sector is extremely difficult to obtain because health insurance contracts are complex, renegotiated annually, and not subject to reporting requirements. This study makes use of a privately-gathered national database of insurance contracts agreed upon by a sample of large, multisite employers between 1998 and 2005. To gauge the competitiveness of the group health insurance industry, I investigate whether health insurers charge higher premiums, ceteris paribus, to more profitable firms. I find they do, and this result is not driven by cross-sectional differences across firms or plans: firms with positive profit shocks subsequently face higher premium growth, even for the same healthplans. Moreover, this relationship is strongest in geographic markets served by a small number of insurance carriers. Further analysis suggests profits act to increase employers' switching costs, and insurers exploit this inelasticity where they have sufficient bargaining power. Given the rapid industry consolidation during the study period, these findings suggest healthcare insurers possess and exercise market power in an increasing number of geographic markets.

10.3386/w14572.abstractZh: 尽管绝大多数美国人拥有私人健康保险，但研究人员几乎只关注公共医疗供给。由于健康保险合同复杂、每年都会重新协商，且不受报告要求约束，因此获取私人保险部门的数据极为困难。本研究利用了一个由1998年至2005年间大型多地点雇主共同签署的保险合同所构成的全国数据库。为了评估团体健康保险行业的竞争力，我研究了健康保险公司是否会对更盈利的公司收取更高的保费。我发现确实如此，而且这一结果并非由不同公司或计划之间的横向差异所驱动：即使采用相同的健康计划，盈利状况良好的公司随后面临的保费增长也更高。此外，这种关系在由少数保险公司服务的地理区域最为明显。进一步分析表明，利润会增加雇主的转换成本，而保险公司则会在拥有足够议价能力的情况下利用这种无弹性。鉴于研究期间行业的快速整合，这些发现表明，医疗保险公司在越来越多的地理区域拥有并行使市场力量。

abstract.text: Research has found that season of birth is associated with later health and professional outcomes; what drives this association remains unclear. In this paper we consider a new explanation: that children born at different times in the year are conceived by women with different socioeconomic characteristics. We document large seasonal changes in the characteristics of women giving birth throughout the year in the United States. Children born in the winter are disproportionally born to women who are more likely to be teenagers and less likely to be married or have a high school degree. We show that controls for family background characteristics can explain up to half of the relationship between season of birth and adult outcomes. We then discuss the implications of this result for using season of birth as an instrumental variable; our findings suggest that, though popular, season-of-birth instruments may produce inconsistent estimates. Finally, we find that some of the seasonality in maternal characteristics is due to summer weather differentially affecting fertility patterns across socioeconomic groups.

10.3386/w14573.abstractZh: 研究发现，出生季节与后来的健康状况和职业成就有关；但导致这种关联的原因仍不清楚。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的解释：不同时间出生的孩子是由具有不同社会经济特征的母亲所孕育的。我们记录了美国各地女性在一年中的生育特征存在显著的季节性变化。例如，冬季出生的孩子往往由更可能处于青少年时期、且结婚或拥有高中学历概率较低的母亲所生。我们发现，控制家庭背景特征后，出生季节与成年后结果之间的关系可以解释一半左右的原因。接着，我们讨论了这一结果对使用出生季节作为工具变量的影响；我们的研究结果表明，尽管出生季节作为工具变量很受欢迎，但它可能会产生不一致的估计结果。最后，我们发现，母亲特征中的某些季节性变化是由于夏季天气对不同社会经济群体生育模式的影响所导致的。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effect of Medicaid eligibility expansions on the health insurance coverage of women giving birth and on the use of prenatal care and infant health, controlling for year and state effects and state-specific trends that may be correlated with expansions in Medicaid eligibility. We combine estimates from the two sets of analyses to construct estimates of the effect of health insurance on use of prenatal care and infant health. We find that the eligibility expansions reduced the proportion of pregnant women who were uninsured by approximately 10 percent, although this decrease in uninsured came with the expense of a substantial reduction in private insurance coverage. Changes in Medicaid eligibility were associated with very small and statistically insignificant changes in prenatal care use, birth weight, and incidence of low-birth weight.

10.3386/w14591.abstractZh: 本文分析了医疗补助资格扩展对分娩妇女的健康保险覆盖情况以及产前护理和婴儿健康状况的影响，同时考虑了年份和州级因素的影响，以及可能与医疗补助资格扩展相关的州级趋势。我们通过结合两组分析的结果，来估算健康保险对产前护理和婴儿健康状况的影响。研究发现，医疗补助资格的扩展使无保险孕妇的比例减少了约10%，不过这一减少伴随着私人保险覆盖范围的显著缩小。医疗补助资格的变化对产前护理的使用、出生体重以及低出生体重的发生率产生了非常微小且统计上不显著的影響。

abstract.text: Amenities such as good food, attentive staff, and pleasant surroundings may play an important role in hospital demand. We use a marketing survey to measure amenities at hospitals in greater Los Angeles and analyze the choice behavior of Medicare pneumonia patients in this market. We find that the mean valuation of amenities is positive and substantial. From the patient perspective, hospital quality therefore embodies amenities as well as clinical quality. We also find that a one-standard-deviation increase in amenities raises a hospital's demand by 38.4% on average, whereas demand is substantially less responsive to clinical quality as measured by pneumonia mortality. These findings imply that hospitals may have an incentive to compete in amenities, with potentially important implications for welfare.

10.3386/w14619.abstractZh: 诸如优质食物、贴心的服务以及舒适的环境等设施在医院的吸引力中起着重要作用。我们通过一项市场调查来衡量大洛杉矶地区医院的这些设施，并分析医疗保险肺炎患者在该市场中的选择行为。研究发现，患者对设施的评价总体上是积极的且相当高。从患者的角度来看，医院的质量不仅体现在临床疗效上，还体现在设施方面。此外，我们发现，设施水平每提高一个标准差，医院的需求平均会增加38.4%；而临床疗效对需求的影响则相对较小，后者通过肺炎死亡率来衡量。这些发现表明，医院在设施方面可能存在竞争动机，这对社会福利有着重要的意义。

abstract.text: A vast literature has examined the impact of family income on the health and development outcomes of children. One channel through which increased income may operate is an improvement in a family's ability to provide food, shelter, clothing, books, and other expenditure-related inputs to a child's development. In addition to this channel, many scholars have investigated the relationship between income and the psychological wellbeing of the family. By reducing stress and conflict, more income helps to foster an environment more conducive to healthy child development. In this paper, we exploit changes in child benefits in Canada to study these questions. Importantly, our approach allows us to make stronger causal inferences than has been possible with the existing, mostly correlational, evidence. Using variation in child benefits across province, time, and family type, we study outcomes spanning test scores, mental health, physical health, and deprivation measures. The findings suggest that child benefit programs in Canada had significant positive effects on test scores, as has been featured in the existing literature. However, we also find that several measures of both child and maternal mental health and well-being show marked improvement with higher child benefits. We find strong and interesting differences in the effects of benefits by sex of the child: benefits have stronger effects on educational outcomes and physical health for boys, and on mental health outcomes for girls. Our findings also provide some support for the hypothesis that income transfers operate through measures of family emotional well-being.

10.3386/w14624.abstractZh: 大量文献研究了家庭收入对儿童健康和发展结果的影响。增加收入可能通过提高家庭为儿童提供食物、住所、衣物、书籍以及其他与发育相关的支出的能力来实现。除了这一渠道外，许多学者还研究了收入与家庭心理福祉之间的关系。通过减少压力和冲突，更多的收入有助于营造更有利于儿童健康发展的环境。在本文中，我们利用加拿大儿童福利的变化来研究这些问题。重要的是，我们的方法使我们能够做出比现有大多为相关性的证据更为有力的因果推断。通过研究各省、时间和家庭类型中儿童福利的变化，我们研究了测试成绩、心理健康、身体健康以及贫困程度等指标的结果。研究发现，加拿大的儿童福利计划对测试成绩有显著的积极影响，这一点在现有文献中也有提及。然而，我们还发现，随着儿童福利的提高，儿童和母亲的心理健康与福祉指标也显示出明显的改善。我们发现，不同性别的儿童对福利的影响存在显著差异：福利对男孩的教育成果和身体健康有更强的影响，而对女孩的心理健康成果则有更强的影响。我们的研究结果也支持这样的假设，即收入转移是通过家庭情感福祉的指标来发挥作用的。

abstract.text: Traditional discrete-choice models assume buyers are aware of all products for sale. In markets where products change rapidly, the full information assumption is untenable. I present a discrete-choice model of limited consumer information, where advertising influences the set of products from which consumers choose to purchase. I apply the model to the U.S. personal computer market where top firms spend over $2 billion annually on advertising. I find estimated markups of 19% over production costs, where top firms advertise more than average and earn higher than average markups. High markups are explained to a large extent by informational asymmetries across consumers, where full information models predict markups of one-fourth the magnitude. I find that estimated product demand curves are biased toward being too elastic under traditional models. I show how to use data on media exposure to improve estimated price elasticities in the absence of micro ad data.

10.3982/ecta4158.abstractZh: 传统的离散选择模型假设买家对所有销售的产品都了如指掌。但在产品更新换代迅速的市场中，完全信息假设难以成立。我提出了一个信息有限的离散选择模型，其中广告会影响消费者选择购买的产品范围。我将该模型应用于美国个人电脑市场，该市场中的顶尖企业每年在广告上的支出超过20亿美元。研究发现，顶尖企业的广告费用比平均水平高出19%，并且获得的广告费用加成也高于平均水平。高广告费用在很大程度上是由消费者之间的信息不对称造成的，而完全信息模型预测的广告费用加成仅为四分之一。我还发现，根据传统模型，估计的产品需求曲线往往过于弹性。我展示了如何在缺乏微观广告数据的情况下，利用媒体曝光数据来改进对价格弹性的估计。

abstract.text: We use the control function approach to identify the average treatment effect and the effect of treatment on the treated in models with a continuous endogenous regressor whose impact is heterogeneous. We assume a stochastic polynomial restriction on the form of the heterogeneity, but unlike alternative nonparametric control function approaches, our approach does not require large support assumptions.

10.3982/ecta5317.abstractZh: 我们采用控制函数方法来确定平均处理效应以及处理对受处理者的影响，这些模型包含了一个连续的内生回归变量，其影响具有异质性。我们假设异质性形式受到随机多项式约束，但与其他非参数控制函数方法不同，我们的方法不需要大支持假设。

abstract.text: This paper provides conditions for identification of functionals in nonparametric simultaneous equations models with nonadditive unobservable random terms. The conditions are derived from a characterization of observational equivalence between models. We show that, in the models considered, observational equivalence can be characterized by a restriction on the rank of a matrix. The use of the new results is exemplified by deriving previously known results about identification in parametric and nonparametric models as well as new results. A stylized method for analyzing identification, which is useful in some situations, is also presented.

10.3982/ecta5940.abstractZh: 本文提出了在具有非加性、不可观测随机项的非参数同时方程模型中，识别函数的方法条件。这些条件是基于模型之间观测等价性的特征而得出的。我们证明了，在所考虑的模型中，观测等价性可以通过对矩阵秩的限制来表征。利用这些新结果，我们推导出了关于参数模型和非参数模型识别的已知结果，同时也得到了新的成果。此外，本文还提出了一种用于分析识别问题的简化方法，该方法在某些情况下非常有用。

abstract.text: Productivity differences across firms are large and persistent, but the evidence for worker reallocation as an important source of aggregate productivity growth is mixed. The purpose of this paper is to estimate the structure of an equilibrium model of growth through innovation designed to identify and quantify the role of resource reallocation in the growth process. The model is a version of the Schumpeterian theory of firm evolution and growth developed by Klette and Kortum (2004) extended to allow for firm heterogeneity. The data set is a panel of Danish firms that includes information on value added, employment, and wages. The model's fit is good. The estimated model implies that more productive firms in each cohort grow faster and consequently crowd out less productive firms in steady state. This selection effect accounts for 53% of aggregate growth in the estimated version of the model.

10.3982/ecta5997.abstractZh: 不同企业的生产率差异较大且持续存在，但关于工人重新分配作为总体生产率增长重要来源的证据并不明确。本文旨在估算一个通过创新促进增长的均衡模型的结构，以识别和量化资源重新分配在增长过程中的作用。该模型是Klette和Kortum（2004年）提出的熊彼特企业演化与增长理论的一个版本，并扩展以考虑企业异质性。数据来源于丹麦企业的面板数据，包含增加值、就业和工资等信息。模型的拟合度良好。估计模型表明，每个队列中生产率更高的企业增长更快，从而在稳态下挤出生产率较低的企业。这种选择效应占模型估计版本中总体增长的53%。

abstract.text: This paper uses revealed preference inequalities to provide the tightest possible (best) nonparametric bounds on predicted consumer responses to price changes using consumer-level data over a finite set of relative price changes. These responses are allowed to vary nonparametrically across the income distribution. This is achieved by combining the theory of revealed preference with the semiparametric estimation of consumer expansion paths (Engel curves). We label these expansion path based bounds on demand responses as E-bounds. Deviations from revealed preference restrictions are measured by preference perturbations which are shown to usefully characterize taste change and to provide a stochastic environment within which violations of revealed preference inequalities can be assessed.

10.3982/ecta6069.abstractZh: 本文利用揭示偏好不等式，为使用有限组相对价格变化的数据来预测消费者对价格变化的反应提供了尽可能严格的非参数界限。这些反应被允许在收入分布中非参数地变化。这是通过将揭示偏好理论与消费者扩展路径的半参数估计（Engel曲线）相结合来实现的。我们将这些基于需求反应的扩展路径界限称为E-界限。揭示偏好限制的偏差通过偏好扰动来衡量，这些扰动被证明能够有效描述口味变化，并为评估违反揭示偏好不等式的情况提供了一个随机环境。

abstract.text: This paper derives asymptotic power envelopes for tests of the unit root hypothesis in a zero-mean AR(1) model. The power envelopes are derived using the limits of experiments approach and are semiparametric in the sense that the underlying error distribution is treated as an unknown infinite-dimensional nuisance parameter. Adaptation is shown to be possible when the error distribution is known to be symmetric and to be impossible when the error distribution is unrestricted. In the latter case, two conceptually distinct approaches to nuisance parameter elimination are employed in the derivation of the semiparametric power bounds. One of these bounds, derived under an invariance restriction, is shown by example to be sharp, while the other, derived under a similarity restriction, is conjectured not to be globally attainable.

10.3982/ecta6113.abstractZh: 本文推导了在零均值AR(1)模型中，对单位根假设进行检验的渐近功效界限。这些功效界限是通过实验极限法推导出来的，属于半参数方法，即将潜在的误差分布视为一个未知的无限维干扰参数。当误差分布已知为对称分布时，可以实施适应性调整；而当误差分布不受限制时，则无法实现适应性调整。在后者的情况下，推导半参数功效界限时采用了两种概念上不同的干扰参数消除方法。其中一种基于不变性限制推导出的功效界限，通过实例证明是精确的；而另一种基于相似性限制推导出的功效界限，则被推测为无法全局获得。

abstract.text: We propose an approximation method for analyzing Ericson and Pakes (1995)-style dynamic models of imperfect competition. We develop a simple algorithm for computing an ``oblivious equilibrium,'' in which each firm is assumed to make decisions based only on its own state and knowledge of the long run average industry state, but where firms ignore current information about competitors' states. We prove that, as the market becomes large, if the equilibrium distribution of firm states obeys a certain ``light-tail'' condition, then oblivious equilibria closely approximate Markov perfect equilibria. We develop bounds that can be computed to assess the accuracy of the approximation for any given applied problem. Through computational experiments, we find that the method often generates useful approximations for industries with hundreds of firms and in some cases even tens of firms.

10.3982/ecta6158.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种近似方法，用于分析Ericson和Pakes（1995）提出的不完美竞争动态模型。我们开发了一种简单的算法，用于计算“遗忘均衡”，在这种均衡中，每家公司仅根据自身的状态以及长期平均行业状态来做出决策，同时忽略关于竞争对手当前状态的信息。我们证明，随着市场的扩大，如果公司状态的均衡分布满足某种“轻尾”条件，那么遗忘均衡会非常接近马尔可夫完美均衡。我们还提出了一些界限，可以用来评估这种近似方法的准确性。通过计算实验，我们发现该方法通常能够为拥有数百家甚至数十家公司的行业生成有用的近似结果。

abstract.text: Rabin (2000) proved that a low level of risk aversion with respect to small gambles leads to a high, and absurd, level of risk aversion with respect to large gambles. Rabin's arguments strongly depend on expected utility theory, but we show that similar arguments apply to general non-expected utility theories.

10.3982/ecta6175.abstractZh: Rabin在2000年的研究中证明，对于小额赌博，如果风险厌恶程度较低，那么对于大额赌博，风险厌恶程度就会变得很高，甚至荒谬。Rabin的论点主要基于期望效用理论，但我们表明，类似的论点也适用于一般的非期望效用理论。

abstract.text: We analyze tender offers where privately informed shareholders are uncertain about the raider's ability to improve firm value. The raider suffers a "lemons problem" in that, for any price offered, only shareholders who are relatively pessimistic about the value of the firm tender their shares. Consequently, the raider finds it too costly to induce shareholders to tender when their information is positive. In the limit as the number of shareholders gets arbitrarily large, when private benefits are relatively low, the tender offer is unsuccessful if the takeover has the potential to create value. The takeover market is therefore inefficient. In contrast, when private benefits of control are high, the tender offer allocates the firm to any value-increasing raider, but may also allow inefficient takeovers to occur. Unlike the case where all information is symmetric, shareholders cannot always extract the entire surplus from the acquisition.

10.3982/ecta6178.abstractZh: 我们分析了那些私人知情股东对收购者提升公司价值能力不确定的收购案例。收购者面临“柠檬问题”，即对于任何提出的价格，只有对公司价值持悲观态度的股东才会出售股份。因此，当收购者的信息较为有利时，诱导股东出售股份的成本过高。当股东数量无限增加时，如果控制权的私人收益相对较低，那么收购提议将不会成功，因为收购有可能无法创造价值。因此，收购市场是低效的。相反，当控制权的私人收益较高时，收购提议会将公司分配给任何能够提升价值的收购者，但也可能导致低效的收购发生。与所有信息对称的情况不同，股东并不总能从收购中获得全部收益。

abstract.text: Matching estimators are widely used in empirical economics for the evaluation of programs or treatments. Researchers using matching methods often apply the bootstrap to calculate the standard errors. However, no formal justification has been provided for the use of the bootstrap in this setting. In this article, we show that the standard bootstrap is, in general, not valid for matching estimators, even in the simple case with a single continuous covariate where the estimator is root-N consistent and asymptotically normally distributed with zero asymptotic bias. Valid inferential methods in this setting are the analytic asymptotic variance estimator of Abadie and Imbens (2006a) as well as certain modifications of the standard bootstrap, like the subsampling methods in Politis and Romano (1994).

10.3982/ecta6474.abstractZh: 在实证经济学中，匹配估计量被广泛用于评估各种项目或处理方案的效果。使用匹配方法的研究人员通常会采用自助法来计算标准误差。然而，对于在这种情境下使用自助法的依据，目前还没有正式的说明。本文表明，一般来说，标准自助法并不适用于匹配估计量，即使是在只有一个连续协变量的简单情况下，只要估计量满足根N一致性，并且渐近分布为正态分布且渐近偏差为零。在这种情况下，有效的推断方法包括Abadie和Imbens在2006a年提出的分析性渐近方差估计方法，以及标准自助法的某些改进方法，如Politis和Romano在1994年提出的子样本方法。

abstract.text: In the past few decades multistore retailers, especially those with 100 or more stores, have experienced substantial growth. At the same time, there is widely reported public outcry over the impact of these chain stores on other retailers and local communities. This paper develops an empirical model to assess the impact of chain stores on other discount retailers and to quantify the size of the scale economies within a chain. The model has two key features. First, it allows for flexible competition patterns among all players. Second, for chains, it incorporates the scale economies that arise from operating multiple stores in nearby regions. In doing so, the model relaxes the commonly used assumption that entry in different markets is independent. The lattice theory is exploited to solve this complicated entry game among chains and other discount retailers in a large number of markets. It is found that the negative impact of Kmart's presence on Wal-Mart's profit was much stronger in 1988 than in 1997, while the opposite is true for the effect of Wal-Mart's presence on Kmart's profit. Having a chain store in a market makes roughly 50% of the discount stores unprofitable. Wal-Mart's expansion from the late 1980s to the late 1990s explains about 40–50% of the net change in the number of small discount stores and 30–40% for all other discount stores. Scale economies were important for Wal-Mart, but less so for Kmart, and the magnitude did not grow proportionately with the chains' sizes.

10.3982/ecta6649.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，拥有100家或更多门店的多店零售商经历了显著的增长。与此同时，公众普遍对这类连锁店对其他零售商和当地社区的影响表示不满。本文提出了一个实证模型，以评估连锁店对其他折扣零售商的影响，并量化连锁企业内部规模经济的影响程度。该模型有两个关键特点：首先，它允许所有参与者之间形成灵活的竞争模式；其次，对于连锁店而言，它考虑了在邻近地区经营多家门店所带来的规模经济效应。通过这一模型，我们不再假设不同市场的进入是独立的。利用格子理论，我们解决了大量市场中连锁店与其他折扣零售商之间的复杂进入博弈问题。研究发现，1988年Kmart的存在对Wal-Mart利润的负面影响比1997年更为显著，而Wal-Mart的存在对Kmart利润的影响则相反。在市场中拥有连锁店会导致大约50%的折扣店无法盈利。从1980年代末到1990年代末，Wal-Mart的扩张解释了小型折扣店数量变化的约40-50%，而所有其他折扣店的变化则占30-40%。规模经济对Wal-Mart非常重要，但对Kmart来说则不然，而且其影响程度并不随连锁店规模的增加而成比例增长。

abstract.text: We develop a framework to assess how successfully standard time series models explain low-frequency variability of a data series. The low-frequency information is extracted by computing a finite number of weighted averages of the original data, where the weights are low-frequency trigonometric series. The properties of these weighted averages are then compared to the asymptotic implications of a number of common time series models. We apply the framework to twenty U.S. macroeconomic and financial time series using frequencies lower than the business cycle.

10.3982/ecta6814.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于评估标准时间序列模型在解释数据序列的低频变化方面的成功程度。通过计算原始数据的有限个加权平均值来提取低频信息，其中权重采用低频三角函数序列。然后将这些加权平均值的特性与多种常见时间序列模型的渐近结论进行比较。我们应用该框架对二十个美国的宏观经济和金融时间序列进行了分析，这些时间序列的频率低于商业周期。

abstract.text: In this paper we revisit the results in Caner and Hansen (2001), where the authors obtained novel limiting distributions of Wald type test statistics for testing for the presence of threshold nonlinearities in autoregressive models containing unit roots. Using the same framework, we obtain a new formulation of the limiting distribution of the Wald statistic for testing for threshold effects, correcting an expression that appeared in the main theorem presented by Caner and Hansen. Subsequently, we show that under a particular scenario that excludes stationary regressors such as lagged dependent variables and despite the presence of a unit root, this same limiting random variable takes a familiar form that is free of nuisance parameters and already tabulated in the literature, thus removing the need to use bootstrap based inferences. This is a novel and unusual occurrence in this literature on testing for the presence of nonlinear dynamics.

10.3982/ecta6979.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们重新审视了Caner和Hansen（2001）的研究结果。该研究中，作者得出了Wald型检验统计量的新极限分布，用于检测包含单位根的自回归模型中是否存在阈值非线性。在相同的框架下，我们提出了Wald统计量极限分布的新表述方式，修正了Caner和Hansen提出的主定理中的某个表达式。随后，我们展示了在某种特定情景下，即使存在单位根，这种极限随机变量仍然具有熟悉的形式，且无需使用基于自举法的推断方法。这在关于检测非线性动态存在的文献中是一种新颖且不常见的现象。

abstract.text: Our concern is the extension of the theory of the Shapley value to problems involving externalities. Using the standard axiom systems behind the Shapley value leads to the identification of bounds on players' payoffs around an “externality-free” value. The approach determines the direction and maximum size of Pigouvian-like transfers among players, transfers based on the specific nature of externalities that are compatible with basic normative principles. Examples are provided to illustrate the approach and to draw comparisons with previous literature.

10.3982/ecta7224.abstractZh: 我们的研究关注将Shapley价值理论扩展到涉及外部性的问题中。利用Shapley价值理论背后的标准公理系统，可以确定玩家收益在“无外部性”价值附近的界限。该方法能够确定类似Pigou的转移支付的方向和最大规模，这些转移支付基于与外部性性质相一致的特定原则。文中通过实例说明了该方法，并与以往的研究进行了比较。

abstract.text: The difficulties in properly anticipating key economic variables may encourage decision makers to rely on experts' forecasts. Professional forecasters, however, may not be reliable and so their forecasts must be empirically tested. This may induce experts to forecast strategically in order to pass the test. A test can be ignorantly passed if a false expert, with no knowledge of the data-generating process, can pass the test. Many tests that are unlikely to reject correct forecasts can be ignorantly passed. Tests that cannot be ignorantly passed do exist, but these tests must make use of predictions contingent on data not yet observed at the time the forecasts are rejected. Such tests cannot be run if forecasters report only the probability of the next period's events on the basis of the actually observed data. This result shows that it is difficult to dismiss false, but strategic, experts who know how theories are tested. This result also shows an important role that can be played by predictions contingent on data not yet observed.

10.3982/ecta7428.abstractZh: 正确预测关键经济变量的困难可能会促使决策者依赖专家的预测。然而，专业预测者可能并不可靠，因此他们的预测必须经过实证检验。这可能导致专家采取策略性预测以通过检验。如果一个不了解数据生成过程的错误专家能够通过检验，那么这种检验就可以被无知地通过。许多不太可能拒绝正确预测的检验可以被无知地通过。确实存在一些无法被无知地通过的检验，但这些检验必须利用在拒绝预测时尚未观察到的数据的预测。如果预测者仅根据实际观察到的数据报告下一期事件的概率，那么这样的检验就无法进行。这一结果表明，很难排除那些知道理论如何被检验的错误但具有策略性的专家。这一结果还表明，基于尚未观察到的数据的预测可以发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: We study a definition of subjective beliefs applicable to preferences that allow for the perception of ambiguity, and provide a characterization of such beliefs in terms of market behavior. Using this definition, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the efficiency of ex-ante trade, and show that these conditions follow from the fundamental welfare theorems. When aggregate uncertainty is absent, our results show that full insurance is efficient if and only if agents share some common subjective beliefs. Our results hold for a general class of convex preferences, which contains many functional forms used in applications involving ambiguity and ambiguity aversion. We show how our results can be articulated in the language of these functional forms, confirming results existing in the literature, generating new results, and providing a useful tool for applications.

10.3982/ecta7660.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个适用于允许感知模糊性的偏好的主观信念定义，并基于市场行为对这类信念进行了描述。利用这一定义，我们推导出了事前交易效率的充要条件，并表明这些条件源自基本的福利定理。当总体不确定性不存在时，我们的结果显示，完全保险是有效的，当且仅当代理人之间存在一些共同的主观信念。我们的结果适用于一类一般的凸偏好，这类偏好包含了许多在涉及模糊性和厌恶模糊性的应用中使用的功能形式。我们展示了如何将这些结果用这些功能形式的语言来表达，从而确认了文献中已有的结果，同时产生了新的结果，并为实际应用提供了有用的工具。
