abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Previous reviews have shown inconsistent effects of publicly reported performance data on quality of care, but many new studies have become available in the 7 years since the last systematic review. PURPOSE: To synthesize the evidence for using publicly reported performance data to improve quality. DATA SOURCES: Web of Science, MEDLINE, EconLit, and Wilson Business Periodicals (1999-2006) and independent review of articles (1986-1999) identified in a previous systematic review. Only sources published in English were included. STUDY SELECTION: Peer-reviewed articles assessing the effects of public release of performance data on selection of providers, quality improvement activity, clinical outcomes (effectiveness, patient safety, and patient-centeredness), and unintended consequences. DATA EXTRACTION: Data on study participants, reporting system or level, study design, selection of providers, quality improvement activity, outcomes, and unintended consequences were extracted. DATA SYNTHESIS: Forty-five articles published since 1986 (27 of which were published since 1999) evaluated the impact of public reporting on quality. Many focus on a select few reporting systems. Synthesis of data from 8 health plan-level studies suggests modest association between public reporting and plan selection. Synthesis of 11 studies, all hospital-level, suggests stimulation of quality improvement activity. Review of 9 hospital-level and 7 individual provider-level studies shows inconsistent association between public reporting and selection of hospitals and individual providers. Synthesis of 11 studies, primarily hospital-level, indicates inconsistent association between public reporting and improved effectiveness. Evidence on the impact of public reporting on patient safety and patient-centeredness is scant. LIMITATIONS: Heterogeneity made comparisons across studies challenging. Only peer-reviewed, English-language articles were included. CONCLUSION: Evidence is scant, particularly about individual providers and practices. Rigorous evaluation of many major public reporting systems is lacking. Evidence suggests that publicly releasing performance data stimulates quality improvement activity at the hospital level. The effect of public reporting on effectiveness, safety, and patient-centeredness remains uncertain.

10.7326/0003-4819-148-2-200801150-00006.abstractZh: 背景：之前的综述显示，公开报告的性能数据对护理质量的影响并不一致，但在上次系统综述后的7年中，出现了许多新的研究。目的：综合使用公开报告的性能数据来提高质量的证据。数据来源：Web of Science、MEDLINE、EconLit，以及Wilson Business Periodicals（1999-2006年）和之前系统综述中确定的独立文章（1986-1999年）。仅包括以英语发表的资料。研究选择：经过同行评审的文章，评估公开性能数据对提供者选择、质量改进活动、临床结果（有效性、患者安全性和以患者为中心的服务）以及意外后果的影响。数据提取：提取了关于研究参与者、报告系统或级别、研究设计、提供者选择、质量改进活动、结果以及意外后果的数据。数据综合：自1986年以来发表的45篇文章（其中27篇发表于1999年之后）评估了公开报告对质量的影响。许多研究集中在少数几个报告系统上。8项医院级别研究的综合数据显示，公开报告与医院选择之间存在适度的关联。11项医院级别研究的综合数据显示，公开报告能够刺激质量改进活动的开展。9项医院级别研究和7项个体提供者级别研究的综述显示，公开报告与医院和个体提供者的选择之间关联并不一致。11项主要医院级别研究的综合数据显示，公开报告与提高有效性之间关联并不一致。关于公开报告对患者安全性和以患者为中心的服务影响的证据非常有限。局限性：由于数据的异质性，不同研究之间的比较变得具有挑战性。仅纳入了经过同行评审的英文文章。结论：关于个别医疗服务提供者和实践模式的证据非常有限。许多重要的公共报告系统的严格评估尚缺乏。有证据表明，公开绩效数据能够刺激医院层面的质量改进活动。但公共报告对效果、安全性和以患者为中心的医疗服务的影响仍不确定。

abstract.text: This paper uses an unusual administrative dataset covering the universe of French hospitals to consider hospital employment: this is consistently higher in public hospitals than in Not-For-Profit or private hospitals, even controlling for many measures of hospital output (such as the type of operations and care provided, and the bed capacity rate). Public-hospital employment is positively correlated with the local unemployment rate, whereas no relationship is found in non-Public hospitals. This is consistent with public hospitals providing employment in depressed areas. We appeal to the Political Science literature and calculate local political allegiance, using expert evaluations on various parties political positions and local election results. The relationship between public hospital employment and local unemployment is stronger the more left-wing the local municipality. This latter result holds especially when electoral races are tight, consistent with a concern for re-election.

https://openalex.org/W1480484207.abstractZh: 本文使用了一种独特的行政数据集，涵盖了法国所有医院的情况，以研究医院就业情况。研究发现，即使在控制了许多医院产出指标（如提供的手术类型和护理服务、床位容量等）的情况下，公立医院的就业率始终高于非营利性或私立医院。公立医院的就业率与当地失业率呈正相关，而非公立医院则没有这种关系。这一结果表明，公立医院在贫困地区提供了更多的就业机会。我们参考了政治学文献，并通过专家对各政党政治立场的评估以及当地选举结果，计算了当地政治倾向。研究发现，公立医院的就业率与当地失业率之间的关系在地方市政当局更偏向左翼时更为紧密。这一结果在选举竞争激烈的情况下尤为明显，这与地方政府对连任的担忧相一致。

abstract.text: The inadequacy of public services in Brazil today constrains the country's economic growth and social development. The volume of government expenditure is not the principal bottleneck: at over 40 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Brazil's total public spending is already much higher than that of comparable middle-income countries. The vital question is how to get greater value for public money. As a federal country, improving service delivery in Brazil calls for strengthening the incentives and institutional capacities at the sub-national level, precisely where the country faces its greatest institutional development challenges. A new report examines how particular managerial innovations have been applied in two locations in Brazil to deliver improved public healthcare services. The health sector in Brazil absorbs approximately 4 percent of GDP, and spending levels are likely to rise further given the country's demographic and epidemiological profiles. Improving the efficiency of public health spending is vital to ensuring the country's public finances and macroeconomic stability in the long run.

https://openalex.org/W2555273651.abstractZh: 目前巴西公共服务的不足制约了该国的经济增长和社会发展。政府支出的规模并非主要瓶颈：尽管巴西的政府支出占国内生产总值（GDP）的40%以上，但这一比例已经远高于同类中等收入国家。关键问题在于如何使公共资金发挥更大的价值。作为一个联邦国家，改善巴西的服务提供需要加强地方层面的激励措施和制度能力，而这正是该国在制度发展方面面临最大挑战的领域。一份新的报告研究了巴西两个地区如何通过特定的管理创新来提升公共医疗保健服务。巴西的医疗保健部门约占GDP的4%，鉴于该国的人口和流行病学特征，支出水平可能会进一步上升。提高公共医疗保健支出的效率对于确保巴西的长期公共财政和宏观经济稳定至关重要。
